articleTitle: Study on Overbooking Management with a Choice Model of Consumer Behavior
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Talluri and van Ryzin provide an exact analysis of a single-leg model of revenue management under a discrete choice model of demand. They obtained some perfect conclusions, but the factors of cancellations and no-shows are not considered. This article combines a single-leg problem with these factors and formulates it into a dynamic programming model. From this model we show that the optimal policy for this problem has a quite simple form. Namely, it consists of identifying an ordered family of “efficient” subsets S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>,...,S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">L</sub>, and at each point in time opening one of these sets S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sub>, where the optimal index k is decreasing in the reserved capacity. That is, the less capacity available, the nearer the optimal set is along this sequence. Basing on this property the overbooking management is well implemented.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: How Service Climate Impacts on Service Performance: Evidence from China Hotel Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Structural Optimization of China's Services Trade in the Post-Financial Crisis Era
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper mainly analyzes the international financial crisis on the impact of China's service in trade, According to the newest statistical date, we found that China's service in trade has shown the new features, as the global economic recovery, a new round of adjustment of industrial structure has brought new opportunities for China's service trade, we made a number of policies and proposals on optimizing China's service trade structure.

articleTitle: Popular Science Research Literature Summary
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has illustrated the basic concept and related concepts of popular science, analyzed popular science research survey, carried on the classification and the summary of the popular science research results both at home and abroad, and pointed out the deficiencies about popular science research at the present stage.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Strengthen the Design Management to Improve the Quality and Efficiency of Product Design
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Relationship between Land Prices and Housing Prices Based on Granger Causality Analysis Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The relationship between land prices and housing prices has been concerned debated widely by public society for a long time. This article first reviewed the domestic and foreign literature about the relationship between land prices and housing prices. Then, collect the national land prices index and the housing prices index from 2000 Q1 to 2009 Q3 as the basic data, and analyze the relationship between the land prices and housing prices with the reciprocity empirical methods, through applying a series of econometric methods such as ADF test, co-integration test, Granger causality test and so on.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Product Positioning and Development Strategy of TV Shopping on the Basis of Value Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: TV shopping, as a burgeoning commodity-selling mode, is praised as the third sales revolution after retail and supermarket, and has become very successful worldwide. Since 2007 China has witnessed a new round of upsurge of TV shopping.Product is the soul of TV shopping, and relates to the success or failure of the whole process of TV shopping.The present paper analyzes the product positioning and development strategy of TV shopping from the angle of value chain. The author thinks that the value chain of TV shopping is made up of the product purchase, program production, product marketing and sales, logistics and delivery, and service, the five basic activities, and explores how a TV shopping enterprise should select products from the four angles: target consumer group characteristic, logistics and delivery cost, channel resource opportunity cost, and call center seats cost.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Effect of Capital Structure on Corporate Performance: A Validating Study Base on Data-Mining Technique
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Financial Services and Economic Development in Rural China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper mainly discusses the rural financial services and the economic development in China. The status of financial services in the rural China is analyzed deeply, and some countermeasures to resolve the problem are put forward. The paper provides the panorama of the financial services in rural China. The research shows that the financial services are very weak in rural China and the policymakers should pay more attention to this problem.

articleTitle: Decision of Entrepreneurs' Inner Psychological Qualities Evaluation Based on Multivariate Generalizability Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Entrepreneurs' quality is a multi-dimensional and multi-level systemic concept. The determination of appropriate evaluation indices, weights and the number of experts are main contents of entrepreneurs' qualities comprehensive evaluation scenario decision-making. Considering the characteristics of the complexity, difficult evaluation of partial indices and high evaluation cost of entrepreneurs' quality comprehensive evaluation index system, , this paper takes comprehensive evaluation of entrepreneurs' qualities from Jiangsu and part of Zhejiang as an example to carry on multivariate generalizability analysis of inner psychological qualities comprehensive evaluation scenario with Multivariate Generalizablity Random Single-sided Crossing p × r research process and mGENOVA software. Results show that all indices take average weight 0.2 for five-dimensional evaluation index system, which is the closest to the ideal weight regarding from universe composite score; the evaluation reliability and credibility are above 0.59 in the case of three evaluation experts, which is basically acceptable; while in order to ensure the composite reliability of the whole test not smaller than 0.8, at least six evaluation experts is needed.

articleTitle: Research on the Adverse Selection of Chinese Enterprises IPO
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In Western corporate finance theory, the Pecking order Theory suggests that when the company needs financing externally, it should firstly debt financing then equity financing. The reason is that the company will face more serious adverse selection in equity financing. However, Chinese enterprises usually have a strong preference on equity financing, this article estimates the intrinsic IPO value of the stock of 77 Chinese companies in Shenzhen and Shanghai through a cash dividend discount model, to explore the adverse selection problem. The results will provide a fundamental basis for decision-making of economic regulation and control departments.

articleTitle: The Application of Spreadsheet-Based Modeling in the Teaching of Accounting Courses
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Even though students know something about the complex theories in accounting, it's still difficult for them to deeply understand and fully grasp these theories. This paper talks about the active roles of spreadsheets in grasping these complex theories. Practice shows that the application of spreadsheets in the teaching can not only deepen the students' understanding of complex theories, but also improve their practical analytical ability, which benefits them a lot in the later work.

articleTitle: Leadership Justice and Negative Organizational Behaviors: Mediated by Affective Commitment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the social identity theory, unfair treatment from superiors may arouse negative identification, which in turn leads to employees' negative behaviors in organizations. This study explored the relationships between leadership justice and two negative organizational behaviors, namely, employee silence and organizational retaliatory behavior, within Chinese context. The study was conducted through a questionnaire-based field investigation, which sampled 361 employees from 17 state-owned enterprises. The results showed that leadership justice was negatively related to employee silence and organizational retaliatory behavior, and that affective commitment partially mediated these relationships. The implications of the findings and future studies were also discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Index System of Performance Evaluation for Public Technological Platforms in Zhejiang Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A series of Public Technological Platforms (PTPs) has emerged in China over the recent years, and has been regarded as R&D alliance. Performance evaluation on PTPs is a necessary and beneficial process, which gives regular feedback to them, and provides guidance to their future work. Based on the mission and function of PTPs in Zhejiang Province, this paper established the index system of performance evaluation with the method of AHP. There are three criteria, namely innovation service, technological capability and managerial capability, and ten subcriteria and thirty-three alternatives in the index system.

articleTitle: Impacts of the Supplier' Role on Knowledge Assignment and Knowledge Sharing in the Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Previous research has emphasized the importance of knowledge sharing in supply chains. However, there leaves the impacts of heterogeneousness of suppliers' roles having not been deeply analyzed. Following the research on supplier's role and knowledge sharing in supply chains, this paper discusses the influence of supplier's role on knowledge assignment/sharing between the assembler and the supplier. At first, we focus on the natures of product parts and analyze the quantity of technological knowledge about the parts the assembler should know. Then, we analyze the assignment of the architectural knowledge (about how to assembly parts to a final product) and the component-specific knowledge (about how to produce a part) in the chain. Finally, we construct the supplier's roles by both the nature of parts he produces and the extent he involves in the part development, and analyze the relationship between the supplier's role and knowledge sharing in the chain..

articleTitle: Tourism Information Value Structure: A Case Study from Changsha
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study explores vacation information value structure relating to tourists (in this study-Changsha residents). To delineate structures for the pretrip information value, five information value dimensions (pragmatism, risk avoidance, hedonism social and self-actualization) were identified through a review of the literature. Using the five value dimensions, two models were proposed for pretrip information value structure and tested with confirmatory factor analyses. The first-order correlated factor model appeared as the more valid framework for tourism information value structure, suggesting that the five dimensions of information value coexist and influence each other.

articleTitle: The Price Model of Shanghai License Auction Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Support vector machine is a new machine learning technology based on statistics and structural risk minimization principal. An analysis method for the quantity and price of Shanghai license plate auction is proposed in this paper. A quantity-price model is given by using support vector machine. The simulation result shows that the proposed model has better modeling capability for the relationship between the quantity and the price of Shanghai license auction.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Importance of Integration in Cross-Border Acquisition by the Chinese Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: On the Role of Government in Developing Sports Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Sports industry has become the new source of national economic growth and it becomes increasingly important in such aspects as enlarging domestic demands, offering employment positions, etc. At this critical point, the government should be clear about its own responsibility in developing sports industry. At present, our country is in a period in which the planned economy is replaced by the market economy. In this situation, aiming at the market benefit and economic benefit, sports industry development will certainly meet problems. The government is responsible to find out some countermeasures from the balance point between developing sports industry and satisfying popular needs, and make sports industry have a healthy and sustainable development. Here, a study is made on the role of the government in developing sports industry, and some countermeasures and suggestions are put forward.

articleTitle: Knowledge Management in China's Tea Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The aim of this paper is to examine knowledge management issues in China's tea industry by focusing on its role in promoting export value based on an analysis of patents and literature. The Johansen cointegration technique is used to examine the causal relationship. The estimation results indicate that literature play a greater role than patents in the international trade of China's tea and the reason were analyzed. In order to achieve better knowledge management in China's tea industry, due attention of literature should be paid as an important source of knowledge acquisition.

articleTitle: Visualization Analysis of Dynamic Evolution in the Field of National Innovation Studies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we researched the development history of national innovation studies from the scope of scientific measurement, and analyzed the distribution features of typical authors and their literatures by countries and institutions combining all publication on national innovation. We used mapping of science and information visualization to analyze dynamic network of national innovation by CiteSpace II. Based on this, we discussed knowledge structure and evolution of national innovation studies, and then detected emerging trends and transient patterns in this field.

articleTitle: The Dynamics and Framework of Technological Innovation in Chinese State-Owned Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Innovation is imperative for the survival and outstanding of Chinese state-owned enterprises under the circumstances of imperfect-market economy. By analyzing and studying the internal and external dynamics of technological innovation in Chinese state-owned enterprises, it reveals market mechanism could not stimulate them to innovate effectively, and the impetus of technological innovation is mainly from the internal innovation entrepreneurship and innovation culture. Moreover, it establishes a technological innovation framework with innovation entrepreneurship and innovation culture, which is an effective way for large and medium-sized Chinese state-owned enterprises to achieve innovations. Furthermore, it takes advantage of Baosteel as a case study for the analysis and validation of the work.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis on the Interest Rate Transmission Mechanism in China: 1998-2008
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Granger causality test, cointegration test, and VAR analysis are used to analyze the interest rate transmission mechanism from 1998 to 2008 in China. The results indicate that money supply plays more important role than both the money-market rate and the lending rate in monetary transmission mechanism, and the interest rate channel is still not the key channel of monetary transmission mechanism. It is necessary to further promote interest marketization reform, and construct effective connecting mechanism between money-market rate and lending rate for enhancing its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Application and Innovation of Open Market Operation in China's Gold Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There are no such financial instruments as gold security and gold depositary receipt in gold market where there are no open market operations at present. Open market operation in the gold market is one channel of the transmission mechanism of the monetary policy. The application of open market operation in the gold market is coupled with the innovation of the gold market development.

articleTitle: Discussion on Enterprises Implementing the Service Recovery Strategy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Along with the economic development, the role of the service industry in China's economic development has become increasingly prominent. Although the management's level of China's service enterprises has been greatly improved, the enterprises in the course of management will still encounter various problems. In this paper we based on analyzing the service failure of the objective necessity and the specific reasons, put forward some strategies of implementing the service recovery such as building up the service concept of "winning the client's satisfaction", making the first service right, setting up the service recovery early warning system, making sure the service recovery's procedure, treating customer complaints fair, authorizing front-line workers and summing up the service recovery experiences.

articleTitle: Study on Cost Control Approaches in Medical Insurance Market--Analysis on the Basis of a Principal-Agent Relationship of Three Participants
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As a way of risk management, insurance plays an important role in people's daily life. Health insurance becomes one of the most concerned types of insurance because it related to health, which is paid much attention by people. Because of information asymmetry and the participation of physician, health insurance market has developed a unique principal-agent relationship of three participants, which creates a barrier to its normal operation. This paper defined the special nature of medical insurance market at first. The problems of insured's moral hazard and physician's supplier-induced demand were analyzed at the main part. Relevant conclusions were summarized at the last part.

articleTitle: A Note on Optimal Policy for Deteriorating Items with Trapezoidal Type Demand and Partial Backlogging
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The inventory model for time dependent deteriorating items with trapezoidal type demand rate and partial backlogging are considered in this paper. The demand rate of the model is denoted as a continuous trapezoidal function of time. The backlogging rate is a non-increasing exponential function of the waiting time up to the next replenishment.

articleTitle: Factors Influencing the Students' Decision-Making to Study Abroad in Selecting Host Universities: A State Sponsored Program
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study is based on a Chinese state sponsored program “State Sponsored Graduate Scholarship Program for Building High-Level Universities” to find out the influencing factors of decision-making for study abroad in selecting a host university. The descriptive statistic method and Chi-Square Test were used to analyze the data. The findings present that the academic level and research field of a supervisor are highly impact the students' decision-making to study abroad in selecting a host university. University factors are also very important. The findings also indicated that some demographic characteristics did not influence the students' intention of applying this program to study abroad.

articleTitle: A Game Theory Analysis of Salesclerk Employment Schemes for the Home Appliances Retail Storefronts
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In China, suppliers and retail traders are making great efforts to enhance their control in the home appliances market to gain the upper hand in profit allotment. In doing so, salesclerks of storefront play an important role. In this paper, a game theory approach is used to analyze the effect of different salesclerk employment schemes on home appliances storefronts. Through modeling, the Nash equilibrium are found to determine the reasonability, stability and replaceability of the schemes.

articleTitle: Research on China's Fiscal Policy Based on the Control of Administrative Expenses
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Although administrative expenses are the necessary consequences of government activities, nowadays some experts point out, "China has the largest administrative expenses in the whole world." Our state's administrative expenses is so high that it has seriously affected the development of the government and the whole society, and it becomes more and more incompatible with the requirement of era's development and the expectation for the administrative effects from the broad masses of the people. This essay analyses the status quo of the Chinese government administrative expenses from various perspectives, and finds that the Chinese government administrative expenses grow much faster than the fiscal expenditure and GDP do, and that the administrative expenses is excessively grown and inefficient. On the basis of the status quo of our state's administrative expenses, this essay points out the key point of controlling government administrative expenses is to start from the reform of the administrative system and consummation the public financial system. It also discusses the tactics of controlling our state's administrative expenses over-growing.

articleTitle: Application of Rough Set and Neural Network in Engineering Cost Estimation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Uncontrolled project investment attracts more and more public attention. The inaccuracy of cost estimation is one of main reasons that make the government investment out of control. Cost estimation is affected by many uncertain factors, and the relationship between these factors are nonlinear, and the traditional model is hard to solve. This paper brings forward a model based on rough set and neural network for estimating engineering construction cost. Firstly based on the original sample, build up the decision table by rough set theory and extract the knowledge of classification, which includes attribute discretization, attribute importance ranking, attribute reduction and classification rule. Then input the extracted key components into neural network as the input training sample. This method reduced the structure of neural network, and improved the training speed and the accuracy of classification. Case study shows that the method has a good reference value for practical application.

articleTitle: Research on Organization Management Process Based on Organization Type Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The root cause of the questions that many organizations faced, such as low efficiency, inadequate execution and dissatisfactory organizational performance, was the lack of process design of organization management. As the variety of organization types this paper divided the organization types into three, namely manual labor-based, skill-based, intelligence-based, according to the principal staff who constituted the organization overall. And then the paper provided the concepts of group need structure and dominant need. On this basis, by logical analysis the paper constructed the process of organization management that was constituted with need analysis, humanity hypothesis, organizational culture, system design, implementation process and organizational performance and made the description and characteristics analysis on the process.

articleTitle: The Influence of Project Cost Produced by Knowledge Sharing on Information Systems Integration Based on KAC Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: From the view of knowledge accumulation, knowledge accumulation cost (KAC) model is built in information systems integration project. With this model, get conclusion that high knowledge sharing would be helpful for project cost controlling, and on condition of fixed knowledge sharing degree higher information systems integration innovation introduces higher project cost, while higher study capability makes it lower. Further more, when innovation degree for integration is high controlling project cost would demand high knowledge sharing, on the contrary when study capability is high knowledge sharing gives little influence on project cost. Then application case is introduced and this conclusion is used in getting some action for project cost controlling.

articleTitle: Analysis of Risk Control Rights Allocation in Financial Holding Company
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Risk control is always the most concerning issue for financial institutions including financial holding company (FHC). Based on the organization design theory and principal-agent model, we analyze the risk control rights allocation between the parent company and the subsidiary company inside FHC. The results show that when the FHC faces external risk, costs of risk control for parent company are lower than that for subsidiary company, thus centralization dominates decentralization; when it faces internal risk, the status of parent company and subsidiary company are reverse and decentralization dominates centralization.

articleTitle: Political Connections and Firm Diversification: A Resource Based View
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study draws from resource based view (RBV) other than upper echelon perspective used in previous research to investigate how and when senior managers' political connections affect company's diversification strategy. Data from a sample of 1280 firms from year 2002 to 2005 highlight a strong positive relationship between political connections and company diversification. The data also suggest that this relationship is contingent on the regional institutional characteristics and company ownership structure.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Analytical Hierarchy Process Application in Safety Risk Management of Aviation Maintenance Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Aviation accidents caused by maintenance errors have increased year after year. It is necessary to carry out the safety risk management during the aviation maintenance process. There are a lot of uncertainty factors in the process of safety risk management. The research in this paper focuses on formulating a fuzzy analytical hierarchy process (Fuzzy AHP) to solve it. The priority weights of factors that affect aircraft's flying safety can be calculated. The approach not only objectively assesses the safety status and identifies the hazards during the process of aviation maintenance, but also improves the safety level of civil aviation.

articleTitle: Credit-Assessment-Based Study on Partner Selection of the Industrial Cluster Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper we want to provide a decision-making model for cluster enterprises to select partners. Previous studies are more based on enterprises' capabilities, we studies from a new perspective of credit assessment. First, we established a credit assessment index system of cluster enterprises' partners, it analyzed a candidate enterprise from three parts as strength credibility, honesty credibility and compatibility credibility. Second, we established a credit assessment model based on BP neural network and the index system. Then, we used Matlab software building a suit of algorithm with the model. Finally, we chose 51 cluster enterprises in Henan as case to test our model, and proved that the model was available. Our paper affords cluster enterprise a valid support on partner selection.

articleTitle: User Study: Introduce Manual Behavior into Video Classification
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article shows the comparison experiment of automatic and manual classification. In the experiment, 80 individuals are invited in the manual group, and four trials for every comparative group are conducted. After analyzing the results, the authors bring forward some suggestion to introduce manual behaviors into video mining to enhance the effect.

articleTitle: Research on Measurement and Comparison of Technological Innovation Efficiency of Key Industries in HeBei Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper first deals with the measurement of technological innovation output and a detailed description of two-stage approach, the least squares method adopted in the first stage can estimate Cobb - Douglas production function of the industry and the resulting residuals are considered as the output indicators of the industries' technological innovation. In the second stage, the stochastic frontier model and the corresponding results drawn from the previous stage are used to estimate new technological innovation function of the entire industry, and the indexes of technological innovation efficiency in different industries are obtained accordingly. Subsequently, the technological innovation efficiency of the key industries in Hebei Province, including iron and steel, food, pharmaceutical, architecture and construction material, textile and garment, equipment manufacturing and petrochemical, is measured by means of this method. Lastly, the related proposals, according to the difference and developing trend of technological innovation efficiency index in different industries, on increasing technological innovation input and reasonable resources allocation are respectively put forward so as to improve the technological innovation efficiency and promote the development of key industries.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Capital Accumulation Model in Markets with Network Externality
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We propose a differential game model in markets with network externalities where two firms compete in capital accumulation by investing. We obtain the following findings: (i) when the marginal costs are equal across firms, the capacities and investment efforts at the steady states increase with network intensity and compatibility parameters for both firms; (ii) when the marginal costs differ across firms, the capacity and investment effort for firm with low (resp. high) marginal cost at the steady states may decrease with compatibility (resp. network intensity) parameter when substitutability is big enough.

articleTitle: Research on Incentive Methods on Sales Staff in Small and Medium Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The small and medium enterprises (SMEs) have played a more and more important role in promoting national economic growth. For this reason, China's government has strongly supported the development of SMEs. Needless to say, the goals of SMEs' development can not be achieved without carrying out the appropriate marketing strategy. In recent years, the problems that SMEs are facing are mainly about human resource management and incentive methods to stimulate the marketing staff. An increasing number of researchers and practitioners are beginning to realize that it is far more important for enterprise's development to establish a set of effective incentive system and adopt appropriate ways or means to stimulate the sales personnel. This paper studied the problems existing in incentive system on sales staff in SMEs, it explored the approaches to establish an effective incentive system with the hope that it may offer some beneficiary suggestions for SMEs' incentive management.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Psychological Capital on Job Performance of Chinese Knowledge Worker
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the basis of 627 valid questionnaires from Inner Mongolia and Shandong manufactures, this paper analyzed the relationship between the various dimensions of psychological Capital and the various dimensions of performance using correlation analysis and regression analysis and other methods. According to the empirical research, it is concluded that knowledge workers' Psychological Capital is correlated with their performance positively. The results show the necessity to invest psychological Capital in the organizations.

articleTitle: Investment Planning Factors and Risk Management in Personal Financial Planning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A number of financial institutes began the operations of personal financial planning service in Mainland China due to the economic development and the accumulation of family fortunes. However, compared with international development of personal financial planning, personal financial planning in Mainland China is still in a cradle without the conduct of influential and localized theoretic fruits. Individuals and families have no clear understanding to financial planning, and more they lack theoretic knowledge and practices of investment planning factors and risk management based on financial planning. By advanced financial planning theories and in a systematic way, this paper analyzed the three major factors of investment planning for personal financial planning: family life cycle, investment principles, and investor's risk appetite; and analyzed the five steps and the five types of approaches for risk management of investment planning, providing theoretic guide for investment planning in the financial planning of individual and families in China.

articleTitle: Analysis of Chinese Film Industry Competitiveness Based on "Diamond Model"
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Under the influence of global financial crisis, how to enhance the competitiveness of the film industry has become one concern of many scholars. This paper first analyses the status quo of Chinese film industry's development and its competitiveness through statistical indicators; then uses "Diamond Model" as the theoretical basis to build an econometric model by selecting the seven factors that affect the competitiveness of the film industry; finally it gives policy recommendations based on the result of the analysis.

articleTitle: Japan's Retirement Adaptive Training and Its Enlightenment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper introduces the background, types, contents and features of Japan's retirement adaptive training. Japan has developed this training for thirty years, and has accumulated rich experience, formed a comparatively perfect training system, which has provided beneficial inspirations for developing this training in China.

articleTitle: The Game Analysis in Navy's Ship Repair Quality Supervision and the Assurance of Ship Repair Quality
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The repair quality of navy's ship would have much great influence to the fleet's battle effectiveness, and it is a important way of assuring the navy's ship repair quality to set up quality supervision sections for the ship repair in different zones. But in the process of repair supervision, driven by benefits and due to asymmetrical information, faulty quality supervision system and lack of inspiriting measures, collusion behaviors occur between the military supervisors and boatyards. By utilizing the game theory, the gambling behaviors and characters of military supervisors and boatyards are analyzed,which found the key factors for the ambilateral collusion. Eventually, related proposals such as adopting invigorative measures, consummating supervision system, implementing information-based repair management and carrying out quality policy through the ship's whole system and lifecycle duration, are put forward.

articleTitle: Research on Company's Financial Performance Evaluation Basing on Fuzzy Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper discusses some theories of the system of performance evaluation, analyses merit and disadvantage of these theories. Based on theories of economics, management and accounting, this paper brings forward the system of performance evaluation with method of fuzzy mathematics. This paper validates the correctness of the system of performance evaluation with the example.

articleTitle: C2C E-Business Seller Credit Evaluation Model Based on Dynamic Weighting
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the fast development of C2C E-business, the report about network humbug is more and more frequent, and the credit matters also have been received higher attention by people. Based on interrelated literatures, this paper set up the seller credit evaluation index system in three degrees, and confirmed the weight of the different level indexes using Delphi and AHP method; this paper set three time-variable weighting functions such as linear, convex and concave, established a dynamic mathematical model for evaluating the seller credit, and used for buyers with different time preferences to evaluate the seller credit. Taking one seller of the Taobao net for example, which gave out the calculation process of the seller's credit evaluation, the result showed that the model can reflect the seller credit well. Besides, this method also can be used on buyer credit evaluation which provides fairer net shopping environment and scientific management methods for the development of C2C E-business.

articleTitle: Study of Predicament and Countermeasures of Effectively Internal Communication in Governmental Organizations
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the continuous boost of China's administrative system reform, the problem of effective communication in the administrative organizations is valued more and more. This article discusses the connotation and significance of the effectively internal communication in governmental organizations, states the predicament, analyses the causes in brief and submits the countermeasures to the proposition.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Why the Speed of the Tax Revenue Is Faster Than the Economy's in China?
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Coal Production in New Mine Basis of Strategic Alliance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For the production of coal enterprises in new mine after the formation of a strategic alliance, the article takes into account the Union,s overall development strategy of coal resources for a certain period and the interests of the coal enterprises, establishes the alliance production planning model in pursuit of the minimum cost. The application of multi-objective genetic algorithm, each enterprise production scale and resources to re-optimized allocation to achieve a new orderly exploitation of coal mines and individual improvement of economic efficiency of enterprises.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Technology & Innovation as Part of a Corporate Culture and Business Strategy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Application of BHO-Based PDF Documents Copyright Protection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For Dynamic Encryption on PDF documents, this passage proposed an IE browser-based PDF documents online Encryption and Decryption method. It uses dynamic characteristics of user encrypt PDF documents, and protects the original author's Digital Rights better. By introducing the technical BHO, this paper gives a detail instruction about PDF Encryption and Decryption process, and the Encryption and Decryption of PDF documents on-line processing mechanism is analyzed as well.

articleTitle: A New Elimination Ant Colony Algorithm for Process Task Distribution
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Task distribution is an important part of process design and affects the cycle of process design. To shorten the design cycle, a distribution method based on part features is prompt by converting task distribution problem to a capacity matrix. For improving algorithm efficiency, an artificial ant model is built with blackboard strategy. This model enhances the communication between ants and environments. Upon this model, the elimination ant colony algorithm is given according to the capacity matrix. Experiments show that the new algorithm, compared with traditional algorithm, leads less iterative steps and better solution.

articleTitle: Normative Analysis on Government Functions in Construction of Suburban Rural Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Development of suburban rural infrastructure plays an important role in the economic development of the suburb and its economic integration with the city. Based on expounding the connotation and properties of the suburban rural infrastructure, this paper analyzes the whole process of construction of it and by taking it as a clue it makes clear the responsibility of government in the construction and management. Then, it standardizes the functions of the government in strengthening of planning and decision-making, increasing large investment, serving as mobilizing and guide, innovation in terms of supervision and management. It will be a reference to improve the level of infrastructure, and promote the suburban economic development.

articleTitle: Effective Methods to Improve General Layout Management in Industrial Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: General layout management in industrial enterprises is an important work in the entire enterprise management. It is the increasingly urgent to strengthen the management and improve scientific level of the management with the modernization and rapid development of science and technology. The principles, requirements and effective methods are proposed according to practical experience in this paper.

articleTitle: Cyber 'Lemons' Problem and Market Segments by E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The e-commerce markets make it easier for buyers to purchase products from distant seller, but the lack of the conventional ways to assess the quality of a product may brings on the cyber 'lemons' problem. This paper builds the equilibrium model between e-commerce and traditional marketplaces. This paper concludes that if 'lemons' problem persists in both two marketplaces, a sub-optimal equilibrium with parallel market segments may arise. As soon as the cyber 'lemons' reduce, the substitution of e-business market for traditional market will increase.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on the Relationship between Internal Service Quality and Staff Satisfaction of Nonprofit Organizations--Taking Hospitals in Hangzhou Communities as an Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The "brain drain" of nonprofit organizations (NPOs) has become one of the bottlenecks hindering its development. The paper starts from the relationship between internal service quality and staff satisfaction of NPOs, analyzing how to attract and retain talents by raising staff satisfaction. By factor analysis and linear regression analysis, the paper concludes that the five dimensions of "value formation", "policy procedure", "seniors' support", "team communication" , and "work environment" of NPOs' internal quality are positively related with the staff satisfaction, while of these five dimensions, the following three of "value formation", "team communication " and "work environment" can obviously predict the staff satisfaction. The conclusion reached in the paper can be taken as theoretical and practical guidance to the internal staff management of NPOs.

articleTitle: The Transformation of Foreign Brands in China: An Legitimacy Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this research is to develop a systematic understanding about social fit process of foreign brands in China. Drawing on personal interviews of 45 CEOs or senior managers of foreign brands operating in China as well as field observation, we explicate the transformation process of foreign brands by which brand legitimacy strategies shapes the transformation outcome (brand equity) of foreign brands in China. The findings suggest that brand legitimacy is a key logic of social fit that improves brand appropriateness and acceptance of all audiences in China society and eventually enhance brand equity.

articleTitle: Why Do Listed Companies Choose Private Equity Placements?-Empirical Evidence from Chinese Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since the non-tradable reform, the private equity placement becomes one of the best popular ways of equity refinancing in China's listed companies. The market and supervision authorities in the multiple expectations place on the private equity placement as an important innovation of the equity refinancing. This paper based on information asymmetry hypothesis examines: Why do listed companies choose private equity placements? Whether information asymmetric hypothesis can explain the boom of the private equity placements of the listed companies, or not? Using a sample of 760 listed companies which have achieved the non-tradable reform during the period of 2006-2008.12 on Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges, the results show that information asymmetry hypothesis does not explain the boom of the private equity placements of the listed companies. The listed company will choose higher possibility of the private equity placement to specific objects in order to raise funds when the stock price is undervalued. The listed company will choose higher possibility of the private equity placement when the listed company is a subsidiary company by the group controlled.

articleTitle: Research on the WebGIS Space Vector Data Based on the J2EE
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Web GIS is becoming the developing hotpot for GIS With the development of Internet technology .Geographical Information System (GIS) is an information system which stores analyzes and visually express spatial data . WebGIS can Provide not only simple text and data , but also graphics and images to more and more people. WebGIS is the outcome of Internet development and information sharing . However, many traditional GIS software adopts file-based data organization, which only publishes GIS data less. The technology of publishing mass vector and image database would be restricted . It is necessary to take the proper syncretizing among such technologies as Web, software engineering, programming languages, database and GIS functions into account and consider how to provide a simple and convenient application mode to client. In This paper the author first discuss the model about the data-memory, organizing and the data publishing, then research the design model and the realize model of the Web GIS based on J2EE. Analyse the work principle , merit , demerit and the realizing method of the constitutes of Web GIS, i.e. the structure of three layers.

articleTitle: M-GBCP: Model of Providing Public Service Based on Mobile Communications Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: M-GBCP is a new topic in the field of e-GBCP, and regarded as the application of wireless communication technology and computer technology in the public management, which provides public service for the public through mobile terminal and network technology. This paper examines provision of public service based on mobile communications technology.

articleTitle: Analysis of Coordination Degree of Land Utilization in Coal-Mining Area
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Coal-mining area coordinated development is an assignment for study in recent years. The article, through constructing comprehensive evaluation index system and coordination degree model, comes to the land utilization coordination degree and order degree in coal mine areas. It not only reflects quantitatively present situations of land use in coal-mining area and existing problems, but also points out the index of order parameter that affects system coordination. It is of great significance for the development of coal-mining area.

articleTitle: Financial Distress Prediction of Chinese Listed Companies Based on Panel Logit Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The recent studies on financial distress are mostly confined to static econometric or statistical methods based on cross-sectional financial data ,and it is ignored that the variation of companies' financial status is a dynamic process. In order to show the change of companies in financial position, this study constructed the financial distress prediction model based on panel logit. On the selection of variables,we select not only financial ratios,but also indexes on ownership concentration, corporate governance and audit opinion. Empirical results indicate that the probabilistic predictions generated by the panel logit model can provide a measure of the company's financial position.

articleTitle: Analysis of Energy Conservation and Sales of New Energy Automobiles in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the time of promoting energy conservation and environmental protection, the use of new energy sources receives more attention. We introduce new energy automobile industry to emphasize the development and the importance of using new energy sources. In this essay, different time slots of data from China and the United States are used to establish theoretical models, to make an empirical analysis of the impact of new energy car sales in China and the United States and to discuss relationship between the main factors. The results show that world oil prices and technology have a significant impact on new energy car sales. Based on this, this essay puts forward some suggestions for the development of China's new energy automobile industry.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Mechanism in Assembly System with Supplier Coalitions under Asymmetric Information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We study the allocation of benefits in a whole-set equipment assembly supply chain with exogenous supplier coalition structure under asymmetric information. Considering the information revelation problem, a two-stage mechanism is proposed, which analyzes the competition and cooperation in the assemble system. In the first stage, an almost BB VCG auction is proposed, in which supplier coalitions compete with each other and the assembler procures components from the coalitions who win the order to assemble the final product. In the second stage, suppliers in coalitions who win the order allocate the benefits of the coalition, using the Shapley approach. We show that the mechanism holds incentive compatible and individual rationality.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Momentum Effect in Stocks from Shanghai and Shenzhen 300 Index
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Making reference to method of the abroad research, selecting the stocks from Shanghai and Shenzhen 300 index, we redo the research about the price momentum effects in China stock market with stocks' monthly return between Jan.2007 and Dec.2009. Under the assumption of short selling, we find significant momentum effect with the forming and holding period of 3-12 months and on the contrary find significant contrarian effect with forming period of 1 month.

articleTitle: Study on Lake Pollution Damage Based on Accounting Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to safeguard the lawful rights of the lakes pollution victims and serve the judicial practice, a study based on theories of the law and accounting were done for recognizing and measuring lakes pollution damage. With the principle of complete property compensation, Concentration attenuation model and loss - concentration relations function were used in this paper. Measurement about the lakes pollution damage is discussed with different functional categories.

articleTitle: Study on the Environmental Protection Strategy of Urban Transportation in Shanghai
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the basis of discussing the present situation of urban transportation environment in Shanghai, this paper analyzed the environmental problems and its cause during the course of urban transportation development. In terms of sustainable development, the strategy that urban transportation development and environmental protection should be carried out simultaneously was proposed as well as its concrete countermeasures.

articleTitle: Explore New Economic Growth Points in the Post-Crisis Era, on the Basis of Independent Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the post-crisis era, to solve the deep-seated problems in China's economic structure, we need to accelerate industrial structure adjustment, achieve the transformation of economic development mode, and seek new growth points. Domestic enterprises should be proactive in taking specific initiatives of independent innovation, brand building, new energy development and cultural and creative industries development, so as to realize sustainable economic growth.

articleTitle: Value Safeguard Mechanism in Asymmetric Interorganizational Relationships
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Network structure is recognized as an increasing important mechanism of value safeguard in interorganizational relationships. This paper employs social network approach to examine how smaller and vulnerable firms use their network structure as governance mechanisms in collaborations with stronger and prominent firms. We identify three distinctive types of tie-formation strategies and illustrate contingents that affect the choice of network strategies.

articleTitle: Mutual Loyalty between the Tourism Enterprise and Core Employees in the Process of Psychological Contract Performance: A Games Theory Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Researches on core employees' loyalty on Tourism enterprises have been an increasing concern. To explore the two under-researched antecedent conditions ---the dimension and intensity of loyalty, this study, based on the one-shot games theory and infinitely repeated games one, analyzes the process for the performance of psychological contract between the core employees and tourism enterprise. It is found that there are driving force and initiative for both sides to achieve mutual loyalty in the long run. Limitations and directions for future research are presented.

articleTitle: Research on Infringement Damages of Software Intellectual Property Based on Economic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Realizing the knowledge assets' value and protecting intellectual property is one of the function of knowledge management. And damages of software intellectual property play a crucial role in intellectual property protection. Based on the analysis of the characteristic and compensation mode of software infringement, this paper discusses a theoretical model of calculating infringement damages for software, and also makes an empirical analysis by using the practical data. This paper suggests that the infringement damages for software should be determined in the perspective of escaping liability. Compared with other infringements, the infringer has more chance of escaping liability in software infringement. Accordingly, punitive damages for software infringement should be applied in more cases. This paper also suggests that punitive damages should be a multiple of the profit difference by reason of software infringement, based on the the theory of monopoly, equilibrium and externality in economics. And the multiple is the reciprocal of the probability of bearing software infringement liability.

articleTitle: Discussion for the Legislation Issue of China's Wetland Ecosystem Protection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Wetlands which have been called the "kidneys of nature", with ecological, economic and social benefits are related to the national ecological security. State wetland management has gone through the management with the purpose of wetland resources use and the wetland ecosystem management stage for maintaining the health of wetland ecosystem. On the basis of analyzing the development and utilization of China's wetland resources and the management situation of these wetlands, the author proposed some ideas on the values of wetland ecosystem protection, the ownership of wetland resources, the establishment of wetland protection and management institutions, the system for rational use and protection of the wetland ecological environment.

articleTitle: GIS Based Urban Emergency Decision Support Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To assist government authorities identify evacuation strategy shortly after the outbreak of disasters, this paper proposes a GIS based urban emergency decision support model for large-scale crowd evacuation. The architecture and function of the model is devised to meet the need of scientific decisions in emergency management, and an expert system integrated with GIS is designed for evacuation planning. By the technology of modularization with multi-layer architecture, an accurate real-time evacuation booting system is established. Experiment results show the feasibility of the proposed model to provide a novel development mode for the establishment of digital urban emergency management system.

articleTitle: Structural Predicament in the Construction of the Team of Student Advisors in Universities and the Solution
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Student advisors bear the tough task to cultivate the constructors and successors of the cause of socialism. The recent team of student advisors has confronted such structural problems as the incomplete administration mechanism in itself, low total compensation, under-developed theoretical studies, unstable staff, etc. To improve the team construction, there are much to be done, as deepening the understanding, strengthening vocational training, improving the system, achieving the sustainable development of the team of the student advisors, etc. This paper, through the empirical study in the current situation of university student advisors, analyzes the problems in the current construction of the team of student advisors, and proposes the new solution to improve the construction of the team.

articleTitle: Dynamic Portfolio Management of Strategic Investment in Chinese Banking Sector
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper makes analysis of the strategic investment risks towards banking shares in Chinese stock markets based on Markowitz mean-variance model using Monte Carlo simulation for solution. Three stocks from banking fields, including state owned, joint stock, and city commercial banks, are used to form the portfolio and get the optimal weights dynamics from 2007 to 2009. It's found that the optimal investment weight of city bank rises during the sample period. The joint stock bank slightly fluctuates, while state-owned bank has obvious down turn. The results offer investors guide towards making decisions in banking sector investment to achieve the minimum risks.

articleTitle: The Mechanism Analysis of the Impact of Mergers and Acquisitions Activity on Labor Demand in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For the first time the paper is to make mechanism analysis on impact the M&A makes on labor demand in China from three aspects: firstly, from the perspective of the Relations of M&A, Economic Growth and Employment, we conclude that the M&A will have different impacts on labor demand from the short to long terms; secondly, from the perspective of M&A Motive, the impacts of M&A on labor demand vary from different motives; thirdly, from the perspective of different types of M&A, different types of M&A have different impacts on labor demand. Specifically, it is classified into the mechanism analysis of the impact of horizontal M&A on labor demand, the impact of vertical M&A on labor demand, and mixed-effects of M&A on labor demand.

articleTitle: Internet Marketing and Innovative Strategies: A Study of China's Travel Agencies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of modern science and IT, the internet has brought a lot of new opportunities for travel agencies, the internet marketing of China's travel agencies has begun and is developing rapidly, it has already become one of the main marketing methods of China's travel agencies. However, comparing with the developed countries, the internet marketing of China's travel agencies generally has a lower development level and is still at the initial stage, there still exist many problems. This paper adopts the methods of induction and systems analysis, has expounded the significance and analyzed the existing problems for China's travel agencies to develop the internet marketing, and proposed some corresponding innovative strategies. Finally such a conclusion has been reached: As long as we innovate continuously on the strategies of the internet marketing in accordance with the actual situation of China's travel agencies, fully understand the importance for China's travel agencies to develop the internet marketing, and take some corresponding strategies to resolve the existing problems, then China's travel agencies will obtain a sustainable development.

articleTitle: Partial-OBB Collision Detection Based on Fisher Discrimination
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Collision detection is necessary in order to resolve interaction between teeth in dental arrangement. Dental arrangement is a part of the invisible correction system which is a computer aided system helping dentist to find a way to correct teeth in disorder. This paper discusses the importance of collision detection; a method has been developed for it, based on a physically-based modeling of triangle material. Teeth are modeled as a set of triangles; define the optimal plane to the neighboring teeth based on genetic algorithm. Through the best training result find the suitable number of individuals to perform our experiment in dental arrangement.

articleTitle: The Research on Repatriation Adjustment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: How to improve repatriation adjustment has became an increasing important issue for multinational corporations, based on analyzing reasons for the failure of repatriation, this paper establishes a theoretical framework of repatriation adjustment. It suggests company should adopt different management according to different types of expatriation; government should play its role as legislation, supervisal, intercession and arbitration.

articleTitle: A Study Based on the Internal and External Factors of Chinese E-Commerce in the International Trade
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies Chinese e-commerce development and its characteristics under the environment of Chinese foreign trade. It indicates the advantages and disadvantages of the foreign trade and e-commerce. It also finds and determines its external opportunities and challenges, in order to facilitating the e-commerce advantages of China's foreign trade, cope with various challenges and seize the opportunities in the 21st century, making foreign trade to achieve long-term sustainable development.

articleTitle: Architecture Design of Risk Control System for Social Medical Insurance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, it has been analyzed for risk factors and control framework. The technology of the risk control system of social medical insurance is studied. The system adopts SOA, active data warehouse and data mining technology, and is based on model base, method base and rule base of risk control of medical insurance fund. The system will realize real-time data exaction, massive data integration and heterogeneous system integration. The study and implementation of this system will give strong support for risk control of medical insurance fund, ensuring basic medical care, and promoting sustainable development of medical insurance.

articleTitle: Study on Spreading Effect of inside Resources in the Parent-Subsidiary Enterprise's System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In view of the advantage of enterprise resource theory resolving black-box problem inside company, the nature of enterprise resource relationships is defined and discussed firstly. Then parent-subsidiary enterprise is described and its characteristics based on enterprise resources relationships are analyzed in detail. Through probing the mechanism of enterprise inside resources spread, following conclusions can be got: the improvement of resource matching and potential difference between parent and subsidiary, the enhancement of information integrity on resources spreading and the development of resources spreading system are benefit for increasing the spreading value of resources between parent and subsidiary, and improving the effect creativity of parent-subsidiary management.

articleTitle: Research on Gridding Management of Circular Economy of Caofeidian Industrial District
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After introducing the status of Caofeidian Industrial district, this thesis analyses the necessity of the gridding management of circular economy of Caofeidian Industrial District. Then it introduces the meaning of gridding management.On the basis of principles of grid cell division and the practical conditions of industrial district, the thesis raises to divide the enterprises into grid units. At last, the grid encoding method is proposed.

articleTitle: Current Status, Problems and Countermeasures of Science Popularization of Scientific Research Institutions in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The scientific research institutions have achieved some results by opening to the social public and carrying out actively science popularization activities. However, there are commonly some problems which are: the scientific research institutions' awareness of the importance of science popularization is not enough; organizations, institutions, funds, and personnel security system should be strengthened; and the transformation of scientific and technological resources into science popularization resources is not enough and so on. So we should strengthen the publicity to improve the scientific research institutions' awareness of the importance of science popularization; establish and improve the organization, systems and financial security system of the science popularization, to ensure the status and role of science popularization; actively create conditions for their scientific resources to be transformed into the science popularization resources; and carry out all-dimensional, multi-level and wide-ranging human resource development of the science popularization work.

articleTitle: Comparison of Alternative Construction Project Transaction Method Costs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Considering a dearth of comparing construction project transaction method, from the point of transaction costs, the overall construction project transaction costs is divided into ex ante transaction costs, construction costs, ex post transaction costs. A framework for comparing construction project transaction method is presented, and applied to a detailed analysis of the department of Taihu drainage area's fist design-build pilot project. The results of the study provide a comprehensive understanding of how this new design-build transaction method affects project cost performance as compared to their traditional design-bid-build transaction method. Other owners can apply this framework to assess their own project transaction performance when employing alternative transaction methods.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Chinese Industrial Diversity and Economic Performance*
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It has often been suggested that economic diversity enhances economic performance, either by promoting higher lever of economic growth or by improving stability of regions. This is the conventional wisdom, but it has not been adequately tested. This paper undertake an investigation of industry diversity to analyze whether support can be found for these assumptions by testing them with data of industrial added value and GDP of China from 1978-2006. The results suggest that in the research period, within-set diversity has a positive impact on economic performance in the pattern of GDP per capita, but between-set does reverse impact, both in a non-linear way. Total entropy indices shows no significant impact on economic performance may because the positive influence taken by within-set diversity is neutralized by impact from changes of between-set diversity.

articleTitle: The Prediction Research on Personnel Composition of College Basic Research with Markov Chain Approach
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of modern education and research work in college,the demand for an optimal structure of research personnel has been increasing.Here we come up with the idea to predicte the composition of academic personnel in college in order to better evaluate the quality of college academic level. We build the state transition matrix and probability transition matrix of the basic researchers in college based on the statistics data, and predict the personnel composition of academic personnel with markov chain. The results showed a gread feasibility and veracity.

articleTitle: The Research of Four-Dimensional Value Quality Evaluating Model of the Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Considering the quality characteristics and quantity characteristics of the value, the study proposes the definition, connotation of enterprise value quality, and establishes the four dimensional model of value quality evaluation based on the FAHP method including authenticity, stability, financial risks and sustainable value growth. In addition, the study examines the Value Quality Evaluating Model with the samples selected from power industry in Chinese stock market from 2004-2005.

articleTitle: Career Planning for Staff of Shaanxi Provincial Natural Gas Corporation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this paper was to provide several different careers planning for staff in Shaanxi Provincial Natural Gas Company according to their characteristics, education background and different ambitions. On the basis of detailed presentation of the institutional framework of Shaanxi Province Natural Gas Corporation, several typical career planning were made for staff with different ambitions according to the career planning principles. These career planning were based on facts; they were practical and realistic; and they coordinated the individual career target with the corporation developing target. The career planning for Shaanxi Province Natural Gas Corporation staff suggested in this paper can help effectively give full play to the staff subjective initiative and help all the personnel to achieve their self-worth.

articleTitle: Game Analysis of Entrepreneurs' Moral Risk in the Venture Capital Investment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Due to the information asymmetry, investors are confronted with the "moral risk" of entrepreneurs in the venture capital investment. By using game theory, this paper gives an in-depth analysis to the "moral risk" of entrepreneurs and draws some valuable research conclusions and suggestions, including: behavioral choice of entrepreneurs is a function of the system; the enterprises should constantly enhance the information transparency; social supervision system over entrepreneurs should be established and perfected gradually.

articleTitle: Instability of Strategic Alliances: A Process-Oriented Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Theories of instability of strategic alliances have tended to focus on alliance outcomes and ignore the development process. This paper explores the key factors which may cause the instability of strategic alliances. From a process-oriented perspective, we suggest that partner selection, alliance structure, and scope of activities may have a significant relationship to instability of alliances.

articleTitle: An Improved Algorithm for Image Mosaic Based on Speeded-Up Robust Features
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Due to the shortcomings of the large data and time consuming in the conventional image mosaic algorithms, an improved algorithm based on Speeded-up Robust Features(SURF) is presented in this paper. The integral image is introduced for image convolutions to reduce the computation and Hessian matrix is adopted for the detector to extract the interest points. For each feature point, the dominant orientation is assigned by Haar-wavelet response, and then the descriptor is determined. Finally, the Homography matrix between two images is obtained by RANSAC. Experimental result shows that this algorithm with strong robustness performs rapidly and effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Criteria of Expatriate Selection in Multinational Corporations
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper takes a critical review of literature relevant to the expatriate selection. After a more precise definition of expatriate success, we analysis the three main sections of selection criteria and compile a comparison table, for the purpose of achieving a systematic overview. Furthermore, we establish the criteria measurements and discuss implications for both academicians and practitioners in international management.

articleTitle: Study on 3D Visual Simulation for Reservoir Construction Layout
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Reservoir Construction Layout, which needs collection and interpretation of generous geographic information and other construction data, is very important and complicated. In this paper, the 3D digital model of Reservoir Construction Layout is established using some software such as 3ds Max. Depending on the established digital model, 3D cruising of the whole scene and local observing of the reservoir are realized. QingLinJing Reservoir, which is located in northeast of Shenzhen City of China, is taken as a case study. The 3D visualization of the whole scene of QingLinJing Reservoir Construction Layout is realized with 3ds Max.
