The 3D visualization scene is visualized in 3D animation. 3D visual simulation is important to design and optimization of reservoir construction and it provides an effective way for the construction management and decision-making for reservoir construction layout project.

articleTitle: The Location Determinates of Overseas R&D across Developing and Developed Areas: The Case of Japan and the US
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper aims to find out the overseas R&D location determinates of MNEs in Japan and the US. This paper found that the location determinates of American overseas R&D are impacted by GDP, GDPP, HTE, R&D/GDP, IPP, SCI, CCR and FREE of host countries, and it shares the same location determinates no matter investing in developed or developing areas. As the late comer of overseas R&D, Japan is different from the US. GDP, HTE, FREE and SCI are identified as location determinates when Japan invests overseas R&D in developed countries. And GDP, GDPP, HTE, FREE, IPP and CCR are identified as the location determinates when investing in developing countries. The conclusion is that MNEs in the US has established its strategic R&D system world wide, and some developing countries are involved in the development of new products and new technology. But Japan's overseas R&D in developed host countries has mainly focused on technique and knowledge tracking, and focused on markets and products in developing countries.

articleTitle: The Impact of Financial Crisis on Chinese SMEs: Based on Dynamic Cluster Analysis of the Growth Indexes of SMEs in China Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The small and medium enterprises in the national economy occupy an important position in Chinese economic growth, labor, employment and social stability and development. For 2007-2008 global financial crisis, Chinese national economy caused by a powerful impact, but also the development of Chinese small and medium enterprises causing serious impact. Based on growth indicators of 218 cities listed on Shanghai and Shenzhen SMEs, the current financial crisis on the impact of Chinese small and medium enterprises conduct an empirical analysis through the cluster analysis method. The results show that in 2008 Chinese small and medium enterprises affected by the financial crisis strongest year for the development of SMEs in China in 2009 has begun to rebound.

articleTitle: The Effectiveness of Strategic Human Resource Management Practices on Competitive Advantage: Dynamic Capabilities as a Mediator
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Effective strategic human resource management practices can lead to competitive advantage. Nevertheless, the mechanism between these two has not been carefully identified. Using the survey data, the paper examines the relationship among strategic human resource management practices, dynamic capabilities and competitive advantage. The results from regression analysis indicate that the effective SHRM practices can increase the dynamic capabilities and competitive advantage. Dynamic capabilities can enhance competitive advantage.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Coupling Mechanism and Systematic Balance of Forest Ecosystem and Forestry Industry: A Case Study of Yichuan Forestry Area
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Application of Associated Clustering Analysis of Extension Group Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the basis of the analysis on the theories and methods of fuzzy clustering and extension group decision-making, this paper established an associated clustering model of analysis of extension group decision-making, centered on correlation function and combined fuzzy equivalence relations with extension transformation. Not only does this method take the advantages of dynamic classification in extension group decision-making, but also achieves the subdivision of the decision-making program under uncertainty, conducive to the promotion of the classification results of multi-factor analysis and multi-project evaluation in extension group decision-making. Finally, an example concerning practical problems is given to demonstrate the process of associated clustering and confirmed the truth of the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Soil Organic Carbon Loss through Water Erosion in Loess Hilly Region of Northwestern China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Soils are a major reservoir of global carbon. Loss of agricultural soil carbon through erosion, management, and decomposition adds to the atmospheric loading of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. Soil erosion is a major driving force to help release the soil carbon to waterbodies and the atmosphere. The present study monitored transportation of SOC accompanying with soil erosion process at field runoff plots in the loess hilly region of Ansai, Shaanxi, China. The results show the SOC loss amount was mainly influenced by soil erosion intensity, linearly increasing with soil erosion intensity. Soil erosion occurred much intensively on the slopes of 20° and 30°. The organic carbon (OC) concentration in sediment decreased as a power function with increasing soil erosion intensity. Organic carbon enrichment ratio (ERoc) was negatively related to the increasing slope gradient, declining from 4.36 at the slope of 10° to 2.50 at the slope of 30°. According to the plot monitoring data, the annual SOC loss amount in this loess hilly region is estimated up to 71.8 tons.

articleTitle: Research on Data Envelopment Analysis of Scientific and Technological Activity
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Regional science and technology activity are a source of economic development. In this paper, it is to establish a efficiency evaluation model of regional scientific and technological activity based on DEA. A positive and quantitative study of Hebei Province shows that the technology market lags behind in developing new products, and the economic benefit is clearly insufficient. Therefore, it needs to take targeted measures to enhance the efficiency of scientific and technological activity.

articleTitle: A Case Study on City Development Strategy of Underdeveloped Region in Hezhou: Aim at Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In traditional, economic construction is usually the only object in city's development. But today, because of the change of international and domestic environments and the challenge of city's sustainable development, the harmonious construction of economic, social and ecological is the new object of city development. In this paper, to take Hezhou, a less developed city in Guangxi Province, as a case study, the quantitative analysis and horizontal comparison on city's resources and environment, economic development and industrial structure is submitted. Meanwhile, the paper gives a comprehensive analysis of the macro context and concerns of the opportunities and challenges of city development. Aimed at the harmonious development of economic, social and ecological, the paper proposes the city's development strategy. Thought the study on Hezhou, the paper tries to explore a mode of city development strategic guidance for less developed regions, to achieve the city's sustainable development.

articleTitle: Food Packaging and Design in View of Environmental Protection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As resource consumption and environmental protection have become two major global ecological issues, modern food packaging has become a hot research both abroad and in China. This article describes development of green packaging, environmental protection in international market, and the new packaging ideas which the developed countries contribute to pollution reduction. The article is also analyze the increasing food packaging design issues as the level of China's consumption and science and technology have developed very fast, and the prospects of food packaging design for the future in these environmental conditions.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: A Study on a New Pattern of Enterprise--Intelligent Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract:
Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles

"A Study on a New Pattern of Enterprise - Intelligent Enterprise"
by Feng Dexiong and Wang Xiang
in the Proceedings of the 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science, August 2010

After careful and considered review of the content and authorship of this paper by a duly constituted expert committee, this paper has been found to be in violation of IEEE's Publication Principles.

This paper was found to be a near verbatim copy of the paper cited below. The original text was copied without attribution (including appropriate references to the original author(s) and/or paper title) and without permission.

Due to the nature of this violation, reasonable effort should be made to remove all past references to this paper, and future references should be made to the following article:

"The Rise of the Intelligent Enterprise"
by Kemal A. Delic, Umeshwar Dayal
in ACM Ubiquity, December 2002


Today's enterprises deploy IT to do their business, which introduces significant complexity. This technical complexity combined with organizational complexity can and does create internal "islands of inefficiency" that are difficult to deal with. The notion of the IE is characterized by the ability of businesses to morph into new forms/entities with some surprising results. We envision that in the future IEs will willingly transform themselves into better forms by becoming "more intelligent". Intelligent enterprises (IE) have broad horizons with long-term perspectives. They will derive efficiencies through the automation of their core business processes, and the exploitation of knowledge. Agility will be improved by one or two orders of magnitude, intelligence density within the enterprise will grow sharply and problem-solving capacities will be dramatically enhanced. They will form dynamic partnerships with other enterprises to create dynamic business ecosystems, which will be self-managed, self-configured and self-optimized. Consequently, they will exploit new forms of business value creation, adjusting their behaviors to the markets.

articleTitle: R&D of Comprehensive Evaluation System of Ecological Environment in Tarim River Basin
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Comprehensive ecological environment evaluation system is an essential professional analysis system in Tarim River basin water regulation management. Research and development of the system consists of ecological environment quality evaluation module, ecological risk assessment module and ecological water demand module. The paper carries out environment quality evaluation by calculating bio-abundance index, vegetation coverage index, density index of network of rivers, land degradation index and pollution load index, and adopts "plant phreatic evaporation quota method" to calculate demand for ecological water in maintaining current situations of natural vegetation. By ecological risk evaluation thought and landscape ecology method, the paper makes calculation of ecological degradation index, risk index and restoration index respectively, and builds an ecological risk intensity index for corresponding ecological risk analysis and evaluation. It further explores the overall plan for system building, system function and structure and integration with other subsystems. Results show that it is very practical and operable to develop environmental information system with the theoretical study results and through ArcGIS +Oracle9 i + ArcSDE technology, and the development helps to make scientific evaluation on environment in arid area, and can offer certain reference for development of other relevant systems.

articleTitle: Modeling Market Volatility with Mixed Exponential Power Asymmetric Conditional Heteroskedasticity: An Application to Shanghai Stock Exchange Composite Index Daily Returns
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We utilize the mixed exponential power asymmetric GARCH model where each component exhibits asymmetric conditional heteroskedasticity to model Shanghai Stock Exchange Composite Index daily returns. Thanks to extra component-specific shape parameters, it can better capture the tail behavior and match the stylized facts of high frequency financial time series precisely and parsimoniously. The application to SSE Composite Index returns illustrates all the conditional variance processes become stationary. Good nature of the performance both in-sample and out-of-sample as well as the flexibility of the maximum likelihood estimation makes it more attractive in the applications of risk management of portfolio and VaR calculation.

articleTitle: Provincial-Level Leading Agricultural Enterprises and Performance Evaluation Based on BP Neural Network Model-Daqing City as an Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Agricultural leading enterprises in the agricultural industrialization plays an important role, is the core of agricultural industrialization. The level of performance of Agricultural Leading Enterprises will have a direct bearing on the success of agricultural industrialization. In view of this, this paper based on BP neural network model and the traditional AHP to build Heilongjiang Province leading agricultural enterprise performance evaluation system. The results show: built in this paper evaluation system is running well, suitable for Agricultural leading enterprises performance evaluation in Province.

articleTitle: Analysis of Chinese Enterprise Financial Crisis Prewarning Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the economic development of the emerging market countries, bankruptcy and financial crisis occur more and more frequently in business, credit and savings institutions, and thus the demand for enterprise financial crisis prewarning is rapidly growing. The main purpose of this paper to build a business financial crisis prewarning model based on BP neural network to conduct empirical analysis of the financial situation in Chinese enterprises. The conclusion shows that this model simulated the actual financial situation of enterprises. It can be not only applied to enterprise financial crisis prewarning in the emerging market countries, but also to financial crisis prewarning in the areas of micro-finance, such as credit and savings institutions, and so on.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation on Emergency Management of the Conflict Groups Social Events of Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: From angle of the enterprise, according to the idears of strategic management of Balanced Scorecard(BSC), the paper focuses on the central of the emergency managerial system of the conflict groups social events and operational mechanism to construct the performance evaluation system. After that, according to the example of the strikes of Taxi companies in Chongqin, the paper made use of the multi-level fuzzy comprehensive appraisal(AHP & FCA)to give the performance evaluation.

articleTitle: Game Analysis of Stability of the Fourth Party Logistics Implementation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As information technology advances, the emerging fourth party logistics (4PL) has become a new kind of logistics operation model to help companies reduce operating costs in recent years. Based on evolutionary game theory, this paper analyzed the stability of fourth party logistics of small and medium enterprises in China, aiming at promoting small and medium enterprises to achieve a smooth and effective implementation of the fourth party logistics.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Brownfield Redevelopment on the Former Huishan Pesticide Factory in Wuxi City
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The objective of this paper was to develop a complete suitability evaluation index system on brownfield redevelopment using a case study of the Former Huishan Pesticide Factory in Wuxi City, China. In this paper, the Extreme Condition Method, the Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Method and the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) were employed for the case study. The results indicated that (1) the suitability evaluation index system of the Land Suitability Class should be estabilished, which was based on concentrations of soil pollutants from the perspective of human health. The suitability evaluation index system of the Construction Land Suitability Class may be determined based on reusing for residential, entertaining, commercial and industrial sites from the perspective of ecological, social and economic conditions. (2) The result of the suitability evaluation indicates that the Former Huishan Pesticide Factory Brownfield could be redeveloped into a residential site, commercial site and entertaining site, which was entirely consistent with the actual municipal planning. (3) To carry out a rational and efficient layout, the Former Huishan Pesticide Factory Brownfield was suggested to be favorablly reusing as a residential and commercial site first and then entertaining site. In addition, remediation technology could be adjusted according to the planning of land reuse in order to achieve the maximum benefits of the reparation. In conclusion, the suitability evaluation of brownfield redevelopment with combining the Land Suitability Class with the Construction Land Suitability Class was viable and effective.

articleTitle: Research and Implement for Dynamic Web Services Architecture Based on Multi Agents
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Dynamic web services based on Multi Agents is a hot topic. This paper analyses the traditional the technology of web services. It identifies three issues: how to simplify the services assembly; how to express strategy dynamically and how to advance services' ability of self-government. It extends prior research with the modeled Dynamic web services architecture (DWSMA) to solve these problems, and outlines its key technologies. Finally, it presents the corresponding implements.

articleTitle: Research on the Adjustment of Engineering Insurance Rate Based on AHP under the Condition of Unit Price Contract
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Regarding the rate-making method of engineering insurance, there isn't a uniform standard in the field of insurance for a long time. Although there is a trend to calculate the engineering insurance rate based on the method of risk coefficient adjustment recent years, it doesn't consider the significance of the risk synthetically by combining project cost and doesn't consider the risk control condition of the insurance policy holder adequately. In order to define the engineering insurance rate objectively, this paper will evaluate the risk with the AHP method and intensively consider the cognition and control on risk by contractors and project owners. This paper also proposes a method to determine the adjustment coefficient of engineering insurance rate based on AHP under the condition of unit price contract, and proves the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Study on Operational System of Project Financing Based on Method of Objective Oriented Project Planning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nowadays, Study on project finance is usually limited to characteristics and its derived patterns, but lack of research on its business methodology. From the viewpoint of system engineering , this paper firstly bring forward the notion of project financial system ,and analyze its operational system based on method of objective oriented project planning, so as to help us to use this financial pattern.

articleTitle: Multi-Resource Leveling Optimization of Large-Scale Projects in Perspective of Dynamic Investment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the main defects of the existing research on resource leveling problem, this paper put forward the multi-resource leveling optimization problem of large-scale construction projects in perspective of dynamic investment. By bringing in the concept of resource entropy and the idea of maximum net present value (NPV), resource leveling optimization model based on entropy function in perspective of dynamic investment was proposed. In order to overcome the shortcomings of traditional algorithms such as heuristic algorithms, the idea and method of searching for the Pareto optimal solutions of the model was presented based on genetic algorithm (GA).

articleTitle: The Study on Logistics and Distribution Strategy of China's Rural Supermarkets
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since "Ten Thousand Villages" market project was carried out, the chain supermarkets have been developing in the rural areas. Logistics and distribution, the tie to various operating of chain supermarkets, play an important role on the smoothly operation of the supermarket. A lot of problems, which are from local markets, now is becoming the bottleneck of the development of supermarket. In this paper, the author analyzed the problems present in current logistics and distribution of China's rural supermarkets, and provided some strategies to the problem.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on Performance Evaluation of Chinese Mutual Funds--Empirical Analysis of Chinese Mutual Funds after Reform of Non-Tradable Shares in 2005
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Finite Time Ruin Probability with Constant Interest Rate and Extended Regular Variation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Consider an insurance risk model, in which the surplus process satisfies a recursive equation U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub> = U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n-1</sub>(1 + r) - X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub> for n ≥ 1, where, U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> = x ≥ 0 is the initial surplus, r > 0 is the constant interest rate, each X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub> denotes the gross loss during the nth year, and X<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>, n = 1, 2, ..., constitute a sequence of i.i.d. real valued r.v.'s with common d.f. F. This paper investigates the ruin probability within a finite horizon and obtains a simple and uniform asymptotic relation when the claimsize is of extended regular variation.

articleTitle: Management Countermeasures of Crop Residues Utilization in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Some problems are emerged in crop residues (CRs) utilization in China today. Based on management theory, it is regarded that shorting management thoughts and methods contribute to the failure of the projects of utilizing CRs, which both wasted the money and counteracted the utilization of CRs. The relationship cycle model is given to clear the relationship among the government, the institution, the enterprise and the farmer. The rules of people's activities of utilizing CRs and the management goals are discussed. The management methods of utilizing CRs are also suggested for the government, including conducting by plan, encouraging by money, competing in the market and controlling by rule. At the last, the available benefits are roughly calculated. It is suggested that the best way to promote the utilization of CRs in China is to see them not as residues, but as valuable resources that can create benefits, and the age of CRs is coming finally at the time that the industrial utilization of CRs is true in society.

articleTitle: On the Moments of the Severity of Ruin in the Delayed Renewal Risk Model under Heavy-Tailed Claims
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Let A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub>(u) be the deficit at ruin in the delayed renewal risk model, where u is the initial capital of the company. Under the assumption that the equilibrium distribution of the claim size belongs to the subexponential class, this paper obtains an asymptotic formula for the φ-moment of A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub>(u). This result improves the related works in the recent literature.

articleTitle: A Public Value Approach to Service Management in Public Hospitals: An Alternative to the Balanced Scorecard
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Chinese government announced a new medical reform plan in April 2009, which reinstates the public nature of Chinese healthcare system and emphasizes the importance of performance evaluation and service management. Mark Moore's Public Value Scorecard model provides the most comprehensive framework for management in the public and nonprofit sectors. This paper discusses the use of Public Value Scorecard as an adaptive strategic framework that public hospital administrators and other public and nonprofit executives can use to evaluate performances. The model accounts for the unique characteristics of hospitals and other public organizations, and can provide a useful framework as leaders strive to better articulate their strategy and goals.

articleTitle: Study on Characteristics of Three-Dimensional Flow Fields in V-Type Heat Exchanger
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The airflow field has decisive effect on how to manage the system to be in good performance. Moreover, it is significant for energy saving and environmental protection. The three dimensional air-flow fields in the V-type heat exchanger was studied by computational fluid dynamics(CFD). In the model, the fin-tube heat exchanger was looked at a porous medium. Numerical results were testified by the experimental data. The results show that the face velocity distribution along the heat exchanger height is non-uniform while uniform along the length direction. It is found such phenomenon is directly determined by the wind path length along different heat exchanger direction. It is also found that the air flow maldistribution will cause directly the heat stress convergence on some points of fins, which is harmful to the fin using life. It is proposed that more attention should be paid on how to make the airflow fields more uniform in order to save more energy.

articleTitle: Insider Trading Regulation and the Distribution of Securities Market Profit
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Investor's trading strategy and the securities market's profit distribution will be affected by insider trading regulation. This paper builds a quantitative financial model to analyze the change of the trading strategy and the market profit distribution. Except the insider trading regulation, market liquidity, insider's type, information veracity and stock price volatility will also affect the trading strategy and market profit distribution.

articleTitle: The Application of Unascertained Measurement Model in Customer Satisfaction of Electronic Business
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is great significance that reasonably evaluates the customer satisfaction of e-business. That can help enterprises to know customer damands and train customer loyalty. The paper firstly analyses the key factors influcing enterprise e-business customer satisfaction, and establish an evaluation index system of e-business customer satisfaction. Then this paper uses the unascertained measurement model based on the theory of unascertained mathematics to evaluate an enterprise e-business customer satisfaction. The evaluating process and result show that this method is scientific and practical.

articleTitle: The Evaluation Model of the Service Enterprise Competitiveness Based on the Fuzzy Set
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The competitiveness of service enterprise is related to the competitiveness of the whole service industry, and affects the development of country's economics and society. Based on the three meanings of the competitiveness of enterprises, this paper defines the content of the competitiveness of service enterprise, which including business resources, entrepreneurial capabilities and business performance in three aspects, constructs evaluation index system of the competitiveness of service enterprise, and presents a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model for the competitiveness of service enterprise. An example of a postal enterprise shows that the evaluation model provides a scientific, effective and practical idea for the competitiveness of service enterprises.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon-Type Government: The Rational Choice for the Development of Low-Carbon Economy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The low-carbon economy has become the focus of global common concern while the government is playing an important role in the process of the implementation of the low-carbon economy. The government's own low-carbonization reflects the true nature of a low-carbon economy. This article gives a definition to the low-carbon-type government and makes an analysis for the necessity to the construction of the low-carbon-type government as well as the possible direction and the path that the government should take in the building up of the low-carbon-type government. It makes it clear that the construction of low-carbon-oriented government is the rational choice for the implementation of a low-carbon economy.

articleTitle: Weighted Fuzzy Clustering Analysis of Enterprise Knowledge Workers Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The classification of knowledge workers has become an important basis for the scientific activities of human resources management in enterprises. Analytical hierarchy process (AHP) theory is introduced simply on weight value calculating and attributes reduction in this paper. Based on AHP, a method of weighted fuzzy clustering analysis of knowledge workers is given. The proposed approach overcomes the traditional subjectivity and makes the classification of knowledge workers more objective. An example is given to demonstrate this method.

articleTitle: Application of Visualized Managements at Labor-Intensive Enterprises in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With long-term actual managerial experience in large labor-intensive enterprise, authors analyse the problem of enforcing visualized management in labor-intensive enterprise. Author discuss the keys of solving problems and concrete measures through classic theory of management and method of quoting examples, deduce the feasibility and developmental tendency of enforcing visualizad management in large labor-intensive enterprise.

articleTitle: Leadership's Function in the Knowledge Management of Rural Regional Development--By the Case of "Rabbit King" in Western China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In nowadays knowledge-based society, the knowledge and innovation are considered as the core-competence of the regions. In rural areas, in order to realize its leaping development, building the regional knowledge network is essential and causes great attention in academic field. As one indispensable element in the knowledge network, researchers emphasized the leadership's function in the organization. Through one case study of poverty alleviation in Western China in detail, this paper suggests that leadership have important effects on creating knowledge vision, knowledge learning, creating and dissimilation, as well as building knowledge applying platform. The implications of the findings along with some potential practical applications are also discussed in the end.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Opportunities Brought by E-Commerce for International Tax Planning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The international tax planning is based on the conflicts of tax jurisdictions and the differences between tax systems of all countries. With the rapid development of E-commerce in recent years, a new trend that the tax planning carried out through internet has emerged. E-commerce puts forward challenges to traditional tax concepts, such as tax jurisdiction, permanent establishment and so on. Under such complex circumstances, different countries have conflicting attitudes with no unanimous regulation; E-commerce broadens the space of international tax planning.

articleTitle: Trust and Learning as Moderators in Achieving Supply-Chain Competitiveness: Evidence from the Chinese Auto Component Sectors
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study uses frameworks from the supply chain management (SCM) and strategy literatures to explore the relationship among learning, trust, and innovation in Chinese auto component sectors. Statistical analysis of the responses of 81 Yangtze River delta auto component manufacturing companies leads to the development of a strategic relational typology which is useful in explaining auto-component manufacturing sector has successfully shifted away from the era of 'contract' and 'catalogue' mindset to 'network' and 'innovation' mindset and could be a good model for others to follow.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Evolutionary Game Analysis on the Technological Road Mapping of Low Carbon Economy within a Cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on Supervisory Effectiveness of Management Level Based on GRA: A Case Study of Chinese Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the main method to prevent the moral risks of the management level, the supervision is implemented by many aspects. Grounded on the basic theory of corporate finance, this paper used grey relational method to analysis the data of 1276 list companies in Shanghai and Shenzhen stock market. It explored that supervision from different executors effected the behavior selection of the management under the certain economic environment in China. Meanwhile, it also provided basis for business owners and economic administers in terms of rationalizing the arrangement of supervision mode and strengthening the prevention of moral risks.

articleTitle: Research on Technical Risk Management of SMS Mobile Bank
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: SMS mobile bank has attained more attention from bank industry and customers for its higher security and lower cost. As a kind of virtual working environment for entity bank, potential technical risk of SMS mobile bank is greater than that of traditional one. In this thesis, we will analyze its technical risk and bring forward some corresponding security strategies according to it.

articleTitle: Research on Supplier Performance Evaluation Model Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the big and complete enterprise disintegrating gradually In the market competition of global economy integration, the relation among enterprises present the obvious network tendency day by day, supply chain management (SCM)obtain universal application in the Manufacturing enterprises, becomes one kind of new management pattern. Now enterprises come to realize that effective supply chain management, which would have to assess supply chain performance. However, scientific, objective and comprehensive analysis and evaluation of the supply chain operating performance is an urgent problem need to be addressed. Based on analyzing the present fact of domestic and international vendor performance evaluation, Based on the construction of index system for supply chain supplier ability evaluation and analysis, a new method is presented in this paper which apply the principal component analysis and fisher method. It may overcome the existing methods shortcomings and contribute to the supplier selection, the analysis result might be taken as one of main reference for outsourcing decision making. Finally, the model is approved by a case provided which is practical and effective. The result shows that the model could reflect the gener capabilities of the supplier objectively and fairly and achieve an effective evaluation on supplier performance.

articleTitle: The Role of Fair Value Accounting for Investment in Securities: Evidences from the Chinese Banking Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: the purpose of this study is to examine the role relevance of fair value accounting measurement for investment in securities. Our sample is composed of Chinese listed commercial Banks from period 2006 to the end of 2008.the empirical result show that First, the positive relationship between stock market value and losses of investment ,stock market value and securities investment . Second, the explanation power of fair value measures for long-time equity investment is less than that for other items in the banking industry. Third, the explanation power of fair value measures for gains or losses is more than that for other items in the banking industry

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Application of Wavelet Threshold De-Noising in Settlement Monitoring for Subway
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Cultural Diffusion of Chinese Opera Based on Replicator Dynamics Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Chinese opera has become a part of Chinese culture, and but faces the challenge of the existence today. Chinese opera culture needs the effective diffusion and protection. The paper shows that the diffusion process is very complicated. According to the complicated characteristics of cultural evolution, this paper establishes an evolutionary game model to simulate the diffusion process of Chinese opera culture and put forward the related strategies for the protecting-opera organization.

IEEE Keywords: IEEE Journals and Transactions On-LINE - OpeRA

articleTitle: A Principal-Agent Model for Cooperative Production of Motor Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The outsourcing production are performed not only by the supplier but also by buyer, so the intangibility and unverifiability of their contributed resources bring on double moral hazard. Focused on double moral hazard, an outsourcing contract of cooperative production of motor vehicle is designed with principal-agent theory. The maximization of benefit of the outsourcing will be given by the optimization between the fixed payment and the proportion of revenue-sharing under the limitation of the participation constraint and incentive-compatibility constraint. Subsequently, the influence of exogenous variable's on the optimized contract parameters is further analyzed. At last, the conclusions are proved by a numerical example.

articleTitle: The Research on the Effect of Organizational Learning on Diversification and Capital Structure Strategy in Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises: An Empirical Research Based on Structural Equation Modeling
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The knowledge theory has increasingly been used to explain the enterprise behaviors. Then, the organizational learning of the knowledge theory has what effect on diversification and capital structure strategy? In this paper, organizational learning is classified into exploration and exploitation and enterprise performance into the overall financial performance and new product performance. On the basis of questionnaire survey, by exploratory factor analysis and structural equation modeling, the results show that exploration has a direct positive effect on diversification, while exploitation has an inhibitory effect; whether exploration or exploitation has little effect on capital structure in SMEs; diversification indirectly affects the overall financial performance through affecting the new product performance.

articleTitle: Apparel Brand Image Management Based on Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Chinese apparel industry has occupied an important position in international industry chain. However, Chinese Apparel Enterprises are not the main beneficiaries of the chain. Product and brand homogeneities are two common problems existing in Chinese domestic clothing industry. With knowledge economy developing rapidly, those who possess a wealth of knowledge and excels at converting knowledge into productivity can be survived in the competition. The paper is to introduce knowledge management to brand image construction and guild the clothing enterprise to enhance the ability of acquiring, integrating, sharing and creating knowledge.

articleTitle: Application of the Power-Law on the Stock Price and Profit Fluctuations of Chinese Listed Banks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The idea of this study is to apply the Power-law on the Chinese listed banks to understand the fluctuations of the stock price and profit. 5 banks listed in the Chinese stock exchange are analyzed in this paper. Recursive procedures based on empirical distribution tests are used to determine the threshold number of observations in the tail estimation.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Study of Knowledge Management Models in the Project-Oriented Service Company
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Cost Prediction and Visualization Control System for Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By combining information visualization theory, multiple regression analysis theory and Java programming language, this paper constructed a cost prediction and visualization control system for enterprises. With the characteristic of human-computer interaction, this system can predict the costs at a specific point of time, which can help decision makers with their decision-making. In addition, the system can show the real-time costs in visualization interface, which enables managers to track the real-time costs. The application of this system in an enterprise shows that it has changed the traditional cost management method that simply relies on the experience of managers and it is a very good reference to the enterprises to carry out cost prediction and control.

articleTitle: Analyze Efficient Frontier of the Asset Portfolio Briefly: Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is very crucial to study financial products in view of financial products emerge in endlessly along with development of the financial market. So, it receives more and more attention from the society about researching how to manage financial assets seriously and scientifically and how to measure asset risk. Now, Application of software MATLAB in the financial area has received much more attention. Both mean-variance and stochastic simulation method are adopted to analyze risk of asset portfolio and income from application of MATLAB in view of asset portfolio, which looks forward to provide reference for efficient frontier of the investment portfolio.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Housing Consumption Pattern of Urban Households with Different Income Levels in Shaanxi Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Performance Evaluation of ERP Systems Based on Fuzzy AHP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Evaluating the performance of enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems is a complex task that requires consideration of many economical and technical factors. This paper proposes a method based on fuzzy analytical hierarchy process (AHP) to cope with the multicriteria decision making problems. AHP methodology is adopted for building the evaluation model based on the performance indicators of ERP systems. In order to calculate the relative weights of evaluation indexes, the theory of fuzzy mathematics combining with AHP is used. The results of the case study, which focuses on evaluating the performance indicators of finances, customers, inner process, learning and growing, have provided satisfactory estimates of the performance of ERP systems.

articleTitle: An Evaluation Method Based on Fuzzy Cluster and Its Application to the Desulfurization Projects of Thermal Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper has made a exploratory research on the evaluation of desulfurization projects of thermal power plants, which is an important reference to classify them by grade, and then Chinese current price compensation policy for the desulfurization projects could be adjusted according to the classification of them. This paper proposes a new perspective by introducing fuzzy cluster sorting method to evaluate the desulfurization projects. According to the evaluation objective, it has constructed the best and the worst standard objects respectively, and inserted them into the original sample matrix as the cluster kernels, then it obtained the similarity coefficients for each sample to either standard and corrected them, then based on the corrected similarity coefficients the samples were sorted. This method is applied to the evaluation of desulfurization projects of thermal power plants, and the results have remarkable accuracy and a reasonableness.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Central Area Urban Cluster Regional Economies Difference Space and Time Evolution Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Research Based on the Value Network Analysis of Promoting the Transportation Enterprise Service Value
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the beginning of the paper, we propose the value network structure of transportation corporations as the basic of following discussions. Focusing on the relations among factors in the value network, the paper discusses the functions and affects of transportation corporations' service value promotion as well as possible problems that corporations need think about in practical processes.

articleTitle: Discussion of Energy Consumption and Management in Tianjin
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By using a modified emergy-based ecological footprint model, this paper dynamic calculated and analyzed the emergy-based ecological footprint and carrying capacity of energy consumption of Tianjin city from 2000 to 2008, and on the basis of this assessed the dynamic changes of carbon emission structure of energy consumption of Tianjin. The result showed that in past nine years the ecological carrying capacity per capita has slowly increased from 0.109 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" According to the results, the paper proposes Tianjin city to promote sustainable energy consumption patterns by measures including restructuring of energy consumption construct, reducing the energy intensity, changing the mode of economic growth and make full use of renewable resources, etc.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Corporate Political Resources and Their Effects on Technological Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Capacity Disruption Management for Complicated Operation System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Some complicated operation systems, such as communication system, auto-plant, refinery and semiconductor fab when critical operational capacities are injured by unexpected events. However, due to the limitation of maintenance technique, a multiple periods of time are usually needed for the restoration process. In this paper, a regular and expedite capacity support from alliance and the attitude factor of the decision makers are considered during the disruption periods. A multi-periods mathematical modal is proposed for minimizing the total loss cost, and 3 interesting managerial insights are obtained by numerical analysis toward some key parameters.

articleTitle: Economic Feasibility Study on the Production of Quality & Safe Food
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article makes a qualitative study for the influence of improving the food quality & safety on the producer's income by building the cost function of food quality & safety. We compare the different influences of improving the food quality & safety on the production behaviors in different conditions. It can be concluded preliminarily that there is an economic feasibility for the producers to improve the level of quality & safety: first, the long-run cost of quality & safety is tending to go down, there is an increasing margin of profit; and second, the maximal profit point can be found.

articleTitle: Foreign Exchange Risk Measurement and Management of Chinese Listed Companies--Take Firms in Copper Industry as an Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper measures nominal foreign exchange exposure in listed companies in copper industry first, but finds little statistically significant as previous studies did. Then, exchange rate movements are decomposed into expected and unexpected components, so as to explain the change of companies' value much better. Finally, the strategic hedging is suggested instead of financial hedging policies.

articleTitle: Noise Dressing of ECM and Investment Portfolio Selection Based on RMT in China Financial Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Empirical Correlation Matrix (ECM) is considered to be the foundation of Markowitz Theory because it measures the statistical overlaps of the fluctuations between price changes of assets. But by applying Random Matrix Theory (RMT) to calculate and analyse empirically the ECM between pairs of price-changing profits of company stocks based on time-series data from both Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Exchange A Shares, it was found that both ECM are all noise-dominated. Consequently, this paper put forward a new and Genuine Correlation Matrix (GCM) by noise dressing of the ECM based on RMT. Finally, this paper made decisions of optimal investment portfolios ground on three different measurement methods of the portfolio correlations with same return series and original time-series or processed, then forecasted and compared their risks. Evidences in this paper indicated that the optimal financial investment portfolio ground on GCM is better than ones ground on both traditional ECM and new Kendall ¿ . That is to say, the method of investment portfolio selection proposed in this paper is good and effect.

articleTitle: Consideration about Innovation of Internal Control in Chinese Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the product of society and economy in certain stage, corporate internal control is an important part of enterprise management, a tool for effective internal management, as well as automatic early warning system and maintenance system of enterprises. From the strategic perspective, this article points out orientation of innovation of corporate internal control in aspect of concept innovation, institutional innovation and management innovation.

articleTitle: Connotation of Knowledge, Service Innovation and Competition among High-Tech Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: During building up the competitive advantages, many high-tech enterprises invest abundant resources in know-how knowledge, that is to say, they highlight technological innovation, while paying no heed to know-who knowledge, especially the know-customer knowledge, which means they disregard service innovation. This is a misconception. As the technologies and functions of products of high-tech enterprises become increasingly homogeneous, an enterprise can hardly be far in excess of its competitors and thus gain the comparative advantages in technologies and products. However, since services are the inevitable extension of functions of products, the service innovation has already become the key to differentiate high-tech enterprises. Accordingly, high-tech enterprises must pay more attention to various distinguished services and supportive services for customers and thus gain long-lasting competitive advantages through service innovation.

articleTitle: The Analysis on the Problems of Third-Party Payment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The construction of the online payment market has been the hot spot of the development of electronic-commerce, and how to improve the electronic payment market to solve the bottleneck of e-commerce payment is the focal point. This paper uses the standardize methods to analyze the problems in the development of the third-party payment and holds that much importance should be attached to risks in the development of third-party payment, and take some measures such as increase supervision, improve the legal system and business and services innovation to promote the development of third-party payment in our country.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation of the Administrative Capacity of City Public Crisis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the review of correlative literatures at home and abroad, this article brings forward the rules of designing evaluation index system of the administrative capacity of city public crisis, which include comparability, the nature of dominancy, flexibility and expansibility, combination of quantification and qualitation, target guide, dynamics and the nature of integration. Besides, 36 specific indexes are designed to evaluate the administrative capacity of city public crisis and an evaluation model of the coefficient of entropy weight is constructed. Then the evaluation of the administrative capacity of city public crisis is carried out.

articleTitle: On Some Problems Relevant to City Planning and Management in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the behavioral characteristics of city planning, the thesis makes a systemic analysis of the problems brought about in the practice of city planning and management in China. The focus of the author's research is mainly on four aspects: institution set up, programming system, policy and regulations, and operating mechanism. The aim of the thesis is to reveal the reasons that cause these problems and to provide suggestions for China's city planning and management which is at the stage of fast development and structural transformation.

articleTitle: Logistics Innovation Based on Linkage Development with Manufacturing Industry: A Conceptual Framework
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Transformed from the business concept of transportation to that of serving the entire logistical needs of customers, logistics industries play an important role on manufacturing industry. However, as neglected in the past, the development of logistics industries lagged behind that of manufacturing industry in China and some logistics barriers to international operations exist. To overcome these barriers, logistics service providers have to make innovation. Only by improving their innovation capability could the logistics enterprises gain the competitive advantages. Through an extensive literature review, this paper examines the drivers for innovation of logistics industries and also identifies the contributions of environmental factors to innovation. After that, the paper proposes a conceptual frame of innovation of logistics industries, which provides a more thorough understanding of innovation of logistics industries based on linkage development with manufacturing industry in China.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise Crisis Public Relations Strategies under Web2.0 Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The primary goal of this paper is to provide the effective strategies for enterprise crisis public relations based on Web2.0. The public relations crisis is a problem which the enterprise must be faced in the development process. With the coming of Web2.0 era, enterprise public relations crisis occurs more frequently than ever before, and its form has also undergone great changes. In this paper, comparative analysis method is used to analyze public relations crisis communication line between the Web2.0 era and traditional media era. Finally, we found that some factors which include fast speed, prevention difficulties, large loss, residual information existing public relations crisis affect the enterprise public relations work under Web2.0 environment. Therefore, this paper suggests that enterprises should take appropriate measures to maintain a good corporate image combined with the new characteristics of the public relations crisis under Web2.0 environment.

articleTitle: Optimal Disposition of Hospital Beds Based on Multiple Objective Programming Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper made a multiple objective programming model, taking into account priority of the waiting time for being arranged in hospital for each kind of patients in a cycle, using Lingo software we made a solution, and we compared the model results with that of the model of First Come First Served (FCFS). The results showed that from three evaluation index, that is, comparison coefficients, total deviation for all the patients' waiting time for surgery and the disposition of doctors, the efficiency of hospital beds is more reasonable. Total deviation for all the patients' waiting time for surgery is 0, it is much better than the FCFS Model.

articleTitle: Anatomy on Interprovincial Changing of Returns to Education in China --From a Viewpoint Based on Hierarchical Liner Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An empirical analysis is employed to study interprovincial changing of returns to education in China and its influencing factors by the database of "Synthesis Investigation of Living Status for Residents in Urban and Rural Regions (2005)" in CGSS and a regressive technology of Hierarchical liner model, the followed results are approved: returns to education in China has surpass mean level of the world; man's return to education surpass woman's, the minority's returns to education surpass the Han's, returns to education descend with rising of education level, but rise with increasing of income in recent China.

articleTitle: The Comprehensive Measurement Model of the Member Importance in Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is proposed that a measurement of the importance of members in an undirected connected network which has weighted nodes and edges. With consideration of the third category of loss, the article built the comprehensive measurement model and algorithm of the member importance and tests it with the data from entrepreneur social networks. The results show that the new model can bring forward a more reliable measuring result of the member importance in social networks.

articleTitle: Study on Cost Control System of Railway Construction Projects
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, being in a rapid stage of development, China Railway Construction requires substantial capital, which makes cost overrun received people's more attentions. In the paper, the factors affecting cost control in railway construction project are analyzed, a conclusion is obtained that effective cost control is not only from the micro-level in whole process of railway construction project, but also from the macro-level (institution) and meso-level (governance). A model of cost control from macro-meso-micro level of railway construction project is established.

articleTitle: Importance Performance Analysis on the Competitiveness of Seaside Tourism Destinations: Case Studies of Qingdao and Dalian
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the questionnaire investigations in Qingdao and Dalian, importance performance analysis was carried out on the competitiveness of seaside tourism destinations. The results showed that there were significant differences between "importance" and "performance" for those influencing factors of destination competitiveness. Several suggestions were put forward in order to improve the levels of destination competitiveness for Qingdao and Dalian.

articleTitle: Research on Cultural Risk Model of Resource-Based Enterprises Internationalization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China's resource-based enterprises encounter various risks in internationalization, among which cultural risk is one of the most significant risks. This paper attempts to build mathematical risk models with formation mechanism, probability and its impact on international operation to effectively predict, identify and monitor cultural risk of China's resource-based enterprises internationalization, thus to enrich enterprise risk management theory, and guide China's resource-based enterprises scientifically in practice.

articleTitle: Pay Gap in Top Management Team and Diversification Operation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper explored the relations between pay gap in TMT and diversification operation. The results show that when large pay gap in TMT force CEOs to face more intense competition, they tend to appeal to diversification which can reduce the probability of being replaced. And in more diversified firm, large pay gaps may be ineffective because high accountability already promotes strong effort and tournament competition encourages sabotage among executives whose relationships are already strained and politicized.

articleTitle: Currency Effects on the Performance of Chinese Foreign Investments: 1994-2008
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the historic market indices for 15 major foreign stock markets for the period from 1994 to 2008, this paper explores the effects of exchange rate changes on the performance of Chinese foreign investments by comparisons between the annual returns and standard deviations in local currencies and in Chinese RMB. The findings indicate that the overall exchange rate effects were negative over the sample period, suggesting the urgent need to hedge the exchange risk.

articleTitle: On the Risk Control in Enterprise Technology Innovation Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the present study, the developing history of enterprise technology innovation was briefly described and analyzed. The risk factors of enterprise technology innovation and the risk control solutions in the process of enterprise technology innovation were briefly summarized. Taking the bankruptcy of Enron Company as example, the achievements of Enron Company in enterprise technology innovation and the reason for the final bankruptcy were presented.

articleTitle: Dynamical Mechanism of Incubator Industrial Base Based on Secondary Incubating
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the functionality of incubator industrial base and the secondary incubation progress based on the definition of secondary incubator. And then the dynamical factors of incubator industrial base are systematically analyzed in relation to the forming and developing stages of incubator industrial base. At last it builds a model of dynamical mechanism of incubator industrial base, and moreover, the dynamical mechanism is further researched.

articleTitle: Material Requirement Batch Model for Process Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Material requirement planning systems for process enterprises are relatively underdeveloped in China. The current models for material requirement calculations do not accurately reflect the batch-wise nature of these enterprises. In this work, we proposed an effective material requirement calculation model. We analyzed the methods and principles of the batch division of materials on the basis of the characteristics of process enterprises, and then analyzed typical manufacturing processes in these enterprises and considered the formation of batches during the processes. Finally, we proposed a material requirement batch model for process enterprises and described the calculations of actual production volumes, material requirements in a manufacturing procedure and volume requirements of different batches of materials. Our experimental study shows that this model is a new and effective solution in the calculation of material requirements for process enterprises.

articleTitle: The Economic and Non-Economic Benefits of the World Game 2009 in Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The World Game 2009 has been the first mega sport event hosted by Taiwan. The public is concerned about the economic and noneconomic benefits contributed by this game. This paper analyzed its economic benefits by investigating the total amount of spending made by foreign tourists; foreign tourists' perception toward the game was examined to understand the noneconomic benefits of this game. The government is recommended to pay more attention to the post use of sport venues.

articleTitle: Liquidity Risk of Stock-Based Pledge Loans for Inventory Financing with Structural Break
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Using nonparametric ICSS algorithm to detect structural breaks of volatility, the author has made research on structural breaks and liquidity risk models and provides a detailed comparative analysis of effects on ratio of stock-based pledge loans for inventory financing under structural breaks among different holding periods and different risk models by taking China eastern silk market as research object. The author draws two conclusions. Firstly, VaR model added liquidity risk can measure the aggregate risk more precisely for stock-based pledge. The greater liquidity risk that account for aggregate risks, the shorter period that inventories are held, vice versa. Secondly, significant structural breaks for volatility and liquidity risk existing in inventories commodity market cannot be ignored. These models added the liquidity risk can measure more precisely market risk, liquidity risk and the ratio of stock-based pledge loans.

articleTitle: China Should Cope with a New Tariff Correctly: Carbon Tariff
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: "Carbon tariff" is a new kind of international trade tariff, which appears after countries have participated in the activity of reducing the discharge of greenhouse gases under the situation of global warming. The direct meaning of "carbon tariff" refers to impose particular carbon dioxide discharge tariff on the import of high-energy consuming materials. However, "carbon tariff" has other deeper meanings for the imbalances of technology and capital existing in carbon discharge and carbon neutralization among countries. We should realize the necessity of carbon tariff scientifically and objectively, raise awareness intellectually, draw on the experiences of foreign carbon tariff collection, obey WTO rules, seriously analyze the practicability of the national carbon tariff collection, make analyses and researches on the range, program, form, tariff type and tariff rate of carbon tariff collection and establish a carbon tariff system in accordance with the actual situation of our country so as to deal with the carbon tariff problems in the national trade.

articleTitle: Analysis on Concept, Indentification and Key Management Elements of Bank Reputation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Managing the reputation risk is a challenge for banks. Viewed from present research current situation, there is little research on reputaton risk.This article embarks from risk management theory, discusses the concept of reputation and it's risk ,indentify the eight sources of risk, and provide with the six key management elements about how to deal with reputation risk.

articleTitle: Separation of Network from Service Provision
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Technological advancements and innovations have changed the market and services structure of telecommunications industry drastically. The market structure is vertically integrated but technological advancements are dragging the markets towards more horizontally integrated value chain structures. Services will be completely separated from access.It is not for the network owner to decide what services should or should not be allowed on the network. Undergoing of different degree of separation in the European Union is the starting of the trend of vertical disintegration.The paper uses recent practical evidence and theoretical reason to illustrate the such changes in telecommunications. Recognizing the future trend is helpful to make proper polices to solve the difficulties in the course of the separation.And all players need to re-evaluate their strategies and market positions and make hard decisions as to where to go next.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Correlation between Business Cycle and M&A
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper, devoted to analyzing the relationship between the business cycle and M&A in empirical way, shows that the M&A presents cyclical changes with a causal and synchronic relation with the business cycle. The study here also demonstrates that M&A enjoys the faint correlation and synchronization with production index, while significant correlation and synchronization with stock price and interest rate, that is, M&A interacts hot with financial indicators' movement, which provides some guidance for M&A concerned policies.

articleTitle: Effect of Environmental Management Measures on International Trade and Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Environmental management measures are commonly used in international trade. Though they may have some restricting effects on export trade volume in short run, they can stimulate environmentally sound technology innovation in the long run. The innovation offset trigged by stringent environmental regulations will improve the firms international competitiveness.

articleTitle: Improvements to the Legal Environment and a Proposed Regulation for the Promotion of the Construction Project Insurance in Hangzhou
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, the existing law environment of the construction project insurance in China was firstly analyzed. Suggestions on improvements to the present laws were then made. Furthermore, a trial regulation of the construction project insurance in Hangzhou City of China was proposed.

articleTitle: An Empirical Examination of Enterprise Nature, Unit Value and Industrial Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article presents an empirical analysis of China's apparel industry and re-examine the evaluation of industrial international competitiveness in terms of enterprise nature and unit value. Making comparisons among contributions of enterprises from different nature and apparel unit values from top five countries (redions) in global export, this article comes to the conclution: Given in-depth investgation of the enterprise nature and unit value, the conventional analysis using "nationality" as a indicator is not rigorous. The great advantages in production links enjoyed by China's apparel industry owe in large part to "foreign enterprises of three kinds". Even in the territory of China, the unit value of apparel exported from foreign-invested enterprises is higher than that of China's domestic apparel enterprises. China's apperal industry is really uncompetitive.

articleTitle: Research on the Accountability System for Government Investment Projects Based on SCP Paradigm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China is in its flourishing period of government investment project at present. However, the utilization ratio of government investment is not very satisfying. The purpose of this paper is to create and analyze a feasible accountability system in order to ensure better performance of government investment projects. In this study, an accountability system is created on the basis of SCP paradigm. The criteria of responsibility attribution (S and C) can be abstracted and listed according to relevant regulations and laws and project contracts, and attributing responsibility or not can be determined by the performance of government investment project (P). Then responsibilities can be attributed according to backward SCP paradigm. The findings indicate that the result of responsibility attribution is either any stakeholder's illegal conduct or the defect in the institutional arrangement and different measures should be taken under different situation.

articleTitle: The Research of Hinders on Development of Virtual Team
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We investigated the context of teleworking as well as the reasons that prevented it from further developing. We also explained why these reasons are responsible for the fact that our interest has been switched from teleworking to virtual teams after the mid-90's. The last part was dedicated to the factors regarded as responsible for the limited performance of virtual teams. We also enumerated the ways in which these factors can be transcended or at least lessened.

articleTitle: Different Effects of Monetary Policy among Enterprises with Different Ownerships in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: If the effects of a unified monetary policy are different on the enterprises with different ownerships, the difficulty for the central bank policy to control the monetary policy accurately will be enhanced, thus affect the effects of macro-control. Based on Vector Auto-Regression (VAR) model, this paper applied the impulse response function to empirically test the ultimate impact of China's monetary policy on the enterprises with different ownerships by EVIEWS statistical software. The results show that, under the unified monetary policy, there exists an obvious difference in the effects on the state-owned enterprises, foreign-funded enterprises and other non-state-owned enterprises. During the period of China's economic transition, enterprises with different ownerships are facing different market environment, which makes them have different constraints, thus the different monetary policy transmission mechanism mainly causes the formation of different monetary policy effects. In order to improve the effectiveness of monetary policy, in the long run, we should try better to promote the market-oriented reform of state-owned commercial banks and state-owned enterprises. In the short run, the flexibility of the monetary policy instruments and monetary policy regulation and control should be enhanced.

articleTitle: The Construction of Evaluation System of Internal Control Based on the Objective and Empirical Test
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, China's government is developing the evaluation of internal control in the listed companies.
