In order to ensure the effectiveness of the evaluation results and save the costs of the evaluation, the author tries to construct an evaluation system based on the realization level of control objectives. By testing a sample of 94 commercial enterprises listed on Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Exchange, the empirical results prove the reliability and validity of the evaluation system.

articleTitle: The Value-Relevance of R&D Expenditure: Experience from China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper investigates the value-relevance of research and development (R&D) expenditures in China for the first time by using a sample of all Chinese listing companies' data, the results indicate that R&D expenditure can bring future benefits in Chinese companies, but the stock market can not evaluate the R&D investment very well. Based on the results, the paper especially suggests that the future research of R&D problems should consider industry as an important factor, and the managers may use the new accounting standard of capitalizing R&D expenditure as a new method for earning management.

articleTitle: City Innovative Capability Prediction Based on Support Vector Machine: Taking Thirteen Chinese Cities as the Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: City innovative capability analysis and prediction play an important role in regional innovation systems development and improve benefit of innovative capability for country. According to the city innovative capability data which is large scale and imbalance, this paper presented a support vector machine model to predict city innovative capability. The method was compared with artificial neural network, decision tree, logistic regression and naive Bayesian classifier regarding city innovative capability prediction for thirteen Chinese cities. It is found that the method has the best accuracy rate, hit rate, covering rate and lift coefficient, and provides an effective measurement for city innovative capability classification and prediction.

articleTitle: The Remain Life Research of Ventilator System Based on Failure Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Coal mine safety is the keystone of the industry safety in our country, in which area, ventilation system is the basis to control the hazards such as gas explosion. Ventilator system is an important part of ventilation system, which can be seen as cold standby system, also is markov repairable system. Here we discussed and calculated the reliability and remain life probability of ventilator system with reliability theory, such as time homogeneous process etc.. The indexes we discessed are the key measuring index of markov repairable system. Finally a case study results showed the approaches we research on is significative and feasible.

articleTitle: A Novel Analysis Model for Project Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Risk management of engineering project is a complicated uncertainty problem. Based on the theory of set pair analysis (SPA), stochastic simulation of triangular fuzzy numbers, herein, a novel analysis model for the project risk management was discussed. A concept of multi-element connection number of the set pair was introduced to express the hierarchy and fuzziness of membership between the evaluation indexes and risk classification standard of risk factor. Moreover, the triangular fuzzy number simulated by Monte-Carlo method was presented to depict the changing process and fuzziness of component coefficients of discrepancy degree. The predicted risk grade of risk factor and corresponding confidence degree are used to select the risk grade of risk factor according to maximum subordination principle. Combined with the weight of each risk factor, the integrated risk degree was calculated to assess the risk grade of engineering project. Finally, a practical example was described to confirm and to compare with the extension method. The results show that the proposed model is more feasible and easy to operate, and the result is good.

articleTitle: Exploration of Five-Star Hotel's HRM in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As a leading company of the hotel industry, five-star hotel embodies the world's most advanced standards in every respect, it can be said that all the details are very important for a five-star hotel manager, there are different operating concepts in the management of Chinese and five-star hotels abroad under different cultural backgrounds, which causes the differences in business ideas, service standards, brand building, and which determines the differences in management mode between Chinese and five-star hotel abroad. So HRM is always a worthwhile exploring problem, which is the most important, variable and difficult to grasp. However what kind of HRM model should be China's needs? and what are the implications that Chinese can get from the foreign well-known five-star hotel group's human resources management model? To solve these problems, this paper proposes constructive suggestions of China's five-star hotel human resources management, based on the comparison of the model features of five-star hotel abroad human resources management, the present situation of China's five-star hotel human resources management and drawing on foreign scientific management methods and management experience.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Causes and Effects of the Global Financial Crisis and Lessons Learned
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Global Financial Crisis since August 2007 was triggered by actual and prospective credit losses on US mortgages. US economy suffered heavy losses in the crisis. Meanwhile the slump on US economy led to a chain reaction all around the world. The recent sharp increases in subprime mortgage loan delinquencies and in the number of homes entering foreclosure raised important economic, social, and regulatory issues. This paper aims to analyze the causes and effects of subprime crisis and also indicate the lessons could be learnt from that. It is divided into five sections. First, a brief introduction of the mortgage crisis is presented. Second, We synthesized the relevant factors which have caused the crisis. Third, we summarized the impacts of subprime mortgage on financial markets. Fourth, we listed several lessons could be learnt from the mortgage crisis. Fifth, the responses from governments and financial institutions are illustrated. Sixth, we recommended some further actions should be taken by the authorities.

articleTitle: How to Assess Patent Values in Patent Infringement Lawsuits?
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study illustrated the procedure to assess patent values, especially for the damage award of a patent infringement lawsuit. 65 effective samples of infringement lawsuits were extracted from 4,289 US patent related lawsuits. 17 patent indicators were summarized to describe quantitative dimensions of a patent. 9 extracted factors were generated from the 17 patent indicators by Factor Analysis. The Multi- Regression Analysis was applied to find 6 selected factors which having higher influence to the damage award. The Extension Neural Network was applied to construct the valuation model, wherein the 6 selected factors were the input variables and the damage award was the output variable. The proposed valuation model was validated to have the predictive power by error analysis.

articleTitle: Classification of Rock Mass in West Route of South-to-North Water Transfer Project Based on Penetrating Rate of TBM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to study the geological factors which impact penetrating rate of TBM, three-dimensional discrete element model 3DEC was used to build simulated models on rock fragment by TBM cutter. The influence of different geological conditions on TBM penetrating rate was analyzed. The surrounding rock in west route of South-to-North Transfer Project was classified according to the drill ability of TBM in surrounding rock. The results show that the penetrating rate of TBM is closely related to the mechanical properties of rock and joint conditions in rock mass. The another result is that the surrounding rock in west route of South-to-North Transfer Project can be divided into 3 classes base on the drill ability of TBM in surrounding rock. A guiding effect was act on the penetrating of TBM in west route of South-to-North Transfer Project.

articleTitle: How Customer Participation Affect Electronic Perceived Service Quality?-An Exploratory Research
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Employing survey method on internet consumer, this article finds internet consumer's participation, especially behaviorally and affectively, significantly affects electronic service perceived quality. However, personality participation, another important factor, doesn't fit our data set and has no significant impact on perceived quality.

articleTitle: Research on Institutional Innovations in Control of Soil Pollution by Heavy Metal in Zhejiang
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With rapid development of economy, the heavy metal pollution in soil has been a serious environmental problem in Zhejiang. The typical events of heavy metal pollution happened in Taizhou, Changxing, Fuyang & Ningbo. Under background of environmental law, environmental taxes, remediation & development of Brownfield and environmental labeling, etc, the research focuses on the situation of heavy metal pollution in soil in Zhejiang and puts forwards six institutional innovations in control of heavy metal pollution in soil. The institutional system will repress the trends of heavy metal pollution in soil with clarifying the liability of pollution & solving the remediation fund. At last the quality of soil will be improved and the safety of farm products will be guaranteed, which will be important to promote ecological civilization in Zhejiang.

articleTitle: The Application of the Post-Relational Database in Digital Library
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For the present situation that many heterogeneous data exist in the digital library, the limitations of traditional relational database is present in this paper, starting from the work theory and access data model, the question of using Cache to solve heterogeneous data in the digital database is discussed. And it is introduced that how to use CSP to develop one Cache based digital library.

articleTitle: Empirical Study of the Effect of Knowledge Types on Knowledge Transfer from Parent Company to the Subsidiaries in Multinational Corporations
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The multinational corporations' cross-cultural, cross-system and cross-country management characteristics bring up its unique knowledge structure and knowledge system. When the different types of knowledge are transferred from parent company to the subsidiaries, the effectiveness of transfer is affected by different factors. We use structural equation modeling to analyze data from 103 subsidiaries in China. The results show that the effect of knowledge types on the relationship between causal ambiguity and knowledge application, and between causal ambiguity and satisfactory are significant. But the effect of knowledge types on the relationship between absorptive capacity and the effectiveness of knowledge transfer, and between absorptive capacity and causal ambiguity are insignificant.

articleTitle: Discussion on Personnel Assignment System for Promoting Scientific and Technical Personnel Innovation in China's Universities
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is closely related between innovation ability of scientific and technical personnel in universities and personnel assignment system of scientific research in universities. The paper analyzes the disadvantages of personnel assignment system that restricts scientific and technical personnel innovation in China's universities, namely insufficiency of direction in personnel management system, insufficiency of scientificalness in talents selections system, inefficiency of rationality of benefit allocation system etc. Thereby, based on these disadvantages, the paper tries to construct a new personnel assignment system for promoting scientific and technical personnel innovation in China's universities, that is, to care for their sound mind and body, to concern about their material requirement and to pay close attention to their spiritual demand.

articleTitle: SMEs' Ruler Credit and Enterprise Alliance Strategy: A Social Capital Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Small and medium enterprises (SMEs) have begun to play an active role in modern economy. Researchers know that Enterprises' social capital is useful for their performance, but very little is known about this relation in SMEs. Using data from an empirical study of SMEs, we devise a research of SMEs' entrepreneur credit and enterprise alliance strategy. These findings and their implications are discussed: SMEs'ruler credit merit enterprise alliance strategy; SMEs' scale, district area and industrial field affect relation of SMEs'ruler credit and enterprise alliance strategy.

articleTitle: A Research on the Relationship between Innovation Environment, Industry Environment and Transformational Performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Organizational environment is closely related to organizational performance. This study tries to verify the relationship between innovation environment, industry environment and transformational performance via multilevel organizational behavioral questionnaires. The result points out that good innovation environment and industry environment have remarkably positive effect on transformational performance, and the result farther indicates that internal innovation system and the growth of industry are the most important factors of innovation environment and industry environment.

articleTitle: An Analytic Network Process Model for Engineering Device Procurement Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The ANP method is used in this paper to evaluate engineering device procurement. The evaluation criteria are given, their control hierarchy is built and weights are calculated. The evaluation can be carried out in four perspectives: the requirements, the finance, the supplier and the procurement procedure. The weights can be used in a semi-automatic evaluation process in which a group of dropdown lists is to be selected and the final evaluation score is the addition of the weighted score. The weight calculation is carried out in Excel and the evaluation can be carried out manually or in software.

articleTitle: The Key Factors Affecting Supply Chain Risk Towards Emergencies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Facing the increasingly frequent emergencies, how to establish the coping mechanisms and management strategies of supply chain system has been becoming an important problem to be solved urgently. In this paper, the system analysis method was used to study the five aspects of supply chain risk, such as supply risk, demand risk, market risk, production risk and the conventional risk caused by emergencies. The analysis framework of supply chain risk towards emergencies was proposed and the risk events affecting the emergency supply chain was analyzed. At last, the key factors were recognized and the index system of supply chain risk towards emergencies was build. This research would lay a foundation for quantitative analysis of risk assessment on emergency supply chain and provide a new perspective.

articleTitle: A Study of Enterprise Independent Innovation and Multi-Element Financing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Government, business and financial systems all have an impact on capacity of independent innovation. Accordingly, build a Multi-element Funding model and test model's validity. Use artificial neural network model to evaluate and predicate the capability of independent innovation. It should consolidate the dominant position of enterprise independent innovation, strengthening the government's guiding role and encourage financial institutions and other external investors through the formulation of relevant policies.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on Interregional Technology Diffusion Channels in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on the Reputation Effect of Construction Agent List under Incompletion Competition Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Selection method of construction agent is the crucial issue in the implementation process of agent construction system in China. At present, selecting construction agent by public tendering appears weaknesses due to the restrictions that brought from imperfect competition in construction agent market. Some domestic regions introduced construction agent list to select construction agent, which can make up the above problems. Construction agent list can promote trust and cooperation between the Government and construction agent, and can incentive construction agent to reduce transaction costs. This paper introduces the reputation effect to establish reputation-based effect construction agent list through the reputation measurement and the analysis of information disclosure, to guide the various regions of the establishment and dynamic management of construction agent list.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Research and Application on the Control of Construction Project Delay Based on Value-Based Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Evaluation Model on Increase Coefficient of Degree of Risk about Debris Flow Ditches after the Wenchuan Earthquake
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Wenchuan Earthquake has not only induced a great deal of collapse and landslide immediately, but also reduced intensity of rock and soil mass in drainage basin, which makes them more liable to be eroded, so that abundant solid matter is provided for formation of debris flow. Activity of debris flow is frequent in disaster area after the earthquake, and great losses have been caused. Evaluation on degree of risk of debris flow ditches is necessary condition for post-disaster reconstruction. Research of evaluation on fatalness of debris flow has acquired quiet great progress at present, and is applied extensively in practice of disaster prevention and reduction. However, rock and soil mass caused by earthquake becomes more incompact, features of barrier dam shaped by earthquake are difficult to be expressed by routine parameter, consequently method for evaluation on degree of risk of debris flow established under general conditions is confined in application of evaluation of degree of risk of debris flow in disaster area after the earthquake. Three important parameters i.e. increment of solid matter after earthquake, seismic intensity and scale of barrier dam are selected in this paper, and evaluation method on increase coefficient of degree of risk of debris flow is put forward after earthquake based on design flow of debris flow. By validation of calculation of 9 typical debris flow ditches in disaster area, increase of degree of risk of debris flow in May 12th disaster area after earthquake can be assessed by this new method rapidly and precisely.

articleTitle: The Selection Research for Beijing Macroeconomics Advanced Indexes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It combines practical data of Beijing to establish the advanced index system which can adapt to the development characters of Beijing economy. It discusses the fluctuation reasons for Beijing economy and provides reference for macroeconomics monitor and forecast. And it provides using ADF estimate method of econometrics to select advanced indexes which different from the past methods.

articleTitle: The Research of the Fire Safety Development Strategies of China under Commercial Crisis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Through analysis of some kinds of economic actions' influence to fire services of China under international commercial crisis, the main constitutes of the fire development strategies of China was analyzed in detail and presented, including the following aspects: the relationship between fire service and economy development, the fire legal system, fire basic infrastructure facilities, fire self operation, and new countryside fire services, etc. All these can be a theoretical guide for fire service construction improvement, and for guaranteeing the economy and society development for the fire forces. Also these can be a countermeasure and advice reference for boosting society's harmoniousness and steady.

articleTitle: Implementation of EAP Service Management System on Intranet
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper briefly introduces the current status of EAP service used in the world; analyzes the fundamental functions of management system of an EAP service organization; explains the hierarchical framework of a internal web-based EAP management system. Then, the paper pays more attention on implementation of the system, especially on management of the uses' role and privileges and accomplishment of the bilingual management system by tag library.

articleTitle: Study on Experimental Teaching and Management for the Engineering Undergraduates
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This Combined with actual situation of current higher education in China, this paper analyzes main influence factors for training quality of engineering undergraduates. By analyzing of a series of examples, it is pointed out that experimental teaching and management is an important part for the engineering undergraduates in teaching. Based on the theory and method of project management, the basic regularity of experimental teaching and management for the engineering undergraduates was studied. The results shows that the model of project management may definite the goal and responsibility of teaching and learning, it has positive meaning for training quality of engineering undergraduates.

articleTitle: Analysis of Two Types of Game and Cooperation Stability in Travel Agent Supply Chain System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By making a systematic analysis of two game relations in supply chain system of travel agent, non-cooperation-partial cooperation and partial cooperation-cooperation theory models are established in this paper. Based on some hypotheses, the results are put forward and analyzed. How to prove the stability of cooperation is a crucial problem. This paper discusses it with game theory.

articleTitle: Unconventional Monetary Policies Response to the Global Financial Crisis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Face the financial crisis, major central banks not only unconventionally use the traditional monetary policy tools, but also take a large number of radical unconventional monetary policy tools. This paper clarifies the differences among the various forms of unconventional monetary policy. Each country's economic and institutional circumstances are different and may require a different approach to unconventional monetary policy. The PBoC adopted moderately easy monetary policy, taking a series of flexible and effective measures to send the signal of maintaining economic growth and stabilizing market confidence. As the financial crisis ends and recovery begins around the world, central banks are under pressure to work out their exit strategy from various forms of unconventional monetary policy.

articleTitle: Fiscal Decentralization and Targeting of Antipoverty Program in Developing Countries
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We study the targeting of antipoverty program under fiscal decentralization in developing countries. Local governments become more important after fiscal decentralization, so it needs analyzing their incentives and behavior in antipoverty program delivery. In some developing countries, local governments' officials are appointed by central government, but elected by local residents in others. The difference of political systems will affect local governments' incentives and behavior, and further leads to different targeting of antipoverty program. This paper argues that large-scale antipoverty program in appointment system is better-targeting, and vice versa in election system through analyzing. Then it provides some suggestions for developing countries.

articleTitle: Study on the Moral Hazard of Developing Tourism Resources in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on information asymmetry, this paper analyzes the moral hazard of developing tourism resources in China by the principal-agent theory. It links tourism revenues to the developing compensation. To solve the moral hazard, this paper designs an incentive and restrictive mechanism. Based on the model, the problems in the development are analyzed, and proposals of improving the mechanism are proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Integration of Logistics Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Industrial integration is an effective way to upgrade the traditional industries. Chinese traditional logistics industry urgently needs upgrading and development through industrial innovation into a modern logistics industry, and further to develop industrial scale and scope of operations. Industrial integration should enhance the market competitiveness of the logistics enterprises. The integration is an important means to achieve this goal. Industrial integration includes intra-industry integration and external integration of industries, while the two approaches achieved by infiltration, cross-industry, industry consolidation and other means.

articleTitle: Effect of BOT Financing Model on Port Construction in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the reform and opening more than three decades , ports construction in China have developed quickly and have been playing a very important role in the development of domestic economy. However, with China's sustained rapid economic growth, globalization of the world economy, the deepening integration of the regional economy, the development of ports construction in China is still a long way to go. One of the major problems in the port construction and development is the problem of funds. China has made a lot of investment and financing policies in port construction, and the innovation of the port management system is gradually deepening, but the laggard port management system is ingrained for a long time. Narrow investment and financing channels, the single mode and little financing dynamics have affected the port development. How to finance and establish efficient port investment and financing system is the important problem which needs to be considered in the current port construction. According to the technology economy feature of port facilities, this paper mainly analyzes the behaviors of local government and foreign agencies, and the correlation analysis for investment effect of BOT financing model is processed from four aspects including capital, technique, management and regional development.

articleTitle: Construction of Public Service System in the Tourism Industry Cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to guide the tourism industry cluster to break away from the initial spontaneous "gather" rather than "group" status, this thesis tries to resolve the issues existing in the tourism public service system of tourism industry cluster by introducing of systems approach. Research shows that: developing tourism public service system of tourism industry cluster must use a variety fields, including Service mode, alliance pattern, Integrated Supply Chain Management, Management innovation, market mechanism, financing Environment.

articleTitle: The Influence of Rock Properties on Seismic Response of Shallow Double-Hole Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the frequent occurrence of earthquakes, which cause severe damage to some underground structure, the existing domestic and international aseismic norms about underground caverns become too briefly, which can not adapt to the development of underground tunnels in high intensity earthquake areas. Now, our aseismic study of expressway tunnel is in urgent need. Combining with the project of aseismic and shock absorption of tunnel in YALU expressway, this paper study the seismic dynamic response of the shallow double-hole highway tunnel. The research shows that: rock-level has important effect on seismic dynamic response of the double-hole tunnel; with the the improvement of rock strength and integrity , the seismic response of tunnel lining tends to decrease.

articleTitle: Select of Supply Chain Postponement Strategy Based on Products
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Previous supply chain postponement strategy research mainly focused on the optimization of inventory and lead time based on the process of products in circulation. Product orders, as the key supply chain driving factors, which reflects the characteristics of products. Therefore, on the basis of summarizing the pre-existing research findings, the suitable postponement strategies are discussed according to different products and their different stage of life cycles. The discussion is based on the supply chain which is built around the manufacturer.

articleTitle: Electric Power Industry Supply Chain Assessment and Decision-Making: An Analytic Network Process Approach
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The quality and efficiency of the supply chain is critical to the electric power industry, with the scope of this paper, supply chain assessment was considered as a multi criteria decision problem. A model aiming the usage of analytic network process (ANP) in supplier selection is developed owning to the evaluation of the relations between the supply chain criteria in a feedback systematic.

articleTitle: The Future Direction of China's Auto-Finance Development----From the Prospective of Low-Carbon Economy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the increasing trend of building a low-carbon economy, the auto-finance industry is likely to encounter potential frustrations and conflicts. How to use national legislation system to support and specify the development of the whole industry is the one of the main issues of Chinese government. The suggestion provides government for correcting the vacuums and leakages in current systems.

articleTitle: Investing Activities of Venture Capital in Japan
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Japan has paid the closest attention to American technical developments, often in order to adopt it. Japanese venture capital today is for the most part copies of American originals. But because the Japanese industrial and social context is so different form the American, the Japanese venture capital has taken on a different shape. Now although the Japanese VC industry is still a young, small industry, in another word, it shows that there is still a substantial room for further development, which makes VC still a promising industry in Japan. The paper discusses the Japanese VC history, development trend and some new operation characteristics which give us a new perspective to understand the current development of VC industry and investing activities in Japan.

articleTitle: Study of Carbon Emissions Trading Based on Options Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Carbon emissions trading is an effective way to solve the problem of greenhouse gases. The carbon trading market has experienced a fast expansion in transaction scale and become an important commodity market in the world. This paper puts forward the concept of options of carbon emissions and introduces the options into the elements of carbon emissions trading. The introduction of options theory in carbon emissions trading can effectively reduce the risks of trading, which provides new research ideas and directions for carbon emissions trading of China.

articleTitle: Management Strategy for the Official Statistics of Fixed Asset Investment in China Transportation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The reasonable, moderate scale of fixed asset investment in transportation is the important factor that influences the growth of industrial economy, and the optimal, balanced structure of fixed asset investment in transportation is the premises that increases investment benefit. And statistics of fixed asset investment in transportation is the effective means of reflecting this kind of phenomenon, relationship and operation rule. In China, transportation statistics is mainly controlled by administrative departments since they have special institution and stable source. By summarizing the demand and supply of statistical information of fixed asset investment in transportation, analyzing adaptability of index system, data quality and informatization level, management strategy and suggestion on strengthening official statistics ability are proposed which are about statistics planning, data evaluation standardization, and promotion of exchange and sharing mechanism of statistical data with furthering informatization.

articleTitle: A Game Analysis on Quality Failure of Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the bi-level supply chain of supplier and buyer, because of the product's quality failure, to optimize the supply chain, the proper quality level of the supplier and the proper appraised level and quality level of the buyer were studied. It explored the proper quality level under the symmetric and other three asymmetric circum stances respectively, the global optimization of supply chain and the local optimization of each member can be obtained concurrently.

articleTitle: Discussion on Informationized Teaching Mode of Design of Mechanisms and Machines Courses
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This essay introduces the basic connotation of the integration of information technology and courses and summarizes the common ways and strategies of the integration on the basis of analysis of the characteristics of Design of Mechanisms and Machines courses. It also elaborates on the specific implement of technology in representative teaching content and procedures of Design of Mechanisms and Machines courses including introductory class, courses experiment and knowledge unit teaching and works out an efficient informationized teaching mode of Design of Mechanisms and Machines courses.

articleTitle: The Researches on the Evaluation System of Investment Value of Listed Companies on the GEM Based on VaR
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The global financial crisis hastened the development of the Shenzhen GEM is a venture capital a key link in the chain, force the development of SME financing difficulty in resolving the issue. As a new thing, there is a higher risk of GEM. In view of the characteristics and specific risks of Growth Enterprise Market (GEM), this paper measures the market risk of 28 listed companies on the GEM by use of VaR techniques, and introduces VaR into the company's evaluation system of investment value, so it provides a set of effective evaluation method for investment value analysis of companies on Shenzhen GEM.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis of Critical Success Factors Based on NPD Projects' Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Optimal Copula Choice of Index-Related under the Financial Crisis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article focuses on the dependence of DJI and HIS under the present financial crisis, applying nonparametric kernel density estimation to fit marginal distribution, using maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) to estimate parameters of Copula and adopting different treatments of Kolmogorov-Smirrnov test to choose the best Copula among Archimedes Copulas and Mixed Clayton Copulas. The caulated outcomes show that the Mixed Clayton copula with weight value 0.61 is the optimal Archimedean copula which can illustrate the correlation between DJI and HIS. Moreover, the tail dependence analysis shows that it presents asymmetry, and lower tail's dependence is higher than upper tail's dependence. The fierce fall of DJI's return caused by financial crisis induced fiercer correlated responses on HIS's return, which shows financial crisis's negative influence is tremendous.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Effectiveness of Marketing Investment Based on Customer Equity Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A right marketing investment has a significant impact to customer equity management. By assuming the relevant conditions, this paper analyses desired rate of return, risk volatility and risk preference of marketing investment. Based on analysis of marketing investment to two customer groups, this paper further describes marketing portfolios and determines a best marketing portfolio for multiple customer groups in order to improve customer equity management.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Relationship between Network Competence and Firm Performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Select 318 manufacturing enterprises for empirical study to analyze the relationship between network competence and firm performance. The results shows: (1) firms can deal with interorganizational relationships; (2) there are multiple paths to obtain competitive advantages under network environment; (3) network learning and network power are the important semi-mediators between network competence and firm performance. The results are helpful for firms living in network environment to gain sustainable advantages.

articleTitle: Appraising Patent by Using Maximum Spanning Tree Clustering Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The value of patent right is always affected by multiple and complex factors at various degrees. Traditional appraisal methods usually only take few and simple factors into account, therefore it cannot objectively reflect the value. However, fuzzy clustering method considers the weights of various factors; thus it can overcome the disadvantages of traditional methods. This article attempts to introduce Maximum Spanning Tree Clustering Method (MSTCM), which is the most commonly used method of fuzzy clustering, to the appraisal of patent right. And set a will-be-transacted Invention Patent as an example to discuses the relevant issues.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation of Investment, Ability and Application Effect in Telecom Operators' IT Support System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: IT support system is important to the telecom operators more and more under the all-service operation era, and the evaluation is a key step in the management of IT support system construction. According to the characteristic of IT support system in telecom operators, a evaluation architecture for IT support system is proposed in this paper. Moreover, the authors evaluate the IT support system of CMCC (China Mobile Communication Corporation) Guizhou company from the aspects of investment, ability and application effect. The evaluation result shows that the construction of IT support system is important to the enhanced the KPI index, reduced costs and improved work efficiency and the evaluation architecture of IT support system proposed in this paper is effective.

articleTitle: The Linkage Mechanisms between Gas Price and the Taxi Fare in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the price of gas contributes to the cost of providing taxi service, the fuel price should be a component of the fare. However, should the fare rise together with the gas price? The government and the public may not agree. Even if the fare is adjusted, the range and method of adjustment need to be examined. The authors suggest that local governments promote the use of fuel-efficient cars and gas substitutes to reduce the financial burden on the taxi company and the driver and to save consumer expenditures and to promote a cleaner city environment. Besides energy substitution, the taxi company and the driver should look to cut down on their costs rather than seeking to raise fares. The eventual adjustment should be less than the rise in gas price with contributions from every party concerned. This paper is based on analysis of the Shanghai and Hunan price linkage mechanisms in the taxi industry.

articleTitle: The Study of Economics of Information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: What is the economics of information? Many scholars study it on the base of the macro-economics or the micro-economics. This paper expounds it from the latter. So the main job of the economics of information is the information economy. The paper introduces the information economy. The paper defines the border of concept of information economy, expounds the essentials of the information economy, the features of the information economy. Finally the paper discusses the difference among the information economy, the network economy and the knowledge economy.

articleTitle: Research of Credit Sale Risk Evaluation Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on analyzing the current way of evaluating the credit risk, BP neural network (BPNN) is used in the paper. BPNN is powerful for the problem with non-linear and high dimension. A multi-class BPNN model is constructed to measure the credit sales risk. In this model, dominant factors affecting the credit sales risk are the input vectors and the credit risk is divided into five grades. Through a special data dealing process, the multi-class BPNN, trained by samples, identifies out the five grades of credit sale risk. An empirical analysis shows the proposed model is feasible and accurate.

articleTitle: Study on Inventory Control Model of Closed Loop Supply Chain for Product Growth Period
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Theory of economic order quantity was used to construct inventory control model of closed loop supply chain-economic manufacturing/remanufacturing quantity (EMQ/ERMQ) model based on product growth period. The model shows EMQ increases along with the finished product value-added rate's rise, but is not influenced by value-added rate, and ERMQ increases along with the recycling product value-added rate's rise. Moreover, it is found that the stockout quantity's rise can cause EMQ and ERMQ's rise.

articleTitle: Evaluation on Interdisciplinary Teachers' Co-Teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Interdisciplinary teachers' co-teaching is required for cultivating international-oriented talents on modern Chinese medicine. The cooperation motive of clinical teachers is to make good use of a foreign language and culture, increase the class hours so as to improve their language skills. Foreign language teachers' motive lies in getting access to scientific research projects, developing teaching ideas, and increasing the class hours. The students' satisfaction, supervisors' evaluation, time length on lesson preparation, class hours and so on are the index of evaluation on interdisciplinary co-teaching. Applying the AHP method and entropy Method in the evaluation will help the administrative staff to better grasp the situation of the teaching group, help teachers to carry on good communication, and help students to master the cross-cultural communication skills well, which is an effective way to improve teaching.

articleTitle: A Portfolio Optimization Model on Condition That Short Selling Is Not Permitted
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A new optimization model on condition that short selling is not permitted is proposed based on Markowitz's mean and variance model. This two-objective programming model can improve Markowitz's model on one side because our new model considers both profit and risk in the objective function at the same time. Finally, the algorithm to the two-objective programming model is given.

articleTitle: Studying the Modem Logistics Enterprise Knowledge Management Capabilities and Enterprise Performance Fit Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the knowledge economy era, knowledge is the strategic resources of the enterprise; knowledge management is the enterprise's strategic response to face the new situation. Level of knowledge management also becomes an important factor to affect the performance of logistics enterprise. At the same time, the relationship between knowledge management and enterprise performance is increasingly becoming a major issue of the international strategic knowledge management research. This article aims to study knowledge management of the logistics enterprise, in particular, its relation with enterprise performance. With a view to demonstrate the intrinsic relevance of logistics enterprise's knowledge management, this article enhances the positive promoting role of logistics enterprise knowledge management towards performance with a systematic view.

articleTitle: Analysis of Constructing the Public Emergency Rescue Force System Based on Fire Forces
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, both characters and problems reside in the present public emergency rescue mechanism were analyzed. According to national conditions, a new pattern of Public Emergency Rescue Force System (PERFS) is presented based on the fire forces, which has the unitized management, coordinated working style etc. Adhering to the laws, this new PERFS is leaded by the central government, and a three-levels rescue system is organized by every province, city and county accordingly, the amid is to take the advantages of the available fire forces which has united agency and a lot of experiences in many kinds of emergency rescue. The new PERFS focuses on efficiently and rapidly dealing with cases of difficult and complex disasters, accidents. And other relative groups are also provided to cooperate to achieve a united and scientific emergency rescue system.

articleTitle: The Evaluation of Business Services Innovation Capability within the Logistics Industry Cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The service innovation system of the logistics industry cluster is an open complex system composed by the elements and resources. The evaluation of business services innovation capability within the logistics industry cluster is an important aspect of the innovation system. The way of logarithmic least squares is used to calculate the judgment matrix in AHP theory, so the decision vector is decided efficiently. Using a medium-sized logistics industry cluster project as an example, the application of this method to select and evaluate partner in Matlab environment is studied. The ability to innovate will be evaluated through scientific and quantitative methods in the logistics industry cluster, a theoretical basis will be provided to search for ways to improve the innovative capability, so as to promote the healthy development of Chinese logistics industry cluster.

articleTitle: Optimal Holding Time in Telemarketing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: When a telemarketing staff or a seat calls, whether the customer will answer the phone is under uncertainty. This is a common risk faced by telemarketing companies: holding the telephone too long will bring a big lose to the company, while waiting too short won't be beneficial also. In this paper, we want to solve the problem and propose the definition optimal holding time, and then we conduct data mining in a deeper level based on a mathematical model. By analyzing specific data from an insurance agency company, we give the conclusion that the optimal holding time in telemarketing is around 20 to 40 seconds in general.

articleTitle: The Coevolution of Knowledge Sharing, Governance Mechanism and Innovation Capabilities in IT Outsourcing Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper examines the evolution of knowledge sharing, governance mechanism and innovation capabilities in IT outsourcing cooperation. Using a co-evolutionary approach, we develop a framework that shows how knowledge sharing, governance mechanism evolve. Especially, the transactional and knowledge governance both are adopted, which how impact innovation capabilities. Propositions linking the concepts are provided as guides for future empirical research.

articleTitle: Study on the Acceptance Extended Model of Virtual Items
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The awareness and acceptance of consumer on Virtual goods are the research focus in the evolution of the internet business model. The Paper based on the technology acceptance model, designs the acceptance extended model for virtual items consumption in the internet environment, uses the model to create attitudes and intentions model of consumer for virtual items, introduces structural equation model statistical methods, and does empirical testing through survey. The result reveals that in the virtual goods consumption, consumer experience and perception easy of use have a significant influence on customer perception use on network virtual items. Perception use on virtual items and consumer experience significantly affects consumer attitudes and indirectly affects the free trial virtual goods intentions. The intention of free trial has a significant impact on virtual items consumer interest.

articleTitle: Multi-Segments' Reservation Price-Based Pricing Approach for Information Goods
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The special cost structure makes pricing information goods be a difficult task. How to estimate the reservation price of information goods is the main barrier of optimal pricing. This paper presented a reservation price estimation method based on fuzzy cognitive map, and then an optimal pricing model is built on the basis of multi-segment's reservation price.

articleTitle: Research on the Problems and Strategic Choices for the Development of Modern Service Industry in Nanning City
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The goal of this paper is to analyze the development status, the existing problems, and the strategic choices for the development of modern service industry in Nanning city. Firstly, we make an introduction about the overall situation of the modern service industry, and also make an analysis about the status of the modern service industry in the revenue growth in Nanning city. Then, we make a discussion about the existing problems such as that the regulatory package and policy environment are not very well, the inter structure within the service industry is irrational and the development is unbalanced, the gap of modern service industry between the urban and rural areas is big, and the high- quality staff is in shortage. Finally, we put forward the strategic routes and corresponding suggestions for the development of modern service industry in Nanning city.

articleTitle: Trend Analysis of Internal Structure of Service Industry in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The adjustment and optimization of internal structure of service industry would promote national economy with high efficiency. First, this paper analyzed the spread effects of the five internal sectors of service industry in China. Based on the analysis of current situation about internal structure of Services, we forecasted each internal sector's added values of China's service industry by using time-series trend extrapolation method and analyzed their future changes in the trend. According to the statistic and analysis, some suggestions about adjustment and optimization of internal structure of service industry would be given in order to provide rational strategy for Chinese government.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Regional Differences in Chinese Energy Consumption Based on Factor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, factor analysis of the different economic regions in Chinese energy consumption, to inspect and evaluate the differences that exist regional differences of Chinese energy consumption. The corresponding energy intensity ,share of energy consumption and energy growth rate of various regions were the main factors affecting energy consumption, These factors make an obvious difference between the various regions.

articleTitle: Grassroots Innovation and the Scoping of Related Concepts in Innovation Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Our country is a late starter in grassroots innovation research. However, grassroots innovation is the starting point of the innovation chain in our country and has become indispensable force in technological advancement and social progress. It is the foundation of the social innovation framework. Consequently innovation research has been extended to civil innovation by theoretical researchers and public administrations. However, most papers concentrate on drawing support and attention to grassroots innovation from society and government agencies and the fundamental research on Grassroots innovation is scarce. As a result, the definition of grassroots innovation and the scope of grassroots innovators are still ambiguous. This paper is dedicated to conduct a follow-up research on the definition of grassroots and its related concepts, non-job invention, grassroots innovation and grassroots innovation from innovation management and government policy making perspectives in order to provide the basis for government to create the political mechanism and social atmosphere for grassroots innovation.

articleTitle: The Mechanical Analysis of a New Multi-Channel High-Pressure Vessel
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, high-pressure vessel has been widely used in petroleum, chemical industry, aerospace, and pharmaceutical areas, and is the key equipment in these areas, and its structure increasing size, operating pressure and operating temperature getting higher and higher, and thus the design of pressure vessels have become increasingly demanding. This type of multi-channel single-cylinder high-pressure vessel is based on the structure and then put on several layers of internal and external radius slightly larger than the previous layer and the overall shape of a cylinder with a similar structure. This paper describes the basic single-layer high-pressure vessel stress-strain formula, on this basis, the special structure of this container with a great deal of research and calculation of two-tier structure of most of the derived formula and the overall general formula. Conducting theoretical analysis and formulas are pushed to the rear, this paper has conducted a simulation experiment ANSYS simulation, the establishment of single-cylinder and multi-layer cylinder model, and its results were analyzed and compared multi-layer high-pressure container must be obtained clearly superior performance, further verify the theoretical analysis and the formula is correct. the multi-channel high-pressure vessel outside the radius of the entire system should be smaller than the other containers, but also proof of its special design can save raw materials, to improve transport and storage efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the Establishment and Application of Synthetic Evaluation Index System for Ecological Park City
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is essential for the sustainable development of a city to establish a set of index system for the synthetic evaluation of ecological park city which is objective, appropriate and practical. This thesis attempts to construct a set of index system for the synthetic evaluation of ecological park city, in terms of the economic environment, ecological environment, environment protection and infrastructure. The weights of the various indices are calculated by the means of Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). The synthetic evaluation of ecological park city is evaluated by means of grey clustering. The paper concludes that the model is both scientific and practical.

articleTitle: Strategic Mode Selections in Developing Productive Service Industry on Historical Industrial Zones: Taking Shenyang as an Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development of productive service industry has a strategic significance to historical industrial zones adjusting the industrial structure and transforming the mode of economic growth. Taking Shenyang as an example, this paper analyzes the advantages of the city's productive service industry and contemporary problems, comes up with the strategic mode under different conditions, indicates its formation mechanism and the key of its implementation and enables it to provide evidence for strategic mode selections and optimizing strategic environment construction.

articleTitle: Based on Ecosystem Management Study Coastal Cities Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Coastal cities are developing rapidly in recent years, but serious broken eco-environment, irrational marine industrial structure; unsound regulations hinder marine economic development. Therefore, this paper studies the EBM (Ecosystem-based Management) and suggests improving the environment, management and marine industrial structure. These suggestions have important significance all-round coordinated and sustainable development of the environmental protection, economic growth, social communities and other aspects in coastal cities.

articleTitle: E-educational Technology in College English Education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the 30 years of reform and opening in China, the education in every field has gained and is gaining a rapid development with the help of ever-progressing technology. Meanwhile, the essential task of education reforms and the e-education development is to implement information technology in education and push the quality education forward. College English education technology is no exception. English, as an international language, is becoming more and more important. In China, its importance has already been shown very clearly. Nowadays, with the wide spread of such modern means as internet, multimedia and information technology, etc, the already popular English education is advancing with times. Electronic educational technology in college English education is mounting the teaching platform. Here, the advantages and disadvantages of adopting electronic educational technology in college English education are studied and analyzed, and some countermeasures are put forward, in the hope of benefiting and improving it.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Research of Software Project Performance Evaluation Model Based-on DEA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Evaluation on Customer Satisfaction of Hubei Unicom Wuhan Branch
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Decision-Making Model of TOT Concession Period Based on Fuzzy Stochastic Petri Net
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: TOT (transfer-operate-transfer) concession period is the core issue of project financing, but also the focal focus of contract negotiation. This paper builds risk decision-making of TOT concession period based Fuzzy Petri Net, then use Stochastic Petri Net for solving Markov process, which reflects the impact of Cash Inflow(CI) and Cash Outflow(CO) by project risk factors. It provides a new solution ideas and methods for TOT concession period.

articleTitle: Model Derivation for Implicit Debt of the Social Endowment Insurance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, the analysis of the composition parameters of the implicit debt of "middle man" and "old man", and presents an implicit pension debt of practical prediction model, then makes an empirical analysis of a region based on the data provided.

articleTitle: Research on Innovative Performance Measurement of Regional Innovation Systems in Central China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the method of DEA, this paper analyzes the innovative performance of regional innovation systems in central China, which is expected to provide a certain thought and guidance for the implementation of central China rising strategy of our country. Unlike past studies, several DEA models are applied simultaneously in this study. Moreover, the data of four years rather than one year are collected to increase information amount. Input and output variables are more carefully selected again. Some preconditions for the application of DEA approach are also considered, such as isotonicity hypothesis.

articleTitle: Study on Mobile Publishing and Its Copyright Issues in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of 3G, the popularity of smart phones, and the emergence of Mobile Internet provide, the mobile publishing has become a new digital publishing fashion after electronic publishing and web publishing. The fundamental purpose of copyright protection is to stimulate the creation, to promote the literature, art and science prosperity. But the opening and sharing are the life of the Internet, which makes contradiction between the promotion of copyright and the healthy development of the Internet. At present, one of the biggest bottlenecks that restrict the development of mobile publishing is the copyright issue. In this paper, it takes a starting point to explore the issue of copyright protection of mobile phones. Then research the mobile publishing and its characteristics, analyze the right segmentation of copyright and problems caused by them in the process of mobile publishing, identify the root causes of infringement issues, find a balance among the interests of different subjects. Finally express some opinions on the issue of mobile publishing copyrights.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Opening Geographic Data Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to provide an access method which is independent of the specific data structure and file formation, in this paper, the design and implementation of GDE(Geographic Data Engine) is discussed based on the research of geographic data modeling course. The research of GDE is the GIS applied Platform design based on geographic data modeling and data structure driving. Related theory involved GDE and design tactic have been discussed conceptually and the implementation of GDE model has been presented.

articleTitle: Risk Management for Climate Change in the World and China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Evidence shows large amount of Green House Gases (GHG) was discharged into the atmosphere during the process of industrial and agricultural production and led to global warming which affected the environment and life of mankind. This press makes GHG reduction the common responsibility of humans. This paper induces risk management into adaptation enhancement and GHG emission reduction, risk matrix is applied to classify the risk level based on which corresponding measures are put forward to cope with this problem. After analyzing the international actions, the author introduces china's measures and the remarkable achievement by data analysis from the point of economic and energy which can prove China is a responsible great power.

articleTitle: Analysis on Influencing Factors of Human Resources Localization of Multinational Corporations in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of China economy, more and more multinational corporations have been to china to develop their operations. Localization is a major problem that multinational corporations are facing in global operations. Although many scholars have already researched on it, a few of them have especially researched on the human resources localization, in particular, from the perspective of influencing factors. This paper will analyze the influencing factors of human resources localization of multinational corporations from the internal and external impacts in view of systematic theory, particularly establish a model of external factors that affect human resources localization. It has a strong theoretical significance to analyze human resources localization.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis on Control Measures of the Water Bloom in Urban Independent Lake
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Process Approach for Decoration Project Quality Control and Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents an issue of using process approach and project lifecycle to manage decoration project. It analyses the five steps such as primary decoration conceiving, technician and builder choosing and signing up contract, decoration work plan designing, material stocking and field constructing, finished product checking and accepting. By using process approach to the project flow control, the decoration project management validity and constructing quality could be ensured well.

articleTitle: The Model of Production Run Time for Products Sold with FMR Warranty in the Imperfect Production System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There exists the nonconforming product in the imperfect production process. Assuming that the percentage of the nonconforming items produced in the "in-control" state is a constant value and the percentage of the nonconforming items produced in the "out-of-control" state is a dynamic value with the process run time of "out-of-control" state. The paper focuses on the production run time for products sold with free minimal repair warranty in the imperfect production system with allowable shortages and time-varying percentage of the nonconforming products. A numerical example is provided to optimize the model, a sensitivity analysis is made to study the effects of model parameters on the production run time and to conclude that the production rate, the demand rate, the setup cost and post-sale warranty coverage period have effects on the production run time.

articleTitle: IPO Underwriting Mechanisms: A Comparison of Stand-By Underwriting and Other Methods
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There are many discussions on such IPO selling mechanisms as book-building, fixed price and auction, but there are few on such underwriting mechanisms as stand-by, best-effort and firm commitment mechanisms. With the adoption of different underwriting methods, market participants will judge the level of offering prices based on the consideration of their own benefits. Therefore offering prices may be affected by different underwriting mechanisms. The firm commitment method is widely used in many developed countries. China has adopted mainly the stand-by method. With the development of China's economy and stock market, China needs to encourage the practice of other kinds of mechanisms.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Economic Impact of Mega-Event: Based on the Case of 2008 Beijing Olympic Games
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Mega-event has received growing attention as it brings great economic benefit to the host country or city. However, Macro-economic approach is the main method used in current researches. Based on 2008 Olympic Games in China, this paper researches on both short-term and long-term Micro-economic impact of Mega-event, using event study method and trend analysis. Employing the financial data of listed company that are affected by Olympics, the research found that successful bid for the 2008 Olympic Games brought more distinct stimulating effects than the games period did, and related companies received long-term effects on profit. The conclusion is that the economic impact of Olympics is limited from the viewpoints of Micro-economy, which also fits to economic assessment of Mega-event in the case of a larger economic scale and helps to make suggestions for managers and participants of Mega-event.

articleTitle: The Research of Chinese Mess Code Based on JSP in Web Application Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Taking as a kind of cross-platform Web development technology based on Java programming language, JSP occupies a great deal of space in the global WEB development domain. Chinese mess code is a problem that we often encounter in JSP Dynamic website development process. This article analyzes the reasons of mess code in JSP Web application development and provides solution to this problem. It has practicability and easy operability.

articleTitle: Research on the Grey Econometric Model with Lags Information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper aim at developing the grey econometric model with lags information. Considering the breakpoint of the traditional econometrics model, the study gives the primary steps and constraint condition of grey econometric model with lags information. Furthermore this paper makes empirical analysis using data from a segment market, and tests the average relative error of the model. The result reveals that the grey econometric model with lags information improves the accuracy of traditional grey model.

articleTitle: An Application of a Task-Based CSCW System in Enterprise Informatization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Enterprise informatization has been put on the business agenda in the informatization process, and information technology has been widely used in businesses. CSCW systems are used in enterprise informatization in the business with branch companies distributed in a number of cities. A task-based CSCW system is introduced. the key technologies to achieve are discussed, and the CSCW system is applied to the enterprise informatization in medium-sized business. The achievement of the cooperative document editing system and the electronic white-board system used in enterprise teleconference are focusing on.

articleTitle: Research on GIS Based Scenario Planning Methods and Applications
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the concept of scenario planning, this paper focuses on the relationships between scenario planning, MCE-GIS and planning support systems. We integrate the idea of scenario planning and GIS technology, and use actual case study to verify the feasibility of this method, in order to support urban planning and urban development.

articleTitle: The Effects of Machiavellianism on Employee's Political Behavior and Career Development: The Moderating Role of Emotional Labor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The study explores the effects of Machiavellianism on political behavior and career development while emotional labor as a moderator among a sample of Chinese public servants. Our quantitative data support that Machiavellianism has positive effect on public servants' political behavior and promotes female public servants to advance up the organizational ladder, however, it hinders male public servants' career development. Moreover, emotional labor moderates the relationship between Machiavellianism and promotion times of male public servants. Corresponding implications of the results are discussed.

articleTitle: Study on Spatial and Temporal Evolution of Grey Correlation Degree between Infrastructures and Oasis City Comprehensive Scale of Xinjiang
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzed Grey Correlation Degree between infrastructures and city comprehensive scale of 22 cities in Xinjiang by Comprehensive Grey Relation Degree (CGCD) method with city date in 1978-2007. The results showed: CGCD of 22 cites belong to middle correlation and strong correlation types; Cities of strong correlation type mainly are in Economic Belt on the Northern Slop of the Tianshan Mountains, and cities of middle correlation type are in South of Xinjiang; CGCD of cities have increased gradually but less in 1997 - 2007. This article proposed some advices about improvement of Grey Correlation between infrastructure and city comprehensive scale.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Trust Building in Network Forms of Organization: An New Institutional Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis on the Construction Industry in Shaanxi Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the Granger causality theory, this paper analyses the relationship of the building industry and the gross domestic product of Shaanxi province in China , using the C-D production function concerning technology advance, this paper also establishes the production function of Shaanxi building industry and offers some advices for the building industry growing style.

articleTitle: A Modeling Framework for Virtual Exhibition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The virtual exhibition (VEx), which generally is the collaborative partnership between service partners in value chains, has shown a great market potential for it's significant low-costing, much convenience, less limitation of physical distance and time phase, and rich expressions of the contents, especially in the context of the current international financial crisis and the rapidly changing business environment. Therefore, a standard schema, for integrating and managing the VEx business processes and components, is highly required. In this paper, a modeling approach to build up a framework of the VEx will be proposed. This methodology will provide business managers or IT system designers with insights of the VEx business processes and an implemented modeling tool, which based on the generalized model suggested by the working group of the international conference on enterprise integration and modeling technology (ICEIMT).

articleTitle: Multi-Player Cooperative Game in Supply Chain: The Model and Its Solutions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There are cooperative games everywhere in supply chain. In many cases, they can be found not only between two players - upstream node and downstream node, but also among many other partners. That's why they are named as multi-player cooperative game. This paper tries to develop the existing bi-player cooperative game theory to the multi-player level, establish a universal model with general sense for multi-player cooperative game in supply chain and give out the solutions and analysis of it. Based on those preliminary studies, a reference can be provided for further complex studies.

articleTitle: TOPSIS Application for Determining Energy Solution to Ground Source Heat Pump Compound System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
