abstract: As ground source heat pump system has been widely applied, the feasibility analysis becomes more and more important. The investment, system cost, energy consumption, maintenance, equipment room area and other things, should be considered when making a decision for a ground source heat pump compound system as an energy solution. The paper applies the way of TOPSIS, which is a kind of Multi-objective analysis methods, and takes some real project for example, to evaluate some energy solution for an air-condition system to make sure the result is feasible. Comparing to the conventional method which only concerns investment and running cost, the method of TOPSIS not only insures the energy solution reasonable, but also helps to make the optimal decision.

articleTitle: Research on Poverty Reduction Performances in Rural China -- Based on an Empirical Analysis of Different Project Models
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Rural poverty reduction is highly concerned with social equality and the building of a harmonized society. Great achievements have been made for poverty reduction in rural China in the last decade. Anti-poverty investment under different project models, however, seems to have different results. By adopting quantitative approaches, and based on the field survey sample data of counties, villages and households from Gansu, Guangxi and Hubei provinces, this paper conducts an empirical analysis of the performances of anti-poverty investment of the major project models in rural China, i.e. the whole village approach, sister-region support, foreign capital investment, and relocation of farmers. Results indicate that (1) anti-poverty investment has significant influences on farmers' income, with great differences under different project models; and (2) the efficiency of poverty reduction investment and the influencing factors are different under different project models. Policy implications are proposed accordingly based on these findings.

articleTitle: High Adaptive Multiple-Encryption of Hidden Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the penetration of the Internet and the rapid development of information technology, the secure transmission of the text and image herewith gets a great deal of attention. The traditional methods of encryption can only maintain the information security. However, the information could be cracked and to proceed criminal acts by the illegal use of the relevant information. Therefore, it is necessary to apply both time-varying and information-varying of encryption/decryption methods to enhance information security.

articleTitle: Dynamic Associated Analysis of Japan's Stock Market and Exchange Rates: DCC and EGARCH Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies the relatedness and the model construction of exchange rate volatility and the Japanese stock market returns. Empirical results show that we can construct a bivariate EGARCH(1, 2) model with a dynamic conditional correlation (DCC) to analyze the relationship of exchange rate volatility and Japan's stock market returns. The average estimation value of the DCC coefficient for these two markets equals to 0.1375, this result indicates that the exchange rate volatility positively affects the Japanese stock market. Empirical result also shows that there exists an asymmetrical effect on the exchange rate and Japanese stock markets. Based on the good news and bad news of the stock market, the bivariate EGARCH(1, 2) model with a DCC has the better explanation ability compared to the bivariate GARCH(1, 1) model.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Factors Impacting the Decision-Making on Higher Education Investment by Rural Households
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The higher education investment decision-maker in rural families is a bounded rational one. The paper analysis the factors impacting the decision-making of them, founded that, the willing of the children and the prospective revenue can give a positive affection to the decision-making of higher education investment in rural families, perceived risks an reverse one. And the perceived cost based on the real cost does not affect the decision-making significantly.

articleTitle: A Study on the Business Model of Logistics Real Estate
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In these years, logistics real estate has become the new point of profit growth in logistics enterprises. As the carrier of logistics activities, it plays a vital role in improving the efficiency of logistics operations, reducing logistics costs and improving logistics enterprise's core competitiveness. In this paper, we provide some suggestions for the business model of logistics real estate in China, by analyzing its several common business model.

articleTitle: Patterns of Service Outsourcing and Economic Transformation and Upgrading in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China's economy is facing great pressure of upgrading and transformation, and an effective path is to develop service outsourcing. This paper analyzes the attributes of service outsourcing as an intermediate structure, and classifies it into two types, which include "value-created outsourcing" and "logistical support outsourcing". We investigate the function of service outsourcing to economic upgrading and transformation from three angles, which are the allocation of resources, corporate restructuring and innovation. At the end, this paper puts forwards three patterns of service outsourcing in China.

articleTitle: An Operational Mode of Virtual Enterprise Based on Self-Organization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As a new organizational paradigm that is initiated by information communication technology to adapt to global competition, virtual enterprise (VE) is viewed as one of the dominant organization modes of the firms in this century. Be rooted in Internet environment, this study aims to investigate the self-organization attribute of VE by putting forward a conceptual framework about the four-flow-integrated operational mode of VE, which describes elaborately the self-organization principle of such four flows as the transaction flow, the material flow, the cash flow, and the information flow. This study would provide some important theoretic and practical implications for the development of VE.

articleTitle: Alternative Energy, Security Constraints and the Development of Bio-Energy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the soaring of energy prices and environmental pollution brought by fossil-fuel consumption, bio-energy as a clean and sustainable energy, captures attentions of both governments and researchers. Although lots of literature discusses the effects of bio-energy policies, little studies the effects of government policy on economic growth. In this paper, we build an endogenous growth model to analyze government support for biomass energy and environmental protection, the dynamic relationship between bio-energy consumption and economic growth. From the analysis, we find that the development of bio-energy could result in a negative impact to agricultural production in a short time, but in the long run it can promote economic development. Besides, government's persistent support could increase long-term economic growth rate.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Regional Innovation Capacity of Equipment Manufacturing Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Technological Innovation Models of China's SMEs: Technological Factors, Innovation Process and Innovation Object
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the era of knowledge economy, one of the key factors to develop SMEs is technological innovation, yet mostly due to short of both capital and human resource, SMEs must encounter with various problems and difficulties when starting technological innovation. So in the paper, the author intends to provide SMEs a practical and theoretical model of technological innovation. After analysis to technological factors, process of innovation and innovation object, it becomes clear what a company shall innovate for, and how to carry out technological innovation, and who shall carry out the work. Therefore a both theoretical and practical model is brought out for SMEs so that their innovation activities may be well guided under the model.

articleTitle: The Analysis of a Model about the SME Supply Contract
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: SMEs(Small and medium-sized enterprises) have played an important role in the process of promoting economic and social development, but the small and medium-sized enterprises are often at a disadvantage in the process of trading with large enterprises because of their own conditions. Through using the dynamic equations of duplicator, giving an analysis of the game question when Small and medium-sized suppliers and customers signed contracts of cash on delivery. Educing that when suppliers and customers tend to co-operation, more contribute to the development of enterprises of both sides.

articleTitle: Dynamic Evaluation Based on Timing Sequence Multi-Index for Technological Innovation Cost
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The cost of technology innovation of enterprise will affect the decision-making of technology innovation project. The now available existing evaluation indexes of the innovation cost are simpler, and the evaluation system is incomplete. Based on the cost structure, innovation efficiency and benefit, innovation cost risk and financial risk, this article constructs the innovation cost appraisal index system, and uses the dynamic fuzzy evaluation method based on timing sequence multi-index to build the evaluation model, and applies this evaluation method to evaluate the change states of some project. The new indexes system reflects the relativity and foresee ability of the indexes used, and can reasonable evaluate the risk of technological innovation project. It gives a whole and dynamic evaluation for the rationality and availability of technological innovation cost.

articleTitle: A Comparison of Analysis Methods of Pipe Failure Characteristics Based on Maintenance Records of Water Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The characteristic data applied for establishing predicting models of pipe failure in water distribution system (WDS) should be examined and screened in the first place. The effects of different way of data processing based on a series on maintenance records are compared, which includes a classification method by Bayesian theorem, a hypothesis testing by analysis of variance and an association rule of data mining. The result shows the Bayesian theorem is applicable for nonparametric analysis, and can give classification limits intuitively. But this method may neglect the relations between different variates and effects. It's proper to adopt this method when there are few pipe characteristics available. The analysis of variance (ANOVA) is able to point out the interaction of variates and deal with both parametric and nonparametric tests. The association rule can provide correlations between different attributes, but may also bring excessive and nonsense results and it appears that more detailed records are required to make use of this method. It is suggested that the data should be carefully examined in appropriate method before applied to a model.

articleTitle: "Co-Production and Co-Marketing" Management System for Rural Residential Energy-Saving Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the social contexts such as urbanization and low-carbon economy, a management system named "co-production and Co-marketing" is put forward in this thesis. Industry operation, the main forms of which are farmers and enterprises, combined production of enterprises and co-marketing industry, is explored to promote residential energy-saving and industrial development in rural areas.

articleTitle: The Review of the Emotional Contagion Theory Based on the Interpersonal Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It has long been noted that emotions appear to be contagious, but until only recently the theory has been more thoroughly examined. In this study, the authors go through the whole theory based on the interpersonal perspective, discussing the mechanism of the emotional contagion, emotional contagion scale, the method of obtaining emotional contagion and the implementation of the theory. This paper tries to present a guideline for people who may interest in the emotional contagion what is the emotional contagion and how is should be. Through the analysis, the authors also give an discussion about the future development of emotional contagion in the service management.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization in Construction Site Layout
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Construction site layout is multi-objective optimization (MOO) problem. However, the previous researchers treated site layout as a single objective optimization problem, which is far away from the reality. In this study, site layout was treated as MOO problem. The two objective functions are minimizing the likelihood of accidents happened and total handling cost of interaction flows between the facilities. The modified Pareto-based ant colony optimization (ACO) algorithm was proposed to solve site layout problem. Moreover, fuzzy rule-based system was used to quantify the interaction flows. Finally, a case of office building was used to evaluate the modified Pareto-based ACO algorithm for solving MOO site layout problem. The results showed the feasibility and effectiveness of the modified Pareto-based ACO algorithm to solve MOO site layout problem.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Production Management Capacity Courses Group Based on BSC
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The construction of courses group which appears recently in the courses construction practice of institutions of higher learning is a new curriculum development technique. Starting from construction of course groups of our college and actual of the reform, this paper summarizes our college production management capacity courses group construction' problems, as viewed from strengthening course groups construction and stressing on training of applied talents, constructs the application ideas of using the Balanced Scorecard (BSC) to implement performance management for course groups construction, and expounds the construction of production management capacity course group specific countermeasures and suggestions.

articleTitle: Exploration of the Urban Waterfront Greenway System Based on the 'Interest Gravitation'
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The thesis attempt to propose an 'Urban Waterfront Greenway System' (UWGS), in order to create a healthy, abundant and efficient life circle in urban waterfront. It aims at how to make full use of the urban waterfront, which acts as the interest origin, to guide the healthy life style at first. States the concept of 'interest gravitation', points out it is the power and emphasizing its importance in helping the waterfront to realize its aim. Then, the thesis brings forward a kind of space carrier UWGS, which can generate interest gravitation. It takes behavior habits of different people as breakthrough points, and analysis the daily activities type and demand of different people in different frequency. Furthermore, the features of UWGS can strengthen its effect of interest gravitation which can attract people along UWGS to the waterfront and the riverbank. Finally, it discusses interest gravitation facilities arrangement in UWGS.

articleTitle: On the Conceptualization of Business Models: A New Approach from Classical Paradigm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The conceptualization of business model has plunged into a dilemma of no consensus on its concept for a long time. This thesis reviews the relevant works, puts forward a proposition of abiding by microperspective and SCP paradigms in business model research, and offers some new explanations on the definition of business model and the relationship between it with those related managerial theories.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Determinants of Urban Environment Cost: Some Modification on the EKC
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Spatio-Temporal Analysis of as Element Pollution of Soil in Tongling Area
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As one of important mineral economic region in eastern China, soil heavy metal pollution has always been a hot point for research in Tongling area. This paper uses two periods' As content data of the surface soil to analyze the spatial distribution variation between different periods. It indicates that great changes of the spatial distribution of As content exist between two different periods.

articleTitle: A Positive Analysis of the Impacts of International Service Outsourcing on the Industrial Structure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzed the impacts of international service outsourcing on the industrial structure of the undertaking outsourcing country. The result indicated: by leading an adding in the GDP and employment share of the producer services and circulation services, international service outsourcing can induce the increase of the GDP and employment proportion of the service industry, and then effectively promote the optimization and upgrading of services internal structure and industrial structure among agriculture, industry and service.

articleTitle: The Fire Development Analysis of China at the Post Commercial Crisis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The global commercial crisis caused new problems and new challenges to the fire departments of China. This paper selected the parameters, which could reflect the fire development of current fire situation, including the number of fire event cases, the number of injured and died, and the direct economic losses of fire, and then using gray GM(1,1) prediction model to analysis the fire development trend of China under post commercial crisis. Results show that, under the background of sustained development of economy, the fire development situation in China will not change much in the recent future, but also fire service need to be strengthened, to further improve the ability for fire forces to serve the economy construction. This paper's conclusion can be a basis and guideline for the fire development strategy creating and real fire services.

articleTitle: Customer Maturity Model Based on Counter Propagation Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the sequential acquisition pattern and bring forward special definition of customer maturity. Also, we provide a new method to calculate the value of customer maturity based on logistic regression. Through investigating the relation between the customer maturity and demographic data, we propose a model to predict customer maturity based on the Counter Propagation Network.

articleTitle: Study on Biomedical Risk Management of Benzene-Alcohol Extractives of Bamboo Leaves
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Bamboo leaves has been used to heal some diseases in the Chinese Folk for a long time. In order to explore the wide biomedicine utilization, the determination of the chemical components of benzene-alcohol extractives from the fresh Phyllostachys pubescens leaves was made by using Py-GC/MS. The results indicated that the main components were 1,3-Butadiene, 2-methyl-, 1-Phenanthrenecarboxylic acid, 1,2,3,4,4a,9,10,10a-octahydro-1,4a-dimethyl-7-(1-methylethyl)-, 1-Hexadecene, 1-Butene, Propene, 1-Pentene, 4-methyl-, 1-Pentene, 2-methyl-, Bicyclo[3.1.1]heptane,2,6,6-trimethyl-, Stigmastan-3,5-diene, Nonacosane, 1-Docosene, 1,3-Cyclohexadiene, Tetracosane, Toluene, Heptacosane, 1-chloro-, 1-Heptene, 2-isohexyl-6-methyl-, Stigmast-4-en-3-one, Hexacosanoic acid, methyl ester, Sulfide, bis(2-cyano-3,4-dihydro-2,3,3-trimethyl-2H-pyrrol-5-yl)-, etc. So the benzene-alcohol extractives of Phyllostachys pubescens leaves could be used as rare biomedicines.

articleTitle: Study on Risks and Precautions of Enterprises' R&D Outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: R&D outsourcing is another management form which can relieve enterprises from complexly daily activities and strengthen enterprises' competitiveness with the exception of human resources outsourcing and financial outsourcing. However, there are great risks involved in R&D outsourcing. The paper aimed at determining key risks of R&D outsourcing and making countermeasures for avoiding them. The paper, based on the concept and connotation of R&D outsourcing, analyzed risks during outsourcing at a strategic level and concluded that risks of R&D outsourcing should focus on risk of business strategic analysis, risk of decision-making on R&D outsourcing, risk of selection and management of service provider and risk of performance evaluation on R&D outsourcing. Finally the paper proposed preventive measure against the risks.

articleTitle: Optimal Deployment of Regional Multi-Objective Water Resources Based on Mixed Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the theory of large scale system general optimization, a model for optimal deployment of regional water resources with multi-sources and multi-consumers was developed. A new nonlinear integrated objective function was introduced in the model, which synthetically takes economic benefit, expense of water usage and water resource's equilibrium distribution into account.With the restriction of water demand and supply, polluntant emission, harmonious development ,the objective function optimal value was calculated by mixed genetic algorithm. The model was applied to water resource deployment in Fenhe River basin. The results show that water demand can meet requirement at different guarantee rate.It indicate that the model can increase obviously the economic benefit and provide a scientific and balanced decision for future water deployment.

articleTitle: The Evolution of Marketing Capability Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper roundly teases the theoretical foundation of marketing capability based on the angle of evolution. It proposes that marketing capability theory is gradually cognized and utilized based on resource and competence theories. As a conclusion, it indicates that although marketing capability theory has drawn lots of scholar's attentions, the existing studies are short of enough recognitions and researches on such capability.

articleTitle: On Analysis of Brittleness and Toughness of Business's Organization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is common that they go bankruptcy because of a little disturbance emerged in the business inside and outside. It is found that main reasons are the business organization itself has brittleness though analyzing. Brittleness and toughness of the business organization refers to the ability to resist the attack shown after the business affected by the external environmental changes, and are the basic properties of the business organization, the former will lead to the business to breakdown, the latter will make the business develop in a higher level, the two are opposite and supplementary to each. The article deeply analyzes the nature of the business organization's brittleness, differences, reasons formed, as well as measurement. Finally, the article suggests the business should strengthen prevention and treatment in order to minimize the occurrence of the business organization's brittleness and increase their toughness.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis of Accidents in Coal Mines--The Case of Kenbo Mining Flooding Accident
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper aims to highlight the significance of the risk management in coal mines and identify the expositions of risk management and risk analysis for hazards. Flooding accident is one of the five natural disasters in coal mines which have caused social and economic benefits of the huge losses. Therefore, authors have presented the Kenbo Mining flooding accident as the case study to analyze the risk of it. On account of the characteristics of the hazard, the risk management model and precautions were proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Real Contagion Mechanism of Financial Crisis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: American subprime mortgage crisis has evolved into the global financial crisis. In order to reduce impact of the U.S. financial crisis on the world economy, this paper uses systematic method to analyze the real contagion mechanism of financial crisis. The results show that competitive effect, income effect, effect of cheap imports and competitive devaluation effect are main influencing factors. Conclusion can be made that real contagion can be controlled when measures are taken.

articleTitle: A New Secure E-Impeachment Scheme with No Trusted Center
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, a new secure electronic impeachment scheme with no trusted center is proposed. The scheme allows the whistleblower to impeach anonymously, but the real identity of the whistleblower is traceable. There is a jury composed of legal experts in our scheme to settle the dispute between the anti-corruption and whistleblower .No one can find out the real identity of the whistleblower without more than half of the members in the jury's help. Our scheme also allows the citizens to supervise the work of the anti-corruption bureau on net.

articleTitle: The Difficulties and Path Selection of China's E-Government Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The e-government performance evaluation is an important means to monitor and to manage the process of e-government construction. Carrying out scientific e-government performance evaluation and management and establishing the whole process of e-government evaluation system and operational procedures are effective measures to improve e-government performance and governmental image. By analyzing the content and significance of e-government performance evaluation, this paper discusses China's current difficulties about the lag of regulation and working mechanism in e-government performance evaluation and puts forward some suggestions, such as improving the lag of regulation and working mechanism, building the incentive and restraint mechanisms associated with e-government performance evaluation gradually and avoiding the risks of e-government performance evaluation.

articleTitle: Study on Economic Development Difference of Guangxi Beibu Gulf Intra-county Economic Regions with Grey Relational Synthetic Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The study of Intra-county Economic Development in Guangxi Beibu Gulf Economic Regions has both theoretical and practical significance. With construction of index evaluation system and application of grey relational synthetic evaluation, assessment and comparison on development of Guangxi Beibu Gulf Economic Region has been conducted. The research shows that economic development of intra-county region of Guangxi Beibu Gulf Economic Region is imbalanced in 'four groups'. At the same time, the suggestion in shortening the imbalance difference of Leading Group, Challenging Group, Catching-up Group and Backward Group is emerging.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Analysis on the Coordinated Development of Regional Science & Technology and Economy System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, the coordinated development evaluation index system and model of regional Science&Technology and economy system have been put forward. At the same time, for example of Heilongjiang province, the development status of Science&Technology and economy system in Heilongjiang province has been evaluated. Finally, some advices have been given based on the demonstration research.

articleTitle: Study on Target System of Engineering Project Based on Construction Reliability
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to target system of engineering project, the definition of construction reliability of engineering project was proposed that was the ability of safely getting required project quality under restrictive conditions of time and cost in process of engineering construction. In the light of compositionality and hierarchy of construction system, pyramid model was built and based on BDD algorithm, disjointed minimal path set method was introduced to calculate construction reliability. The result provides theoretical basis for later research on construction project target optimization and it is useful try for the combination of system reliability and project management.

articleTitle: On Digital Archives Management and Service System Based on Web 2.0
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper, from the perspective of concept, characteristics and architecture of both web2.0 and digital archives, analyses the basic architecture, feasibility, necessity and roles of web2.0 applied in digital archives service and management, and then proposes the application approaches of web2.0 in the system.

articleTitle: Study on the Land Management Based on Theory of Land Potential Energy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper preliminarily discusses land potential in regional land use based on the relative factors. In terms of system, predominance in a regional land quality, land circumstance and geographical location is called regional land potential. Among these factors, the geographical location is decisive factor to land potential. Land potential will follow the law of conservation of energy, that is, the potential increasing in a region will decreasing in other regions. Drive force for the transformation of the potential comes from both the nature and the society. It conduces to carry out regional functional orientation of land use and sustainable development.

articleTitle: Parameter Estimations of the TFR Model under Gompertz Distribution at a Normal Stress
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The TFR (Tampered Failure Rate) model was Proposed by Bhattacharyya and Soejoeti (1989) for step-stress accelerated life tests. This paper point out that the strategy provided in for seeking parameter estimates under normal stresses in step-stress Completely accelerated tests using the usual regression analysis is unreasonable, and offers a method of estimating Parameters under a normal stress. For the sake of convenient expression, the paper considers simple SSALT only, but multiple SSALT can be studied similarly.

articleTitle: Effects of Leadership Behavior on Organizational Performance in Research University
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We construct a research model to investigate effects of leadership behavior on organizational performance in research university, in which leadership behavior includes three dimensions of structure, concern and development oriented leadership behavior, and organizational performance includes satisfaction, research performance and teaching performance. Hypotheses were tested using self-perceived data from new faculty of a research university. Results from the method of SEM suggest that both structure and development oriented leadership behavior positively and significantly affect organizational performance in research university.

articleTitle: Index Optimization Based on Gaussian Mixture Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article proposed a nonparametric test method by using Gaussian mixture model application idea for reference to evaluating the construction of index architecture. First use Gaussian mixture model to cluster analysis the index architecture. Second use rank correlation coefficient of nonparametric test method to select index architecture. Then determined the evaluate index architecture and guarantee the comprehensiveness and representativeness of the index architecture. The example shows that the new method is simple and practical and has high classification precision and is useful for index optimization.

articleTitle: Research on Flexibility Benefits Policy of Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Flexible benefits system in the developed countries has become more mature, but difficulties in Chinese companies' actual conditions, it has not been widely used. Analyze the flexible benefits in enterprises through research questionnaire and factor analysis method. And finally get a clear formula and a series of strategies for flexible benefits system implementation.

articleTitle: Study the Transaction of Maritime Use Right Based on Market Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to current marine industry developing fast with the unsound mechanism of the ocean management applied the western property theory to analyze the transaction mechanism of the right to use sea area. Through the analysis, this dissertation built a transaction market of the right to use sea area based on bi-level market mechanism. It revealed that the maritime market based on market mechanism could get the marine resources to the allocation with higher efficiency. The transaction mechanism of maritime based on bi-level markets has practical guidance for perfecting management in china, the transaction mechanism of the right to use sea area and developing the transaction market.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on the Relationship between Organizational Commitment and Turnover Intention of Wuhan Telecom Best Tone Center
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper regards the operators in Wuhan Telecom Best Tone centre(WHTBTC) as the research object, and the operator's organization commitment for the research contents, on the basis of existing relevant research, this paper improved the definition of organization commitment, established "Personal attribute" and "organization commitment" as influencing variables to turnover intention; by using the statistical analysis method, the impact model of organizational commitment to turnover intention about operator in WHTBTC has been built, and some management suggestions for WHTBTC has been provided.

articleTitle: The Effect on Organizational Performance by Human Resource Management Practices: Empirical Research on Chinese Manufacturing Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the literature review and questionnaire investigation, the paper analyzes the effect made by human resource management practices on organizational performance in Chinese manufacturing industry. The data of this research was collected from 28 cities in 13 provinces in China, via network by both website and electronic questionnaires. In addition, this paper discusses different emphases of human resource management according to organizational characteristics. Thus, we can help them understand the role of human resource management.

articleTitle: Formal Description of Workflow Patterns Based on Pi-Calculus
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Workflow patterns contain basic features of business process, and describe activities and their execution ordering through different constructors, which permit flow of execution control. Pi-calculus, as a kind of process algebra, can be applied in business process modeling. In this paper, we introduced a formal semantics for workflow patterns, which is based on the Pi-calculus, to investigate some workflow patterns.

articleTitle: Leveraged Lease Financing Model in Large-Scale Hydropower Projects' Equipment Financing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper firstly analyzes the methods of hydropower financing in China and the pros and cons of them based on the characteristics of China's large-scale hydropower construction. And then author proposes that leveraged lease financing model can be used in hydropower projects' equipment financing. In this paper, author describes the features of leveraged lease financing models, and elaborates how to use this model and its advantages from the perspective of both hydropower development companies and hydropower construction enterprises. On the basis of all-round analysis, this paper is to demonstrate there is ample room for the development of leveraged lease financing model and construction enterprises can take advantage of this model to seek new development opportunities for businesses.

articleTitle: The Research of Interactive Problems between Transnational Corporations' R&D Institutions and Regional Innovation System of China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The organizational structure of R&D institutions is more inclined to localize, which is bound to have some certain interactions with the main bodies of China's regional innovation system. The paper selects the relevant data of China in 2007, analyzing the interactive situations between transnational corporations' R&D institutions and the main bodies of China's regional innovation system. Summarize the factors that affect the interactions and propose some suggestions to increase the interactions between the two.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on the Book-to-Market Effect in China Stock Markets
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper shows that the book-to-market effect is existed in China stock markets by using the data from 1995 to 2008, and we have the ability to use the book-to-market ratio to predict future returns and arbitrage. Through comparing aviation enterprises with the market average level, we also find the book-to-market effect exists in aviation industry. Result shows the semi-strong form Efficient Market Hypothesis is untenable in China stock markets, and investing on value stocks can get abnormal returns.

articleTitle: Research on Event Analysis Approach for the Identification of Aircraft Large Vertical Load
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Aircraft large vertical load means the aircraft is weighted above the normal, which may harm the air safety. So it is crucial to do the research on how to choose suitable models and methods to identify whether the aircraft got a large vertical load before landing and adjust immediately. The MWW nonparametric test is used to extract the distinct features. Then, compare the most commonly used models and choose the k-nearest neighbors and support vector machines with dynamic weight consideration to classify, both of them ensure the accuracy and make sense according to the feature of the dynamic data and comparison of some classify methods. The results indicate that the two methods make no difference on this problem but the model v-SVC in support vector machine seems more adaptable when the problem expands.

articleTitle: Mining Perfectly Sporadic Rules with Two Thresholds
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A sporadic rule is an association rule which has low support but high confidence. It is divided into two types: perfectly and imperfectly sporadic rules. In this paper, we describe an efficient algorithm to mine perfectly sporadic rules by proposing a problem of mining perfectly sporadic rules with two thresholds and developing a MCPSI (mining closed perfectly sporadic itemsets) algorithm to find perfectly sporadic itemsets with two thresholds. Unlike the previous approaches, the development of MCPSI algorithm is based on the pruning of the closed itemset lattice, therefore efficiency of the algorithm can be improved via reducing a search space and removing redundant imperfectly sporadic rules with two thresholds. Experiments comparing MCPSI to Apriori-Inverse on the same databases also proved this conclusion.

articleTitle: Study on the Improved RBAC Model in E-Government
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-government is the important way to enhance the administration and the public service. By the analysis of Chinese government's organizations and positions, the paper proposes an improved RBAC model which faces the integration of various business fields in the organization. In the view of management and technology, it solves the problem of the separation between organization management and empowerment, and decrease the complexity of management. It is hoped to be referenced for the construction of E-government.

articleTitle: Mitigating Supply Chain Risks Using Flexibility Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Without a clear understanding of the benefit associated with different levels of flexibility, companies are reluctant to invest in flexibility, especially when reliable data, accurate cost and benefit analysis are difficult to obtain. In this paper, the flexibility theory and models are elaborated, then the five risk sources exist in the supply chain were pointed out, in the end measures using elasticity theory that can mitigating these risks were discussed. Our findings highlight the power of flexibility, and provide convincing arguments for deploying flexibility to mitigate supply chain risks.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Research on the Agent Loyalty of Telecommunication Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A Systematical Analysis for the Mechanism of Urban Industry Ecological Transformation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Industrial ecosystem has become the focus of urban environmental management research in a rapidly changing environment. In this paper, we explores the mechanism of urban industry ecological transformation from a systematic perspective and surveys driving force and resistance force in order to promote the formation of urban industrial ecosystem. The environment of urban industry ecological transformation is firstly presented. Then, we analyze driving forces influencing industrial ecology and point out resistance factors. It is conclude that the transformation of urban industry ecology is interaction result between various driving forces with resistance. It is a long, fuzzy and systematic engineering. So the author suggests that relevant government should take institutional mechanism innovation during the process of developing transformation strategies and related policies, and make best use of the role of dynamic mechanism to eliminate the effect of resistance factor in order to effectively create a good urban industrial ecosystem.

articleTitle: Study on Service Quality Management in Social Service Projects
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Social service project is a kind of social activity which aims to provide service and whose quality is mostly decided by service quality. Service quality, in essence, is a perception, a result after customers compare the service they have experienced with their expectation. Therefore, service quality management becomes the core of social service project management. Major approaches to improve quality management of social service project include decision making with participance, reasonable authorization to employees, self-determination of service receptor, Strengthening supervision, monitoring and control and evaluation, Service recovery in time, improving the skill of interpersonal relationship and properly handling relations with customers.

articleTitle: On Conversion and Management of Tacit Knowledge in EKM Based on the Incentive Mechanism-Buildings
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: One characteristic of the knowledge -based economy era is that knowledge has become the real and key power of development. In this era, while the enterprises are still strengthening management of the explicit knowledge, actually the tacit knowledge has become a significant and difficult problem which is more challenging in knowledge management. Due to the characteristics like individuality, strong inertia and so on, conversion of the tacit knowledge into the explicit knowledge is full of challenge. In view of the situation, this paper will provide several appropriate suggestions from the perspective of the incentive mechanism-buildings.

articleTitle: Research on Autonomous Management Pattern of Cellular Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: International Engineering Consortium predicted that cellular manufacturing would become the main production model of manufacturing enterprises in the future. In recent years, studies both at home and abroad were primarily around cellular manufacturing system design and equipment layout, while research on cellular manufacturing management pattern was relatively small. Based on elaborating the basic concepts and organizational forms of cellular manufacturing, this paper gives autonomous management models of cellular manufacturing, and proposes optimization management method, so as to expand production management theory and provide reference to cellular manufacturing enterprises.

articleTitle: Speculations on Benefits Policy of Unemployment Insurance in Chengdu City
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The large numbers of workers laid off due to the worldwide economical crisis have posed a new challenge to the unemployment insurance system in Chengdu City. Unemployment insurance benefits affects the realization of the unemployment insurance system; effective coverage provided for the unemployed; and the smooth operation and efficiency of the unemployment insurance work. The implementation and the raising of funds for unemployment insurance are to guarantee a smooth effectuation of payments of benefits. By integrating local circumstances, there are a couple of crucial points to consider when establishing the unemployment insurance system for Chengdu City: defining scope of recipients and boundaries of conditions; defining schemes and standards of benefits.

articleTitle: Study on Economic Sustainable Development in the Yangtze River Delta Region: Based on Transforming Economic Development Mode
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Yangtze River Delta region is one of the most rapid economic development areas in China. In fact, its economic growth still contains extensive features, which constrain economic sustainable development and international competition improvement of this region. Due to its inherent problems, extensive growth is unsustainable, while intensive growth contains sustainable development meaning and possesses conditions and foundation to realize sustainable development. Therefore, intensive growth is an inevitable choice for the Yangtze River Delta region to transform economic development mode. In virtue of scientific and technological progress and system innovation, starting with changing economic growth mode, adjusting and optimizing economic structure and transforming government function, a fundamental change of economic development mode and economic sustainable development will come true.

articleTitle: Studies on Innovative Mode of Chinese Folk Traditional Furniture
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The innovation and development of traditional folk furniture should not be ignored in contemporary society,if Chinese furniture moves towards the world. Based on analysis of the folk traditional furniture creative thinking on contemporary value,it proposes three kinds of innovative models CAI-based technology design innovation,furniture materials-based innovation and intermediate technology-based innovation in furniture production.

articleTitle: Human Resource Development Strategy Based on Mentoring
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Mentoring as an important measure for organization to development employees in America and other developed country has attracted lots of attention from practitioners and academic researchers in recently 30 years. In this article, the results of theoretical research of mentoring were analyzed, and a human resource development strategy model was proposed, including key points among the steps of strategy formation, strategy implementation, and strategy evaluation. This article will be helpful to make out a framework to integrate western theory and the experience of Chinese practitioners.

articleTitle: A Study on FDI's Crowd-out and Crowd-in Effect on Shanxi's Domestic Investment-Based on Panel Data Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper uses provincial panel data of Shanxi to investigate the relationship between FDI and domestic investment and make a comprehensive and systematic study of the impact of foreign direct investment on domestic investment in the region. Results show that: For the central region and Shanxi province, FDI has caused the crowding -in effect on the domestic investment.However, due to the Shanxi province, such as economic management level differences, leading to FDI on domestic investment to crowd-in effect level of Shanxi province(5.88)higher than the level of the central region(4.088).

articleTitle: Channel Competition Decision after Store Brand Introduction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper analyzes the channel competition decision under the channel structure with two symmetric manufacturers and one retailer. We reach some findings: Store brand will result in the decline of national brand wholesale price and retailing price. Store brand introduction will result in the decline of national brand profit, and the decline of imitated national brand profit is evident when store brand positions to one national brand. Store brand introduction can improve the retailer profit. Store brand positioning to one national brand is superior to positioning in the middle of two national brands.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation of Urban Environmental Infrastructure Investment Benefit
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The evaluation of urban environmental infrastructure investment benefit is the foundation of urban environmental infrastructure investment. On the basis of the urban environmental infrastructure investment and its characteristics, this paper establishes the evaluation index system and evaluates the investment benefit with the method of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation. It provides a scientific, practical and quantitative method for the systematic analysis and comprehensive evaluation of urban environmental infrastructure investment benefit.

articleTitle: Dual-Threshold Cooperative Sensing Based on Coherent MAC in Cognitive Radio
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies the detection of the primary signal under noise uncertainty. A coherent MAC (Multiple Access Control) cooperative sensing scheme is proposed, adopted dual-threshold detection determined by the noise uncertainty range. Using the one-bit hard combine make the cooperative overhead reduce from O(N) to O(1). Simulation shows that the proposed method is superior to the traditional collaborative detection method on performance.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study of 3C Streamlined Service Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Simply Research on the Knowledge Management Strategies in Product Development Cycle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Product development is the most knowledge-intensive segment in enterprises; therefore knowledge management will have a direct bearing on the efficiency of product development. Taking the entire process of product development as research object, this paper divide product development process into three cycle stages which are product conceived, product design and product implementation. According to characters of the flow of knowledge in these stages, we put forward to implement knowledge management audit strategy, knowledge map strategy and knowledge patent strategy at each stage that enable enterprises to develop high-quality products quickly and accurately to meet market needs and obtain higher return on knowledge.

articleTitle: Model and Model Implement of Farmland Circulation in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this study is to analyze the influence factors of farmland circulation. Theory analysis and empirical study were employed. The results indicate that farm households' behaviors result from kinds of factors, including social economy factor, market and property right condition, participators' condition. Contract land per person, non-agricultural income per person, agricultural members per family and the high school education are four main influence factors. According to the results, the paper gives some suggestions of improving farmland circulation, which include farmland moderate scale management, development of non-agricultural industries and increasing investment in rural education.

articleTitle: The Design of Jiangxi Waterway Toll Levy System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the present situation and existing problems of Jiangxi waterway toll levy, and making the requirements analysis of Jiangxi waterway toll levy system, this paper proposes the solutions to Fixed Levy Subsystem, Mobile Levy Subsystem, data synchronization mechanism between Fixed Levy Subsystem and Mobile Levy Subsystems based on B/S mode, including the functional structure and data access method of Fixed Levy Subsystem, the functional structure of Mobile Levy Subsystems and the program of Centralized and Distributed Mobile Levy Subsystem Based On CF GPRS Wireless Network Card, and conducts the program selection. The system will achieve comprehensively computerized bills cutting of waterway toll levy, enhance the level of management standardization, and provide the basis for the auxiliary decision-making.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Staff Justice Influenced by Pay Diversity in Organizations
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the growing progress of globalization in China, the diversification trend of workers in organization becomes more and more common. The phenomenon of pay diversity between local and expatriate workers need be paid attention in that pay diversity are closely related to sense of distribution justice which plays a significant role on job satisfactory and turnover intention. This paper investigated 249 workers in the international companies/schools based on a practical project using methods of factors analysis, variance analysis and hierarchical regression. The results showed that the decrease of pay diversity can not decrease unfairness of local workers, on the contrary, it enhances unfairness of local workers as well as the turnover intention.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Problems and Control of Drinking Groundwater Quality in the ChangBai Mountainous Region of China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research of Executives' Performance Evaluation System of Chinese Listed Corporations
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper reviews and references systems of executives' comprehensive performance evaluate of Chinese listed corporations, then establishes a more suitable indicators and method system of comprehensive performance evaluate of Chinese listed corporations.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An Empirical Study on Interaction among Intellectual Capital, Organization Culture and Firm Performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Study on Bond Strength of External Thermal Insulation System with Perfusion Polyurethane Foam
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: External thermal insulation system (ETIS) is an important part of building energy efficiency. Polyurethane foam as a superior external insulation material was analyzed in this paper. The variation law of bond strength of the ETIS with polyurethane foam was studied by atmospheric exposure tests which consist of two stages including high temperature-spraying water cycle and heating-refrigeration cycle. The results show that its bond strength declined lightly with time increasing and its value is always greater than specified value. Therefore, the ETIS of composite perfusion polyurethane foam has better weatherability and it can adapt the various inconstant weather conditions. By comparing the bond strength curves of the three kinds of popular ETIS of expanded polystyrene (EPS) board, polystyrene granule mortar and polyurethane foam, the result shows that the downtrend of bond strength of composite perfusion polyurethane foam ETIS is gentlest, thereby the weatherability of polyurethane foam ETIS is best among the three ETIS.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Evaluation of the Development Level of Services in Hubei's Major Cities
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper uses factor analysis and nine indicators to analyze the development level of services in Hubei's major cities. The result shows that there is a big gap among different cities of Hubei. The cities of Hubei can be divided into three groups. The first group includes Wuhan, which development level of services is far ahead of other cities. The second group includes Huangshi, Shiyan, Xiangfan, which development level of services is relatively high. The third group is Jingmen, Yichang, Huanggang, Suizhou, Jingzhou, Xianning, Ezhou, Xiaogan, which development level of services is low.

articleTitle: Revolution and Challenges in Financial Mixed Operation in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Ever since a long time ago, the system of divided operation has been always been existing in the financial industry in China. Since the reform and opening-up in China, the financial industry has switched from mixed operation to divided operation and then back to mixed operation. The original idea of divided operation is to construct a financial firewall between commercial banks and securities companies to avoid cross-industry transmission of risks so as to diminish systematic risks. However, generally speaking, mixed operation is favorable for improvement of service efficiency of assets and reduction of risks. Thus, we should further perfect financial laws and regulations system, improve financial regulation technology and supervision system, speed up reform pace of financial industry and boost the core competitiveness of financial institutions.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Relationship between Architectural Modeling Design and the Surrounding Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As we known, many successful architectural modeling designs are harmonious with their environment. So, any form of construction should be coordinated with the surrounding environment during design. This paper discusses the relationship among the architecture, surrounding natural environment, surrounding architectural style and local history and culture, and how to make construction coordinated with their surrounding environment.

articleTitle: Personal Credit Evaluation Model for C2C E-Commerce Website-Taking Taobao Website as an Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the mode of c2c e-commerce, because of the increased degree of information asymmetry and frequent occurrence of internet fraud, the credit problem has ever been the biggest obstacle in the c2c e-commerce development. Taking Taobao as an example, through analyzing the personal credit evaluation system , this essay think what does Taobao do on personal credit method, reward points gradients setup is unreasonable. Through summarizing some credit deficiency problems it may bring, this essay suggests a new improved credit evaluation system reward points gradients decrease credit deficiency. Finally, in view of the c2c e-commerce, this essay suggests that the sellers should choose appropriate express delivery and our government perfect the relevant laws.

articleTitle: The Empirical Study about the Employee Performance of Tourist Hotels Based on Internal Marketing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years tourist hotel industry in Shandong Province attempts to introduce an advanced marketing mode --internal marketing, which is an emerging management concept, to improve enterprise performance and enhance their core com-petitiveness. The purpose of this paper is to use structural equa-tion model to analyze the effect of tourist hotels' internal market-ing in Shandong Province, sum up their successful experience and analyze their shortcomings. Then it can provide theoretical reference for tourism industry which includes tourist hotel indus-try in Shandong Province to further develop and implement in-ternal marketing model.

articleTitle: Study on Meta Index in the Process of Evaluating Regional Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article analyzes the shortage of existent index systems of regional sustainable development. The concept of meta index is put forward for the first time. The article describes the feature of meta index. Based on meta index, the concept of secondary index is also put forward. Based on meta index and secondary index, this paper classifies the evaluating indicators of regional sustainable development, and a case is given. After the classification, the connotation of index is clearer, and the selection of index is more scientific.

articleTitle: Evaluation about the Old Asphalt Pavement Performance of Chang-Tai Freeway
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, with the development of freeway in China, requirement of road users is increasing and construction mechanization degree is enhanced, asphalt pavement structure has been generally used for freeway, but how to design the asphalt pavement construction is the key problem that to ensure pavement performance. Asphalt pavement has appeared more or less premature failure in each province freeways. This paper tests and evaluates the existing asphalt pavement performance based on Chang-Tai freeway maintenance projects, and the results can provide some technological supports for engineering maintenance programs.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis on Dynamic and Optimal Portfolio in Real Estate under VaR Constraint
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The real estate portfolio is a dynamic process and an ffective way to spread risk. The article analyses the risk of real estate portfolio using VaR method, and on the basis of this, establishes an optimization model for real estate portfolio under VaR constraint , in ddition, arrives its efficient frontier and optimal strategy. Finally, through a case of real estate portfolio, the paper also discusses the risk dispersing and restricting effect of VaR constraint on real estate portfolio.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation of Contingency Plan System of Emergency Management in Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: When emergency events break out, many enterprises in supply chain are forced to suspend their normal business, sometimes even go into bankruptcy. Therefore, it is imperative to establish a dynamic contingency plan for supply chain emergency management with high adaptability and self-adjustment. To ensure that the existing contingency plan for supply chain is able to reach ideal effects when handling emergencies, it is vital to make accurate assessment of the ability of contingency plans to handle emergencies. On the basis of theoretical research and empirical investigation, we construct evaluation indices of contingency plan for supply chain emergency management. Applying Analytic Hierarchy Process,we identify the weights of the indices, then using Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Model,we make overall assessment of contingency plan for emergency management in supply chain. In the end, the validity and practicability of the index system and the model have been verified through empirical research.

articleTitle: Study on the Audience Attitudes to the MFA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Recently, the movie film advertisement (MFA) has a great development, as a new advertising media, it has a big potential market. But there exists big gap of MFA between China and some developed countries. This article describes the relationship between audience and such kind of new advertising media, through SPSS to analyze the audience's attitudes on the MFA. And it can provide some valuable suggestions for the advertiser and issuer to develop the movie media from the results of survey.

articleTitle: Project Scheduling Problem Based on Modular Outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The market competition under globalization promotes enterprises to integrate resources all over the world, and the decision-making of outsourcing is becoming an important influencing factor of project scheduling. Taking subproject TCP/C1-3-1A-1 of Three Gorges Project for example, this paper constructs module network by design structure matrix, and chooses outsourcing module primarily by two levels, then formulates optimization model of project scheduling based on modular outsourcing. The results show that the income of the project is enhanced and the duration of the project is greatly shortened because of synergy effects with modular outsourcing.

articleTitle: The Impact of Corporate Image and Customer Expectation on Customer Satisfaction: An Empirical Study in Power Supply Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we study the impact of corporate image and customer expectation on customer satisfaction in power supply industry. We took 1150 customers of Jiangsu Electric Power Company (JEPC) as samples and made an empirical analysis with SAS software. It was found that corporate image had remarkably positive affect on customer satisfaction while customer expectation had weakly negative affect on customer satisfaction. Finally, suggestions were put forward on how to improve customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: Research on Enactment of Regulatory Policy, Investor Protection and Market Reaction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It has been proven theoretically and practically that stock market regulation is very important in a developing economy for investor protection and stock market development. This article uses theories from behavioral economics to analyze the influence from enactment of regulatiory policy on market reaction. Results show a substantial influence on investors' behavior from enactment of stock market regulation in China, and different regulations yield significant variations in market reaction.

articleTitle: Analysis of Moral Hazard in Virtual Enterprise Based on Random Constraints
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, the moral hazard in Virtual Enterprise (VE) is studied based on principal-agent theory with random constraints. The risk coefficient is used to quantify the member's risk preferences in VE, and the principal-agent model with random parameters is used to deal with the problem. Firstly, according to uncertain environment in VE, the model with random constraints is proposed, then the model is solved using the method based on risk coefficient, and some significative conclusions are obtained through analyzing the result.

articleTitle: Research on Current Status and Problems in the Chinese Carbon Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper firstly gives an overview of the CDM market in China, and further introduces China's CDM project management system, key CDM policies and voluntary emission trading. On this basis, the paper analyzes barriers to the Chinese carbon market. Finally, it makes some suggestions such as strengthening the policy support, fully utilizing international mechanism, enlarging the financing channel for technologies promotion, and deepening the international cooperation in the field of carbon Market.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on Evaluation Mechanism of Famous Brand Product - Taking Shandong Province's Evaluation for Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Core Competence Evaluation of Modern Service Industry Cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Service industry cluster has played an important role in economic system of an area. Core competence evaluation of modern service industry cluster has been a very significant theoretical and practical problem of the research on industry cluster. The goal of the investigation is to assess core competence of modern service industry cluster accurately and visually. The primary factors of core competence of modern service industry cluster are analyzed first. Radar chat which is mapping of evaluation factor is used as a diagrammatic representation to assess core competence of modern service industry cluster. In order to get the priority of evaluation factor, Analytic Hierarchy Process is adopted and the hierarchy of core competence of modern service industry cluster is developed. Then the circle of radar chart is marked off in accordance with the priority above. Further more characteristic elements of radar chart are used to evaluate core competence of modern service industry cluster quantificationally. The examples demonstrate that use radar chart to assess core competence of modern service industry cluster is feasible. It is not only intuitionistic and visual, but also can get quantitative value of core competence of modern service industry cluster.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Effects of Internal Marketing on Service Branding
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Does Porter Hypothesis Exist? - Take Major-Surveyed Industries in Jiangxi Province as an Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With 2001-2008 panel data of major-surveyed industries in Jiangxi, we do the empirical test on industrial competitiveness, innovation capacity and environment protection capability of environmental policy regulation, to test Porter hypothesis. We find Pollution tax policy has the best performance, emission abatement investment policy be the second. While the "three simultaneous" implementation policy, administrative punishment policy and the policy of public partition do not play their roles because of the execution and coverage. Among them, the pollution emission tax policy elasticity on technology innovation and profit-cost ratio are 0.97 and 0.007; the elasticity on wastewater, waste gas, SO2 emission intensity are -1.47, -1.21, -1.37 respectively. All the conclusion is agree to Porter Hypothesis, so it is helpful to implement environment policy under low-carbon economy.

articleTitle: The Plan of the Selected Location of the Dynamic Alliance Store Centre and the Example Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The agile virtual enterprise sets up the distribution centre and store centre of the dynamic alliance. It's the important way that realizes the supply chain "the agility". It is discussed in this paper. This paper uses the precise centroid method and linear plan model to carry on the selected location modelling for the store centre of the dynamic alliance and example analysis.

articleTitle: Study on the Semi-Strong Form Efficiency of Housing Market: Evidence from Hong Kong
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Hong Kong housing market is probably one of the most efficient markets in the world because of its transparent transaction information, relatively low trade cost and multiple brokerage shops. This paper performs the test on the semi-strong form efficiency of the Hong Kong housing market. A two-stage model is set up to examine whether the housing price could fully and instantaneously reflect the relevant information based on the long-term equilibrium model and error correction model. This paper adopts unique transaction-based data and covers a longer period from 1980 to 2004 in the Hong Kong housing market. The results show that the deviation of the housing price from its long-term equilibrium is just adjusted quarterly by about 53.8% instead of being corrected fully and instantaneously, which is inconsistent with the semi-strong form efficiency hypothesis. The Hong Kong housing market is not fully efficient.

articleTitle: The Marketing Moment Theory and Empirical Research Based on Relationship Value
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Under the conditions of mutual benefit and win-win situation, the relationship gradation between the increasingly become increasingly evident, with differentiation as the core of marketing theory in no longer enough to help today's companies to take marketing opportunities. In this paper, Relationship Gradation-centric is the core of understanding relationship value, we proposed the marketing moment theoretical framework based on the relationship value in this based, effectively combined the marketing moment, relationship gradation, relationship fit and relationship value theory, then verified the relationship between them through empirical, improved the theoretical framework, pointed out the new direction to seek marketing moment for modern enterprise.

articleTitle: Research on Electronic Service Lifecycle Management of City Government
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Electronic service is an important part of e-government development of city government, at present, the development of electronic services among regions is uneven, and information release, forms download, online delivery and online transaction processing co-exist. System analysis personnel is at the center position of electronic service lifecycle management, who is responsible for service analysis, design, implementation and maintenance, but growing demand of electronic service brings great challenge to electronic services management. This paper attempts to propose the basic thought of electronic service lifecycle management, to balance responsibilities between system analysis and operational support members, to promote the electronic service development of city government.

articleTitle: Transformational Leadership and Organizational Commitment: The Moderating Role of Leaders' Centrality in Influence Networks: Implications for Human Resource Management Practices
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper identified organizational commitment as an outcome of transformational leadership through the moderating effect of leaders' centrality in organizational influence network. Drawing upon previous literatures, three dimensions of organizational commitment are differentiated as to discuss the impact of transformational leadership on these different dimensions of organizational commitment. Implications for human resource management practices such as job mentoring and change management are discussed.
