articleTitle: A Novel Risk Management Method Based on Active-Matrix Theory for Project Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Engineering project risk management is a systematic and whole process management. This paper starts with the analysis of the risk influence on engineering by means of active-matrix theory. Risk factors include aspects of nature, economy, management, technology. Reply evaluation and distinguish to the risk factors, based process of engineering cost risk, for risk fountain arrangement, and corresponding countermeasure are directed at analysis results. The method is convenient and efficient.

articleTitle: Index System of Culture Risk in Chinese Cross-Board M & A Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The study aims at improving the consciousnesses and ability for the Chinese enterprises to identify and control culture risks in their cross-board M & A corporations. The paper analyzed the characters of culture risks in cross-board M&A enterprises, identified the factors of culture risks in Chinese oversea M & A enterprises, and established the index system of culture risks for Chinese M & A enterprises through formatting the principles for index system establishment and sorting out the resources and levels of culture risks in Chinese cross-border M&A enterprises.

articleTitle: Quality Analysis of SME Websites Based on Third-Party Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on existing website evaluating model, this article gives specific evaluation indicators of the quality of SME websites based on third-party platforms after sample survey and analysis. Result indicates that the run and maintenance quality of SME websites based on third-party platform has the following problems: uploaded information is incomplete, information update isn't in time; especially that many websites have no picture; about design quality, the number of platforms with the function of interactivity and identity authentication column is not enough. In the end, the article discusses the reasons for above problems.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence Factors of Logistics Development in Henan Province Based on DEMATEL Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The index evaluation system of logistics development in Henan Province is built. The interactional relationships between each index are decided by the expert investigation method, and the influence factors of logistics development are analyzed quantitatively by decision making trial and evaluation laboratory (DEMATEL) method. Based on this, the total-relation index of each factor is determined through systematical analysis, and the influence degree of each factor has been classified and arranged in order. Then centeral factors, causal factors and effect factors of logistics development of Henan Province are identified. And the corresponding strategies are proposed.

articleTitle: Remanufacturing Network Analysis of Third-Party Reverse Logistics for Waste Household Appliances
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the increasing technology and people living, many electronics products were discarded, which has been influence to environment, and now some studies of environment and product recovery have been emphasized with attention being given to societies and government .It is necessary to recovery household appliances, which take a large part in the waste electronics. In our country there is not a complete recovery system of waste household appliances, so it is necessary to analyze remanufacturing network analysis of third-party reverse logistics for disused household appliances. This paper gives the process of selecting the third-party reverse logistics provider by using the method of AHP(Analytic Hierarchy Process). According to the model designed, the paper illustrates the build of remanufactured network by using MILP(Mixed Integral Linear Planning)model. The relative examples are given to prove the validity of this model.

articleTitle: The Risk Management in the Linear Combination of Two IT System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Enterprises use IT system in business sector, information management sector and production management sector on purpose of the operation, which , Of course, is inseparable from risk management. Two non-independent risk estimates functions are hence founded in order to receive the information of risk easily, that is, the cash flow-based evaluation function. Applying the logarithmic probability-distribution function in the estimates function as well as giving an example by simulating, this essay has explained the affection of the uncertain factors to the enterprise management such as the business treatment and so on. At last, it has commented the application of the estimates function in the risk management.

articleTitle: Research on Coal Face Ventilation Reliability with Data Fusion Approach
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The ventilation system conveys fresh air into laneway, dilutes the noxious gases, and keeps the working environment safe and reliable, how to evaluate the performance or reliability of ventilation system has been one of the important issues in coal mine safety research field. The reliability of underground coal face ventilation was discussed in this paper based on multi-sensor system data fusion approach. A partial-fusion architecture were built and a new basic probability assignment(BPA)based on distance function approach was brought forward. The final case study showed a good effectiveness and feasibility of the data fusion approach.

articleTitle: An Empirical Examination of Cumulative Capabilities in Value Co-Creation with Customers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to extend the cumulative theory by examining the interaction mechanisms of capabilities in the setting of value co-creation with customers. Based on large-scale survey data collected in the middle of China and coupled with multi-method, this study makes contributions in the following three aspects. First, the enhancement of certain traditional capabilities (flexibility and delivery capabilities) can amplify certain new capabilities, i.e. service capability and customerization capability, when properly involving customers in value co-creation system. Second, this study finds flexibility plays a basic role to amplify other capabilities in the new strategy. The findings of this study help extend the cumulative theory to the scenario of value co-creation with customers. The results of this research help guide companies to take both internally and externally focused views of capabilities development to excel in coming competition.

articleTitle: Study on Connotation of Intensive Agricultural Land Use and Its Evaluation Index
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this study is to define the connotation and establishing a scientific evaluation system of intensive agricultural land. Methods of documentation and synthesis were employed. The results indicate that the intensive level of agricultural land use includes the index of labor, index of capital and index of technique. And at the same time, the assessment index system of intensive use of agricultural land was established. It reflects the index level well of intensive use of agricultural land, and provide a reference for studying the intensive use of agricultural land.

articleTitle: Banking System vs. Stock Market in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper applies the TYDL procedure to test the comparative advantage of the banking system vs. stock market in China. For the availability of the data, we confine our analysis between 1992Q1 to 2008Q4. Empirical result shows that there exists bi-directional Granger causality between the banking development and the economic growth in China; on the contrary, evidence implies that the stock market in China generally has a negative impact on economic growth but economic growth indeed has promoted the stock market development.

articleTitle: A Quantity Flexibility Contract with Price Dependent Demand
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper is the coordination of two periods' Supply chain with price dependent demand, and a rebate and penalty contact is introduced. Compared Supply chains with quantity flexibility contract and without quantity flexibility contract, it's proved that the quantity flexibility model with rebate and penalty can coordinate and optimize the whole supply chain, and can improve the profits of all sides.

articleTitle: Experiment Management System for Industrial Engineering Based on a Virtual Integrated Experimentation Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Experiment teaching for Industrial Engineering (IE) was an important component of IE teaching, traditional experiment equipment and method had revealed many limitations. In this paper, Virtual technology was applied to experiment teaching for IE according to IE curriculum requirement, virtual experimentation platform for IE was developed. New lab management system was developed, this provided a reference for IE laboratory construction of other universities.

articleTitle: The Application of Factor Analysis in County Economic Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article described the basic principles and main steps of factor analysis, at the same time, used this method to make a comprehensive analysis and evaluation of economic development of the top ten counties in Jiangsu Province. It overcomes the deficiencies of traditional multi-index comprehensive evaluation method in dealing with high correlation between indicators and weight setting, and confirms that it is successful to apply factor analysis into county economic evaluation.

articleTitle: Efficiency and Equity under Public Investment Policy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The government needs to adopt public investment policy to achieve social efficiency and equity. The public investment model with objectives to increase income per capita, decrease income per capita gap, and increase employment rate was established by reconstructing neo-classic economic growth model. Empirical research shows the validity of the model. The government is suggested to pursue these objectives by allocating public investment proportions to various regions and sectors.

articleTitle: Predicting Criminal Recidivism with Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Predicting criminal recidivism effectively is of major interest in criminology. In this paper, we study the ability of the support vector machines (SVM) to predict the probability of reincarceration. As a semi parametric approach, the SVM minimizes structural risk whereas nonparametric models, such as neural networks, minimize empirical risk. Furthermore, the SVM differs significantly from existing parametric models, such as logistic regression, in prediction of criminal recidivism. Due to the relatively new application of the SVM in predicting criminal recidivism in the field of criminology, a general framework is presented for how the SVM may become a supplemental or alternative method for recidivism prediction. Comparisons among logistic regression, neural networks, and the SVM are made with empirical testing results on a well-known recidivism data set. A combined prediction utilizing all three methods provides the most flexibility and accuracy in decision-making.

articleTitle: Intelligent Products for Monitoring and Control of Road-Based Logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents a new architecture of an intelligent information system for monitoring and control of road-based logistics. The typical business of road-based logistic companies is to transport goods from a certain source to a certain destination by the use of trucks. During the actual transportation of goods, small disturbances such as delays or wrongly loaded goods can prevent the original plan from being executed as intended. Some of the main problems caused by these disturbances, and how they are currently dealt with, are investigated in a medium-sized logistics company. Typically, traditional planning and control systems have difficulties handling these kinds of problems effectively. However, recent technological developments, such as intelligent products, enable new solutions in the field of information systems. Therefore, a new system architecture is proposed here to tackle the outlined problems. The system is designed to detect local disturbances in real-time, and solutions to problems caused by these disturbances can be presented to the users directly. This approach is validated through an evaluation method based on real-life descriptive scenarios.

articleTitle: Pre-Training Motivation and Transfer of Training in Downsizing Environments: A Preliminary Review and Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Drawing upon previous literatures in training and downsizing issues, this paper aims at examining how the efficiencies of training programs in downsizing environments might be determined. The authors looked at both pre-training and post-training phase and identified pre-training motivation and transfer of training as two critical factors deciding training efficiencies. Variables such as career planning, job involvement and supervisory support are studied to better understand pre-training motivation and transfer of training.

articleTitle: Study on Application of Extension in Enterprise Synthetic Benefit Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By means of extension method, a new qualitative and quantitative evaluation technique is established to evaluate synthetic benefit evaluation of enterprises. The model obtains the index weight using incidence function and computes the incidence degree and adopts the optimal degree evaluation approach. A demonstration is applied to illustrate and validate advantages of the method. The result indicates that this method, simple and clear, is not only easier to be implemented on computer but also can be used to carry out risk control better. The approach is flexible and can be extended into other fields.

articleTitle: Study on the Effects of FDI in Chinese Forestry on Foreign Trade of Forest Products
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since 2000, foreign direct investment (FDI) has become the most common form of foreign capital utilization in Chinese forestry. In the year of 2008, the amount of foreign capital utilization in Chinese forestry achieved USD1.008 billion, while FDI accounted for 82.73%, that is USD8.34 billion. According to the trade and investment theories, FDI can have trade creation effect or trade substitution effect on the foreign trade of a country. This paper makes an empirical research on the effects of FDI in Chinese forestry on foreign trade of forest products and draws a conclusion: there is more creation effect than the substitution effect; and the effect on export is larger than on import. It is mainly because of the investment motivation and the characteristics of FDI in forestry. In the end, some suggestions are put forward to promote the foreign trade of forest products during the utilization of FDI.

articleTitle: Sum-of-Weighted-Square Method for the Research on Accomplishment Appraisal for International Liner Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the perspective of three dimensions for resource-capacity, organization-capacity and outcome-capacity, the article establishes the indexes of accomplishment appraisal. And sum-of-weighted-square method for accomplishment adjustment is put forward. Further, empirical research on accomplishment appraisal for international liner shipping enterprises is achieved and arrives at effective conclusions.

articleTitle: Research on Loans Efficiency of Commercial Bank Based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Money-lending business is one of the traditional businesses of commercial banks; it is also the main source of income of commercial banks. This article will analyze the efficiency of Chinese commercial banks' money lending business, application of data envelopment analysis (DEA). After a series of analyze, we could draw the conclusion that the difference of lending business's efficiency between different Chinese commercial banks is not dramatic, most found in the fund utilization efficiency. Moreover, with application of DEA, there will be some solution to increase the efficiency of commercial lending business.

articleTitle: SORA: A Sustainability-Based Objective Relaying Approach on Post-Disaster Aid Project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The feasibility study and design is a key for engineering assets sustainability. The sustainability-based project objectives are generally derived from a project environment investigation and then relayed to the criterions or standards associated to alternatives assessment and optimization excused by planer or designer. However, it is difficult to undertake a sustainability-based planning or designing by those professionals independently on a Post-Disaster Aid Project (PDAP) after Wenchuan Earthquake. This paper tend to explore the issues relevant to decision-making on the PDAP, then a Sustainability-based Objective Relaying Approach (SORA) is presented by an empirical case study.

articleTitle: Perceived Performance Measurement of Outward Bound Tourists: An Empirical Study of SERVQUAL Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Outward Bound, as a kind of activity tourism, has gradually being accepted by tourists to strengthen the team spirit and improve individual quality. Satisfaction measurement of Outward Bound tourists is a hot issue for the academic at present, however, the original target of Outward Bound tourism has still not focused in the long term, whether it is achieved or not. This study aims to study the relationship between social-demographic and participating motivation of Outward Bound tourists and the perceived performance measurement, by developing SERVQUAL model combining generic dimensions of the model and the designated targets achieved by Outward Bound tourism. After analysis of 363 valid samples from on-site and web-based investigation as the object of Shiyan Lake Ecological Park, Changsha city, the finding shows that individual education, occupation, marriage, monthly income and tourism motivation had an association with the perceived performance of Outward Bound tourists, except individual gender, age and marital status, and the original target can be achieved by outward Bound tourism. Finally, some recommendations are put forward in the study.

articleTitle: International Situation of Service Outsourcing and China's Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes some main characteristics of present international market of service outsourcing, i.e. enlarged market scale, short-term vibrating, twoness of competition and upgrade of market structure. On this basis, this paper puts forward countermeasures for China's development of service outsourcing, i.e. improve the industry environment of service outsourcing, promote vigorously the development of service outsourcing providers and accelerate talent introduction and trainning.

articleTitle: Financial Performance Evaluation of Post-Acquisition Based on SOM and Hopfield Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we apply Self-Organized Mapping and Hopfield neural network to cluster characteristics of financial performance and predict the performance of post-acquisition. Financial characteristics of samples of targets are divided into three sorts very evidently by clustering of SOM. According to the financial variables of every sort, we build Hopfield network model to predict the sort of performance of test samples. Demonstration indicates the accuracy is 92.11%.

articleTitle: A New Exploration of New Service Development Process Considering Concept of Bricolage
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Competitive pressures are prompting a new-found aggressiveness that questions established service offering and calls for new ways of identifying and satisfying buyers' needs. Today's customers are demanding quality, style, and uniqueness over homogeneous products. Therefore, it's necessary to deploy new service development (NSD) considering both common service needs and personality needs. Existing studies largely attempt to model the systematic sides of NSD. This tends to produce studies incapable of capturing the complexity of NSD. Therefore, it's necessary to deploy NSD based on firm's grasp of its customers' real needs. However, it's still void in academic field. In order to fill this gap, a new method of NSD is proposed in this article. First, we review literature on NSD and concept of bricolage. Then, we come up with a new way of NSD. We propose that service firm should collect its customers' customized needs first and then make cluster analysis of them. According to the cluster analysis results, we propose its corresponding formal model, which is accompanied by thought of bricolage to deploy NSD. Management implications and areas for further research are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Development of Core Service Capability of Chinese Technology Business Incubators
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on defining composition of core service capability of technology business incubators, this article makes an analysis of core service capability of Chinese incubators from four aspects, namely, financing service, technical service, information service and high-tech achievement transformation and transaction service. In response to existing problems, this article makes a proposal on how to develop core service capability of incubators from such aspects as change of governmental function, corporation operation of incubators, market-oriented financing of incubators, establishment of technical service sharing platforms and construction of information network.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Job-Hopping by Evolutionary Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Job-hopping occurs frequently in modern companies. Employee are classified into talent one and general one. Then the employees' payoff Matrix is given in the view of the employees. Evolutionary game theory is applied to analyze the employee's job-hopping problem. The results are obtained that talent employee prefers to choosing job-hopping, while general one would keep the work in the long term.

articleTitle: Study on Influence Factors of Non-Interest Income in China's Listed Banks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since banks were listed one after another, non-interest income has been continually growing. In this paper, data of 11 listed banks from the year 2003 to 2008 is chosen as sample to study quantitatively on the status and factors of non-interest income of listed banks, using SPSS software. The results show that non-interest income share to total assets and that to operating income are generally rising, especially stronger since banks started to list in 2007. The factors of non-interest income include the proportions of deposits and loans to total assets, the proportion of employees to deposits and the scale of banks etc. And also the property of banks is significantly affected to non-interest income.

articleTitle: The Bibliometrics-Based Analysis on TAM with English Literature
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In 1989, American scholar Davis proposed the technology acceptance model (TAM) to explain the user's adoption of IS. Database of ELSEVIER and EBSCO were used as data sources. English literature of the TAM model were analyzed from the amount of articles, authors, regions, application areas and so on. We hope to provide reference for the application research of TAM.

articleTitle: Study on the Digital 3D Modeling and Its Application in a Gold & Copper Deposit
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The program of the digital 3D modeling is described through the establishment of the three dimensional model of a gold - copper deposit by using Surpac Vision software. Combined with collar and channel sample data, estimation of the grade of Cu, Au, Fe in the block model was made by Kriging method. The present situation of project and stopes are visually described. Furthermore, the application of this model in grade optimization for multiple deposits could be developed.

articleTitle: Risk Management in Alliance: The Effects of Contractual-Based Versus Relation-Based Governance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Focusing on alliances in high-tech industry, we apply theory of transaction cost and relational contract to explore the effect of uncertainty and experience on firms' choice of alliances governance. By using a sample of 99 strategic alliances in high-tech industry, we empirically examine the theoretical hypotheses proposed in this paper, and find some evidence supporting these hypotheses. Consistent with transaction cost economics (TCE), empirical results suggest that alliances are more likely to be organized by equity joint venture (EJV) when more uncertainties or complexities are involved. However, the existence of alliance experience can also significantly affect the alliance governance, and we find out that alliance experience may substitute for contractual-based governance to some extent, for both prior ties and reputation negatively correlate to the choice of equity alliance.

articleTitle: Research on Operation Model for Inventory Control of Reverse Logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There is now considerable concern for manufacturers about inventory control of reverse logistics, driven by growing environmental concerns, legislative actions, economic profits and the issue of China's sustainable development strategies. A periodic handling returns model was developed for inventory control of reverse logistics, with which returns and demands were obeyed independent Poisson distribution and the repairable products could be sold on discount. A simple method was presented for determining the optimal order policy and the handling period for returns. Applied examples were shown that return intensity, repairable rate had great influence on the total cost and ordering policy and the discount had little influence on the ordering policy. The numerical examples' results also showed that the model could not only effectively coordinate retailers' activities, but also help retailers to set down their own ordering policy.

articleTitle: Stock Price Informativeness, Free Cash Flow and Overinvestment: A Chinese Study
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Wurgler (2000) first show how firm-specific information affect the allocation of capital at the country level. I first show how stock pirce informativeness affect overinvestment of free cash flow at the firm level. This paper studies the relationship of stock pirce informativeness and overinvestment on a sample of China's listed companies from manufacturing industry between 2001 and 2008. Empirical results show that, the overinvestment caused by free cash flow decreases significantly with increasing stock pirce informativeness. The empirical results also strongly support the point that more informative stock price facilitate more efficient capital allocation.

articleTitle: An Exploration of Risk Factors Selecting for Hospital Information Security through NGT Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Identifying the risks associated with the self-assessed security management in healthcare organizations can be a major challenge for managers, clinicians, and IT specialists. For the rapid change in the healthcare environment and health insurance regulations, the healthcare providers of Taiwan are facing a lot of managerial challenges and problems. An integrated security management can not only improve weakness but also decrease the damaging situation of risk. The main goal of this paper is to show how the nominal group technique (NGT) works as a management tool when an initiative is planned to be developed. In addition, the paper also provides insights how risk factors selecting can affect the future hospital information security management infrastructure development. We adopt the ISO17799 practical standard with the eleven controls items and experts' opinions with Failure Mode Effect Analysis (FMEA). The primary data was collected in the NGT and uses a structured group process to elicit and prioritize answers to a carefully articulated question. The chosen expert panel consists of the following interest groups: Developers of information security system, Industrial experts and Representatives of academic institutes. Based on the result of this study, we found that NGT represents a workable research tool in hospital information security management to capture multifaceted and enriched view about risk factors selecting. Finally, it not only can realize the more accurate potential risk incident by utilize the ISO17799, but also achieved the objective for self-assessed management of hospital information security.

articleTitle: Model Analysis the United States' Direct Investment in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the acceleration of the process of economic globalization and foreign direct investment of multinational corporations, international direct investment becomes an important factor of promoting global economic growth. During the process of the United States' investing in China, the position of the United States in China's utilizing foreign direct investment continuously enhances. This thesis analyzed the number, areas, industry, decisive factors and the relationship with Sino-US trade of the United States' foreign direct investment in China; it concluded that the main motivation of the United States' foreign direct investment in China came from internal factors of China; The United States' foreign direct investment in China was highly correlated with Sino-US trade, it prompted Sino-US trade development. Therefore, China should take measures to make good use of the United States' direct investment.

articleTitle: Study of Land Use Economic Benefit in Development Zone by Choquet Integrals
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By building an evaluation index system, using λ - fuzzy measure and Choquet fuzzy integral approach and using the software R, we make a more scientific evaluation on economic benefits of zone land use .The result shows: the total index value can be calculated by the basic indicator value, and then we get a more scientific evaluation value. The study conclusion is: the non-linear economic benefits evaluation on the every park's land use of the New Technology Development Zone of East Lake in Wuhan promotes the rational land use of development zone and provides a theoretical basis for management decisions.

articleTitle: The Capacity Balance Research on ERP System Based on "Out- Cooperating Model"
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Aiming at the absence or simpleness of capacity balance of ERP system, or the absence of capacity balance mathematics tools and optimization solution tools, the thesis puts forward the capacity balance model based on out- Cooperating model---that is to establish mathematics model and to depend on the third party optimization tools to solve the capacity balance problem. The thesis has validated the feasibility by experimentation.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal Analysis in Land Use Change and Its Application in Lijiang Region
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Land Use / Cover Change (LUCC) is an essential component in the field of regional environmental monitoring and economic development analysis. Its motivation is to get an in-depth understanding of dynamic process, leading causes and evolution mechanism of regional land use change, which provide accurate information for land administration to develop local economic development planning and management. Data analysis and processing plays a key role in LUCC. This paper summarizes four kinds of spatio-temporal analysis indexes, including magnitude, velocity, regional differences and inner conversion. Then Lijiang Region is taken as an example, and these four indexes are applied to analyze its land use change. Results reveal numerical and spatial difference in LUCC, and they are accorded with local actual conditions.

articleTitle: Development and Improvement of Factor Markets in Wuhan City Circle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development and improvement of the regional factor markets is a key part in building a regional market network, as well as insurance for the healthy and sustainable development of the regional economy. Regional factor markets have high transaction cost and property right cost, which have made them lag behind the regional product markets. The key to development relies on a correct understanding of the traits of the circulation system and environment of the regional factors. This paper makes a deep study of the development and improvement of regional factor markets in Wuhan city circle from the perspective of regional economy, which is meaningful for the allocation of regional resources.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on the Momentum Effect in China Stock Market during the Financial Crisis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the established methodology, this study investigates the momentum effect of China stock market. The data from 2005 to 2008 is used, covering the period of the America financial crisis. The empirical results show that momentum effect exists in China Stock Market, but not significant during the financial crisis.

articleTitle: Adaptable Analysis on Storage Mode of Institutional Repositories Based on CC License Agreement
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper , CC (Creative Commons) agreement and accrediting mode of the agreement copyright are described, the impact of CC license agreement on the storage modes of digital media and the accrediting mode are discussed, and the classifications of the storage modes of institutional repositories are defined .There are now such self-storage modes as institutional repositories, discipline storage , individual homepage blog and so on . The constrain storage form also is divided into the constrain self-storage and commitment storage by agreement. At the same time the cause of existing problems of institutional repositories and slow progressing in China are analyzed. For increasing in approbation degree of users to the mode of digital media, a common constructing mode of unconstraint self-storage and constrain self-storage on the CC zero agreement and the open source collaboration mode are put forward , so as to establish the correlative laws and license policy of constrain storage agreement to study many effective storage methods in more favor of implement of the digital media sharing.

articleTitle: An Effective Model to Support Uncertain Skyline Cubes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Skyline cube is the crucial mechanism in multidimensional skyline queries and preference analysis, and has attracted much attention recently in knowledge management community. This is mainly due to the importance of skyline cube in many applications, such as data mining and visualization, user-preference queries, and multi-criteria decision making. In this paper, we propose a novel multidimensional model which can efficiently support uncertainity both in dimensions and hierar-chies. Specially, the uncertain operations can fully depict the characteristics of uncertain skyline cubes.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on the Performance of Equity Incentives of Chinese Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article uses an empirical analysis to investigate the performance before and after the implementation of equity incentives with the paired-samples T test .In this paper, 25 listed companies which began to implement equity-based incentives in 2006 and 2007 are taken as the sample. And the corporate performances are divided into two stages by share splitting reform. The findings indicate that there is no significant correlation between equity incentives and corporate performance.

articleTitle: Forecasting the Price of Online Auction Items Based on a Hybrid Approach of ANN and GRA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Aiming at the BP artificial neural network unable to auto select and optimize input variables, this paper integrates BPANN with grey relational analysis method, establishes an optimized BP artificial neural network arithmetic (GM2BPANN) which based on the grey relational analysis method. The hybrid approach has been used to forecasting the online item price. The result shows that the new model can deal with mass input variables without special subjective selection, enhances the adapt ability of BP neural network. It can also get good forecasting stability and accuracy.

articleTitle: Hedging Optimization Model Based on the Risk Control of WCVaR
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, using the worst-case conditional value-at-risk of hedging portfolio as optimal function, the hedging ratio is obtained. The distribution type of hedging return is not considered in this method. Then the problem which the subjective determination hedging return distribution causes hedging failure is solved. Considering tail loss of hedging portfolio and colligating the hedger's expectation and risk aversion, the model reflect the risk tolerance ability of hedger, which enhances the hedging effectiveness.

articleTitle: The Ecological Imbalance of the Virtual Learning Environment and Its Solutions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The article defines the basic characteristics of virtual learning environment ecosystem and analyzes the root causes of ecological imbalance of the virtual learning environment, and proposes corresponding solutions.

articleTitle: Study on the Effect of On-line Word of Mouth on Tourists' Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The existing literatures on Word-of-mouth (WOM) focus almost on the motivation, behavior, affecting factor of WOM spread. Researches about WOM on Tourists' decision-making in the on-line environments are extremely exiguous. This article constructs the research framework model from the interpersonal factor (receiver's trust propensity, tie-strength of the sender and the receiver) and impersonal factor (initiative in searching for WOM, fun, receiver's expertise, perceived risk, tone of WOM), collects 354 samples through the tourist virtual communities and commentary site. Then we use statistic methods to further testify proposed conceptual model. Also the paper reveals managerial implications to the tourist enterprises based on the final conclusions.

articleTitle: Individual Donors' Giving Intention and Behavior: Effect of Their Perceptual Determinants on the Nonprofit Organization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The dimensions of each construct of individual perception on nonprofit organization and their effects on individual giving intention and behavior were studied by using survey to selected 393 valid respondents. The authors report the result that three distinct categories of two perceptual level (nonprofit organization specific and cause specific) can impact on giving intention and behavior, namely perceptions of the benefits (if any) that might accrue from support, perceptions of the operational performance for the specific nonprofit organizations, and perceptions of nonprofit brand equity. And then the authors examined the effects of the components (e.g. perceptions of demonstrable benefit, emotional benefit and familial benefit; perceptual effectiveness, perceptual efficiency; the perceptions of brand personality, brand image and brand awareness) of each perceptual category on individual giving intention and behavior respectively. And a positive casual link between individual giving intention and giving behavior is also revealed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Affecting Safety Management in Construction Projects
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The influence of construction safety on a project is complex and important, including schedule on milestones, delays in project duration and cost overruns. So a number of safety improvement measures have been taken to migrate this problem in the construction industry of China in the face of the poor safety records. However, not all of these programs are effective enough to satisfy with the need of time, resources and cost. Then, to compare and analyze the degree of effectiveness of the measures can help us concentrate on the major management factors. This paper tries to evaluate the current safety management systems and prioritize these steps with the consideration of various decision criteria. The nonstructural fuzzy decision making method is applied to solve this multiobjective problem. Case study shows that the method is suitable for the appraisal of complex construction problems, which allows assessment based on a pair-wise comparison of alternatives using semantic operators, even under the condition that in sufficient precise information is available. Finally, policy implications are obtained to strengthen the safety management in construction project.

articleTitle: Study on the Organizational Boundaries of Competence
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Traditional organizational boundaries are challenged in a knowledge-based economy. New boundary conceptions should be developed as the demarcation between the organization and its environments. Analyzing organizational boundaries of competence under dynamic complex environment, the paper describes the organizational boundaries of competence fitting with organizational environment. Based on resource based view of the firm and organizational network theory, resources, network ties and network positions have effect on organizational boundaries of competence which are developed by combining the internal firm capabilities and external resources to enhance organizational performance.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study for Green Supply Chain Management: Relationship between Collaboration and Extended Supply Chain Performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to measure the relationship between collaboration and the extended supply chain performance in green supply chain. Following a literature review, the paper develops items for collaboration and extended supply chain performance. The model is tested with structural equation modelling (SEM). There are total 3 hypotheses failed to pass the test, other 7 hypotheses pass the test. This research provides necessary basis for long-term strategy and planning for enterprise.

articleTitle: Research on the Staff Maturity of Software Companies in China--------Take Hangzhou City as a Sample
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper we use the people capability maturity model (P-CMM) to focus on the improvement of people capability of software organization. Firstly, on the basis of the investigation to software enterprises in Hangzhou, the questions of P-CMM2 are abstracted and perfected further, and totally 31 questions are chosen in this research. Secondly, a questionnaire survey is conducted in software enterprises to figure out their people capability status, software quality, and the rate of employee turnover in Hangzhou. Investigation result is analyzed by SPSS. The factors influencing the software quality and employee turnover are analyzed, and the conclusion are drawn and discussed.

articleTitle: Study on Customer Participation in New Service Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Competitive pressures are prompting a new-found aggressiveness that questions established service offering and calls for new ways of identifying and satisfying buyers' needs. Services involve customers as co-producers. Therefore, it's necessary to deploy new service development (NSD) considering customer participation. However, it's still void in academic field. In order to fill this gap, we study on customer participation in NSD in this article. First, we review literature on NSD and customer participation. Then, based on learning curve theory, we come up with a new method to deal with customer participation in NSD. We propose that service firm should collect all the customers' description needs' content and its corresponding service firm's action first. Next, service firm makes cluster analysis of customers' description needs' content to gain several main customers' description needs' aspects. For every customer's description needs' aspect, service firm should describe the relationship between customer degree of satisfaction and service firm's action. At last, service firm chooses the actions which meet its target service level set beforehand. According to the method, the service firm deploys NSD and continues to make progress based on its experience. Management implications and areas for further research are discussed.

articleTitle: An Exploration of Job Rotation of Administrative Staff Members in High Education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Purpose: To understand the impact on how job rotation of administrative staff members in high education. Design/methodology/approach: the implement of job rotation of staff members in school of International Education, Wuhan University of Technology. Findings: administrative staff members would like to participate in job rotation program; job rotation provided administrative staff challenging experience and avoided job burnout; job rotation broadened the eyes of administrative staff members and encouraged teamwork spirit. Research limitation/implication: job rotation of administrative staff members is just a trial in one school instead of the whole university. Practical implication: the means of how job rotation can be put into practice are concluded. Originality/value: this paper has provided several useful experiences of job rotation which can be used in other professions besides of high education.

articleTitle: Expatriates Management for MNCs: A Dynamic Objective Optimization Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the advent of the era of economic globalization, more and more enterprises in China are moving towards transnational operations. Based on the four dimensions of the requirements of expatriates, the knowledge flow of MNCs, the career and support of expatriates, this paper employs the research approach of managerial operation and the method of dynamic objective optimization to construct a model by which MNCs manage their expatriates, and comes up with a dynamic optimization management methodology of MNCs' expatriates.

articleTitle: Business Process Automation for Universities: Enabling Effective and Efficient University Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Universities are a societal asset of immense value as they are an important driving force of scientific creativity, knowledge creation and innovation. Consequently, the pressure to perform in teaching, research, alliance building, and networking on a national and international level has grown tremendously over the past 20 years. To live up to their full potential, universities have to put to the test their structure and processes and make use of the IT-technologies available to enforce more effective and efficient management processes.

articleTitle: CFD Simulation of Planting Effect on District Air Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The application of CFD (Computational Fluid Mechanics) simulation is more and more extensive in the research field of urban air environment. CFD has its advantages on simulating the complicated air flow phenomenon and presenting intuitional descriptions. Planting work within a city has great ecological effect on city or district air environment, CFD simulation of planting effect on district air environment and its superiority for district air environment planning, the establishment of the model and its application for air environmental evaluation and improvement in district environmental management process is introduced and discussed in this paper. The significance and prospect of CFD simulation of planting effect for district planting planning is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Analysis on Ecological Efficiency of Construction Industry in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Serving as the pillar industry of domestic economic as well as the main consumer of social energy, construction industry plays a critical role in the sustainable development of China. To comprehensively and quantitatively understand the level of energy consumption and environmental loads of Chinese construction industry, this study figures out the ecological efficiency of construction industry and its correlated industry by adopting the input-output life-cycle assessment (I-O LCA) model. The boundary of ecological items covers 8 types of energy and 4 sorts of environmental emissions. Results show that the energy consumption structure of the construction industry is unbalanced which mainly relies on fossil energy and thus becomes pollutant-intensive. Besides, the enhancement of ecological efficiency of construction industry dependents heavily on the ecological improvement of correlated industry sectors.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on the Influencing Factors of Online Customer Trust
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper discusses the relationship among antecedents of trust, ability trust and goodwill trust in internet environments. Findings of the study indicate customer perceived value and customer satisfaction are positively related to ability trust and goodwill trust, corporate reputation has a significantly negative impact on ability trust, trust propensity has a significantly positive correlativity with goodwill trust.

articleTitle: Literature Review of Strategic Human Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Transforming human resources management processes from their traditional style focus to a more strategic business contribution is a key to improving performance of individuals and the organization. This paper is a review of literatures about strategic human resource management, and trying to uncover the various perspectives from which they are written.

articleTitle: Paying for Watershed Services: Mechanisms, Modes and Compensation Methods in the River Basin, China--Case Study of Jinhua River
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Payment for watersheds services (PWS) is an important instrument of watersheds protection and management, which can transform fortune and reduce the inequity of environment and development between the upper reach and lower reach. Both government and market play a key role in the course. Based on case study of Jinhua River, the analysis on the payment mechanism and modes of environmental services and compare compensation methods: WTP, direct payment and opportunity costs of watershed services, opportunity cost of limitation of development rights on paying for watershed services in China, and estimates the value of water resource based on water quality and water quantity. We get the results: (1) Clear original water property and the criteria of water quality and water quantity are primary to watersheds payment; (2) The government still plays an important role in payment for watershed service (3) The largest loss in the upper reaches is from the limitation of development rights, so it is important that the government offers good policy to support and foster green industry and ecological agriculture and build local capacity for healthy watershed. The payment criteria based on water resource value is feasible which is evaluated by water quality and water quantity and (4) Due to the larger OCLDR, so building local development capacity and land planning for healthy watershed is very important.

articleTitle: Study on the Stackelberg Strategy of Information-Sharing among Supply Chain Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Large numbers of studies have shown that: through the information sharing between enterprises upstream and downstream of supply chain, enterprises can improve their customer service quality, shorten payment cycles and reduce labor costs, so as to effectively alleviate the "bullwhip effect". However, the above studies of the supply chain were generally set up an absolute controlor, and used the unilateral or integrated decision-making model for minimizing cost or maximizing the benefits of the overall supply chain. This paper researched the supply chain with Stackelberg game characteristics, through the model analysis to explore the decision-making behavior of supply chain enterprises in three different information-sharing conditions. Then proposed the equilibrium conditions in each case of formation-Sharing.

articleTitle: Research into Corporate Internal Control under the Circumstance of E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As a mainstream trade approach, E-business has gradually penetrated into each filed of social and economic life. Under the circumstance of E-business, corporate internal control experiences great changes. In face of the circumstance of E-business, we need make innovation in concepts of internal control and control measures.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On the Promotion Mechanism of the Knowledge Chain's Inter-Organizational Knowledge Spillover to Its Inter-Organizational Knowledge Creation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: ID-Based Threshold Proxy Signature Scheme Based on Elliptic Curve Cryptosystems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Most of the existing threshold proxy signature schemes were under the certificate-based public key systems. However, in these schemes, some revealed that the receiver cannot find out who signed the proxy signatures. In this paper, based on Schnorr's signature scheme, integrating the short secret key characteristic of the elliptic curve cryptosystem, we proposed a novel (t, n) threshold proxy signature scheme. Compared with the reported (t, n) threshold proxy signature schemes, our scheme can reduce the amount of computations and communications without a dealer. What's more, used our scheme, the original signer can know who generated the proxy signature and the receiver can certify the actuality of the group signers.

articleTitle: Research on Low-Tech Strategy for Technology Innovation of Low-Tech Enterprises in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China low-tech industry encountered "bottle-neck" of development. Studies and observations of low-tech firms indicate that the enterprises have problems with obtaining resources for launching innovation activity. Technology innovation validity is influenced by four factors: innovation motivation, the choice of innovation strategy, innovation input, and support policy of government. According to technology innovation validity model of the enterprise, while innovation input is limited, innovation validity can be reinforced by support policy of government. The implication of low-tech strategy lies that the need to give priority to high technology has not been demonstrated. In the future, the policy towards low-tech enterprises should be oriented to increase innovation input, motivate innovation spirit of employee, choose appropriate strategy, and allow low-tech enterprises to improve innovation ability and their competitiveness in the market.

articleTitle: The Research of Pull Production Strategy and Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Pull production is an important component of Lean Production, it can help the corporation implement Lean Production to study pull production. Based on the survey of the corporation in Changchun, compares and analyses the current three pull production strategies and the operational process, concludes the merits and faults of the current three pull production strategies. After investigating the actual production conditions of the corporation, puts forward the new pull production strategy-KCB strategy. Applying this strategy, the corporation can get the maximum capacity of the production line and the minimum inventory; applying this strategy, the corporation can enhance the competitive power and economic profits.

articleTitle: The Corporate Brand and Corporate Social Responsibility
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Brands have become powerful tools for getting profit for corporations, however, more and more corporate casualties make the brand confront with crisis, which includes environmental pollution, crude labor treatment, gender discrimination etc. People call for the corporate social responsibility for improving corporate performance. This study analyses the corporate casualties and brand crisis, pointing that the best solution is to set up a new agenda toward corporate social responsibility.

articleTitle: The Impact of Government Price Subsidy from a Supply Chain Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper discusses the impact of government subsidy on the supply chain performance. We consider a model where a manufacturer supplies a product through a single retailer with a constant price elasticity, and the government offers a price subsidy for each product to reduce the real price for the consumers, so as to promote the demand. We show that the retailer makes a further price cut as the subsidy is offered, and both the two parties of the channel benefit equally from this policy. The best subsidy that the government can offer is analyzed, given the budget constrain. We further show that the government subsidy can not help to achieve the supply chain coordination.

articleTitle: International Outsourcing Ratio of China Industrial Sectors: How Measurement Matters
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper uses three methods estimating material outsourcing ratio and service outsourcing ratio of China's 36 industrial sectors in 1997, 2002 and 2007. Then we investigate the quality of the three methods through the Shift-Share method. This study is useful for related empirical studies on outsourcing. We find that different methods lead to a big difference of outsourcing ratio. The results show an upward trend of China's industrial sector outsourcing ratio during 1997-2007, and the growth rate of service outsourcing is higher than material outsourcing; structural changes have a greater impact on the material outsourcing ratio than the services outsourcing ratio.

articleTitle: Study on Service Characteristics and Competition of Community Bus
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzed the function and service features of Community Bus, and put forward four types of line layout form according to the factors including travel demand characteristics and attractive point location. At last this paper dissected the competition of community bus and demonstrates that there exist considerable demands in central area of Shanghai for community bus through disaggregate model.

articleTitle: Development and Application of GIS-Based Mine Management Information System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on management features of digital mine, this paper makes full use of the spatial data processing of GIS (Geographic Information System) to analyze the module designing and system development of GIS-based mine management information system. It also discusses the spatial data presentation, data manipulation, data queries and data storing in the process of mine management system application.

articleTitle: Technology Spillover Effects and Independent Innovation of Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyses the technology spillover effects and its relationship with independent innovation from the point view of knowledge evolution. The result indicates technology spillover is the most important channel for an organization to acquire the technical knowledge for the technical follower. The absorptive capability, independent R&D investment and stuff makings are the most important affective elements for acquiring the technology spillover. The technology spillover effects affect the independent R&D motivation by monopolization, demand, technological opportunity of knowledge. The technology spillover effects can benefit the learning ability, knowledge innovative ability, knowledge sharing ability and knowledge integration ability of an enterprise, which can help to form the independent innovation capability.

articleTitle: The Development Research of Ecotourism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The concept 'ecotourism' appeared in recent decades. The first formal definition of ecotourrism is credited by Ceballos-Lascurain in 1987, who define ecotourism as 'traveling to relatively undisturbed or uncontaminated natural areas with the specific objective of studying, admiring, and enjoying the scenery and its wild plants and animals, as well as any existing cultural manifestations (both past and present) found in these areas'. After that, many different researchers or organizations carry out a series of researches on this concept and its practice. This paper reviews the development of the theory and practice of ecotourism. After that, the author discusses the Chinese ecotourism thinking and recent development.

articleTitle: Study on the Evaluation of Support Capability of Urgent Logistics Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Urgent logistics is a complicated system, and the support capability evaluation for urgent logistics have a large number of attributes or aspects. The analytical hierarchy process (AHP) is a simple and effective way for multi-criterion and multi-objective analysis in system analysis and system assessment. In this paper, the meaning of urgent logistics and the general principle of AHP are first introduced. According to the master state plan for rapid response to public emergencies, there are four kinds of emergent public events will lead to urgent logistics. So six factors for urgent logistics are put forward based on the four kinds of emergent public events. A hierarchy model for urgent logistics is made in this paper. Through an example, the evaluation model of the support capability of urgent logistics based on AHP is analyzed. The result proves that the model in this paper is available for the evaluation of the support capability of urgent logistics.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Numerical Analysis and Processing of Seismic Wave in Aseismic Research of Underground Structure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: R&D and Productivity in High-Tech Industry: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The econometric model in this paper is estimated with the data between 1998 and 2006 in 29 provinces in China, and concludes that R&D has significantly positive contribution to productivity whereas there are individual differences in the contribution of R&D to productivity among provinces and that R&D in the east region affects productivity growth more instantly than that in the central and western regions. The regional difference may result from relatively higher possibility of success of invention and relatively stronger spillover effect of the eastern region to the central and western regions.

articleTitle: Abusive Supervision: An Interactive Model of Human Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study examines how authority submission and abusive supervision influence subordinates' supervisor-directed deviance. Using a sample of supervisor-subordinate dyads in six manufacturing companies, we found that (1) abusive supervision was positively related to subordinates' supervisor-directed deviance; (2) authority submission moderated the association between abusive supervision and supervisor-directed deviance, such that the relationship was stronger among low traditionalists than among high traditionalists. Implications of the findings are offered.

articleTitle: An Analysis on Corporations Exerting Network Marketing Strategies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of Internet, network marketing becomes a new type of marketing. The article analyses advantages of network marketing comparing with traditional marketing, puts forward strategies by which corporations exert network marketing, and looks into the prospect of network marketing in China.

articleTitle: Optimization of "One-Stop" E-Government Process Based on E-Government Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the continual development of information technology, building an E-government system which is adapted to actual conditions of China is increasingly becoming an important issue. In this paper, by comparing the electronic "one stop "service platform and the traditional model of government, the author analyzes how to use the "one stop" service platform to optimize the path of China's E-government processes. It specifically includes: to implant the part of authentication to "one stop" service platform, to create a stand-alone server to establish a separate e-mail system for the government, to build a more complete system of making government affairs public and electronic databases on the "one-stop" platform with the spirit of servicing and being responsible for citizens, to aim at providing a good environment for businesses and citizens under the condition of market economy, to build a system of unified tax and monitoring of the whole society on the "one-stop" platform. According to these, the paper concludes that based on "one-stop" platform, the process of E-government would be optimized.

articleTitle: Decision Making in a Fuzzy and Random Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper illustrates decision making method in a fuzzy & random environment. For the fuzzy constraints not only fuzziness of the constraints relations but also uncertainties of the response of the structures, allowable limits of the constraints and structural design variables, etc. are considered. And every possible case of the fuzzy variables, random variables and fuzzy-random variables, etc. for the uncertainties of the optimization problem are all considered, so the most general method of the decision making is presented.

articleTitle: Cross Listing and Price Volatility Based on Time Series Filter in Chinese Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the fundamental model tool, time series filter can help specialist and researcher to examine volatility. The time series filter may play a significant role in statistical model building. The foreign law and market bond the behavior of self-interest in emerging market. The empirical evidence results indicate that Coefficient of GARCH (1) in Table 1 is bigger than Coefficient of GARCH (1) in Table 2. After cross listing, price volatility of the share is increased for different expectations. The relation between cross listing and price volatility of the share may be changed with different markets. We provide theoretical and practical evidence for time series filter on volatility as a normal approach.

articleTitle: The Community of Practice's Strategy for Chinese Government
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Community of Practice (COP) is an emerging theory in the knowledge management field, analysis and discussions involving the COP stay mainly in the context of enterprise knowledge management. Introducing the COP concept into the governmental management area represents the essential pursuit of government management innovation and the strategical option of the government in line with the current development trend. At the end of the paper, the author aims at discussing the pending problems the Chinese government faces in the cultivation mechanism, and sincerely intends to start further discussion on the issue of the COP in government.

articleTitle: The Petrochemical Industry Production System Optimizing Simulation Based-on HLA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By analyzing the characteristic and the application of distributed interactive simulation (DIS) and high level architecture (HLA) and researching the management of federation object model and data distribution in DIS, A new method is presented to develop Petrochemical industry distributed interactive simulation adopting HLA technology. A simple petrochemical industry is modeled with HLA, the FOM and SOM are developed. The results of the instance research show that HLA plays an important role in developing distributed interactive simulation of complicated distributed system and the method is valid to solve the problem puzzling petrochemical industry.

articleTitle: A Study on the Reconstruction and Paradigm of Marketing Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to maintain a sustainable development in this dynamic plight of current world financial crisis, a firm must make marketing innovation as one of the core topics. However, the theoretical system of marketing innovation neither has yet entered the field of innovative research nor formed its own system because it is still mainly in the period of practicing both at home and abroad. Therefore, marketing innovation has become a new field of marketing research. In this paper, the author firstly reviews and analyzes the latest literature of marketing innovation and then reconstructs it from the perspective of strategic value innovation. By combining with the practice of marketing innovation both at home and abroad, the author puts forward structured marketing innovation paradigm.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Role of Higher Educational Institutions in Local Economic Development: From the Examples in Zhejiang Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nowadays, the economic and social development has more and more relied on the technology accumulation, application and innovation. The higher educational institution comes with the functions of knowledge innovation, knowledge application, knowledge education and personnel training. It is an important part in the regional innovation system and main force of technology innovation. The article took the instance of Zhejiang, discussed the main functions of the higher educational institution in regional economic development, analyzed the main obstacles in the cooperation of businesses, academies and research institutions and brought up approaches for and suggestions on promoting the cooperation of businesses, academies and research institutions based on that. The article provides a basic idea for improving the role of local higher educational institutions in serving regional economic development.

articleTitle: The Constituent Elements and Countermeasures for the Development of Innovative Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The goal of this paper is to analyze the constituent elements, the analysis model and the suggestions and countermeasures for the development innovative enterprises. Firstly, we make an introduction about the connotation and the characteristics of innovative enterprises. Then, we make an analysis on the constituent elements of innovative enterprises, and find that we can divide the innovation in the enterprise into four categories: technological innovation, market innovation, product innovation, and management innovation. Thirdly, we put forward the suggestions and countermeasures for the development innovative enterprises. Finally, we get the conclusion that the Implementing the system innovation, continuous technological innovation, human resources innovation, corporate culture innovation and the brand innovation can improve the innovative capability for the innovative enterprises.

articleTitle: Establishment of Cultivated Land Quality Evaluation Information System Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Taking Shihezi Farm General, Agricultural Division No.8, XPCC as the example, GIS technology is used to establish the cultivated land quality evaluation information system. The system, adopting MapInfo management spatial database and attribute database, Access management data entry, application model analysis and statistics database, Delphi language, develops application models of hierarchical analysis and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation and integrates spatial database, attribute database and application model base, making it able to control fertility and quality situations of cultivated land in the Farm and provide basis for cultivated land fertility construction and soil improvement and utilization.

articleTitle: Catalytic Wet Air Oxidation of PH3 over CuO-CeO2 Catalysts
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The influences of CeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and La<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> on catalytic wet air oxidation of PH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> was investigated. CuO catalysts, CuO-CeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> catalysts and CuO-La<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> catalysts were prepared using the co-precipitation method. Results revealed that the purification efficiency of PH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> removed by the combination of Ce and Cu oxide was good. The catalystic activity of CuO-CeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> catalysts influenced by the ratio of Cu to Ce was studied, the optimalizing ratio was 10:1. Main influence factors for reaction temperature, O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> content and gas flow rate were also studied, the purification efficiency of PH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> was enhanced with reaction temperature increasing, slow gas flow was good for removing PH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>. O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> 2% were best for the reaction.
