The results indicated that good conditions of the reaction were 80°C, gas flow rate of 200 mL/min, O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> content of 3%.

articleTitle: Service Supply Chain and Its "Bullwhip Effect"
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article summarizes two kinds of service supply chain, product servitization supply chain and professional supply chain. Combined these two kinds, a general definition of service supply chain is given. Then, this article compares the differences and similarities between service supply chain and manufacturing supply chain, points out the unique characteristics of service product. At last, this article studies the bullwhip effect in service supply chain, and it analyzes the reasons to bullwhip effect. After all, this study has far-reaching research meaning both in theory and practice.

articleTitle: Study on the Environmental Technology Application Strategy of the Housing Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is important to study the environment technology application strategy of the housing industry which will give a comprehensive consideration between the social benefit and the economic benefit, between the long-term benefit and the short-term benefit. How to allocate the limited resources between the rapid demands of more acceptable cost and sales prices residence available and the demands of environment protection application is crucial. According to the character of this strategy problem which can be researched as the optimal control of the dynamic system, an Lagrange's function and the Euler equation can be constructed to extract the solution of the differential equation correspond with this strategy problem by using the calculus of variations method. And this research method can also improve the decision quality of the strategy application.

articleTitle: The Applying Discrimination of the Common Slope Bioengineering Protection in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As Chinese government giving more attention on environment protection, the techniques and methods on slope bioengineering protection have developed rapidly. Various kinds of techniques have been put into different regions, industries, fields, and produced positive ecological and environmental effects. However, there are certain understanding deviations of the slope bioengineering protection because of corresponding norms and standards lagging. In this paper, the common slope bioengineering protection measures in China are divided into three types of dibbling, covering and hanging, and spraying. These three types of measures are respectively introduced in detail, and the understanding deviation in application is discriminated.

articleTitle: The Financial Early-Warning Model of Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper use Microsoft SQL Server 2005 data mining tools and three methods of neural networks, decision trees and logistic regression to establish the financial crisis early-warning model of listed companies. The conclusion is that the three kinds of methods have good results and the prediction accuracy rate are 80% or more. The accuracy of the decision tree algorithm model is higher than others.

articleTitle: Study on the Collaboration Architecture of Supply Chain Entities in Intelligent Logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Few studies have focused on the supply chain collaboration under the conditions of intelligent logistics. In this paper, the collaboration architecture of supply chain entities in intelligent logistics is structured to analyze the rules and mechanisms of supply chain entities collaboration, and to provide operation and collaboration standard for supply chain in the future. The architecture includes following sections, which are entities correlation analysis and key criteria choosing, dynamic nonlinear modeling of supply chain system, associated stability analysis with Lyapunov exponent and value simulation. Finally, Markov methods are recommended to study the state transition and feedback mechanism of supply chain system.

articleTitle: The Organizational Form Selecting of Venture Capital Funds and Its Institutional Innovation in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, the debate on the organizational forms of venture capital funds in China is increasingly fierce, and with the development of venture capital industry, its institutional innovations are more worthy of attention. This paper argues that Corporations is a realistic choice of venture capital industry in China, meanwhile, the institutional innovations as well as the possible innovation direction of Corporations in the development of venture capital funds are discussed on the basis of policy environment and governance structures.

articleTitle: Entrepreneurial Orientation and Organizational Performance: Exploring the Role of Internal Resources and External Environments
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In strategic management and corporate entrepreneurship field the literatures indicate that entrepreneurial orientation (EO) improves organizational performance, but the empirical results are inconsistent. In this paper, we analysis the direct effect of EO on organizational performance and deem that a main effect analysis providing an incomplete picture of performance implications of EO. Internal resources and external environments are important to the development of a firm, and we adopt a combinational approach to explain variance in organizational performance.

articleTitle: Operator's Mobile Internet Strategy in the Process of Converged Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is as a result of this profound converged network that mobile internet has emerged as both a new phenomenon and a necessity. Mobile internet is promoted by the convergence of the traditional Internet and mobile terminals which is playing an important role of the internet by advantages of a large user base and further explore of the cell phones and other mobile electronic devices. At the crossroads of the rapid developing mobile internet industry, mobile operator should be sensitive to seize the trend in order to achieve its long-term sustainable development. This paper begins by describing the origin and development of mobile Internet. Then, based on the analysis of the mobile internet development environment and the development trend of mobile operators in china, the paper brings forward some effective strategies with a view to the domestic mobile operators and thereby generates novel insights for researchers, managers and investors.

articleTitle: Study on the Selection and Assessment of Channel Strategic Retailers for Cigarette Manufacturers in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the deepening of the reform of Chinese tobacco distribution system, The State Tobacco Monopoly Bureau is accelerating the dissemination of the new purchase and sale model as "organizing sources of goods in accordance with the customer order ", which highlights the importance of Cigarette retailers in sales channels compared with traditional planning model. From the strongpoint of improving the marketing function of Cigarette manufacturers, optimizing the channel for the allocation of resources and enhancing the power of channels. This paper builds the selection and assessment system of strategic retailers in channel for cigarette manufacturers in China. The system has been successfully used in a certain cigarette manufacturer which makes a selection and assessment of strategic retailers to Beijing market channels, which shows a good applicability and practicality.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on the Relationship between Environmental Pollution and Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, serious environmental pollution has been one of major constraints of China's sustainable economy, for the most part, the rapid growth of energy consumption is attributable. In this paper, we firstly use factor analysis method to do evaluation on environmental pollution degrees of China's 30 provinces, municipalities and autonomous regions (not including Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan and Tibet) by means of statistics of 2007, and then use regression analysis method to research the relationship between the regional environmental pollution degree and regional energy consumption. The results show that there is a significant positive correlation between them.

articleTitle: Dynamic Clustering Analysis of Expert Instances with XML Structural Based on the Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article dynamically analyzes large scale XML documents of experts' instances according to thought of particle swarm and algorithm of dynamical cluster. It can quickly find out the same or similar experts' instances in Long-distance Medical System, so it improved the efficiency and accuracy of the querying, and provided us a new thinking for future instance studying in Long-distance Medical System.

articleTitle: The Resource Constraints Project Scheduling Based on DSM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: with the improvement of project complexity, project management become important more and more, especially project schedule phase. Project schedule not only solve the project time conflict, but also project other resources conflict. So it is necessary to research resource constraints project schedule. The Resource constraints usually lead to project tasks delays and rework, because the tasks have to use serial structure and coupling structure. For solving this problem, the paper proposes a model based on design structure matrix (DSM) to optimize the serial structure and coupling structure, and sets time-factor (TF) parameters to consider the time impacts of the resource constraints. The model that integrates TF into DSM can optimize above- mentioned logical structures efficiently, and then shorten the project time effectively. Meanwhile, DSM applies simple calculation procedures to construct solution, and the used formulas in model are easily calculation, so the operation processes of project scheduling is very convenient. Therefore the model for project schedule and reasonable tasks sorting is highly practical value.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Action Mechanism of Knowledge Conflict on Team Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Duality Theory of Generalized Separated Continuous Linear Programming
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we consider a kind of new problem called generalized separated continuous linear programming (GSCLP), motivated by the great modeling power of it. By using discretization methodology, we prove that the strong duality holds between GSCLP and its dual under some mild condition.

articleTitle: Reflective Essay on an Adult Learner----A Constructivist Qualitative Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Constructivist qualitative research perspective is conducted to explore what an adult learner like when he returns to university. We investigate the influence of adult learner both on themselves and the community they are involved in. By doing some naturalistic research on a specific adult learner, We find the reasons why he returns to school after long time absence. To figure out the background of his continuous study will also help to understand his current choice. By observation and interview the process of his adult study, We find out how it is different from his previous ones. Finally, based on the observation We analyze and interpret the data and draw some tentative conclusion with the principal of probability.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Factors Affecting China's Regional Service Industry Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The goal of this paper is to analyze the factors affecting China's regional service industry development. Firstly, we make an analysis on the limitations of the traditional zoning methods for service industry development, and make regional cluster analysis on the development level of service industry. Then, we also build the empirical models according to the theory of regional services, pending empirical test. Thirdly, we fit regression equation with the Eviews software and exclude some non-significant variables, and find that the statistic is large and pass the test under the condition of 1%, the equation successfully pass the significant test. Finally, we make an empirical analysis on the factors affecting regional service industry, and find that the existence of squeeze, the regional government, the consumer demand, and the regional infrastructure affect the development of regional service industry in different ways.

articleTitle: Executive's Alteration and Earnings Management under Corporate Governance Structure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The corporate governance structure plays an important role on earnings management. Based on the consideration of the relation between corporate governance and earnings management, this paper make an empirical study on the earnings management behavior before the changing and leaving of chairman and general manager in the listed companies. The research result shows that chairman will take the action of increasing profits the one or two year before the routine turnover, with the evidence being more significant in the last year than the next-to-last year. There is no evidence which shows departing general manager increases discretionary accruals before routine turnover. At the same time, perfect governance mechanism can successfully mitigate the earning management caused by chairman's normal turnover. So it is pressing to optimize governance mechanism in the company and establish long-term reputation mechanism in top management market.

articleTitle: Study on Corporate Patent Early Warning Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the request of building innovation-oriented country and the background of national intellectual property strategy, intellectual property rights play a greater role in the economy. What this paper do is to build corporate own patent early warning system, including the systems organization institution, operational subsystem, patent early warning indicators. Through corporate patent early warning mechanism, the decision maker of company can cope with patent crisis better than before.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on Safety of Ship Maneuverability in Complex Environmental Conditions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research of Project-Oriented Social Organization Model Based Innovative
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this article is to develop a model of project management based team work to allot the social resource efficiently in a country. The article analyzes the relationships between innovation and project-oriented society based the Organizational Theory, It is concluded that the found of Innovative Country should establish the project-oriented society system and organization adapted to, so all the innovative activities can achieve efficiently by the new project management model based project-oriented.

articleTitle: A Study on RMB as an International Currency
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper assesses the potential significance of the RMB as an international currency by drawing on the experiences of the other major currencies. Based on the work of Chinn and Jerrfey (2005), we first estimate an empirical relationship between currency shares of reserve holdings and main determinants. Using the empirical results we do a simulation about the potential share of the RMB in the total world reserves if it were to become fully convertible today under three different cases, the results suggest that the RMB's potential as a reserve currency would be very large.

articleTitle: Classification and Prospects of Chinese International Contractors' Industry Integration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Because of high developing speed of Chinese economy, services industry in China is now playing an increasing important role within all industry sectors. However, the improving rate of service industry is dramatically lower than traditional industrial and agricultural sectors, so it is urgent to find a more efficient approach to speed up service industry. In order to meet this call, on one hand, many actions have been taken to expand domestic needs, and on the other hand, a large number of service companies have begun to go for outsourcing and exploring in international market. As one of most important service industry sectors, Chinese international contractors (CICs) have set up a good example for other external services firms. Based on the research of CICs, we find that industry integration is an effective and efficient approach to enhance international competitive power of Chinese international contracting industry. We applied surveys to investigate the top 10 CICs, summarized and classified these methods by its driven power: the industrial chain, clients' value innovation and core business. Through the comparative analysis between top 10 CICs, we categorized and compared the characters of these methods and found some prospects of industry integration that can build and enhance CICs' international competitive power.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of State-Owned Capital Security Management: From the Perspective of Internal Control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development of state-owned economy reflects China's socialist public ownership, and plays an important role in ensuring the safety of state-owned capital, which is conducive to realizing the country's fundamental interests. Through the analysis of the relationship between internal control and the security of the state capital, the effectiveness of internal control is beneficial to the increase in EVA and thus help to enhance the security of state-owned capital and the realization of national interests of investors. The research, based on the data of a state-owned enterprise, has conducted an empirical analysis with EVA as a variable, and concluded that with the current EVA as a performance evaluation system of the state-owned enterprises, the internal controls of state-owned enterprises should be strengthened so as to ensure the security of state-owned capital.

articleTitle: An Integrated Supply Chain Modeling and Simulation Based on System Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An integrated supply chain includes original manufacture and remanufacture. It can collect the used goods and close the material cycles. In this paper, an integrated supply chain with recycling are designed based on system dynamics. In this model, used goods can be collected by both collectors and retailers. The simulation proves that the choice of perfect collection style is based on the leader of the market. If the market is led by manufacture, the used goods must be collected so as to maximize its profit. But if the market is led by the retailer, the best policy is that the used goods must be collected by the retailer itself. The retailer will not be benefited from the collector's collection.

articleTitle: Jiuzhaigou Tourist Perceptions of Wenchuan Earthquake
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study is designed to explore the relationship between the Wenchuan earthquake and tourist perceptions of it, at Jiuzhaigou valley in China. Data were analyzed from a sample of 196 first-time and repeat visitors to the Jiuzhaigou Valley during National Day, the first Golden Week of tourism after the earthquake. The results indicate that: (1) The influence of this earthquake on the tourism industry of the Jiuzhaigou characterized by episodes of depression, and (2) the tourists have different social property, but have similar perceptions of Wenchuan earthquake. Therefore, the local government and tourism enterprises actively guide and affect the destination image of Jiuzhaigou to promote rapid recovery of the local tourism, considering the characteristics of tourist perceptions.

articleTitle: Communication Media Selection in Online and Offline Environment: A Comparison of Three Theories
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The issue of communication media selection dominated all other considerations for setting up an online environment. Three media selection theories were selected to predict a group of media selection activities and compared their results with the real selections. It was found that the Media Fitness Theory was more effective than other two. Instant messenger was identified to be a promising communication medium.

articleTitle: Research on the Supply Chain Reconstruction Strategies under the Financial Crisis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In view of the bad effect on supply chain enterprises from current international financial crisis, the paper has put forward the necessity and urgency of reconstructing enterprises' supply chain, analyzed the enterprises' reconstruction strategy adapting to the current condition for the supply chain, and brought forward some effective measures. Under the financial crisis the supply chain enterprises will benefit from this paper which owns better research value and practical value.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Incentive Mechanism for Managers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to improve performance of enterprises, the mathematical analysis method is used to design an incentive mechanism for managers. Results show that constraint degree, supervision strength, supervision motive, incentive strength, incentive direction, incentive frequencies are main influencing factors. Therefore, measures should be taken to enhance strength of these factors.

articleTitle: Exploration on the Secret of Supernormal Tacit Knowledge Management System of Silicon Valley: An Institutional Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Silicon Valley is well known as the cradle and habitat of original innovative economy. There is an institution of supernormal tacit knowledge management system in Silicon Valley. Silicon Valley's induction mechanism keeps young people discovering supernormal tacit knowledge. Silicon Valley has persistence evaluation mechanism to supernormal tacit knowledge. Silicon Valley has a supernormal tacit knowledge-based competition and overtaking mechanism. Silicon Valley has the connotative organizational setup to promote cooperation among the owners of supernormal tacit knowledge.

articleTitle: Measuring Investment Efficiency of Sewage Treatment Plants
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid growth of the national investment in sewage treatment industry in China, more and more sewage treatment plants have been set up. Therefore, investment efficiency of the sewage treatment plants is of great significance. Since the traditional CCR model does not take into account "slack" of input elements, and it's unable to solve the problem of ranking efficient DMUs, this paper figures out investment efficiencies of 13 sewage treatment plants in Henan province, applying Supper-SBM model. The result shows that the average investment efficiency is higher, but there is still waste in construction management, land acquisition and resettlement, personnel training, as well as survey and design of investments.

articleTitle: Model of Risk Forewarning Control of R&D Investment Projects in Chinese Construction Enterprises and Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After the entry of WTO, construction enterprises acutely need to improve the technology level through R&D activities for the market competitive ability. With the perfection of the mode of technology innovation dynamic mechanism and policy in Chinese construction industry, its enterprises will add the input of R&D extremely. Because of the uncertainties of R&D activity in construction enterprises, especially the character of easy-used of construction technology and the fluidity of construction professional, the investment of R&D is extremely likely to fail. So, the construction enterprises need to forewarn the risk of R&D investment projects. This paper prescribes the risk measurement of R&D investment projects in construction enterprises and builds the forewarning limitation based on the principle of system dependence and Shewhart control charts to warn the fluctuation of risk values of R&D investment projects in construction enterprises early. Then the mental trend of decision-makers in construction enterprises is correctly judged by the method of time series regression. In the last, the validity of the model is proved by a case.

articleTitle: Research on Welfare Distribution of Monopolistic Retail Supply Chain Upstream Based on Shapley-Value
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The international corporations in retail trade are developing fast in China at present; their competitive mode is changing from price competition to the supply chain management competition. To integrate upstream supply chain, these corporations are trying to buy out the land management right of Chinese peasants at upstream extremity in the name of Chinese agricultural companies. This article mainly studies on the welfare distribution of players in supply chain in cooperative game by Shapley value when upstream extremity of supply chain is monopolized by these international corporations, then get the conclusions about gain and loss of players' earning in such a case, and put forward proposals based on conclusions.

articleTitle: Job Burnout in College Teachers and Management Strategies: Based on the Correlation between Job Burnout and Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: From the perspective of human resources management, this survey discusses the correlations between job burnout in college teachers and school environment by means of Maslach Burnout Inventory-General Survey (MBI-GS) and School Environmental Scale, in which 416 college teachers are involved. The findings indicate the status of job burnout in college teachers is not severe according to theoretical value, but as for the dimension of “emotion exhaustion”, the subjects get a higher score with the implicit feature. Generally speaking, college teachers have a comparatively low opinion of their school environment, in which the material conditions are considered the most unsatisfactory. Negative correlations exist between each environmental factor and each job burnout factor, and except the material conditions, all the other factors of school environment have significantly negative correlations with the total score of job burnout in college teachers (p <; 0.01). Moreover, “interpersonal relationships” and “influence of the president” play the role of predicting teachers' job burnout. Based on the empirical evidence above, the author further puts forward some management strategies and countermeasures concerning the job design, performance evaluation, excitation mechanism, management system, and organizational climate, so as to relieve the job burnout in college teachers.

articleTitle: Status and Characteristics of China's Foreign Trade from the Perspective of Global Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the context of economic globalization, the globalization of allocation of resources and industrial internationalization is an inevitable trend, China's total foreign trade volume has also been growing by leaps and bounds, not only in quantity, but also in position. China has become the largest country in trade in 2009 exceeding Germany. However, if in perspective of international supply chain, neither the trade pattern nor the evolution of industrial structure in China stands the challenges of global economic integration. This article analyzes the conditions of China in the international division of labor and the trade pattern as well as the working factors to figure out the unfavorable situation in China.

articleTitle: A Study on Cooperation Innovation of Industrial Clusters with Government Regulations
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Industrial Cluster, as a special economy organizing form, have exhibited its huge compete advantage, and the cooperation innovation mechanism is the important side of it's competitive advantage. However, government regulations play a very important role in cooperation innovation of industrial cluster. In this paper, by establish the coopetation innovation game models among enterprises and government, reveals the cooperation innovation behavior of enterprises. The conclusions shows that a mixed strategy Nash equilibrium will exist between the government and enterprises during cooperation innovation of industrial cluster,and their strategies are interdependent. The government's regulation effect depends upon support level, punishment level and probability of the government for support coopetation innovation.And based on the above analysis, this paper present some countermeasures and suggestions.

articleTitle: Risk Management of the International Energy Cooperation: A Research Review
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The study on risk management of energy cooperation is much more in risk identification and risk handing than in risk predication such as risk assessment, but has not yet raised the concept and theory and methods of valuation explicitly, even without effective risk assessment system to guide risk prevention, and need further investigation. In this paper, the author proposes a new way of thinking risk management of energy cooperation on the basis of a literature review: firstly defining the concept of International Energy Cooperation Risk: A complex system perspective, secondly building an Indication evaluating system of risk to estimate it, lastly proposing effective control and prevention measures.

articleTitle: Based on Grid Anti-Spam System Research
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Through the grid services research and analysis, on the basis of the heterogeneous network and share resources, the design model of E-mail system which is based on the service grid anti-spam system is proposed and some functions are achieved. Through the GT containers the system with the pooling of anti-spam servers resources filter E-mail with distributed statistical method used in the entire network.

articleTitle: Incentive Effect of Executive Stock Option: Empirical Evidence from Listed Companies of Japan
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the occurrence of accounting scandals in Enron Corp, Incentive Effect of Executive Stock Option(ESO) is being questioned more and more. The task of the greatest urgency at present is to ascertain and find out whether ESO provides the administrators a stimulus to improve the corporate performance. This essay carries out a study with the samples from Japanese listed companies and the results show: the company's share price and performance with the introduction of ESO are significantly higher than those without; the incentive effect of the new and high-tech industries with the introduction of ESO is significantly better than those industries with traditional technology.

articleTitle: Research on Service-Oriented Manufacturing Mode Based on Grid
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With further developing of service economy, Boundary between service and manufacturing is more and more dim. Service-oriented manufacturing, which is presented by some Chinese scholars, is a new advanced manufacturing model for catering to integration and fusion of service and manufacturing. One of key problems in service-oriented manufacturing is operation mode. A mode of service-oriented manufacturing, which is by grid, is presented in this paper. And Architecture of service-oriented manufacturing system based on OGSA is also presented.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Influence Factors of the Investment Cash-flow: Evidence from Chinese Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper is mainly about the investment by cash flow. According to investment method, the paper divides the investment into four parts: cash outflows from direct investment, cash inflows from direct investment, cash outflows from indirect investment, cash inflows from indirect investment. The paper uses the four indexes as the proxy variable to describe the expanding and shrinking of the cash flow from investment. What's more, the authors study the influential factors of Chinese listed companies' investment by autoregressive distributed lag model. The empirical study shows that the internal and external factors have different roles in the investment decision making. At the same time, the cash flows from investment have inertial character.

articleTitle: Formalized Description of Service View within C4ISR Architecture Framework
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the System View of C4ISR Architecture, the military resource systems were tightliy coupled and hard to adapt to the dynamic changement of operational process within Operational View. This paper presents a service oriented C4ISR Architecture Framework and prescribes the formalized description of service view. In the future integrated joint operation, C4ISR system which federates systems, sensors and effectors to promote military effectiveness, is moving towards a more dynamic producer/consumer environment. In order to improve the C4ISR Architecture Framework including SOA related issues, service and related elements are added to the C4ISR architecture as integrated parts and service view is added to the framework. Further, due to ensure the data coherence of C4ISR architecture, service view and its product formalized descriptions are prescribed and followed by the relationship between the products.

articleTitle: Status and Improvement Strategy of Chinese Urban Greening Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Urban greening is one of the important issues to improve the urban living environment, to improve the quality of people's life, to realize urban sustainable development, but also the important component of building a conservation-conscious society and low-carbon environment. This article is based on the operation point of view, analyzed the emergence ,connotation and significance of the concept of urban greening operation, as well as problems existed in China, explored the optimal strategy of urban greening operation, and proposed to establishing a correct concept of urban greening operation, put the urban greening philosophy throughout the entire process of construction and management of urban green space to solve the exsited problem.

articleTitle: Enhanced Coagulation/Electro-Flotation Process for Algae Removal
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper described the reductions of Microcystis aeruginosa and Anabaena flos-aquae using enhanced coagulation/electro- flotation process. A L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sub>(3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>) orthogonal test including pH value, PAC doses, electric current and coagulation time is designed to remove algae in paper. Analysis of the removal of two major water-bloom algaes, viz Microcystis aeruginosa and Anabaena flos-aquae is addressed in paper by enhanced coagulation/electro-flotation process. The best removal of Microcystis aeruginosa and Anabaena flos-aquae achieved 93.33% and 96.47% respectively. The analysis of variance and range to the result of experiment indicates that coagulation process plays major role and pH value has the most remarkable influence.

articleTitle: The Comparative Analysis of Economic Growth of the Yangtze River Delta and the Pearl River Delta
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of the integration of the world economy, the two deltas, that is, the Yangtze River Delta and the Pearl River Delta have developed fastest and are the strongest and the most dynamic areas. The economic development of the two areas plays a most important role in the all-around development of China's economy. The paper introduces factor analysis and clustering analysis of multivariate statistical analysis to appraise the development status of the above two regions' economy, finds out the reason why the economic development is different in different clusters.

articleTitle: Application of AHP and Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Method in the Assessment of Leaguer's Core Competence in Dynamic Alliance in Project Construction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper combines fuzzy mathematics method with the analysis of hierarchy process, developing the multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method based on hierarchical analysis, and applying this method to the assessment of leaguer's core competence in dynamic union in project construction. The result demonstrates that this method better reflects the fuzziness of core competence's classification boundaries, effectively solves the distribution of weight, so that evaluation conclusions are more reasonable and reliable. In consequence, it is a valuable method applied to core competence in construction enterprises comprehensive evaluation, and it is also a useful approach in choosing partner enterprises to set up the dynamic alliance.

articleTitle: Study on the Development of Dumbbell Model of the Human Resources Matching Industrial Economic Upgrade of Wuhan
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To raise the development level of the industrial economy in Wuhan is the essential path to carry out the reform of modern industrialization in Wuhan, since industries as steel, mechanical equipments, cars, and electronics etc. are the foundations of the economy of Wuhan. The core competitive power of the industry usually comes from human resources (HR), especially from those with creative ideas and with strong adaptability. So the paper makes a deep study of the human resources in Wuhan and designs a HR dumbbell model adapt to the development of the industry in Wuhan at present. Also, the paper puts forward that the HR dumbbell model can be well developed only on the base of co-actions among universities, enterprises and governments and explores their respective roles and actions.

articleTitle: Web Services System Optimization Based on Modular Classification and Multi-Threading
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Web Services is an effective way to realize service-oriented architecture. In order to enhance user experience, it is one of the key problems to respond client requests quickly when lots of data is required from the server. Based on modular classification and multi-threading transfer principle, a new method transmitting large data is proposed in this paper after network transmission feature is analyzed. In the paper, how to classify modulus according to the data characteristics and retrieve data through multi-threading respectively in batches are shown in details. The experimental results show that the proposed method based on modular classification and multi-threading transmission can respond client requests quickly when large amounts of data need to be transmitted.

articleTitle: Co-integration between Capital Allocation and Financial Development Based on Jiangsu Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper tries to unfold the linkage between capital allocation and financial development by undertaking a co-integration analysis for Jiangsu Province between 1995 and 2007. Following Jeffrey Wurgler's model, this paper proposes a panel data model to measure the efficiency of capital allocation. Using the data of 37 industries in Jiangsu Province between 1995 and 2007, we find that the average capital allocation efficiency is .4844, which is higher than Shandong province over the period 1993-2005 and the whole country in 1990s. The co-integration analysis shows that capital allocation and financial development are co-integrated. This means that there is a (possibly bi-directional) causality relationship between the two. We establish that there is a unidirectional causality running from financial development to capital allocation indicating that financially developing would promote capital allocation in Jiangsu.

articleTitle: Research on Product Over-Functions Based on Enterprise's Perspective--An Empirical Research on Mobile Phone
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the research results related to product over-functions, interviewing with business and consumer, to build in line with our business and market characteristics of the product over-functions incentive model. Mobile phone manufacturers as the main survey, conducted a questionnaire survey, based on regression analysis using SPSS to test the model results showing that: to promote sales contribution to the greatest excess, followed by the design preferences, once again is the information asymmetry, while the Chinese consumer market `s face consumption is also a significant impact.

articleTitle: Pragmatic Methods for Controlling Quality of GPS RTK Survey in Road Engineering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on GPS RTK Technology, pragmatic methods of quality control in road engineering horizontal control survey are presented, which include spatial distribution, PDOP value, repeated survey, and observation time. The methods are evaluated by plane precision of observed data from a large road and bridge project.

articleTitle: Integrated Equipment Reliability Programme: A Proactive Maintenance Programme - Customized for Combined Cycle Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper introduces an integrated maintenance solution called Integrated Equipment Reliability Programme, which is developed by Asset Management Services of SKF* Reliability Systems. The programme is a proactive maintenance programme - customized for combined cycle power plants. The paper also shows successful cases that SKF uses the programme globally to help clients to increase machine reliability and improve plant profitability.

articleTitle: The Research on Influencing Factors of Dividend Policy Based on Data-Mining Technique: A Validating Study Based on Listed Companies in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The dividend payable of Chinese enterprises has the feature of randomness and volatility, resulting in a discontinuous dividend policy. However, this is inconsistent with Western dividend policy and entrepreneurial practice. This article will analyze the factors which impact the dividend policies, with the data mining method, to understand the relationship between the combinations of different enterprises' features and different dividend payable policies; so that the company could choose the optimal dividend policy as well as the investors could set up the most profitable portfolio.

articleTitle: Patterns and Regions Selection of International Science and Technology Cooperation of Guangdong Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the development orientation of Guangdong province's leading industry, this paper confirms key countries or regions concerning science and technology cooperation as well as the priority areas and content of cooperation according to the analysis of the current status of industry development in Guangdong province and the research upon competitiveness evaluation of the world's related leading technology, and it also puts forward corresponding countermeasures and suggestions on the science and technology cooperation patterns and approaches in terms of technological level and resources of Guangdong province.

articleTitle: Improving E-Government Performance through Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-government has now become a reality for the vast majority of developed countries and is also beginning to take root among the developing nations. Public administrations must make a greater effort to implement e-government systems that allow fluid communication with the general public, thereby achieving a greater degree of participation, which is the key to the success for e-government. This article gives some suggestions as to how to improve e-government performance from the point of view of innovation.

articleTitle: Research on the Enterprise Knowledge Innovation in Dynamic and Complex Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper first carried on the analysis to the dynamic and complex trend in environment development. According to the dynamic and complex environment, we analyzed the orientation to sustainable competitive advantage in enterprise knowledge innovation. Based on this, we bring forward the sustainable time dimension and comprehensive open space dimension of knowledge innovation. Finally, three principles for enterprise knowledge innovation are put forward in this article.

articleTitle: The Research of Technology Innovation Chain Based on Inter-Enterprises Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development of economy and society has provided new requirements for the technology innovation. It has become essential to strength the cooperation of technology innovation between enterprises. Through the analysis of the new changes in the field of technology innovation, this essay provides the technology innovation chain on the basis of multi-organizational and specialized division of labor. The essay does some researches and analyses into the composition model of, the evaluation of the technology innovation, and discusses the transmission of technology innovation stream on the chain under the function of the node innovation requirement potential difference, probes into its applicability and finally displays the application case of the mould technology innovation chain.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Correspondence Analysis in Patterns and Resources of International Science and Technology Cooperation between Universities
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Longitudinal Study of Chinese Online Shopping Diffusion Process Based on Actor Net-Work Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: While online shopping has many advantages, it did not diffuse as fast as people's forecasting. In this paper, we conduct content analyses to some news reports from 1998-2007 based on actor network theory in order to explain how online shopping developed and diffused in China and what technological and social factors attributed to the adoption process of online shopping. By doing this, we can better understand the dynamics of the online shopping diffusion development in China and provide valuable suggestions for the Chinese government, online shop and consumers.

articleTitle: Importance of Environmental Education for Raising Environmental Consciousness in Japan
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To realize coordinated development of economy and environment, the Japanese government promulgates the Basic Law on Promoting the Building of a Circular Society and makes the building of a sustainable and circular society an important goal for national development. Environmental education plays a decisive role in raising people's environmental consciousness and building a circular society. Based on the developing process of environmental education in Japan, this paper describes environmental education in schools, enterprises, society and environmental publicity in Japan, analyzes the results of environmental education and explores the importance of environmental education for raising people's environmental consciousness.

articleTitle: The Performance for Knowledge Workers Based on the SEM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of knowledge economic, the knowledge workers have been the core resource of the company. It is difficult to manage knowledge worker effectively because of their creativity and independence. Traditional methods of performance are simple and direct, but they greatly depend on people's subjective judgment and experience. In order to overcome the default, this paper put forward the method of Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) to determine the weight of performance index. Then to establish performance appraisal to evaluate knowledge employees' performance. Finally the sample illuminates the validity and feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Research on After-Sales Service Standardized Management: Based on Self-Service Terminals in Telecommunication Operators
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After-sales service of self-service terminals, which have provided us with convenience and have played an increasingly important role in our lives, is becoming an important part of self-service, thus enterprises should pay more attention to it. Based on the various and complex self-service terminals of telecommunication industry, we study the management of after-sales service from five aspects and propose a standardized management system.

articleTitle: Reputation Risk Management: A Corporate Social Responsibility Reporting Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper explores one of the reputation risk management (RRM) processes through which corporate social responsibility (CSR) reporting can help companies achieve reputation gains, or at least mitigate reputation losses. The paper presents and analyzes a case study of Nippon Steel Sustainability Report 2008, which is a CSR report published by Nippon Steel Corporation (NSC). The key elements revealed in the report were (1) financial performance; (2) quality of management; (3) social and environmental responsibility performance; (4) employee quality and (5) the quality of the goods/services provided. These five elements played a crucial role in ranking companies according to their reputation scores. The paper analyzes the report with content analysis. In addition, an image restoration framework is employed in the paper. The analysis leads to two conclusions about the CSR reporting which companies can use to manage reputation risk. First, CSR reporting as a communication tool can deliver information on five elements of reputation which would enhance reputation capital. Second, some image restoration strategies are employed in CSR reporting, which implies that CSR reporting could work as part of RRM process.

articleTitle: Research on the Innovation of Rural Policy Finance in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Rural economy in China cannot develop without financial support. Firstly, this paper analysis the process of the development of agricultural policy finance and Current rural finance's imperfection; Secondly, we analyzed features and challenge on policy rural finance; and finally we pointed out the path to construct rural policy finance in China. Under present condition, it is imperative for the government to demarcate the business scope of rural policy insurance, establish feasible rural guarantee mechanism, improve multi-layered rural disaster & risk shifting & sharing mechanism and thus gradually set up long-term mechanism on rural policy financial system development.

articleTitle: Process-Oriented Knowledge Management: A Review on Strategy, Content, Systems and Processes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Recently, interests in the notion of process-oriented knowledge management (POKM) from academia and industry have been significantly increased. This paper surveys the four different levels of intervention in process-oriented knowledge management, strategy, content, systems and processes. The survey also extracts some implications from the review on related issues. Finally, risks, limitations, and shortcomings, as well as possible future work are discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: The Evaluation of Compensation Mechanism of Agricultural Natural Disasters Based on Entropy Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As an agricultural country, there are many nature disasters taken place in successive years, and they caused great loss to the peasant-household. But our compensation mechanism is distempered currently, so it is necessary to construct a compensation mechanism which is fit to the situation of China. The system entropy is about the complexity of the system, the relations of orderly structure and the description of efficiency state. This article builds mathematical model to evaluate the status of compensation mechanism of agricultural natural disasters by entropy theory, and finds that the compensation mechanism of agricultural natural disasters in a state of entropy reduction. Finally, the article puts forward the specific policy recommendations according to empirical results.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on the Performance of the Value-at-Risk Using Realized Volatility and GARCH Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The risk of the financial market is the focus of global financing institution and supervisory authorities. Correspondingly, the accurate measure of volatility is central to the measure of the Value-at-Risk. VaR is a popular method to computer the finance risk at present, and the key of calculating VaR is predicting volatility exactly. About the measurements of volatility, the first method is the initial classic model that the volatility is estimated from the financial analysis model (such as Black-Scholes). The second method is the ARCH model and the SV model. The third method is realized volatility which is based upon high frequency data. From these, we can see the measure of volatility is developed quickly. In this paper, we compare the performance of the value-at-risk based on realized volatility which is based upon high frequency data and GARCH(1,1) model under different distributions, and the results show the performance of value-at-risk using realized volatility is more effective.

articleTitle: The Information Technology Spillover Effect and Substitution Effect Analyses on Economics in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the developing of the information technology, the information technology plays more important role in economy. The information technology innovation's forming process not only produces economic effect itself, but also has some influence on the other related industry. The influence effect analyses of the information technology on the economic growth includes two parts : The information technology innovation's forming and spreading. The former mainly is the information technology itself on economics influence effect; The later mainly is that the non information technology industry economic effect caused by the information technology innovation. This paper's emphases research that how much is the information technology innovation and spreading effect during different period in order to make sure what period produce Spillover Effect and what period produce Substitution Effect. The Spillover Effect technology can bring the benefit to the third party and Substitution Effect cannot. The problem will direct influence the state policy . It also used to reflect and measure how a kind of technology advancement influencing to economic growth. Here first we'll do some theory analyses to the effects of the information technology innovation's forming and spreading, i.e to find out their effect rules. And then we'll do some demonstration by using the real example and further analyses the influence effect of the information technology on the economic growth with the mathematics, and find out the conclusion: In the lower informationization period, The information technology is a Spillover Effect technology. During the higher informationization period, the information technology is a Substitution Effect technology. The conclusion will be redound to the harmony develop for the IT industry and the economic growth. Finally offer a series of the suggestions about information technology.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis and Granger Causality Test on Foreign Direct Investment and Economic Growth in the Eastern Region
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the time serial method, this paper makes quantitative analysis and Granger Causality Test on the relationship between foreign direct investment (FDI) and economic growth in the eastern region. The result shows that the contribution elasticity of the current FDI to GDP in the eastern region becomes greater and greater as time goes on. There exists reciprocal causation between FDI and economic growth in the eastern region. The eastern region should try to take the lead in realizing the transition from the quantity to quality in utilizing FDI.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Indicator System of Person-Organization Fit for Enterprise Technician
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on investigation, this article identified an evaluation index system of person-organization fit for enterprise technician through analysis data, and applied the comprehensive evaluation methods, such as Analytic Hierarchy Process, comprehensive index and clustering analysis, to evaluate and analyze a particular enterprise's technicians on person-organization fit.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Tourism Image of Cities in the Southern Yangtze River Perceived by Tourists--A Case Study of the Four Cities in Zhejiang and Jiangsu
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Information Needs for Asset Management for Australian Government Property
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Governments provide services to their citizens. Organisations including government departments necessarily require built infrastructure in order to deliver these services and carry out their business. The effective and efficient management of built assets and infrastructure is called Facilities Management (FM). The three enablers of FM are cited as "leadership and governance; resource capacity and capability; and management information systems (MIS) and data". This paper discusses the issues of governance, resource capacity & capability, and management information & data with respect to their improvement - hence enhancement of the management of service delivery by the Australian Government to its citizens.

articleTitle: Risk Factor Analysis of Safety and Security of Large-Scale Sport Events: Decision Making Trial and Evaluation Laboratory Approach
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper adopts the decision making trial and evaluation laboratory (DEMATEL) approach in its quantitative analysis of the effects of the risk factors of the safety and security of large-scale sport events. The goal of large-scale sport event safety and security is proposed, the risk factor index system of safety and security on large-scale sport event specified, and the relation between each pair of indexes decided by expert survey. The analysis reveals weather risk, group accidents, serious traffic accidents, serious fire and crime as significant risk factors; hence organizers must take serious precautions to avoid or reduce the possible effects of such risk factors on large-scale sport events.

articleTitle: Research on the Strategy of Construction Material Procurement When the Price Fluctuation Is Considered
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Analyzed the contractor's material procurement process and management, and put forward that the contractor should use the quantitative order methods to order the material. Ensure the material supply timely, at the same time, also considered the impact of price fluctuations, and accordingly two kinds of procurement adjustment strategy are given, which can make the procurement cost and total inventory cost achieve the lowest. Finally, though a case study validated the method usability. It can guide the procurement of construction materials effectively.

articleTitle: Logit Model for Pre-Warning Financial Distress of Listed Real-Estate Companies in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper mainly discusses the study of models for financial distress pre-warning, trying to select general financial indexes by principal component analysis, and meanwhile adding nonfinancial indexes which reflect corporate governance state to complement. Logit Model which is more accurate in prediction is selected, with the 56 company samples including both delisting pre-warned companies and counterparts without financial distress. Old Logit Model with 9 integrative financial indexes and new model with 6 more nonfinancial indexes are respectively built and pass the tests finally. By adding nonfinancial indexes into Logit Model, this paper goes to the conclusion that the new index system was more precise than the old one.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Framework Design and Research on Enterprises Group Financial Decision Support System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Setting up of Management Information Subsystem of Searching, Analysis and Utilization: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The popularization and application of management information system (MIS) is an important mark of the information age, which mainly includes two subsystems: search system and system of analysis and utilization. Taking Haier Group for example, the thesis analyses its construction experience in building MIS and information competition rules that it contains. Haier's experience has fully proved that MIS' integration is not only a platform for integration of subsystems, but also the data integration that subsystem could achieve timely management, play and explore the overall effectiveness of information system.

articleTitle: Ethical Restraint Mechanism of E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-commerce is a new form of economic activity that uses the Internet and electronic technology to assist people in conducting various business activities. E-commerce is a new kind of activity space and form created by people with modern Internet technology by using the Internet as a carrier, but e-commerce is not in a confronting position to other forms of economic activities; instead they are closely related and inter-penetrating. While enhancing economic efficiency and creating huge economic benefits, e-commerce, as a new form of social economic activity, brings a lot of ethical problems. This article starts with the ethical problems existing in e-commerce, summarizes the manifestations of the problems in e-commerce, analyzes the causes and then proposes approaches and solutions to these problems.

articleTitle: Research on Service Capacity of Production Line Based on Complex Weighted Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Production line is a complicated system which comprises many various interacting elements. A complex weighted network model is presented to describe and analyze service capacity of production line in this paper. Manufacturing units are regarded as vertices to denote various resources, such as equipments and workers. The production processes could create directed edges and network topological structure. Network model assigns weight to represent the times of process relationships between vertices. Some feature parameters are defined to characterize the complex statistical properties and uncover the service status of production line. Some important vertices and edges are obtained through analyzing topological properties of complex weight network. Then corresponding controlling strategies are suggested to maintain service capacity of the whole production line. Finally an actual production line as an example is analyzed in this paper to exhibit method and approach of complex weight network of production line.

articleTitle: Experimental Study and Performance Analysis of New Ceramic Materials
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Experiment of liquid phase sintering of boron carbide ceramic material was taken as an object, the description of the formation process of this material was made based on the nature of the material and sintering mechanism. Properties of the material were analyzed through density and the quality, types of additives. The study on performance of the material was made to expand on their various aspects of effective development, and this made the material to meet wider application.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Organizational Culture on Human Resource Management in China's Transportation Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Organizational culture and human resource management are two basic impetuses that concentrate mainly on human resources and promote the development of enterprises. In this paper, the author briefly introduced the organizational culture and the human resource management in the beginning, and then thoroughly analyzed the impacts of organizational culture on human resource management of the transportation enterprises in China, which mainly consist of guidance, agglomeration, regulation and motivation. Finally, based on the previous studies, several corresponding reasonable and practical policy recommendations are provided for reference.

articleTitle: Probability of Default Estimation Model for Listed Bank Based on Minimum Error
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The main trouble to calculate the probabilities of default of listed banks with KMV model is that the coefficient of long term liabilities γ is uncertain. The probabilities of default can also be calculated according to credit spreads of financial bonds. Following the idea to minimize the differences between the probabilities of default calculated by KMV model and the probabilities of default according to credit spreads, a non-constrained programming model is established to determine the optimal value of γ for calculation of default points of listed banks. Adopting the optimal value of γ, the probabilities of default of listed banks without financial bonds issued can be estimated with KMV model, and the probabilities of default calculated are consistent with the situation in the credit market.

articleTitle: Discovery of Multi-Level Spatial Association Rules Based on DE-9IM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Expression and definition of spatial relationship are crucial for spatial data mining. A new method of spatial relationship expression based on DE-9IM theory is proposed. The accurate spatial topology relationship between different objects can be expressed when this method is used in multi-level association rules discovery. The corresponding algorithm is also implemented and efficiency is enhanced by the MBR test and meta-rule. Experimental results show that the algorithm is valid and efficient.

articleTitle: Gender Matters: College Students Using Internet Interactive Services
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study uses a sample of 368 senior undergraduate students to analyze whether there are gender differences in using 3 kinds of internet interactive services. Results show that female students tend to be more communicative than male, which is consistent with previous researches. At the meantime, college female showing stronger tendency in reaching out for information and net resources in BBS is new compared with other researches.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on Brand Identity Impression of Customer to Satisfaction Degree--Based on a Survey of KFC's Consumption of Nanchang City
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The research on brand identity impression and satisfaction degree of customers is an important issue and academic frontier in the brand research area. In this paper, using first-hand data of KFC and structural equation model (SEM), we have empirical study on the impact of customers' brand identity impression to satisfaction degree. The results show that: advertisements and customers' consume experience to products have a significant positive impact on customer satisfaction degree; however, customers' impressions of the KFC appearance and perception to its products and service have no significant impact on customer satisfaction degree.

articleTitle: Research on Questions of Human Resources Management Effectiveness Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Human Resources Management Effectiveness is the effect or the degree of achieving goals of Human Resources Management (HRM). It is the concerned topic of managers and senior executives of human resources all along. A good many scholars have carried out indefatigable pursuit to its evaluation modes and measures. The authors synthesize views of scholars home and abroad and make a relatively complete summary and illustration to the questions of the HRM effectiveness evaluation.

articleTitle: The Forming Mechanism of Brand Experience
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Consumption experience is one of crucial factors influencing consumers' purchase behavior. How do consumers experience a brand? However, this question is not well answered. Thus, this article explores the forming mechanism of brand experience. Particularly, this article attempts to address the influence of two antecedent variables of perceived quality and value on brand experience; and the moderating effect of quality consciousness and price consciousness on above relationships, respectively. By the regression analysis of Chinese survey sample, this article finds, perceived quality and value both positively influences brand experience. Furthermore, price consciousness positively moderates the effect of perceived value on brand experience. In contrast, however, quality consciousness doesn't positively moderate the effect of perceived quality on brand experience. Finally, this article presents managerial implications.

articleTitle: Analysis on Resource Productivity in Binhai New Area of Tianjin City
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Tianjin Binhai New Area plays an important role to boost the economy of Tianjin and North China according to the long-term development planning of China. Since a large amount of resources will be needed, the environment pollution will be much more concerned. Improving resource productivity is of great importance to conserve the resource and solve the pollution problems. The study explores the current state of the resource productivity of Binhai New Area and compares it with that of Tianjin, which aims to help improve the productivity of Binhai New Area. We conclude that from 2000 to 2007 Binhai New Area has improved the productivity of most of the resources. The resource productivity of DMI has increased by 78 percent, while the increasing rate for energy, land, labor, mineral, water, and biomass is 49 percent, 313 percent, 202 percent, 27 percent, 105 percent and 37 percent respectively. The productivity of each type of resource of Binhai New Area except biomass is higher than that of Tianjin. And the gap of the productivity of mineral between Binhai New Area and Tianjin is narrow. Thus, we suggest that Binhai New Area should pay more attention to increasing the productivity of energy, mineral, water and biomass in the future. A proper improvement goal and the supports from the government and private sector will be helpful to improve the resource productivity of Binhai New Area.

articleTitle: Extension of Some Asymptotic Results on Finite Time Ruin in Compound Poisson Model with Constant Interest Force and Diffusion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Kluppelberg and Stadtmuller (1998) proved a precise asymptotic formula for the ruin probability of the classical interest force and regularly varying tailed claims when the initial capital u tends to infinity . This paper extends their results in several aspects as follows: First, the risk models are the Conditional Poisson and Non-Qici Poisson Process respectively; Second, the ruin probability is replaced by the finite time ruin probability within time T and the claimsize is of Subexponential family which is more wide then that of regularly varying's family. At last, the diffusion term of Brownian Motion is considered. construct et ψ(u;T) be the finite time ruin probability in the renewal risk model, where u is the initial capital of the company and T denotes some given time bound. Under the assumption that the distribution of the claim size belongs to the Extended regular variation class, this paper obtains an asymptotic formula for ψ(u;T). This result improves the related works in the recent literature.

articleTitle: Research on Emergency Management System of City Disasters in Tianjin
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper, based on researches, analyses the status and problems of Tianjin city disasters emergency management system. The paper, by analyzing the connotation of city disasters emergency management system and the need to set up it, and learning from advanced emergency management experience in other cities at home and abroad, points out the corresponding countermeasures on building Tianjin city disasters emergency management system, as well as the guarantee of its laws and regulations, every function.

articleTitle: Competitive Analysis on Financial Leasing Problem
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the on-line financial leasing problem, an on-line player, who is the leaser, is given the job of deciding whether to buy the equipment initially or to rent it according to the financial leasing contract, without knowing the future interest rates over the whole rental time. This paper studies the on-line financial leasing problem from the perspective of competitive analysis theory. To begin with, based on the formulation of relevant parameters, a Financial Leasing Competitive Algorithm is established. Following that, corollary and numerical examples concerning competitive analysis for this algorithm are given. Finally, some future research directions are pointed out.

articleTitle: The "Pyramid Model" and Measurement on Regional Human Capital Competence
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Regional human capital competence model named "Pyramid Model" is established. It is agreed that regional human capital competence depends on forth major factors and they are human capital stock, structure, performance and attraction. In terms of "Pyramid Model", the evaluation indexes system of human capital competence is built up. Human capital competence of Chinese provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly is evaluated and analyzed by means of principal component analysis.
