The research and facts show that regional human capital competence and economical development reinforce each other and interact, that economically developed areas generally pay more attention to Incentives to human capital and that it can be carried out from the four aspects of human capital stock, structure, performance and attraction for regions to upgrade human capital competence.

articleTitle: Strategic Human Resource Development through Mentoring
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this study were to discuss diversity mentoring and organization's influence. The case study is a high technology company in Taiwan. There are 11 employees interviewed, and come out the conclusions as: diversity mentoring from organizational development, has faced the multiple hardships but still insisted on keeping conducting, influence on the organization and employees from the mentoring systems. We then further discuss the theoretical and managerial implications of our conclusions.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Emulator Model of Mont Carlo of Supply Chain Management by Form and Exploitation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A Study on the Forms of the Seismic Damage to the Tunnels and Its Influencing Factors
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Through the investigation of the seismic damage to the tunnels by the Wenchuan Earthquake on May 12, 2008, the damage mainly takes the following forms:tunnel lining shear location movement, the tunnel structure destruction caused by the slope destruction, tunnel lining destruction, side wall destruction and tunnel portal collapse. It is closely related to the earthquake magnitude, the earthquake intensity, the buried depth of the tunnel, the geological conditions, and the underground structural model. These findings provide evidence for the seismic design of the tunnel.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Design Framework of E-Commerce Platform of Chinese Forest Products
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on the Independent Innovation and Motivation Mechanism of SMEs in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper construct the model of the small and medium-sized enterprises independent innovation system. Through empirical analysis on the SMEs innovation system of the Jilin Province, we found there are some phenomenon in the process of the creation and development of SME's innovation systems such as not obvious motivation, indifference innovative culture, insufficient innovation investment and imperfect innovation policy. The government should improve incentive mechanism, make full use of entrepreneur role in innovation activities, create innovation environment, solve the bottleneck of lack of innovation funds and make relevant policies to promote the independent innovation upgrading.

articleTitle: The Administration of Career to "The 1980's" Employees Based on Psychological Contract
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper has introduced Rousseau's characteristic model of psychological contract. It has established four different kinds of psychological contract model from two-dimensions of time and employing condition. At the same time, it has introduced four different personal behavior reaction models while psychological contract is violated. Regarding these two models as analytic tools, this paper has analyzed the characteristic and localization of psychological contract models of "the 1980's" employees at developing stage of career. Then the paper pointed out how to apply the psychological contract to effectively manage "the 1980's" employees at career.

articleTitle: Cause-Related Behavior: Comparison of Consumer Goods Corporations and Industrial Goods Corporations
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The matching of corporations cause-related behavior and types of corporation has a great influence on the efficiency of cause-related marketing. We compared the cause-related behavior of industrial goods corporations with consumer goods corporations' in this research, and discussed how the different types of corporations choose the suitable cause-related actions.

articleTitle: Study on Fuzzy Reliability Multi-Objective Optimization of Incomplete Probability Information Systems Base on Genetic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In view of system reliable multi-objective optimization design question which the conventional optimization method were mutually contradictory attribute and difficulty, It proposed multi-objective fuzzy reliability optimization decision method based on genetic algorithm and non-probability distribution information. The method used fuzzy set membership function characteristic to reflect objective function relatively important degree and used the probabilistic perturbation method and Edgeworth series technique to transform incomplete probability information for the standardized normal distribution function, then ,it make simple target model with each goal coordinated degree, it uses the conventional optimization method to obtain the multi-objective optimization satisfactory solution. Finally, It gives an example to confirm this method is validity.

articleTitle: A Study on the Construction of Virtual Enterprise Capability System Oriented to Project Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The concept of virtual enterprise capability is proposed based on the theory of virtual enterprise and enterprise capability. Virtual enterprise capability depends on project, so it is temporary, integrated and complex capability. The system of virtual enterprise capability is presented which is composed of project, organization, communication, process and environment. Virtual enterprise capability has three stratums: standard capability, systematic capability and complex capability. Virtual enterprise capability is dynamic in quantity and quality.

articleTitle: The Impact of Social Learning on Mass Customization Capability
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this study, we explored the impact of customer and supplier learning on the improvement of firm's mass customization capability that is an imperative weapon for today's market competition. Using the data from a global survey, we find that both the customer and supplier learning will increase firm's mass customization capability.

articleTitle: Study on Carrying Capacity of Agricultural Water Resources in Fuxin City
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on utilization conditions of water resources, this paper analyzed the carrying capacity of agricultural water resources in Fuxin city by applying fuzzy synthetic evaluation model. Results showed that the development of agricultural water resources tended to reach saturation in Fuxin City in 2008. In order to realize sustainable utilization of agricultural water resources and water resources as a whole, we should focus on two aspects: on one hand we should adopt water-saving irrigation technology to improve utilization efficiency of agricultural water. On the other hand, we should optimize agricultural planting structure and raise the proportion of low water-consumption crops.

articleTitle: Research on the Role of Teamwork in Innovation Management within Manufacturing Companies in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper aims at identifying the role teamwork plays in innovation management within the manufacturing companies in China. Using a questionnaire-based approach, a survey was conducted from five manufacturing companies in China namely; Haier, C- Bons Group, Midea, Wuhan Economy Technique Development Area Dongjiang Commerce cl. Ltd and Dongfeng Peugeot Citroen Automobile Company Ltd. The outcome of the analysis of 351 respondents revealed that, teamwork helps in ensuring effective innovation management by promoting good managerial decisions thereby helping these manufacturing companies achieve their innovation objectives. However, the index Appraisal of Team members instead of the team according to the result, do not play much role in effective innovation management as it received the highest total score under disagree option.

articleTitle: Information Technology in English Teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Modern information technology can not only show the teaching content vividly, enlarge students' horizons, broaden students' views through the combination of audio and sound, appropriate forms of expression but also activate classroom atmosphere greatly, enrich the teaching content, stimulate students' interest and thirst for knowledge, strengthen students' ability of autonomous learning, understanding etc. Therefore the application of information technology in English teaching has become the hotspot in English education. This paper mainly expounds the concept, strategies and advantages of application of information technology in English teaching. The application can promote teaching reform.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Innovative Measures of the Internationalizing Development of Chinese Futures Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Industry Linkage, Market Thickness and the Development of Producer Services in Regional Economy: Case of Heilongjiang, China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Producer services play a strategic role in regional economy development by increase in market specialization and decrease in transaction cost. This article constructs a Cobb-Douglas Production Function of manufacturing, in which producer services were treated as an intermediate input in manufacturing. In the model, market thickness is the key determinant which exercises great influence on the development of producer services in regional market equilibrium. The Heilongjiang's empirical results suggest that producer services do play an important role in expending the division of labor and productivity regionally, and the thickness and categories of manufacturing restrict producer services' scale.

articleTitle: Research on Supplier Selection with Data Envelopment Analysis under Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There is now considerable concern for foodservice industry about the problem of supplier selection in the background of supply chain management. A supplier selection index system based on chain catering industry was developed, and the relevance between indexes were reduced through factor analysis. Suppliers can be analyzed with the decision making model. Further more, to achieve the dynamic selection of supplier, life cycle of enterprise development was introduced, which make contribution to the integration of supply chain. Finally, the method of supplier dynamic selection was tested and verified by a numerical example.The result showed this supplier selection method was applicable to chain catering industry.

articleTitle: Traffic Control Site Selection for Freeway Management in Mountainous Areas under Foggy Conditions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to ensure the traffic safety of freeway in fog, it is necessary to take traffic control measures. Based on the road networks conditions of mountainous freeway, and the analysis of driver's travel behavior as well as the requirement of traffic control in fog, it brings forward the selection principles of traffic control site for freeway management under foggy conditions, researches on the technology of traffic control site selection under static and dynamic traffic conditions, sets up an algorithm of traffic control site selection, and then proposes the recommended standard of dynamic traffic control for mountainous freeway in fog from those aspects like vehicle mobility pattern, sight distance support and information distribution, etc.

articleTitle: Key Element Identification of Workplace Emergency Management in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The aims of seeking a solution of workplace emergency management and enhancing emergency management pertinence demand identifying the key elements of workplace emergency management at present stage in China. The author systematically categorized workplace emergency management problems, and combed the logical relationships separately with key elements and with management stages. Through literature research method, the essay, with theoretical elements, identified the key elements of workplace emergency management at present stage in China.

articleTitle: Employee Performance Improvement by Internal Customer Orientation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Internal markets have been identified due to exchanges of values existing inside the organization. The existence of internal market advocates the concept of internal customers. Companies with an internal customer orientation have more power in human resource management and gaining competitive advantages. This paper investigates how internal customer orientation can have positive impact on employee's performance at both the attitude and behavioral level. Three major dimensions are required for successful internal customer orientation. An exploratory research has been taken by using the qualitative method. The research outcome shows a positive relationship between internal customer orientation and employee performance. Finally, management implications have been recommended.

articleTitle: Influence of Petroleum Price Fluctuation to Main Petroleum-Consumed Industries in USA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: USA is a country seriously relied on petroleum energy. Several historical petroleum crises had caused huge negative influence, more or less, to USA economy, these urged USA government to establish a comprehensive petroleum crisis coping mechanism International petroleum price fluctuated dramatically, especially, international petroleum price fluctuation range in whole year of 2008 exceeded those of three petroleum crisis of last century. By studying influence of all previous petroleum crises to USA petroleum-consumed industries, this paper comes to following conclusion: Increasing of petroleum price all-round reduced production added value of road transportation, chemical industry and aviation industry in USA, brought adverse effect to these industries. USA highway transportation industry has a relative weak capability to cope with petroleum price increasing, and recently, affected seriously by petroleum price increasing. International petroleum price rise had caused each industry's expense to petroleum increasing constantly, and resulted in added value reduction. Affect by international petroleum price increasing to main petroleum-consumed industries is under weakened.

articleTitle: Secondary Development on Android Intelligence Mobile Phone Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper we use Android application development interfaces and Eclipse IDE development environment, design and develop the electronic dictionary application based on a new generation of intelligence mobile Google platform Android. The English words' import, retrieve, add and delete function are simulated through a virtual machine Device. We simulate the design through Sharp SH905i mobile. The purpose is to verify the availability of the platform.

articleTitle: Study on Conservation and Revival of the Historic Site
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Xi'an was once called Chang'an and has nearly 1100-year history as the capital of China. The Shuyuanmen block located inside the South Gate along the city wall was built in the Ming Dynasty, which is well known as the quarter of culture and education in the past. At present there are some historic and monumental buildings scattering over, such as the Confucius Temple and Steles of the Song Dynasty, the city wall of the Ming Dynasty and the Baoqingsi Pagoda of Qing Dynasty etc. Under the effect of the strategy of passive protection on the historic sites in the latest years, the status of historic block has been the ever worse, the residential environment deterioration and the living quality degradation made the area an neglected part in the process of urban development. Therefore this paper points out the conservation of historic city should implement a more positive urban strategy. The conservation of historic city and the revival of traditional culture deserve to be related with the upgradation of residential environment and living quality. Thus the urban development can stride forward in a favorable way.

articleTitle: Safety-Oriented Optimization of the Community Organization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper emphasizes that social capital should be deeply understood besides the government plans of command and control in the progress of making urban disaster policy. The existent social networks, citizen organizations and social institutions of the primary-level community should be used comprehensively, so as to confront urban disaster. The purpose of the safety-oriented optimization of the community organization is to build the cell of disaster prevention and relief. The practical methods include: the self-organized optimization by flexible design of community security organization and function integration, and hetero-organized optimization by common utilization and organized coordination.

articleTitle: Study on Urban Low-Carbon Competitiveness of China Based on Co Integration Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Urban low-carbon competitiveness is closely related to environmental protection, low-carbon economy and sustainable urban development. The G20 Low Carbon Competitiveness report by Vivid Economics provides a fresh perspective. Commissioned by E3G and the Climate Institute (Australia), the report offers the first comparative, data-driven analysis of the low carbon competitiveness of major economies accounting for around 75% of world GDP and nearly 70% of global greenhouse gas emissions. However, it is not perfect enough to study on urban low-carbon competitiveness. In this paper, the essential of urban low-carbon competitiveness is discussed based on the co integration relation between CO2 emissions and HDI index in China during the period time from the year 1990 through 2005. The fundamental system of urban low-carbon competitiveness is investigated from the following three aspects: carbon threshold, welfare threshold and decoupling development. This study may provide some valuable reference for the low-carbon urban management.

articleTitle: Analyzing Influencing Factors of Organizational Innovative Climate Based on DEMATEL Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Summarizing influencing factors of organizational innovative climate according to literature review, the paper which analyzes influencing factors of organizational innovative climate quantitatively by using Decision Making Trial and Evaluation Laboratory (DEMATEL) approach explores internal structure of influencing factors system. Its conclusion is that the key influencing factors of organizational innovative climate are organizational strategy, leadership style, organizational structure and management practices and so on, which should be especially focused on in the course of forming a good innovative climate in the organization. It provides a theoretical basis to manage organizational innovation.

articleTitle: Evolution and Innovation of the IT Industry Chain of China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on deeply analyzing the situation of the IT industry chain of China, this paper takes dissipative structure theory and synergetics to analyze its evolution dynamic mechanism, and then constructs the evolution model to judge its evolution laws. Finally, this paper puts forward with innovation mechanism for the IT industry chain of China from five aspects including conception innovation, perspective innovation, model innovation, force innovation and strategy innovation.

articleTitle: A Model of Supply Chain Construction Based on OGSA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Choosing satisfactory cooperative partner, i.e. supplier or retailer, and constructing excellent supply chain are important for success of manufacturing enterprise in today's global highly competitive business environment. Grid, which stands for developing trend of next generation of Internet, make enterprise use global manufacturing resource more easily. Model of common supply chain construction is presented in this paper firstly, then method of searching for supplier based on OGSA, i.e. Open Grid Services Architecture, is proposed. Finally, algorithm of evaluating supplier is discussed. In this way, a model of supply chain construction based on OGSA and its key research topic is presented.

articleTitle: A Model of Monopoly E-Marketplaces with Inter- and Intra-Group Externalities in Two-Sided Markets
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The e-marketplaces, which play a key role in electronic commerce with facilitating transactions and aggregating information, show positive inter-group externalities where one group's benefit from receiving a service depends on the number of the intermediary services consumed by the other group, and negative intra-group externalities where the surplus is destroyed because members within the group compete with each other. In this paper, with a different approach from the emerging theory of two-sided markets, we analyze an e-marketplace owned by a third-party firm by substituting the size of consumers with the number of intermediary services. Moreover, we pay close attention to solving the following problems: (1) When these inter- and intra-group externalities exist, are both the demand curves and the pricing strategies of intermediary services different from those of traditional goods? (2) How to price intermediary services to maximize profit in the e-marketplaces? (3) How do these network externalities affect the management strategy of platforms? Finally, we exemplify such analytical results as pricing strategies of platforms with managerial practice of electronic commerce.

articleTitle: County Sustainable Development and Management in Gansu Loess Plateau Based on Emergy Analysis--Taking Zhengning County in Gansu Province as an Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Zhengning County in Gansu Province, the cradle of traditional farming culture, is abundant in coal resource and solar energy, but it is ecologically fragile and has significant ecological service function, therefore facing the dual pressure of resource exploitation and environmental protection. Based on the analysis of main emergy indices of Zhengning eco-economic system during the past 20 years, this paper evaluates the efficiency of material metabolism and the capability for sustainable development, and puts forward sustainable management to promote the rapid and harmonious development of west China's counties.

articleTitle: Research in Infrastructure Financial with Government Guarantees of Prestige Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Financing of the infrastructure is always a focus and also it is difficult for the government, especially the local government which is not rich. In the processing of Infrastructure construction, the government's guarantee plays an important role. Government may be charged with contingent expenses. Based on prestige model, the paper compare the government's the behavior with and without the pressure of financial constraints. And the paper arrive at a conclusion that the government's finance is very important to determine the government's behavior.

articleTitle: Integration Stages & Patterns of Port Service Supply Chains
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Through elaboration on the concept of Port Service Supply Chain, the four integration stages like no integration, interior integration, exterior integration and integration among different port supply chains are pointed out, among which the third one is the emphasis of this paper. Six integration patterns applicable for this stage are introduced and compared according to their different characters like degree of integration, degree of coupling, information capability and influence on the partners. The transition mode of six integration patterns is analyzed and the six patterns are divided into primary, intermediate and advanced level according to their degree of integration. Finally, the features of three integration levels are discussed and some conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: A Trust Model of Public Information Platform of Logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The article analyzed the trust problem in logistics public information platform through direct and indirect reputation. A trust managing model based on reputation was developed through setting up evaluation criteria system for direct and indirect reputation, integrating the weight and the fuzzy membership degree of each criterion. An Incentive factor was introduced to the model so as to avoid Freerider phenomenon effectively. And the model was explained and verified through a calculating case.

articleTitle: Evaluation Indices System of Freeway Alignment Design and Natural Environment Protection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Highway construction inevitably may cause certain influence to the natural environment along the route, particularly in design stage; if the route selection is unreasonable, it will certainly poses the serious threat to the natural environment. On the contrary, good design can reasonably develop, use, protect and promote the value of natural environment along the route. In order to assess different route design schemes, firstly, it should establish a reasonable index system based on the aim of alignment design, then, select impersonal assessment method. According to the aim of alignment design of freeway on mountain areas, eleven indexes have been selected by design investigation, experts consultation and combining criterion indexes, such as the flexibility of route adapting to terrain, the maximum height of fill slope, the maximum depth of digging slope and so on. The grade criterion of indexes has also been studied. Application results shows that the index system is representative, exercisable and simple for selecting good design which can reduce freeway's impact on natural environment along the route.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Atmospheric Thermal Environment of Residential District by CFD Simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The application of CFD is more and more extensive in the research field of district environment. The way of intuitional expression is also tend to more and more recognized by citizens and city decision makers. CFD simulation and its superiority for district planning and design, its application for residential district atmospheric thermal environmental evaluation and improvement in district planning and design is introduced and discussed in this paper. A practical example of CFD simulation and evaluation for district planning and design is also presented. The significance and prospect of CFD simulation and evaluation for district planning and design is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: The Application Research of Visualization-ACA Technology in the Study of Scientific Structure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper is dedicated to describe scientific structure, analyze the discipline development trends and draw scientific knowledge-mapping by visualization-ACA. We can get a subject scientific paradigm by studying and developing ACA and visual ACA from which a more accurate science structure description can be made. Certain science developing laws and science structures can be illustrated by visualization-ACA, which paves a way for science research management and technology policies.

articleTitle: The Research and Construction of Rural Information Platform Based on CMMB
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The CMMB (China Multimedia Mobile Broadcasting) rural information platform provides farmers with a new, fast, and comprehensive information transmission channels. The text introduces a method of rural information platform construction based on CMMB. China's present Rural Information station and problems are given and the role of rural information platform is designed. The CMMB network coverage and the rural information platform structure are introduced. At last, the conclusion is given.

articleTitle: Detecting Relationship of Learning City and Urban Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Large-scale industrial transfer and varied competitive factors, City, as a sort of regional economic organizations, competitive elements of it has extended from the capital and resources which are the most primitive factors to knowledge, resources and capital and other factors. Construction of Learning City is the most important ways to raise competitiveness. Knowledge stock, learning ability and motivation to learn and the main platform for learning are the key factors to learning-oriented city. Strategies of building learning networks and partnerships in the city, building knowledge bases, strengthening knowledge training system and lifelong learning mechanisms, establishing the exchange platform for the units to learn from each other in the city are contribute to the construction and development of a learning city.

articleTitle: Empirical Studies on U-I Collaborative Innovation Mechanism: Based on the Dominant Design Review
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: U-I collaborative Innovation has become an imperative for both universities and companies to strengthen their values and to remain competitiveness gained. This paper, Firstly based on U-A model and dominant design perspective, identifies three key controllable factors which affecting U-I innovation performance as research hypothesis; Secondly, based on the acquisition of 551 questionnaires and the mathematical statistics methods, verifies above hypothesis. The research result of this paper will play very important role for U-I collaboration innovation practices, as well as for optimizing public polices.

articleTitle: Study on Biomedical Application Prospect of Benzene/Alcohol Extractives from Magnolia heptapeta Based on Environment Protection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Magnolia heptapeta has been used in traditional Chinese medicine. However Magnolia heptapeta are still underutilized and hence wasted. In order to better utilize Magnolia heptapeta resources, the biomedicine resource of benzene/alcohol extractives from Magnolia heptapeta leavies were analyzed by GC/MS. The main ingredients of benzene/alcohol extractives of Magnolia heptapeta were toluene, 1,3-dioxane, 2-pentadecyl-, 3,6-nonadien-5-one, 2,2,8,8-tetram ethyl-, 6,8-dioxa-3-thiabicyclo(3,2,1)octa ne 3,3-dioxide, aromadendrene, dehydro-, 1-naphthalenamine, n-phenyl-, phenol, 2,4-bis(1-phenylethyl)-, vitamin e, 3,6,9,12-tetraoxatetradecan-1-ol, 14-[4-(1,1,3,3-tetramethylbutyl)phenoxy]-, phytol, phenol, 2-(1-phenylethyl)-, ethanone, 1-(methylenecyclopropyl) , 6,7-dimethoxyquinoxaline, 1,2-benzenedicarboxylic acid, bis(2-methylpropyl) ester, etc. The results obtained fully indicated that the benzene/alcohol extractives of Magnolia heptapeta leavies had the great potential of biomedicines.

articleTitle: Research on Concurrent Engineering in Product Design
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Concurrent Engineering is a new mode of product development which emerging in recent years, and it will be paid attention by many foreign research institutions and manufacturing enterprises. According to the characteristic of product design, the development process of product design based-on concurrent engineering is brought forward in the thesis, and the scope, characteristics and applications of product design based-on concurrent engineering are researched, and propose concurrent design.

articleTitle: Study on Innovation Management Model Based on Technological Growth
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the pertinent literature at home and abroad, this paper made a comparative study on the concepts, models and characters of continuous and discontinuous innovation, and provided an important criterion to define continuous and discontinuous innovation-weather the technological trajectory and technological paradigm are same. According to the technological growth curve, the process of technological innovation is divided into the growth phase, plateau phase and transitional phase, then the paper proposed that the enterprises should adopt innovation combination, conduct continuous and discontinuous innovation management activities during technological growth and technology alternation, and the author built the manage model of the continuous and discontinuous innovation based on technological growth.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Deformation Predication and Management of Large Bridge Based on Radial Basis Function Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on Strategic Risk Based on Resource-Based View: From the Perspective of Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Competitiveness is the most important aspect in an enterprise, and it reflects the overall level of an enterprise. Based on resource-based view, this paper points out the competitiveness is composed of three elements, that is, resources, capacity and environment. From the angel of competitiveness, we analyze the formation of strategic risk. In the end, we also provide some methods, such as accumulating the resources and keeping strategic flexibility, to control the strategic risk.

articleTitle: Analysis of Priority of Engineering Project Management Objective System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is very important to determinate the objective system priority that affects the realization of project general objective. In this research Analytic Hierarchy Process is introduced into analyzing the relationship of three objectives from the questionnaire data collected by the experts. Priority of three objectives is identified, which is the quality as first, time and cost next. The result of this research can help to determinate objective system reasonablely, carry out the project smoothly and improve management level.

articleTitle: Influencing Factors Analysis and Spreading Suggestions of Online Bank in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Although online bank is more and more important in the business, some customers still do not use it. Therefore, this paper analyzes some critical factors that may influence the use intention of online bank, including perceived usefulness, and perceived easy to use based on TAM model and perceived riskness and familiarity. Then this paper takes WELLS FARGO bank as an example which implements successfully in online bank field, and through analyzing its strengths to provide some suggestions to Chinese online banks.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation of Customer Satisfaction in Service-Oriented Small and Medium Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the characteristics of the customer satisfaction of Service-oriented small and medium enterprises, this paper is to analyze its decision, build its decision model, put forward the principle of evaluation, assume the evaluation index system, explore the feasibility of carrying through fuzzy synthesis evaluation, establish the mathematics models for fuzzy synthesis evaluating the customer satisfaction of service-oriented small and medium enterprises, and provide demonstration. And then, this article will discuss the fuzzy mathematics concrete application in the service customer satisfaction evaluation, and establish the fuzzy synthesis judgment indicator system of customer satisfaction and the mathematical model, which is a kind of beneficial exploration to appraise the service quality.

articleTitle: Elements Impact on Retail Chain with Real-Time Logistics Based on ISM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The retail chain faces new problems and challenges with the change of external market environment. This paper introduces real-time logistics into the operation of retail chain. To analyze the elements that influence the implementation of real-time logistics in retail chain, the paper constructs an ISM model and a decision-making hierarchy diagram. With the result of MICMAC analysis, the paper gives the key elements of management and intervention in the retail chain with real-time logistics.

articleTitle: The Initiating Forces of the Born Global Firms: An Empirical Research from China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper selects 198 Born Global Firms (BGFs) in Chinese Pearl River Delta and Yangtze River Delta regions as research object to build a drive model of BGFs. The study finds that the entrepreneurship is the most crucial initiating force of BGFs; Relationship network, market environment and product characteristics also play important roles in triggering rapid internationalization of the BGFs.

articleTitle: On Multi-Media Technology in College Teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is very important to use the multimedia as supplementary means in college teaching, and it is the need of educational development. This paper analysis the feature of multimedia computer-assisted instruction and the basic principles that should be followed in the fabrication of multimedia courseware. And the author have pointed out that in the teaching practice, because of the insufficient understanding of the position and function of multimedia computer-assisted instruction, there emerge such mistaken ideas: accolade the multimedia technology excessively and neglect the function of regular teaching; Pursue the multimedia form excessively and dilute the theme of the teaching content; Rely on the multimedia technology excessively and lose the teacher's teaching style, etc.. In order to make multimedia computer-assisted instruction develop in a healthy way, we should pay more attention to these mistaken ideas.

articleTitle: Building Semantic Web Services Automatically Based on PART
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Internet is the largest information repository. Most information retrieval systems are based on the premise that users know the keywords for searching subjects. Web services provide a suitable technical framework for making business processes accessible within enterprises and across enterprises, so that they have promoted a new paradigm of a business process which is called the service-oriented business process. The system then uses a Bayesian network to insert the terms and finish the complete hierarchy of the ontology. The feature of this ontology construction system includes that the PART architecture overcomes the lack of flexibility in clustering, while in the web page analysis, WordNet and Entropy deal with the lack of knowledge acquisition. Empirical results demonstrate that the new design help users with little domain knowledge obtain appropriate keywords.

articleTitle: VRP Optimization of Intensive Distribution in Enterprise Sales Logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the logistics system for vehicle routing problem is a hot issue of the current study, problem-solving is good or bad a direct bearing on the overall performance of the system. This paper studies vehicle routing problem in sales logistics, and mainly to solve the problem of distribution center how to achieve route optimization from a cost point.

articleTitle: Mechanical Characteristics of Anchorage Interface Based on Fractal Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Mechanical characteristics of anchorage-body interface were studied by using fractal theory. The influence to fractal dimension of anchorage-body interface caused by the sand factor of grouting material and the sand fineness was studied. The study shows that the fractal dimension and the roughness coefficient of the interface increase with the increase of sand factor, and decrease with the decrease of sand factor. The fractal dimension of the interface decreases with the increase of the fractal dimension of sand fineness, on the contrary, the fractal dimension of the interface increases. The results show that fractal theory provides a new method of studying mechanical characteristics of anchorage-body interface. During anchorage design, sand factor of grouting material may be optimized based on the analysis of the fractal dimension of sand fineness of grouting material, in addition, the fractal dimension and roughness of anchorage-body interface may be increased to improve the shearing resistance of the interface.

articleTitle: PRINCE2 Based Project Management Maturity Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents the PRINCE2 based project management maturity model that determines and positions an organization's relative project management level with other organizations. The comprehensive model follows a systematic approach to establish an organization's current project management level. Each maturity level consists of key PM focus areas, and each key PM focus area consists of key PM components according to PRINCE2. The model evolves from functionally driven organizations practices to project driven organization that incorporates continuous project learning. The PRINCE2 based model provides an orderly, disciplined process to achieve higher level of project management maturity.

articleTitle: Research on Construction of the Methodological System of Weapon and Equipment Requirement Demonstration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies the process domain of weapon and equipment requirement demonstration and generalizes the typical methodological system of weapon and equipment requirement demonstration. On the basis of describing and analyzing the five primary features of method, the methodological system framework which establishes a common means to express integrated methods architecture was put forward. With the methodological system framework, the methodological system of weapon and equipment requirement demonstration which based on correlative matrix was constructed.

articleTitle: Human Resource Management Model of Motivating All Personnel to Participate in Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Independent innovation ability has become the decisive factor to gain competitive advantage for enterprises. By conventional human resource management, labors are restricted to fine performance. Reforms are required to adapt to the new economic condition in which enterprises must carry out innovations. This paper analyses the model of motivating all personnel to participate in innovation.

articleTitle: Management Information System for Liaohe River Estuary Wetland Based on Open Source WebGIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent decades, the society has changed view of wetlands from wastelands to highly productive areas with rich resources. More and more organizations have been conducting a variety of research and monitoring activities. For conservation and ecological restoration of Liaohe River estuary wetland, it is necessary to construct wetland management information system. Wetland information system involves management of attribute and spatial data. Web-based Geographic Information System (WebGIS) has come to be an indispensable tool for analyzing and managing both attribute and spatial data. Based on WebGIS technology, the system architecture is described in detail. By integrating open source software into a Web based Browser/Server environment, the system is developed and realized at nearly zero cost. Lots of features which are not inferior to those produced by commercial software are implemented in the system.

articleTitle: A Research of Investor Protection Based on the Reputation Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper we establish a reputation mechanism model, based on the effective reaction of rational investors to fresh news, to regard the supervision ability as an endogenous variable, and therefore to analyze the relationship among the listed company, the regulatory authority and the exterior investors. This model may contribute to realization of the exterior investors' self-protection by impelling the listed company and the regulator to maintain their own reputation. By constructing a reputation mechanism on the securities market, based on Diamond's model on the bank loan market in 1989, we provide an access to a well-established securities market, that is to promote the rational investors' ratio in order to strengthen the reputation mechanism on the securities market. Besides, this model provides a benchmark to the problem of selection between centralized supervision and decentralized decision-making.

articleTitle: The Possibility of the Application of Product-Service System in Chinese Urban Families
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Analyzing the developmental trends of Chinese urban families, which is influenced by the social development, and combining characteristics of Product-Service System(PSS), this paper conducts a research on the motivation of accepting PSS in families and draws a creative strategy for PSS to implement the sustainable development. On the basis of evaluations and creative ideas, some primarily potential design programs of PSS are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: A Path Analysis of IOS Appropriation's Impact on SC Collaboration and Collaborative Advantage
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The objective of the study is to explore the impact of IOS appropriation on supply chain collaboration and collaborative advantage. Reliable and valid instruments of these constructs were developed through rigorous empirical analysis including structured interviews, Q-sort, and a large-scale study. Data were collected through a Web survey of U.S. manufacturing firms in various industries. The path analytical results indicate that IOS appropriation strongly supports supply chain collaboration, which in turn affects collaborative advantage.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: How to Use the Brokerage Roles of Innovation Networks Efficiently
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Dynamic Evaluation Model for the Prototype Information System Development Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to promote the developing efficiency of information system (IS) and to make greatest possible effort to eliminate the information asymmetry between user and developer through constructing the dynamic evaluation model for prototype IS development process. Methods of fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) and a new fuzzy matrices combination were employed. By constructing the hierarchy of IS development process, determining the indicators weights using FAHP and calculating the score and level the indicator belongs to, both developer and user can clearly figure out the main problem In accordance with the different IS developing stage, and reduce the lose to the minimum extent at development process.

articleTitle: The Operational Strategy of Mobile Phone OEM Manufacturer in E-Commerce Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development of E-commerce has changed the traditional trading model, which brings the challenges and opportunities to mobile phone enterprises. This paper discusses the dilemma faced by the OEM manufacturer and the operational strategy that can be adapted in the E-commercial environment.

articleTitle: Application of Environment-Friendly Pigment Printing Technology in the Wood Color Control
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The construction of artificial plantation must be vigorously developed because the resources of high-quality natural large-diameter timber and valuable timber are limited and expensive. Environmental awareness must be greatly enhanced while wood dyeing technology being used to improve the low-grade wood of fast-growing plantation and to imitate precious wood. Textile pigment printing has been widely used in countries around the world, because it has advantages of simple process, complete chromatogram and environmental protection. Paulownia is an important fast-growing plantation tree. The textile pigment printing technology was applied in the color control for Paulownia veneer in the paper. Printed Paulownia veneer could obtain a clear pattern, uniform color, good printing fastness, color yield, and feel, when dosage of pigment printing binder ET accounted for 10% of total system mass, dosage of pigment printing thickener CP accounted for 1.8% of total system mass, and the printed veneer was cured at 100°C for 2 min. Printed Paulownia veneer could be used for furniture, decoration, flooring, decorative panels, windows and doors, speakers, sports timber, wooden carvings, handicrafts and other fields.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Performance of Compound Foundation Isolation System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper has generalized the dynamic response result in structural system, by the time history analysis of the large complex structure. At the meantime, we drew up the dynamic response curves, analyzed the results of dynamic response, and compared the differences of dynamic responses between isolation-structure and non-isolation structure, the result manifests that the isolation-structure system is more excellent on alleviate the seismic damage. According to the research and analysis on isolation structure and non-isolation structure system and the comparison of structural seismic capacity, it is feasible to obtain a simplified and effective approach in isolation which is technically reliable, especially, could reduce the construction cost.

articleTitle: The Determinants of Sourcing by Multinationals in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on literature review, influencing factors model of sourcing in China is constructed, and 14 hypotheses are put forward. 109 companies are surveyed and efficient data is analyzed using multiple regression method. The results from our survey show that asset specificity and cost have significantly negative influence on the extent of sourcing in China; entry mode, policies, exchange rate, tariff and non-tariff trade barriers, China's attractiveness as a market and potential of supply market have a significant impact on the extent of sourcing in China; other factors are not notable. And the result is explained at last.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Yangtze River Delta Regional Economic Integration and the Development of the ICT Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Evolvement Mechanism of Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises Element-Oriented Innovation Pattern------Case Study of Fujian Haiyuan Automatic Equipments Co., Ltd
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes a dominant element innovation theory of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), analyzes the theoretical connotation which start from extracting dominant element and end in forming dominant innovation pattern, then takes the dynamic and evolutionary perspective to describe the evolvement mechanism of element-oriented innovation pattern, later through a case study of Fujian Haiyuan automatic equipments CO.LTD to analyze and prove the theory proposed above, aims to provide a theoretical reference and practical guidance for SMEs innovation and gradually towards innovative enterprises.

articleTitle: Coordinating Three-Level Supply Chain with Quantity Discount Policies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A two-level supply chain which consisted of a supplier and a retailer can be coordinated by a quantity discount policy. In this paper, the coordination problem of a three-level supply chain under quantity discount policies is investigated. By properly set the parameters of the quantity discount policies, the three-level supply chain can be coordinated, and the profit of the total supply chain can be properly allocated among the participants of the supply chain. The validation of the mechanism is illustrated by numerical examples.

articleTitle: Effect of Psychological Contract on Employee Performance: A Review
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, the concept and development process psychological Contract is introduced firstly. Then, the measurement method of Psychological Contract is discussed. Thirdly, we summarized the effect of Psychological Contract on Employee performance, including the direct effect and the indirect effect. Based on the analysis, we build a comprehensive model of Effect of Psychological Contract on Employee performance. Finally, the directions of future research are discussed.

articleTitle: From "Pay-as-you-go" to Partial Accumulation Pension System That Combines Individual's Accounts and Society's Planning--The Path Selection of Chinese Endowment Insurance System Reform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The social security system should be based on the reality of our country. The social security level should be adapted to the economic development level of different phases. In the process of reform, "Lindblomism" should be observed. This paper has fully analyzed the advantages and disadvantages of the traditional State-Unit Security model of our country, gradual reform and gradual transfer and discussed the path selection of endowment insurance reform of our country.

articleTitle: An AHP/DEA Methodology for Assessing the Productive Efficiency in Construction Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A two-stage methodology integrating analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and data envelopment analysis (DEA) methods for analyzing and assessing the productive efficiency in construction industry was proposed. This paper discussed the productive efficiency of the construction industry in Shanghai using the statistic data in Shanghai from 1997 to 2007. The results indicate that the index selection process based on AHP is more objective and the integrated AHP-DEA methodology is suitable and reliable for productive efficiency assessing in construction industry. Meanwhile, the proposed assessing index will be valuable references for similar regions in Mainland China.

articleTitle: Centrographic Analysis of Urban Growth in Xinjiang during the Last Three Decades
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Xinjiang has experienced considerable urban growth in the past sixty years, especially since the implementation of socio-economic reforms in 1978. When Xinjiang was founded as a Uygur Autonomous Region in 1955, there were only three cities with an urban population of 870 thousand, while in 2008 it had 21 cities with a total urban population with 8.45 million. Such an urban growth is attributed to the boost in the number of cities and the urban population. Urban expansion enhanced geographic inequality between the two major regions in Xinjiang. Compared to the Northern part, Southern Xinjiang only has 33.3% of the total cities and 35% of the urban population. Using centrographic analyses, this study aims at explaining the movement of urban center in Xinjiang during the past three decades. The conclusions are the following: 1.The center of city gravity moved to southwest, while the center of town gravity moved to southwest first then returned back to northeast; 2. The distribution of urban area was tending to be balanced from 1982 to 1990, while it is concentrated in the northern area, especially on the economic belt of northern slope of Tianshan Mountain in during 1990-2008. This kind of decentralization in the first stage and concentration in the second period was more obvious for cites than towns; 3.The main factors which effected the movement of urban center in Xinjiang are government new rural economy system (1980), the new urban definition(1984) and superior geographical location as well as better socio-economic conditions are main factors .

articleTitle: A Study on Contract Coordination of Supply Chain Based on Demand Disruption
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper focus on studying of demand disruption. Based on understand of risk conduction of demand disruption, how to control the effect of demand disruption is described qualitatively from three aspects. Finally, in a circumstance that price-sensitive coefficient is affected by demand disruption, how retailer to re-price products is discussed qualitatively. In order to ensure retailers order products according to the optimal order quantity after demand disruption and price product according to the optimal retail price, the contracts of supply chain are used to coordinate supply chain based on different levels of affects of demand disruption so as to maximize profits of supply chain.

articleTitle: The Studying on Industry Construction of Yinchuan City after Reformation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After reformation, how to face sorts of unknown factions about urban development and to set up industry construction, it is studying object having important theory and practice meaning. In this paper, with studying urban industry construction, analyzing the development tendency, provides reasonable development model, which will create an opening, continuous urban space. The studying result, on the one hand, is benefit for analyzing the change of urban economy function, showing the law of industry construction; on the other hand, studying Yinchuan's industry construction, the urban developmental experience can be attracted in order to treat to the questions being in urban development, as a result, reasonable policy of industry construction can be made.

articleTitle: The Services Pricing Strategy on Software as a Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The pricing of "pay-per-use", which is usually viewed as the application of Differential Pricing in Software As A Service(SAAS) become more popular in IT society. Differential Pricing has greatly promoted the development of software industry, but it could not reflect the substantive relationship in terms of the services price, cost and quality. In this paper, we apply bargaining theories, static games of complete information and dynamic games of complete information to analyze the pricing behavior of the oligarchic software enterprises. We use the value of services quality to measure the longitudinal differentiation degree, and study the pricing strategy based on the fluctuant market of homogeneous or heterogeneous consumers with static games. Finally we discuss the dynamic games between the enterprise with cost advantages and with cost disadvantages, and get the subgame perfect Nash equilibrium. The conclusion indicates that the pricing strategy could normalize the price mechanism of SAAS and promote the development of SAAS fairly and effectively.

articleTitle: How Financing Match Entrepreneurial Growth Cycle?: Evidence from Chinese Technological SMEs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Financing hindrance has become a bottleneck for the development of the technological Small and Medium-sized Enterprise (SMEs). Based on literature review, this paper collects the actual questionnaire from 17 cities in Guangdong Province and employs correspondence analysis to investigate the interrelation between the entrepreneurial Growth cycle and financing characteristics in technological SMEs, with an attempt to provide reference to technological SMEs in terms of the financing means and government policy implementation. The results indicate significant disparity among financing channels, financing demands and financing obstacles in different entrepreneurial Growth cycle. When the technological SMEs are in the early period, growth period and maturity period, they are inclined to employ private capital, enterprise self-owned fund, shareholder injection fund, banks and business credit; External financing demand demonstrates a trend of first increase then drop; simultaneously, financing obstacle is a common issue existing in Chinese technological SMEs.

articleTitle: The Study on the Influence of the Financial Crisis on Software Outsourcing Enterprises: Based on the Survey of Jiangsu Software Outsourcing Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The financial crisis had a heavy blow on the software outsourcing industry around the world, including Chinese. This research analyzed the Jiangsu province outsourcing enterprises data, then had the view that the influence of financial crisis on software outsourcing enterprises is profound, and refined three key factors of external circumstance that have effect on software outsourcing industry with the background of financial crisis. They are economic situation both at home and abroad, the government's attitude to the software outsourcing industry and the talent supply. Then we drew the conclusion that the government had a motive force to the software outsourcing enterprises during the initial stage of the development.

articleTitle: Towards Web-Based Information Retrieval in Grid Environment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Traditional information retrieval has long been dominated by a location-centric organization of application objects and requires users to specify a path to access desired objects. Grid-based information retrieval is a new initiative to bring together information retrieval techniques with grid technologies. Grid technologies will offer new techniques and powerful information retrieval systems, whilst information retrieval will offer the grid new ways of handling and discovering information. This paper analyzes grid-based information retrieval. Grid-based information retrieval is capable of searching vast amounts of geographically distributed information, which in many cases could not be searched effectively, if at all, by traditional information retrieval. Then, this paper probes into the process of grid-based information retrieval. Lastly, this paper explores the architecture for grid-based information retrieval.

articleTitle: Algorithm Study of the Time Parameters and the Resource Requirements of the Network Diagram Based on the Duration Matrix
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The time parameters calculation of the activity-on-arrow network is the base of duration optimization and resource optimization, but the complexity of existing methods limits its wide application in practice. In face of these shortcomings, based on studying the activity algorithm and the node algorithm of the activity-on-arrow network, this paper proposes to use the duration matrix to show the schedule and logical relations of activities, and then gives the corresponding calculation formulas of time parameters and resource requirements. In the last, this paper uses matlab language to program, and verifies its feasibility and simplicity by an example.

articleTitle: Variance Reduction Techniques for Basket Option
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper prices the basket option by Monte Carlo simulation. With the comparison of the methods used as variance reduction techniques, to find the optimal way for reducing variance for basket option.The methods include antithetic variates, control variates,importance sampling,stratified sampling,moment matching, Latin hypercube sampling and combined methods. Numerical results indicate that an appropriate combination of importance sampling and stratified sampling can obtain the largest variance reductions when estimating the basket option.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on Low Temperature Selective Catalytic Oxidation of Ammonia over Transition Metals Supported on TiO2
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Four different transition catalysts (V, Cr, Zn, Mo) supported on TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> were prepared by incipient impregnation and their performances of selective catalytic oxidation (SCO) of ammonia(NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>) were investigated in mixed gas in which 500ppm ammonia was included and the gas hourly space velocity(GHSV) was 35385h<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. The results shown that 99% ammonia removal efficiency, 19% nitric oxide (NO) conversion and neglectable nitrogen dioxide (NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) conversion were obtained at low temperature over Cr/TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. With increasing temperature, the lowest NO and NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> conversion were found on Mo/TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. Then comparatively tested Cu/TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and Cr/TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, much lower NO and NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> conversion over Cr/TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> than Cu/TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> was obtained. Various oxygen contents ranging from 0.5% to 5% for the SCO of ammonia were as well as tested and it revealed that oxygen content affected the ammonia removal efficiency, but not as significantly as possible at low temperature, the NO and NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> was either not affected by lean oxygen condition at low temperature.

articleTitle: The Study of Construction Inherent Defect Insurance Based on Market Supply
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Inherent Defect Insurance is one kind of commercial insurance and one of the important economic methods to provide protection for the final buyers of the buildings in some developed countries worldwide. The experience of the IDI in other counties indicates that the IDI can reduce the inherent defects of the building and protect the clients free of lost from the inherent defects and damages. According the Legal Status of insurance, there are two kinds of insurance. One is compulsory insurance, the other is non compulsory. The practice of the IDI was carried out in some selected cities in China from 2005. But it did not work well. One of the main reasons is that there are no qualified IDI clauses supplied. In order to make clear of the reason of market supply shortage, the unformatted questionnaire and formatted questionnaire were designed. And an economic model was used to analyze the theoretical reasons of market failure. In view of government regulation, some useful policy suggestions of the development of IDI in China were given.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis on the Growth Tendency of Building Energy Consumption in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Building energy consumption refers to various energy used in buildings, including energy consumption in heating, air-conditioning, illumination and hot water supply etc. Based on a comprehensive analysis of all kinds of main factors influencing building energy consumption, this paper simulates the future development tendency of building energy consumption in China through a quantitative analysis so as to reveal the necessity and urgency of energy conservation in building.

articleTitle: On the Risk Assessment of China's Commercial Banks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, CAMEL method has been used to construct an evaluation index system to evaluate the risks of China's commercial banks. According to Evaluation System, we choose the three major state-owned banks and five joint-stock banks as the sample. Lastly we identify the reasons for the risk of commercial banks, and propose some measurements to reduce the financial risks of commercial banks.

articleTitle: Study on Energy Saving Technique of Inhibition to Bamboo Mold for Energy Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Bamboo wood is ready to be affected by mold, which leads to large amounts of economic losses. the drug safety of benzene/alcohol extractives from Pinus elliottii leavies were analyzed by GC/MS to make bamboo mold. The main ingredients of benzene/alcohol extractives were vanillin, urea, 1-(3-methoxybenzoyl)-3-(4-me thyl-6-trifluoromethylpyrimidin- 2-yl)-, undecylenic acid, toluene, tetrahydrocyclopenta[1,3]dioxin-4- one, silane, trichloropentyl-, propan-1-one, 3-(4-acetylphenylami no)-1-(2-thienyl)-, phenylethyl alcohol, phenol, 3-methoxy-2,4,6-trimethyl-, phenol, 2,4-bis(1-phenylethyl)-, phenol , pentaethylene glycol monododecyl ether, nerolidol, naphthalene,1,2,3,5,6,8a-hexahydr o-4,7-dimethyl-1-(1-methylethyl)-, naphthalene, decahydro-1,1,4a-trim ethyl-6-methylene-5-(3-methylene- 4-pentenyl)-, naphthalene, 1,6-dimethyl-4-(1-met hylethyl)-, naphthalene, 1,2,3,4,4a,5,6,8a-oct ahydro-7-methyl-4- methylene-1-(1-methylethyl)-, etc. The results obtained fully indicated that the benzene/alcohol extractives had the great potential of inhibition to bamboo mold.

articleTitle: The Teaching Excellence Mechanism and Effect of Vocational and Technological Education Teachers to Adjust Teaching Excellence Award Plan
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The study integrated a cognitive apprentice theory with a learning and knowledge base into a teacher development program, developed a "Teaching Excellence Mechanism for Vocational and Technical College Teachers" in an action research. In addition, it analyzed the effectiveness of the action research and explored the content of the proposed mechanism in order to provide a reference for the adjustment of the Teaching Excellence Award Plan. The results showed that the main purpose of the teachers using the mechanism are to "check the latest news/ events message", "access to education-related information", "self -enrichment and access new knowledge". They also use this mechanism to access the "Education Zone", "teaching treasure chest". Teachers think that a teaching excellence-based system should also include the functions of "other education related sites" and "provide more learning activities and information".

articleTitle: The Application of Forecasting Optimization on City Commercial Development Requirements Based on the Grey Theory--A Case Study of Wuhan
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Land demand forecasting is the core content of urban development, it not only directly determines whether urban land use planning is reasonable or not, but also provides necessary data to support planning of the next. In today's vigorous development, demand construction land forecasting is much more essential. This article tends to use qualitative and quantitative methods based on the grey theory, to study the application of the grey prediction model in commercial development requirements forecasting in Wuhan.

articleTitle: Is Real Investment-Sentiment Sensibility Symmetrical?--Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Basing on the assumption that of rational managers coexist with the irrational investors, this paper develops a manager's optimal investment decision model including both of catering channel and equity issuance channel, to analyze the asymmetrical effects of investors irrational sentiments on firms investment decision in different period of stock market, and examines the theoretical results using the data of Chinese listed firms as samples. It shows that, because of some investors' belief bias such as self-attribution and overconfidence or instability preference such as loss aversion and disposition effect, the firms' investments are more sensitive to investor sentiments in the upward period of market than that in the downward period of market through the catering channel and equity issuance channel.

articleTitle: Construction of Telecom Brand Image Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Brand image refers to the set of associations linked to the brand that consumers hold in memory, which is the key driver of brand equity, Because of its complexity, multi-dimensional and situational feature as yet there is no system and model in conformity for the construction of brand image. By now most of the research about brand association focused on consumer goods, while ignored the industry and service industry brand. Based on the literature review of traditional brand image model, this paper used free association method to make empirical analysis and form telecom brand image model. Two conclusions were drawn: (1) Telecom brand image is an organized and ordered system which is consisted of multiple dimensions. These dimensions belong to product function, meaning and company, code and so on; (2) Dimensions of telecom brand image have both common points and individual points compared with consumer-goods.

articleTitle: Growing Though Innovatively Exploiting Context-Related Knowledge- Cases of Entrepreneurial Firms from China's Information Technology Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The literature indicates that technology, knowledge are important factors on entrepreneurial firm's growth. Imitation can also be creative and help new ventures defeat industry pioneers. Three cases form Chinese IT industry were selected for study. Conceptual framework was developed for explaining rapid growth of these companies, and its implications to future study and practice is discussed.

articleTitle: Study on the Purchase Agent Service for China's Real Estate Brokerage Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Information asymmetry in the real estate market may aggrieve buyer's legal rights. And the current model of real estate brokerage service seems relatively single. In particular, there is no agent that provides professional service for buyer. So it is not conducive to changing the information inferior position of buyer. This paper presents the idea of building purchase agent service model. By using game theory, the paper analyzes the complex relationship among the participants, puts forwards purchase agent service pattern, and studies the feasibility of the new service model. This service innovation will play an important role in the development and standardization of real estate industry.
