articleTitle: The Hybrid Differential Evolution Algorithm for Optimal Power Flow Based on Simulated Annealing and Tabu Search
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is usually imperfect for the traditional algorithm of mathematical programming when it is used to analyze the optimal power flow (OPF) issues. A new optimal power flow model of differential evolutionary algorithm has been developed in this paper through combining modern intelligent optimization algorithms, such as differential evolution (DE), simulated annealing (SA) and tabu search (TS). Concerning IEEE6, IEEE30bus system in the optimal power flow, simulation case study shows that the novel hybrid optimization algorithm has a better global optimization capability.

articleTitle: The Discussion of Collaboration Management of Tourism Services Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the understanding of logistics supply chain and services supply chain to tourism service, this paper is going to discuss issues related to the collaboration management of tourism services supply chain (TSSC) and tourism services supply chain dynamics alliance. Through core enterprises' coordination and integration of information and resources and each enterprise's strategic alliance, win-win and common added value is achieved. The customers' demands are better satisfied at the same time. The operation of TSSC in collaboration management is discussed from diversity of customers' demands, travel agencies, hotels and restaurants, and several aspects, including information management, process management, capability management, services performance, government guarantees and the collaborative design of tourism transportation facilities. Setting up an effective TSSC would promote the development of China's tourism and improve the competence of enterprises as well.

articleTitle: Study on the Promotional Factors of Extended Producer Responsibility
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the enforcement of "Circular Economy Promotion Law", extended producer responsibility has become the important institution of China's circular economy. However, incentives for the majority of producers are lacking. This paper starts with EPR's theoretical base, clarifying its environmental goals and responsibility modes. Five promotional factors are deduced, which are improvement potential of product's environmental performance, feedback to product redesign, closed-loop recyclability, cost-benefit certainty and service substitutability. The promotional strategy of China's EPR is then discussed.

articleTitle: The Categories of External Technology Sources in Open Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper explores the categories of external technology sources in open innovation. The architecture of equipment products is complex, so external technologies are utilized in the innovation of equipment industry. To study the external technology sources in open innovation for equipment industry, the five sources commonly used are chosen as research objects, which are suppliers, users, competitors, universities and research institutes, R&D service companies. The field survey is conducted for open innovation projects, and the statistical data are collected. Based on this, the external technology sources are analyzed by descriptive statistics. The categories of technology sources are studied based on multidimensional analysis, the results show that these sources can be categorized into three types by technology supply form and technology export attitude. R&D service companies and universities and research institutes are one category, suppliers and clients are one category, and competitors are independently another one.

articleTitle: Some Suggestions for Community-Based Ecotourism Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Ecotourism is an important development trend of the tourist industry in the future as well as the inevitable choice for the tourism destination to realize the sustainable development. Community participation is one of the optimal modes to realize the above-mentioned goals. Based on the sustainable development theory of tourism, ecotourism theory and so on, the basic theories of ecotourism development are studied in this paper. From the viewpoint of community-based ecotourism management, some measures on community-based ecotourism development in China are illuminated systematically. The community-based ecotourism management will be advantageous for optimizing the economic structure of the community, protecting the ecological resources and environment, maintaining the traditional culture of the community and improving the environmental protection consciousness of the local residents, which is an effective approach to realize the sustainable development of the community-based ecotourism destination.

articleTitle: Assessment of Agent System Project Risk Based on Entropy Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Agent construction system is a new project management mode to meet the need of modern engineering construction, and is an innovation of government-invested engineering management mode. There are some positive aspects and some risks during the implementation .This paper analyses the risk factors based on the characteristics of agent management projects, establishes risk index system, using Entropy measurement to calculate the risk degrees , Finally, it gives an example to show how to use this method. This paper sets up an reasonable and effectively method for risk management of agent management projects.

articleTitle: Financial Distress Costs and Ownership Structure in Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the data of financially distressed listed companies in China from 2004-2006, this paper measures the financial distress costs and examines the relationship between ownership structure and financial distress costs. The results show that the average financial distress cost is 17.27% and varies considerably among companies. It also shows that the nature of a firm's controlling owner influences financial distress costs, which are significantly lower in stated-owned firms than in private firms, while ownership concentration and ownership balancing don't have significant impact on financial distress costs.

articleTitle: Hybrid Genetic Algorithm for Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) is an important class of scheduling optimization problems in the supply chain management. Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (VRPTW) is an extension of VRP and involves the setoff of a fleet of vehicles from a depot to serve a number of customers at different geographic locations for within specific time windows before returning to the depot eventually. This study aims to solve VRPTW, which has received considerable attention in recent years. To solve this problem, this study suggests a hybrid genetic algorithm combined with priority rule heuristic to make an initial population and <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ-</sup> interchange mechanism to increase the diversity of the population and enhance the local search, applying guiding mutation to find improved descendant and using the Bi-directional Decoding (BDD) to find the better solution of the same chromosome. Finally, the repairing method is applied to reduce the number of non-feasible solutions in population. Experimental results show that the proposed hybrid algorithm has a better performance than other related algorithms.

articleTitle: Achieving Market Responsiveness: The Enabling Role of IT and E-Commerce Adoption in SMEs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In an environment with competition and changes, it is critical for SMEs to achieve market responsiveness, the ability to rapidly sense and respond to changes from external markets. However, little research has been conducted to explore the relationships between IT resources, e-commerce adoption, and market responsiveness of SMEs. By drawing from IT business value and e-commerce literature, this paper proposes a conceptual model that describes the impacts of IT resources on e-commerce adoption and market responsiveness of SMEs.

articleTitle: Model of Cattle Feeding Based on Crop Residues with the Core of Specialized Households
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The project of cattle feeding based on crop residues (CFCR) is the important approach of utilizing crop residues(CRs). But there are problems in current projects according to the drawbacks of CFCR, that are low quality beef and low content of milk protein caused by CRs. Then led to the different management methods the controversy by some leaders and experts, it is not good to the project. In this paper, the model of CFCR with the core of specialized households is bring out based the theories of division of labor and economies of scale with seizing the essence of CFCR-"lower grain, longer cycle", that is the combining centralization and decentralization modalities. The correct pattern of specialized households is decentralized and small-scale, the centralized and large-scale pattern is suitable for calf production, cattle fattening or dairy production. And suggested that the government should focus on the specialized households because they are the most appropriate and important parts of CFCR.

articleTitle: Study on the Application of Knowledge Discovery in Data Bases to the Decision Making of Railway Traffic Safety in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The existing safety guarantee systems for the railway operation in China only focus on upgrading their information technology, while their auto-control and intelligent capacity are relatively low and the auxiliary decision making capacity is poor. Knowledge Discovery in Data Bases (KDD) enables us to find out potentially useful information from mass database so that the decision will be more accurate. Applying knowledge discovery to decision making of railway operation safety can improve the intelligent, real-time and integration performance of the system. This paper applies case-based reasoning to accident treatment, and shows important significance to assist the decision making for train running safety.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Structural Change and Spatial Pattern of Urbanization in Xinjiang
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on Motivation System of Employees-Analysis of Human Resources Management from a Psychological Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the existing study of domestic and international management theory and a variety of psychological motivation theory, principles of incentive based on the psychological contract have been presented in order to effectively mobilize creativity and enthusiasm of employees to improve the company's cohesion and centripetal force, we should apply proper ways or approaches of incentives to establish incentive system of the employees under the new situation, starting from the employee's psychological thinking and enhancing innovative consciousness and sense of ownership in order to enhance the company's core competitiveness, thus ensuring the company's sustainable development.

articleTitle: Knowledge Synergy and Long-Term Value Creation of M&A Based on the Dynamic Capabilities Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In mergers and acquisitions (M&A), enterprises should not only pursue the realization of short-term financial value, but also the creation of long-tem strategic value. Based on the analysis of knowledge synergy in the capabilities innovation system, this paper studies the mechanism of knowledge synergy for enterprises' dynamic capabilities evolution in M&A. According to the research, it can be concluded that enterprises can build and strengthen the dynamic capabilities by knowledge synergy in M&A, achieve sustainable competitive advantages in the rapidly changing dynamic environment, and then realize the long-tem value creation.

articleTitle: The Moderating Role of Organizational Learning in the Relationship between Organizational Innovation and Performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study investigates the 217 enterprises in Pearl River Delta Region to examine the interactive effect among organizational innovation, organizational learning and organizational performance. A moderate effect model is formulated and validated. The results of hierarchical multiple regression not only show that organizational innovation and organizational learning have direct effect on performance, but also verify the moderating effects of organizational learning between organizational innovation and performance.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Quality, Satisfaction and Loyalty: A Comparison of SERVQUAL and SERVPERF for Educational Service in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Two-Dimensional Model of Information and Formal Denotation of Rationality in Game Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Information and rationality are two important factors that effect game analysis. Two-dimensional model of information was put forword and studied. Degree of information depth and width are discussed, and their effects on learning were also compared. After analyzing the essence of rationality, a formal denotation of rationality in game analysis was given out in the paper.

articleTitle: The Impacts of Energy Prices on Energy Intensity in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we present a review of the deregulation of energy prices in China between 1981 and 2007, and assess the impacts of changes in energy prices on aggregate energy intensity. We concluded that raising energy prices is an effective policy tool for decreasing energy intensity by increasing efficiency of energy use. According to research, the author suggests that, to save more energy, in addition to optimizing its sectoral structure and technical progress, rising relative energy prices, research and development expenditures, and ownership reform in the enterprise sector to be the principal drivers of China's declining energy intensity and use. Moreover, according to the situation of China, this paper analyzed the mechanism of energy intensity changes and puts forward the government-led energy-saving model.

articleTitle: Public Participation, Civil Society and Environment Protection in China: A Comparative Study of Environmental Cases
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article examines the participation of ENGOs and individuals to show the interaction between government and civil society in the area of environment protection in China. It shows that there is two types of participation in terms of environmental protection, that is, NGO-driven and mass-driven participation. A comparative case study indicates their common attributes as well as differences. The participation can affect government's decisions and has a positive function to environment protection. At the same time, public participation is greatly shaped by the government and its political system.

articleTitle: Identification and Research of Risk in the Industry-University Cooperation Based on Factor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The article summarized 19 risk factors which impact University-Industry Cooperation based on the analysis of related literatures and then explain the meaning of risk factors. Use the methods of Factor Analysis and Questionnaire to extract six common factors which include 16 key risk factors from the 19 risk factors, then provide basis for decision-making of Industry-university collaboration's risk management.

articleTitle: The Comparison of HR Practice and Job Satisfaction: A Case Study of a Domestic and a Foreign Company in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is understandable that Chinese and foreign companies may have difference in their HR policies or practice, which may consequently impact on employees' performance and satisfaction in either positive or negative way. Job description, performance appraisal, and compensation are three major dimensions of human resource management, closely related to people's satisfaction. This study scrutinizes of the three aspects and the impact of each on employee's satisfaction with Chinese and foreign companies accordingly, to make good sense of HRM approaches and managerial strength of the two types of company. This comparison will add to companies' learning from various corporate cultures and their better understanding of local staff. The study presents also a new content or direction for comparative HRM research.

articleTitle: BIM's Content and Its Application in Contemporary Architectural Design
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: BIM is always a major concern in the Architecture, Engineering and Construction (AEC) industry. The paper described the dynamics of digital technology in Chinese architectural design industry in recent years, analyzes the new opportunities and challenges which our design firms will face in the future . On the basis of this background , This paper describes the basic principles of BIM and its superiority, analyzes the BIM's five levels use in architectural design industry , provides a lot of suggestions how Architects involved in building a BIM to improve the quality and efficiency of architectural design.

articleTitle: Study on Customer Loyalty and Influential Factors in Mobile Telecommunications
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Customer loyalty is very important to telecommunication operators, and this paper intends to find out the influential factors of customer loyalty for mobile services. The paper first clarifies the meanings of customer behavioral loyalty and attitudinal loyalty, and analyzes the main driving factors of customer loyalty. It then constructs an effective mechanism model for customer loyalty programs, and by empirical analysis, finds out the relationships between customer loyalty and factors such as customer satisfaction, switching costs, and relationship trust.

articleTitle: Research on Technological Innovative Evaluation of Regional Enterprises Based on Entropy and Gray Correlation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Strengthening the regional enterprises' technological innovative capacity is an important measure to upgrade the construction of regional technological innovation. This paper takes regional enterprises' technological innovative ability as research object, and constructs evaluation index system; Ascertains weight of index system using entropy theory. And then it constructs comprehensive evaluation model on enterprises' technological innovative ability based on the gray correlation theory, and evaluates technological innovative ability of large and medium-sized enterprises in various provinces in 2005, 2006, 2007 year. The results show that technological innovative capability of various provincial enterprises is disharmony. At last, the paper summarizes the application of evaluation model.

articleTitle: The Theory and Path on Tax Promoting Energy-Saving and Environmental Protection Technology Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of economy in China, the issue is increasingly serious involving the degradation of environment, the shortage of resources and the absence of environmental protection. To keep sustainable development of economy, this paper illustrates the theory and significance of tax policy involving in environmental protection from aspect of technology innovation. Furthermore, it puts forward proposals including making tax preference law, extending the scope of indirect tax preference and improving the tax system with the analysis of existing tax policy on environmental protection and energy-saving and emission reduction.

articleTitle: R&D Alliances in Horizontally Differentiated Oligopoly
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper extends the analysis of R&D network in a setting when horizontally differentiated oligopoly is considered. Our intention is to analysis the interaction between firms' incentives to invest in R&D and the structure of collaboration networks in different intensities of market competition. In the case of stronger market competition, firms' R&D efforts are decreasing in the level of collaboration links, and the level of cost reduction is initially increasing and then decreasing. By contrast, under weak market competition, individual R&D effort, the level of cost reduction, profits and social welfare are all increasing in the level of collaboration links.

articleTitle: Long-Term Capacity in 25 Industrial Sectors: A Structural VAR Approach Based on Twenty-Five Years Evidence in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The measure of capacity level has always been useful monitoring indicator in Engineering Management, especially in the countries like China, conducting extremely high growth in industrial sectors during last three decades. We introduce a structural VAR model in this paper to estimate long-term capacity in China's twenty-five industrial sectors. We concluded that most of sectors experienced high capacity growth at the beginning of China's Reform, and then changed into a moderate growth in latest years.

articleTitle: Profit Maximization Model of Telecom Operators Based on Full Load Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nowadays, cost reduction has become one of the major profit sources for telecom operators, so how to realize profit maximization has always been a focused issue. Given that the customers have different communication demands at busy times and idle times, taking profit maximization as the goal, this paper first establishes a model based on the full load theory in economic to simulate the operation of telecom operators; and then makes the further research on the equilibrium prices and network demand when telecom operators achieve the profit maximization using the method of comparative static analysis; furthermore, general processes that how the decision variables are derived are given. Finally, the paper analyzes the results of the model and gives the conclusion according to the practical situation.

articleTitle: A Case Retrieval Algorithm Based on Bayesian Estimation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Implementing knowledge engineering in DSS has brought a problem of inefficient reasoning due to huge searching space. The use of case-based reasoning technique has ameliorated the situation. The validity of case retrieval directly influences the effect of case-based reasoning, and the key is to measure the similarity between cases. In this paper, an algorithm for cases similarity computation based on Bayesian Estimation is proposed. First, we designate the priori distribution parameters by the semantic distance-based similarity algorithm, and then calculate the posteriori encountering probability using Bayesian Estimation, thereby, the cases semantic similarity integrating the subjective experience with the objective statistic is acquired. This approach can effectively improve the success rate of case retrieval in the situation of incomplete sample information.

articleTitle: Research on Security System for Government Information Disclosure in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China has established a legal system of government information disclosure. The current key point is to safeguard the execution of government information disclosure system from every aspect. This paper researches deeply into the government information disclosure system of China from the supervision to the information disclosure department, the relief for the information disclosure right and the external security environment of government information disclosure systems with different dimensions, comprehensive and systematic cogitation.

articleTitle: Multifractal Spectrum Analysis of Crude Oil Futures Prices Volatility in NYMEX
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: International crude oil prices volatility has significant effects on global economic activities. On the basis of WTI crude oil futures price of New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) from Apr 1983 to Aug 2008, this paper analyze the multifractal spectrum of crude oil futures prices. The results show that the crude oil prices have multifractal characteristics; international oil futures market has the property of scale invariance in the short-term. During the earlier periods, the oscillated magnitudes of futures prices were large and the characteristic of non-uniform distributions was apparent.

articleTitle: Research on Regional Innovation Ability Based on Sub-Provincial Panel
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There are three main elements of regional innovation ability proposed in this paper, which include patent and its degree of market, import, and export, FDI inflows. Based on this, we researched relation between sub-provincial innovation ability and economic growth taking those of 1999 as a base point. As a result, we found that sub-provincial innovation ability could interpret growth of past 5 year as weighed by import and export, patent and its degree of market, and FDI inflows. Import and export are still engines of China's economic growth as prior, while FDI plays an important role in it. A change is that patent and its market become more important for economic growth.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence Mechanism of Online In-Game Advertising Psychological Effect
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Online in-game advertising is a new form of advertising, and the most promising advertising form in recent years. Finding out the influence factors of online in-game advertising is useful for the advertising industry, game industry and the advertising businesses. This paper finds out these factors by the empirical method through investigating the online game players. The result shows that the credibility, information pertinence, structural distribution, matching degree and embedding degree will remarkably impact players' interests in the advertising, among which the embedding degree is the most influential factor; besides that, this paper discovers that players' interest in the advertising has a positive impact on their purchase intention under the play condition.

articleTitle: The Ideas and Countermeasures on the Promotion of Traditional Industrial Structure by Informationization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Information technology is a means and an integrative technology of all industries, which is also a way to improve efficiency, save energy and save raw materials. Informationization is a process, whose social in-depth application is the only way to promote China's economic and social cost-effective development. To use informationization to transform traditional industries and develop an efficient, low-consumptive way is the important guiding ideology of the Government formulating industrial development . For traditional industries in the future will continue to be the main body of China's national economic development and the basic force of promoting economic growth, therefore, enhancing the technological level of traditional industries, optimizing and upgrading traditional industrial structure is an important foundation for modernization, and also is the definite way of China's new industrialization that Under the industrial structure optimization and upgrade.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on the Relationship between Money Supply and the Property Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The property market and the money supply are highly relevant. The total value of residential is approximately equal to M2. The growth of M2 determines that of total value of residential and housing price, while the growth of property sales is generally determined by that of increment M2. Therefore, when the government takes the monetary policy to regulate the economy, it should take into account the impact on property market and takes some appropriate hedging policies.

articleTitle: Application and Outlook of Environment-Friendly Reactive Dyes in Wood Dyeing Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The increasing shortage of supply of large-diameter-class and high-quality natural forest resources is caused by the intensification of the crisis of forest resources and changes in the structure of forest resources. As a result, excellent and valuable tree species are expensive and then they are gradually replaced by a large number of low-quality fast-growing plantation wood. Wood dyeing technology can improve the decorative of fast-growing wood and add value to their products, and can achieve efficient use of resources of fast-growing plantations. In current wood dyeing industry, acid dyes have all long been used, however, dye uptake of acid dyes in wood dyeing is very low (generally less than 30%), about 70% to 80% of acid dyes cannot be used and then left in dyeing wastewater resulting in high chroma and difficult treatment of dyeing wastewater. At the same time, because acid dyes for wood staining depend on the intermolecular forces of smaller bond energy, when the external environment changes dyes easily lose not only affecting the application of dyed wood but also bringing about environmental pollution. So dyeing wood with acid dyestuffs can not meet environmental protection requirements. M-type reactive dyes containing 2 reactive groups with advantages of high fixation, low hydrolysis and environmental requirements were selected to dye fast-growing plantation wood. Dye uptakes of reactive dyes were all above 55%, which were significantly higher than the dye uptakes of acid dyes, thus the emission of dye in the dyeing wastewater could be reduced, and the objective of energy-saving and emission reduction could be achieved. Furthermore reactive dyes react with the chemical compositions of wood through reactive groups to form covalent bonds of larger bond energy and then to fix on the wood. And thus problems of dyeing depth and color fastness restricting current wood staining techniques with acid dyestuffs can be removed, moreover, the loss of dyes bringing about environmental pollution can be avoided in the process of late application (finishing and gluing) of dyed wood. Application of environmental-friendly M-type reactive dyes in wood dyeing technology can reduce a significant burden on the treatment of dyeing wastewater, not only bringing huge economic benefits to the enterprises, but also bringing enormous environmental benefits to society. In today's dyeing and printing industry of serious pollution, environmental-friendly M-type reactive dyes applied in wood dyeing industry will have great practical significance and social meaning.

articleTitle: A K-GA for Routing Optimizing Problem with Fuzzy Duration Time in 4PL
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, a 4PL Routing Problem (4PLRP) with fuzzy duration time is presented where the fuzzy numbers is used to describe the uncertainty of the duration time. After the description of 4PLRP, a fuzzy programming model is established according to the uncertainty theory. And a crisp equivalent is derived when fuzzy variables are characterized by triangular fuzzy numbers. Then a Kth shortest path algorithm embedded Genetic Algorithm (K-GA) is designed to solved the model. Finally, numerical analysis is presented and the results show that the proposed method is useful for the practical problems.

articleTitle: Study on Development of Water Resources in Tianjin Based on the Notion of Ecological Civilization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Water resource is a key element of maintaining human existence, economic development and social progress. Against the background of ecological civilization, water resource is an indispensable basic strategic for urban development. As a city short of water, urban development and construction of Tianjin will be directly affected by whether they have rational development and utilization of water resources. As a result of it, relevant measures must be taken to address the critical issue of water resources to ensure sustainable use of water resources in Tianjin.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Decision Support System Based on Data Mining and Web Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper gives the model of the decision support system based on data mining and web technology. The structure of the decision support system has been improved. And the paper studies features of each module of the new system. The system makes use of the technology of the data warehouse and data mining to improve the decision-making ability, and uses Web technology to improve the efficiency of the decision. It realizes the scientific decision-making of enterprises.

articleTitle: Price Subsidy Subject Choice of Different Price-Sensitive Products
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: From the perspective of expansion of domestic demand and improvement of supply chain profit, this article studied the best state financial subsidy subject in the supply chain considering the different price-sensitivity. The main conclusion is that if subsidy impact on the demand is equal to that on the enterprises cost, for the weak price-sensitive products, the subsidy should be offered directly to consumers. On the contrary, for the strong price-sensitive products, the subsidy should be offered to the enterprises.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Credible Degree of E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the view of the third-party of authentication, this paper established the model of evaluating the trusty of e-commerce based on the gray Correlation theory as analyzing tool in order to provide a method of measuring the credible degree of e-commerce web-site. This method may have succinctness and practicality. Finally this paper makes a case study to validate the model.

articleTitle: Issues in the Design of R&D Tax Incentives Policy for Chinese Firms
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By combining some successful experience of the developed countries with the specific situations in China, the design of R&D tax incentives policy for Chinese firms should be moved towards four directions. First, the best portfolio of incentive instruments will be a combination of giving priority to indirect favorable preference instead of direct favorable preference. Second, the object of tax incentives should concentrate on four fields, which are R&D activities of small and medium-sized companies, cooperative R&D activities, fundamental technology researches and R&D activities of transnational companies in China. Third, as to the calculation method for tax incentives, incremental expenditure approach should be optimized. Last, a scientific assessment system with Chinese characteristics should be established as soon as possible.

articleTitle: Digital Propagation of She Ethnic Culture
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: She ethnic is one of old and mysterious ethnic groups who are scattering in the south-eastern mountain area in China. Owing to the outward impact, its indigenous She culture has been severely weakening. The paper aims to save and spread the precious cultural relic by discussing the present dilemma, spreading types and features faced by She ethnic culture. And systemic saving methods have been proposed to save the relic and promote its propagation:(1)Digital and web technology should be adopted to build up a She culture digital library and an overall digital propagation network.(2) Combined with the traditional propagation methods, new media forms such as Blogs, BBS, and mobile phones should be used to enlarge the propagation channels and enrich the propagation methods.(3)A positive propagation environment should be established based on the web technology in order to achieve the healthy propagation of She ethnic culture.

articleTitle: The Analysis on Risk of China's SME Downsizing Outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the financial crisis, China's enterprises have downsizing in order to survive. To downsizing effectively and minimize adverse effects, companies are seeking outsourcing services. In this paper introduced about its concept, pointed out that its risks could make the enterprises to loss profits, and finally come up with some suggestions on how to shun the risks of it.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Training Scheme Research of Core Competence of Entrepreneurs: Based on the Improved Sand Cone Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Automatic Annotation for the Generation of Extraction Rules
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Current Web information extraction systems are supervised systems which require manual annotation of training instances in order to learn extraction rules. The annotation is tedious and subject to changes when Web sites upgrade. In this paper, we present a finite-state-transducer-based method of automatic annotation, which can deal with pages with missing attributes, multiple-valued attributes, multi-ordering attributes. Moreover, we also argument it with probability theory to reduce the uncertainty of the state machine. The experimental results show that our algorithm can annotate Web pages efficiently and accurately and thus speed-up extraction rules learning in Web information extraction systems.

articleTitle: Quantum Leap for Greater Commercialisation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The successful commercialisation of R&D in Australia has been quite low, even though it is shown that the output of new knowledge as measured by R&D publications is ranked quite high. This paper outlines a new systems engineering model that after implementation to date has proposed an improved probability of a successful commercialisation. This is achieved through greater flexibility achieved through a dynamic model and sets out procedures, activities and measurements to allow better decisions to be made. With greater emphasis on risk minimisation and rafting scenarios in contrast to risk avoidance and singular direction this model provides a fresh system that can be implemented on a broader range of different products and technologies looking for commercialisation.

articleTitle: The Enterprise Co-Evolution Model of Industrial Chain in Economics Development Zone
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on detailed discussion of enterprise ecological relationships in economics development zone, this paper fully described the relationships and evolution processes between enterprises, and established a dynamic co-evolution model for enterprises in economics development zone by reference of Lotka-Volterra model to analyze the co-evolution motion and mechanism for enterprises in economics development zone. The objective is to provide a reliable reference and method for the enterprise that how to increase the ability of organizational survival and improve the existing strategy in the existent competitive paradigm and how to select strategy and realize the organization adoptive transform when the competitive paradigm changed, and then to strengthen the whole competitive ability of industrial chain.

articleTitle: Implementing Environmental Management as Construction Project Management Objective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The stratagem of sustainable development challenges the traditional construction project management objectives. The author does a qualitative investigation aiming at practices of Chongqing's local project management, various passive influences on environment arising from construction activities are identified. This paper points out that the traditional construction project management only focus on cost, time and quality but neglect environmental protection, and it agrees to the idea of adding environmental management into project management objectives. Some suggestions that project's environment objective can be implemented by enhancing external supervise and driving internal environmental management are put forward.

articleTitle: Application of Grid Technology in Resource Storage of Digital Library
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper analyzed the characteristics of digital library resources and the requirements for storage.It gave the technology and characteristics of grid storage ,analyzed the advantages of the grid storage, and discussed the application of grid storage technology in the digital library resources stored from three aspects.

articleTitle: Research on Knowledge Sharing among Partners in Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of knowledge economy, knowledge has become the most important strategic resource, and knowledge management in supply chain has become increasingly important. Influencing factors on knowledge sharing among partners in supply chain are analyzed and the countermeasures are given in the paper. A logical model of knowledge sharing among partners is built, which mainly includes knowledge base, knowledge community, knowledge sharing platform of supply chain and knowledge conformity within partners.

articleTitle: Research on the Partners' Valuation System and Optimum Decision in Agile Enterprise Alliance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Agile enterprise alliance (AEA) is the main procreative organization form of information society in the 21st century. Choosing and deciding partners in AEA is one of the key links to set up agile enterprise alliance. The correct partners' selection is very important to enhance total competition power of AEA. In this paper, a new partners' valuation system in AEA and a revised analytic hierarchy process (AHP) method is put forward.

articleTitle: Outward Direct Investment and Productivity Changes within China: An Empirical Test
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, We adopt VAR model to estimate the technology sourcing effects of China's ODI on its domestic productivity growth and the contribution of two sources of productivity growth - technological progress and efficiency change, respectively. We examine these with data from China's direct investment in 8 developed countries during 1991 and 2007. We find the ODI to be strongly beneficial to total factor productivity and efficiency change appears as the greater source of productivity growth in China.

articleTitle: Study on the Comprehensive Evaluation of Human Resource Internal Control Based on the Unascertained Measure Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Personnel control is one of the most important content of the enterprise internal control. The effective and perfect control of the human resources is not only the basic guarantee to realize the enterprise internal control, but also the reasonable safeguard to realize effective corporate governance. The paper will construct the evaluation index system of human resource internal control and then use unascertained measure model to evaluate it. The unascertained comprehensive evaluation results of human resource internal control will be get clearly. This is a good way to provide scientific theory and methods for building effective evaluation system of human resource internal control and for the explanations and suggestions on the policy of corporate governance.

articleTitle: The Analysis of the Mathematical Model of Knowledge Field from the Perspective of Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The study of knowledge is an important part of knowledge management. In this paper, the mathematical model of knowledge field has been built up in the way of vector field, and the Laplace's equation of knowledge potential has also been built up. This paper takes those examples to explore the solution of mathematical model of knowledge field. It figures out the rules of diffusion of knowledge under the general field circumstances, it aimed at providing a way of quantitative analysis to the diffusion of knowledge, and it combines natural science with social science more effectively.

articleTitle: Analysis on Behavior of Patentees in "Delay" of Technology Transaction: Based on Evolutionary Game
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The primary goal of this research is to discussed the behavior of the group of patentees in the problem of "delay" during the process of technology transaction. By considering bounded rationality of the patentees, a model of evolutionary game is founded to analyze the strategy choice of individual patentees, regarding the probability of infringement by purchasers as exogenous variable. Results from the model show that the postponement is mainly influenced by the original proportion of different choices in the group of patentees. This work also provides the policy makers with suggestion to avoid delay in technology transfer.

articleTitle: The Mechanism Analysis on the Impact of Entrepreneur Reputation to the Consumers' Purchasing Behaviors
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the era of commodity economy in which buyer's market is increasingly popular, the consumers have more choices when they want to purchase some products or services, and even the entrepreneur reputation is also becoming an important consideration. In this paper, from the angle of the constituent elements of entrepreneur reputation, the author discusses the mechanism on the impact of entrepreneur reputation to the consumers' purchasing behaviors in theory, and comes to a conclusion that a good entrepreneur reputation is conducive to enhancing the products or services purchasing behaviors of the consumers.

articleTitle: A Study on the Leading Fact of Stock Index Future and Spot Stock Index
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper choose sample data from both the upward trending market and the downward trending market for the empirical test. We find that (1) on the whole, the movement of the spot stock index and the stock index future adjusts consulting to each other. But the time when the stock index future is leading is longer than the time when the stock index future is leading. (2) as the approaches of the delivery months, the time when the spot stock index is leading the stock index future shortens.

articleTitle: Design of Advanced Remote Sensing Data Processing Grid Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of spatial information technology, remote sensing data processing has become a kind of important service to the public. Traditional processing mode with one single machine and one software can't meet the demand of various requirements and high performance processing though there exist various isolated remote sensing resources such as data, software over network. Grid is a infrastructure for resource-sharing which uses the resources of many separate computers connected by a network to solve large-scale computation problems. Grid computing is the technology for problem solving based on grid. Extending the processing to grid is the trend of remote sensing data processing. In this paper, the architecture of service oriented remote sensing data processing grid is proposed and a grid prototype system is implemented based on Globus Toolkit 4.2(GT4). A heterogeneous image fusion service is implemented and taken as an example design of advanced remote sensing data processing grid service.

articleTitle: Analysis on Chinese University-Enterprise Collaboration Networks of Patent Applications - An Example of Chemical and Metallurgical Patents
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper analyzes the evolution of Chinese university-enterprise networks of patent applications during a special period. Data of chemistry and metallurgy patents which applied jointly by universities and enterprises were obtained from China's State Intellectual Property Office. The data were applied for the analysis on the evolution of Chinese university-enterprise collaboration networks. Social network analysis method was used to analyze the evolution of Chinese university-enterprise collaboration networks. The findings of this paper are helpful for government to deepen the mechanisms of university-enterprise collaboration.

articleTitle: Main Bank System Reform in Japan: The Terminal or Coexistence with Other Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The main bank system in Japan has undergone remarkable reformation since the 1980<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup>. Through analysing its reform realisation, functional range and performance, it has been derived that the main bank system neither comes to its termination nor does it simply evolve into the 'creditor ex post monitoring' mode like that in the Western countries, but follow an integrated way to transition. The main bank system and the creditor governance mode coexist in one economy and form a complementary binary structure, which will definitely function for a long term.

articleTitle: Design of Bipolar Odd-Even Method for Immediately Correction of Information Errors
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Packet losses and errors are common through current wireless transmission due to signal decay, barriers in-between and other environmental related reasons. Although there are many ways to correct these errors, there is no one can deal with them immediately. For the efficient use of energy to achieve the purpose of energy conservation, and use the smallest energy to implement monitoring more, rapid implementation of parallel processing, a division of cooperation can be real-time monitoring without individual inquiries. If data are sent in hardware method, safer transmission can be reached by simply modify the hardware. Adopted the principle of variable packet, each single-chip can act as transceiver at any time, automatically send or emergency call by turns. The use of searching the initial symbols and the suspension symbols of the interpretation of the way to transmit the information and the related content. Signals can be sent to the extensions by monitoring and management of the host, also can be transferred to another host through cross-regional, as well as the transmitting DATA can be mounted other messages without wasting time. By checking the connection between any two adjacent bytes, problems like signal decay can be solved. At the meantime, it can correct errors automatically, to prevent interferences, and fortify the safety and encryption of wireless transmission.

articleTitle: Research on Cost Control Strategy under Asymmetric Information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The problem how a manager motivate producers to reduce product costs under asymmetric information is discussed on a basis of principal-agent theory. Under asymmetric information, manager can not monitor producers' effort to reduce costs; therefore, manager needs to motivate producers. The manager determines a contractual basic cost according to his own requirement and producers' self-reported cost, and establishes a model to maximize manager's expected utility under the conditions of producers' individual rationality constraint and incentive compatibility constraint. The model uses incentive and punishment coefficient as decision variables and the evolutionary programming algorithm is used to do the simulation.

articleTitle: Urban Transition in Western China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China has experienced considerable urban growth in the past sixty years, especially since the implementation of Economic reform and Opening Policy in 1978. In 1949, there were only 132 cities with an urban population of 27.4 million, while in 2007 it had 655 cities with a total urban population of 500 million. Such an urban growth is attributed to the boost in the number of cities and the urban population. Urban expansion enhanced geographic inequality between the three major regions in China. Compared to the Eastern and Central regions, Western China only has 19% of the total cities and 17% of the urban population. The urbanization rate was 36% for the Western region in 2007, while it reached 53.7% for the Eastern regions and 43.1% for Central China. Using Geographic Information System (GIS) and statistical analyses, this study aims at explaining the structure and spatial development of urban growth, and highlighting the current issues of urban inequality in Western China during the past two decades. The conclusions are the following: 1. Urban growth disparities between East and West have become increasingly obvious, but seem to be evolving slowly since the establishment of the government's Western Development Priority policy in 2000; 2. Cities were of various sizes expanded in Western China, and the main factors which effected the urban growth are population numbers and density, government investment and geographic conditions; 3. Current patterns of urbanization in the Western region are distributed unevenly between provinces.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis on the Influencing Factors of the Effectiveness on the Whole Process of the Patent Technology Industrialization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Cross-Function Structure of Social Network and Its Management Enlightenment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the theory of organizational social networks and combined with six companies' case study of social network structure. We conduct a comparative study on the structural differences of cross-function advice network and intelligence network from the point of density, group degree centrality and group betweenness centrality. The results reveal that: the density of advice network is lower than the density of intelligence network; in the aspect of the group degree centrality and group betweenness centrality, advice network is higher than intelligence network. Finally, we discuss implications of the conclusions in understanding the transmission of information, organizational communication and knowledge management.

articleTitle: The Research on the System to Remove the Trade Barriers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we followed the development trend of service science and the idea of knowledge services. We provide kinds of socio-economic system to remove the trade barriers. Based on the existed research results on knowledge-economic field, we researched the propagation characteristics of the regional economy. At the same time, we applied the method in the research of trade between two countries. Then we researched the propagation environment of the economic wave and the factors that cause barriers to trade. At last, we recommend establish appropriate talent, technology and economic systems to remove trade barriers.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Investment Costs and Cash Expenses: Based on Survey of 13 Henan Sewage Treatment Plants in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper comparatively analyzes investment costs and cash expenses of thirteen newly built sewage treatment plants in Henan Province, based on the actual research data. The research result suggests: Sewage treatment plants of the same construction scale in the same drainage basin and with similar processing and discharge standard, are different in investment costs and cash expenses. And the chief factor affecting investment costs of sewage treatment plants is civil working and equipment capital; while the principal element influencing cash expenses is electricity cost and rate of loading. Therefore, means of reasonable plans and scientific management and so forth could be applied to reduce investment costs and cash expenses of sewage treatment plants.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Football Player Transfer Problems Based on Real Options
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper we discuss the uncertainty of the player's value with protection period, develop a pricing framework based on the real options methods and present a new valuing model for the player transfer dealing. By using the partial differential equations approach, the closed-form solutions are derived from these models. Meanwhile we also consider the effect of injuries on the financial value of the profession players.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influencing Factor on Household Financial Assets: The Case of Beijing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper regards Beijing households as object of study. Based on household disposable income, wealth, consumption, risk and profession character, this paper presents a detailed analysis of influencing factor about household financial assets by using aggregate and survey data. We find that at present household income, consumption, portfolio have not formed a good cycle. Therefore our government needs strengthen and improve macroeconomic management such that households can reasonably arrange their financial assets.

articleTitle: Fractal Study on Urban Systems in the Underdeveloped Regions in West China: A Case Study in the Lanzhou-Xining Town Compact Region
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, the fractal theory is used to carry out a case study on the spatial structure, scale structure and formation mechanism of urban systems in the Lanzhou-Xining town compact region, an underdeveloped region in west China. The results show that the rank-sizes distribution of the urban systems is dispersive, there is an obvious primate distribution, development of the large- and mid-sized cities is insufficient, rank-sizes of the urban systems are generally low, and the evenness of urban population distribution is poor, the spatial development degree of cities and towns is low, spatial distribution is quite uneven, decentralization is high, and the density of cities and towns away from the central cities is attenuated rapidly, the mature degree of spatial development of cities and towns is poor in some regions, and the spatial fractal characteristics are unconspicuous and even the fractal structure is not formed yet.

articleTitle: Dynamic Game Analysis of the Pure Public Welfare Project in the Concession Management Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper mainly study the decision-making model on the concession term for pure public welfare project in the concession management process. The traditional pure public welfare project always adopted the single government supplying mode which can easily cause the lack of predominant investor and make the incentive and obligatory mechanism invalid. Eventually this may lead to the low efficiency of the project management. Learning from BOT financing mode, introducing concession management mode into pure public welfare project can not only absorb the diversified predominant investors who may bring about competition, but also solve the problem of fund shortage. Because the pure public welfare project doesn't satisfy the conditions for charge and can't generate future cash flow, its concession management mode also has some differences with BOT projects'. This paper mainly studies the pure public welfare project which doesn't have cash income. After analyzing the characteristics of the pure public welfare project concession management mode, the paper establishes the game model on government and the project enterprise, discusses the relationship between concession term, construction cost of the project enterprise, compensation fees and so on, gets a decision-making model of the concession term and a calculation formula of construction cost which has been proved by empirical example. This model provides a concession term determination method of the pure public welfare project in its concession management process and has great theoretical value and practical application value.

articleTitle: Study on the Relation between Execution and Competition: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As we know, execution is the key factor for a company's success, which composes one important component of enterprise competition in the 21st century. The main focus of this research has been analyzed the relation between execution and competition. Based on survey and study of one municipal engineering corporation, this article analyses problems existing, such as efficiency comes down, profit declines, benefit depresses and so on. Then it clarifies the relation between execution and competition. Finally, through introducing a folk, it probes methods and approaches to cultivate and advance enterprise competition.

articleTitle: Does Bancassurance Add Profitability and Risk to Banks and Insurance Companies?-Evidence from China Based on Simulated Merger Methodology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Using a sample of the major China's commercial banks and insurance companies over 1999-2006, this document empirically tests the effects of bancassurance created by simulated merger on the profitability and risk of banks and insurance companies involved.

articleTitle: Valuing the Environmental Damage or Improvement: Based on the Happiness Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In addition to standard methods of environmental valuation, a new method has emerged which models individuals' self-reported happiness as a function of their incomes and the environmental quality. The estimated method is used to calculate the trade-off that people would be willing to make between income and environmental conditions, i.e. the increase in income is a necessary compensation to individuals for any given decline in environmental conditions. The happiness method is introduced by both the theoretical and empirical aspects in this paper.

articleTitle: Automobile Financial Service in China's Mainland
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China is considered as the potential automobile financial service market throughout the world. However, the actual market is still less developed nowadays. This paper concentrates on the problems and seeks to discover some explanations of this phenomenon. The structure of this paper can be divided into four parts. After a brief introduction and background of the situation in China automobile financial services market, the two hypotheses are assumed. Subsequently, the questionnaire and depth interview are both conducted to validate and collect primary data. SPSS have been used to analyze the data and finally get the conclusions about the brief reasons of the impropriety of China automobile financial services.

articleTitle: The Study on Evaluation and Selection of Coal Client for Port Based on Rough Sets Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The selection of Client is the key point of the operation in port, select an excellent client will make the use of resource more reasonable, and increase the benefit of port. A system of evaluation and selection indexes for coal client selection is put forward based on the fact of Qinhuangdao Port Group, and establish a model of the selection of coal client, then use rough sets extract the decision-making rules through attribute reduction. The results show that the model and the method are effective and practical, and can provide the basis for the evaluation of clients and the selection of candidates.

articleTitle: Study on Experts Scheduling Strategy of Collective Consultation in Long-Distance Medical System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the Long-distance Medical System, experts scheduling of collective consultation is a key part. On the basis of systematic analysis, we established a mathematical model of scheduling algorithm and described the algorithm. The algorithm is realized with less waiting time to achieve greater collective diagnosis, but also maximize the number of experts participating in each collective consultation, with high efficiency in collective consultation.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Project-Level Influencing Factors on Information Technology Implementation in Construction Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Express Enterprises of China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the base of designing the index system of evaluating competence, this paper empirically investigates the five dominating express enterprises of China with the data of survey, including EMS, Shunfeng, Shentong, Zhaijisong and Tiantian, in the approach of information entropy and gray relevant analysis. The influencing factors of competence are analyzed deeply, and hereby some suggestions to promote competence are offered.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Application of SHEL Model on Ship Safety Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Water-Saving Agriculture Based on Financial Support
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Developing water-saving agriculture is a way to resolve agricultural water crisis, also the fundamental way to maintain the agricultural ecological environment. As about 70% of agricultural water is irrigation water, the improvement of farmland irrigation infrastructure is an important way for water-saving agricultural. While the ecological environment and farmland irrigation infrastructure have public goods attributes, comprehensive measures should be taken for public finances to support agricultural irrigation infrastructure so as to promote water-saving agriculture development.

articleTitle: Fraud Detection: From Basic Techniques to a Multi-Agent Approach
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to KPMG figures, fraud represents a serious economical problem, which has been studied in different ways due to the fact that fraudsters are benefiting from the fast development of ICT and are developing their techniques. In this paper, after summarizing different fraud detection methods and tools proposed in the literature like meta-rules and tree-based detection, we will introduce a multi-agent system, called FIDES, which integrates the computational power of data mining tools and attack trees with experts' judgments negotiated through a Delphi-based system. Two scenarios are described: in the first one FIDES, supported by cause-effect diagrams, is used to classify alarms generated by the system to help the experts to focus on the real dangerous ones; in the second one FIDES is used in a proactive way in order to block or prevent human based frauds.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on Manager Overconfidence and Acquisition Decision in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on behavioral finance perspective, this paper did a study theoretically and empirically on the relationship between the characteristics of general manager overconfidence and M & A. The research shows: the degree of general manager overconfidence is positively related with M & A, which means, general manager overconfidence is an important factor which drives M & A.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on FDI Knowledge Spillover: Spatial Econometric Models Based on Panel Data
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper utilizes Moran's I Index to investigate the spatial correlation of the regional technology innovation in China. Referring to the knowledge production function (KPF) by Griliches-Jaffe and the spatial lag econometric models based on Panel Data, the effects of four domestic factors is checked through the panel data of 29 provinces (cities/municipals) for the period 2000~2008. The study has shown that (i) FDI hasn't motivated the regional technological innovation in China but has even played a function of restraint for several reasons; (ii) The input of R&D of enterprises and institutions of higher education and the R&D staff of enterprises are the main factors that have promoted the regional technological innovation; (iii) The technological innovation of a region could be influenced positively by the technological innovation in its neighboring regions. On the basis of the above-mentioned conclusions, this paper has brought forward concerned suggestions on the policies regarding to the strategies of FDI introduction in China and the development of regional technological innovation in China.

articleTitle: The Relationship between Agency Cost and Capital Structure: A Study with the Restriction of Free Cash Flow
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Agency cost theory is an important branch of capital structural theory. Free cash flow has significant impact on agency cost. The combination of research on these two fields would help to build and extend the theoretical system. Based on agency cost theory, the present study firstly categorized the characteristics of free cash flow as well as the statistical methodologies. Furthermore, the existence of investing free cash flow in agency cost was proved by a model. Then free cash flow was introduced into agency cost theory as restriction, the analysis shows that it will change agency cost, in turn, will have an impact on the relationship between agency cost and capital structure, finally, will influence the optimal capital structure point to maintain the equilibrium. Concretely, with the increasing free cash flow, correspondingly, debt proportion will decrease.

articleTitle: Survey and Research on Undergraduates' Information Demand for Information Service in Network Environment in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This thesis emphaticly analizes and studies undergraduates' information demand and information behavior through investigation. Based on the conclusion of this investigation, we try to understand the demand awareness, the information needs, information seeking patterns and evaluation items and purchase intention of undergraduates' for business information in China. At the end of the study, we also try to make a few recommendations for government and information service providers including universities' libraries or information centers and business service providers.

articleTitle: Research on Vessels' Portable Ammunition Support System Based on Data Warehouse
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There are many problems in the management system of vessels' portable ammunition which uses the traditional affairs database. The shortcomings of traditional database are analyzed firstly. To deal with these problems, a new ammunition support system based on data warehouse is proposed. The structure of the data warehouse is discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on the M&A Performance of Listed Coal Companies Based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) is suitable for effectiveness analysis of complex systems with multi-input and multi-output indicators. For the purpose of evaluating M&A performance and efficiency of listed coal companies, this paper utilizes DEA method to research 11 listed coal companies that has taken place M&A incidents in 2005, draws conclusions, analyzes the questions and eventually puts forward ways to increase it.

articleTitle: Does Chinese Distribution Industry Have Development Pattern?: Empirical Analysis Based on the Province Data
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In contrast to the rising pattern in service sector, using Chinese province data, an inverted-U curve between the share of distribution in GDP and the level of development arises. The empirical results are robust to the choice of functional form.A similar pattern is also found when cross-section data is used.

articleTitle: Management Strategy to Ensure Gas Source Stable in the Vehicle CNG Filling Station-- Planning to Build Environment-Friendly Energy Fund
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, there has a problem that the gas source in Vehicle CNG stations(VCS) supplied in short in the domestic vehicle market which has huge potential. This paper suggests Gas company proposed the organization, environment-friendly energy fund(EEF), that corporate money market funds to gather plenty of private capital to make or pay the smooth implementation of this economic strategy, thus ensuring the CNG industry chain on the middle and lower reaches of the coordinated development, at the same time, take and pay without discussion(TPWD) between upper and low in CNG industry chain can be practiced smoothly to provide adequate gas source for VCS.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Effect of Modern Service Industry Clustering on Regional Economic Integration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The phenomenon of modern service industry clustering has attracted more and more scholars' attention. As a result, this paper attempted to make a research on the effect of modern service industry clustering on regional economic integration. This paper firstly evaluated the development of regional service industry clustering in 8 economic zones in China, and analysis the relation between the modern service industry clustering and regional economic growth by the method of least square, so as to put forward suggestions for the development of regional service industries.

articleTitle: Research on Efficiency of Investment in the World Bank with AHP/DEA Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we use AHP/DEA model to analyze the efficiency of investment in the Water Infrastructure of the World Bank. Through the input and output index, we select the relative importance of index as a basis for AHP/DEA model, and according to the result of calculations with AHP/DEA model, we evaluate the efficiency of the second loan project of the inland water in the World Bank. With the help of AHP/DEA model, we find the efficiency of the loan projects in the World Bank; can be more objective to be evaluated.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of China Price Transmission Mechanism Based on VAR Model with Seasonally Adjusted Data
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the China seasonally adjusted monthly chain price indexes, the VAR model has been used in the research on the transmission mechanism of market price. Empirical results show that MPI, PPI, CPI monthly chain index are not smooth series, but with cointegration relationship in China, and a long-run equilibrium relationship exists among them.
