Then Granger causality test and impulse response function analysis is applied into the VAR model based on them, and the conclusions are as follows: there is a demand-pull characteristic in China price transmission, and the effect of transmission from CPI to PPI is very obvious, but has two months lag, the transmission from PPI to MPI has the same effect. In addition, the impact of transmission from CPI to PPI is gradually stable after three months, and the stabilization time of transmission from PPI to MPI is four months. And then the market prices have entered a new equilibrium. The conclusion shows that the market price is influenced by demand in current time, the price fluctuations in the consumption area will have an impact and influence on the whole industrial chain price, and the CPI has become the leading indicators in the price fluctuations.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of Law Enforcement and Stock Market Development--Based on Actual Analysis of International Comparison
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Recent researches indicate stock market development largely benefited from effective law enforcement for investors. This paper compares law enforcement effectiveness internationally across 49 countries' legal origin, focusing on influence of resource investment in law enforcement had on the stock market development. Research shows public enforcement and private enforcement work hand in hand to provide essential protection for investors and the development of stock market.

articleTitle: Post-Accident Human Reliability Analysis and Improvement of Operator Performance in a Chinese Nuclear Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Human Reliability Analysis (HRA) is an important part of Probabilistic Safety Assessment (PSA) in a nuclear power plant (NPP). It can be used to evaluate and quantify the behaviors of the operators in a main control room (MCR) for a safety assessment. Most of the MCR operator actions fall within category C (post-accident) human factor events. The paper analyzes the post-accident operator's behaviors quantitatively and makes a classification and divides them into groups on the basis of an actual HRA analysis of a pressurized water reactor (PWR) of a NPP in China. The basic human errors involved in events in the NPP and their weightiness are ranked in sequence to obtain the order of operator actions to be as a basis to improve the performance of the operators including the rectification of emergency operating procedures (EOPs) and the improvement of management and training.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysing Quality Management Status Quo of Equipment Manufacturing Industry in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Problem and Sustainable Development Measures on the Manuscripts Source of the University Journals
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The university journals are not only an media of demonstrating the teaching and researching level of universities, but also an important window to exchange academy with others. However the quality of university journal and source of manuscripts decreased owing to the imperfect scientific evaluation system, which lead the academic influence of university journals decreased obviously. The university journals should play discipline advantage and strengthen the characteristic column. The high quality manuscripts can be obtained by stabilizing the core authors of native school, striving for the authors of other universities and actively cultivating the authors of postgraduates. Preferential policy can be adopted to attract the excellent manuscripts which determined the quality of university journals. The quality and academic influence of university journal can be improved by the connotative development and sustainable manage the manuscripts source of the university journals.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the KM Competence of a Small and Medium Multinational Company in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Effects of Justice on Service Recovery Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study reviews literatures currently available on the effects of perceived justice on service recovery satisfaction, especially on their relative weight. Based on justice theory, we propose hypotheses in the model of service recovery satisfaction and empirically examine them in restaurant industry. The results indicate that both of outcome justice and procedural justice significantly affect recovery satisfaction and the outcome justice is of more weight than procedural justice in their influence on recovery satisfaction.

articleTitle: Research on a Single-Period and Two-Level Supply Chain Coordination under Uncertain Demand and Delay in Payment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The supply chain coordination is the core of supply chain management. This paper researches on supply chain coordination under uncertain demand and delay in Payments and establish specific mathematical model that apply to a specific two-level supply chain that consists of one supplier and one retailer. Finally, a numerical example verifies the validity of the model. The result show that the strategy of delay in payments can improve the whole supply chain benefits and the reasonable sharing contract could further contribute to the integration of the supply chain. With that the whole supply chain could maximize the profits and achieve win-win objectives.

articleTitle: Transnational Capitals and Industrial Chain Upgrading
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Industrial chain upgrading usually shows that the local cluster enterprises operates ascending from low added-value segments to the high ones by means of OEM or supporting MNCs. The technology, brands and channels from MNCs serves as prerequisite for upgrading to high value-added segments. The paper constructs a two-stage optimization model of industrial supporting and upgrading to illustrate that the cluster enterprises in the first stage can obtain independent innovative capacity by building perfect supporting system and integrating with transnational capitals, while in the second stage they can enhance their regional competitiveness by out breaking low-added value segments and upgrading along value chains.

articleTitle: Determinants of Personal Well-Being in Urban China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The study investigates the relationship between environmental satisfaction and personal well-being with a sample of 336 urban residences from 4 Chinese cities: Changchun, Dalian, Harbin and Shenyang. In contrast to previous studies, this study controlled job satisfaction and Big Five personality traits. In addition, the research variables of PWI, job satisfaction, Big Five, and environmental satisfaction are measured with multi-item scales. The research finds that environmental satisfaction is positively related to personal well-being, suggesting that improvement of environment can enhance urban residents' well-being.

articleTitle: H-index Research Missed Information Value Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The author analyzed the limitations of the method current used in h-index research, raised that h-index can be reanalyzed using the theory of information value, and discussed the h-index's principle based on information value, studied the scope and inadequate of the h- index finally.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Knowledge Management Strategy Change Model of Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Overseas M&A by Chinese Enterprises: Analysis of Restriction Factor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The global financial crisis has brought an unprecedented opportunity to Chinese enterprises' overseas M&A. More and more Chinese enterprises participate in it. However, behind the prosperity of overseas M&A, there are many constraints to the internationalization of Chinese enterprises. Based on the public data and typical cases since the financial crisis, this text discussed the characteristics of Chinese enterprises' overseas M&A. And then this text analysed the restriction factors of Chinese enterprises' overseas M&A regarding the finance, cultural integration, human resources, politics. At last, Chinese enterprises can get countermeasures from these analyses.

articleTitle: Analysis on Principle Observation, Path Selection Mechanism, and Risk Control of Enterprise Strategy Evolution
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The enterprise strategy depends on its capability with comparable advantage, if one enterprise wants to change its strategy, it must change its capability structure. Based on the above principle, the evolutionary path of enterprise strategy is decided by the following three elements: present strategy, environment change and senior management team, which produce effects by the inheritance, variation and selection mechanism. In addition, an enterprise must pay attention to the strategy-breaking risk, and solve it by enhance present strategy life-cycle or accelerate the input of new capability.

articleTitle: Genetic Function Analysis in Corporate Developing Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The future developing track and status of a corporate were to a great degree determined by certain important factors shaped when its business started. One corporate is consisted of and operated with different individuals whose values and abilities constructed genes of this corporate. Among these genes, 5 of them are of great importance: corporate driving force, enterprise pursuit, executive ability, innovation and corporate ethic. Of course, different corporate will have gene construction with diversity considering that these corporates are in the different business and have different driving force. When discussing corporate operation, the gene in the leading role is coporate driving force with other genes fuctioning differently under its domination. Sometimes, one of these genes will have such enormous power that it will become a new corporate driving force.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimal Strategies between Information Gatekeepers and Price-Competing Firms
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the case where identical firms pay a fee to list prices at a price comparison site and can price discriminate between consumers, how the optimal strategic behaviors of online firms and price comparison site evolve with the time process and the number of competing firms is researched. Using dynamic competitive game models following the diffusion process of price comparison technology, equilibrium results from dynamic competitiveness are obtained. It is predicted that, high price-listed fee policy would discourage the firms to list prices, but increase the expected revenue of each firm. The lowest price and expected revenue of each firm decrease with time process and the increase of firm number. Finally, when information gatekeeper charges a monopoly fee to price-listed firms, the probability at which each firm posts a price, the lowest price firms decide on and expected revenue are independent of time parameter, but shift downward with increasing the number of competing firms.

articleTitle: Application of Mathematica in Economic Order Quantity Model with Weibull Deterioration Distribution, Time-Varying Demand and Shortages
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An economic order quantity model for deteriorating items with time-varying demand and Weibull deterioration distribution. The shortages are allowed and backlogged completely. The inventory model is developed over a fixed inventory cycle and the optimal replenishment policy is derived by minimizing the total inventory cost. The inventory problem in general cannot be solved in an explicit form. Hence, we solve the problem with the help of Mathematica, which can perform the symbolic as well as the numerical calculation. Two numerical examples are presented to illustrate the inventory model. The results have shown that Mathematica is suitable for finding the optimal solution of the inventory problem.

articleTitle: Business Performance Analysis of Listed Companies under the Stock Dividends Behavior: An Empirical Approach Based on Factor Analysis Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes business performance of A-share listed companies issued stock dividend using factor analysis model (FAM). The FAM method generates weights through mathematical transformation and enables us to avoid the subjectivity of giving weights. It is found that the main factors that affect the business operating performance of listed companies are six variables, including operating capacity, growth capacity and cash flows. Also, it is indicated that the main weights of business operating performance are the expansion of capacity, profitability and solvency. Our findings imply that investors should analyze the multi-dimensional factors of company business performance while forming up a portfolio and making investment decision.

articleTitle: Dynamic Control for Resource Leveling in Project Network Planning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To meet the physical limits of construction resources, to avoid day-to-day fluctuation in resource demands, and to maintain an even flow of application for construction resources, resource leveling is needed in the construction industry. A new idea was put forward that is the classificatory criteria of the new evaluation indexes and computational method of the dynamic evaluation indexes are redefined, because the analysis of the four resource-balance evaluation indexes shows their shortages. The new ones can efficiently avoid the frequent consumption curve, the peak or trough serious resource consumption intensity, such as supply capacity exceeding the resources of the occurrence of engineering resources, thus the uses of the recourses will be kept balance. To get the deficiencies of resource leveling indicators solved, the opportunity cost of non-predictability of the resource leveling indicators are raised, which improve the description of resource leveling performance accuracy. An example is used to demonstrate the application.

articleTitle: Research on the Relation between Quality and Competitive Advantage Based on Value Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nowadays increasingly fierce market competition focuses on quality. Only through the pursuit of high-quality products and services, is it possible to have a high international competitiveness. From the viewpoint of strategic management accounting, based on the theory of value chain, this paper explores the relation between quality and competitive advantage and points out quality chain and value chain are integrated in the operation chain. Through the analysis of upstream value chain, enterprise can optimize the procurement cost; through the analysis of downstream value chain, enterprise can optimize the product life-cycle cost and improve customers' satisfaction.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Thematic Chains: The Effectively Coherent Device in the Constructing Skill of the Text
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Inquiring into International Business Product Innovation in Commercial Banks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper first analyzes necessitates of innovation in international business, and then it gives six countermeasures of how to implement innovation for banks. After that it discusses how to deal with several relationships in international business innovation, finally it summarizes the above content.

articleTitle: Using System Dynamics as a Knowledge-Based Decision Making Paradigm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we suggest a method of knowledge-based decision making using system dynamics, with an emphasis to strategic concerns. The proposed method transforms individual mental models into explicit knowledge by translating partial and implicit knowledge into an integrated knowledge model. The scenario-based test of the organized knowledge model enables decision-makers to understand the structure of the target problem and identify its basic cause, which facilitates effective decision-making.

articleTitle: The Concentration Ratio of China Construction Industry Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The concentration ratio indicates the concentration of production management in a particular industry and is and important index to reflect industry and market structures. This paper applied concentration ratio (CRn) method, Lorenz curve and Gini Coefficient into analyze the absolute concentration ratio and relative concentration ratio for China construction industry market with 2002 to 2008 statistical data. The research shows that the concentration of China construction industry market definitely has developed. However, there still exist considerable gaps when it is compared with counterparts in developed countries. Therefore, the strategic ways to improve the concentration ratio of China construction industry market are fully discussed, based on the laws and regulatory system, market order and industrial and enterprise structure.

articleTitle: Application of Green Roof Techniques in Beijing, China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Over the past several years, green roof techniques have been widely used in Beijing, China, to better utilize rainwater, improve air quality and reduce city heat island effects. By the end of 2008, a few hundred buildings had been constructed with green roofs, with a total green roof area of more than 1 million m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Currently, more than 100,000 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of new green roofs are being created per annum in Beijing. The tough natural environment in Beijing, such as very cold winters and long periods of drought, means that great efforts from scientists, engineers, and landscape architects are required to ensure the success of these green roofs. This paper introduces: A. the relevant policies and regulations which enable the rapid application of green roof techniques in Beijing; B. new research and technical publications/specifications which help to design and construct green roofs correctly; and C. maintenance requirements. Several examples of the existing green roofs will be presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Grey Correlation Analysis on Innovative Talents Cultivating in Higher Education and Industrial Structure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Industrial restructuring is an important way of changing the mode of economic development and improving the quality of economic growth. Colleges and universities shoulder the heavy responsibility of cultivating high quality talents and providing intellectual support for the industrial upgrading. Therefore, it has important theoretical and practical value to research on the relationship of innovative talents cultivating in higher education and industrial structure. Grey correlation method is applied to studying the relationship between innovative talents nurturing in higher education and industrial structure. The results indicate that the innovative talents cultivating in higher education is closely linked with industrial structure. The increase in the number of students and the enhancement of human capital has significant effect on industrial upgrading. The talents cultivation of higher education must be adjusted to the development of industrial structure and employment structure.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation on Authentication Servers in DRM System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Digital Rights Management (DRM) technology play a very important role in solving the problems of digital copyright, it includes streaming media servers, authentication servers, web servers, file servers, database servers several parts. The paper mainly discusses the design and implementation of authentication server.

articleTitle: Research of Semantic Information Retrieval Based on Grid
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, semantic retrieval methods are applied to information grid environment. It is much easier realize ontology reasoning, as well as more accurate response to users' retrieval request using ontology. To build the ontology about user and grid, through which relates the information resource and grid, and enhances the effect of grid in semantic retrieval. Based on this, we proposed the architecture of the semantic retrieval based on Grid.

articleTitle: An Ontology-Based Report Designer Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The report designer is the core part of flexible report systems which provides the decision support to information systems. In this paper, we propose an ontology-based report designer which provides a flexible mechanism to generate different reports. The paper gives the principle of report designer and details the formal description of report designer ontology. At last we give an application instance which uses this model, the practice proves that the report designer model can enhance the development efficiency and reduce the costs.

articleTitle: Emergency Communications Specifications under Large-Scale Disaster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Emergency communications are important channels for instructing relief operations, transmitting information and appeasing the public. Emergency communications specifications enable emergency communications implemented reasonably, effectively and reliably. The article emphasizes the necessity of emergency communications specifications, analyses the features of emergency communications, sets up the structure of emergency communications, details the process of emergency communications with its classification.

articleTitle: Practical Diagnostic Approach of Energy Consumption and Systematic Fault of AC System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Due to the vast amount of energy consumption of AC (Air Conditioning) systems, the reasonable design, optimal operation and efficient management of AC systems are inevitable and necessary to the whole city energy management (CEM). To achieve these objectives, the verification of systematic characteristics, practical approaches of energy consumption and systematic fault diagnosis of AC systems should be taken as the premises and the most elementary works. Based on AC commissioning principle, a practical diagnosis approach of energy consumption and systematic fault of AC system is established. The framework and general procedures of the practical approach is presented and introduced in this paper.

articleTitle: Do Venture Capital Networks Really Work in China?
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Many financial markets are characterized by strong relationships and networks. We examine the performance consequences of this organizational structure in the context of relationships established when venture capital (VC) syndicate portfolio company investments. We find that social network has played a significant role in china VC industry; The increase of the centrality and stability contribute to higher exit rate of VC. We also provide initial evidence on the evolution of VC networks.

articleTitle: The Analysis and System Simulation of Price Competition in a Duopoly Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies the price competition in the duopoly market without considering the non-price factor. The Gravity model is introduced and a new type of price competition model is established based on the game theory. Finally, using simulated data, the system simulation process is demonstrated, and the price competition result is given.

articleTitle: The Influential Factors of China's Foreign Exchange Reserves
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The growth of foreign exchange reserves has been the focus of much recent research. Studies have examined the influential factors of foreign exchange reserves in a range of different settings and contexts. However, most of the existing research has focused on the international balance of payments, despite the fact that there is general agreement that international balance of payments plays an important role in the growth of foreign exchange reserves. In the current study, we explore the effect of balance of domestic economy on China's foreign exchange reserves through empirical analysis. Through the data from 1978 to 2007 in China, we find that the gap between savings and investment has a positive impact on China's foreign exchange reserves. This result explains that the continued growth of foreign exchange reserves not only reflects the imbalance of a country's external economy, but also reflects the imbalance of domestic economy. In addition, we find that economic scale, dependence on foreign trade and exchange rate can affect China's foreign exchange reserves.

articleTitle: Construction of High-Availability Teaching Website
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper introduces the concept of high availability. And it discusses high-availability teaching website design methods in the following six aspects: site architecture design, content design, page template design, ease of use design, navigation design, and search functionality design.

articleTitle: A Rational Consensus Model in Group Decision Making Based on Linguistic Assessment Information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on advance order of linguistic phrases, a new approach to select the best one from alternate plans is proposed. The linguistic assessment information can be aggregated by an improving arithmetic, a combination of LWD operator and LOWA operator, to obtain the group assessment information given by the form of linguistic phrases, so the best plan can be chosen from the advance order of these linguistic phrases. In order to illustrate the viability and adaptability of this approach, a simulation example is given by this paper.

articleTitle: A Framework for Multi-Agent Based Supply Network Simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is a challenging task to analyze dynamic performance of a practical supply network system, as well as performance of its members. This paper addresses this problem, and proposes a new framework for multi-agent approach. In the paper, the primary objects required for supply network simulations are defined. The static relationships among these objects and dynamic order in which they interact with each other are also presented. Finally, a simple four-echelon supply network system is simulated to validate and illustrate the framework.

articleTitle: Incentive Mode of Information Sharing in Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Firstly, this paper discusses the value of the information sharing in supply chain, Then it sets up model of information sharing comprehensive benefit in supply chain. Finally, it analyzes incentive mode and corresponding strategy in order to promote the performance in the whole supply chain.

articleTitle: Complex Projects Organization Networking: Perspectives from Centrality, Centralization and Power
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In Social Network Analysis (SNA), the centrality and Centralization are key performancing indicators for measuring person's (organization's) position and power in a organizations. This paper focuses on connecting the organizational power with organizational relationship, and quantify the power by three major indictors including degree Centrality, betweenness centrality, and clossness centrality. Followed by the SNA algorithm, the 2010EXPO are further studied for a case to compare different types of power in traditional organizations and the complex ones. And the final conclusion comes out to show that the power belonged within the traditional organization structure and the project organization network are different, and the following style is more close to real practices.

articleTitle: Challenges and Solutions to China Communist Youth League's Construction of Hub-Type Social Organization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Organization of China Communist Youth League(hereafter refereed to as CCCYL) can better play the role of political bridge, business aggregation leader and intensive service management if built to be a hub-type social organization. This paper beginning from analysis of the political, organizational, talent advantages of CCYL in its construction of hub-type social organization, focuses on analysis of the existing problems of construction; explores the principles and solutions, useful methods and channels of construction in the new era background. It proposes that the important approaches of CCYL's construction of hub-type social organization are to improve the service ability of CCYL, better play the role of major carrier, well control four points: voluntary service, public welfare undertakings, starting a career and getting a job, growing up and becoming talent.

articleTitle: The Study of Improving China's Shipping Soft Power
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since the reform and opening up, China's shipping industry has been developing rapidly, with rigid targets reaching or approaching the world's top level. However, meanwhile, a variety of bottleneck effects gradually emerge, which are mainly in the area of soft power construction. For example, the shipping development lags behind the port development, shipping service industries behind the shipping development, and the development of Maritime research behind the development of shipping services. As the centre of world's cruise industry is progressively shifting to the Asia-Pacific region, the cruise economy has arose in China and developed well so far. In view of the status quo of China's developing shipping and cruise industry, this article builds up an innovative model of CHS three-force, probes deeply into the relationship between cruise industry and shipping industry, and puts forward suggestions on how to enhance the core competitiveness of China's shipping industry in the world as well as promote the scientific development of China's shipping industry.

articleTitle: Contributions and Constraints of Rural Household Biogas Construction Project in Northeast China: A Case Study of Gongzhuling County
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Household biogas is not only an important part of the development of rural new energy, but also an important aspect of sustainable development in China. This paper analyses the contributions and constraints of rural household biogas based on the sampling data in Gongzhuling County. The result shows that biogas construction can protect environment, improve the quality of farmers' lives. However, the cold fermentation temperature and incomplete technological service mainly restrict the implement of biogas project. Basing on the analysis above, the paper brings forward the relevant countermeasures and policy suggestions.

articleTitle: Analysis of an Energy-Efficiency Supervision and Diagnostic System to Improve Ground Source Heat Pump Air-Condition System Operation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper discusses an energy-efficiency supervision and diagnostic system (ESDS) to address the problem that the air-condition system do not perform as well as anticipated. The ESDS consists of a set of sensors, data acquisition system, data analysis and diagnostics system including a web-based remote access system that can be used to identify problems in operations. The operation state of a typical ground source heat pump system including indoor thermal environment, water transfer coefficients, heat pump and water pump efficiency was analyzed in detail. The results show that the air-condition system energy saving has great potential. The ESDS are meaningful for building efficiency retrofit and management.

articleTitle: Integrative GIS of Public Service Information Platform for Low Carbon City
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, the integration of GIS (Geographic Information System) into Location Allocation Model (LA), cellular automata (CA), knowledge-based system (KBS) is proposed to plan low-carbon city from the distribution of industrial reconstruction , public facilities and other multi-levels, and then E-government on public service information platform is discussed .

articleTitle: Green Public Procurement in China: Current Practices, Barriers and Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the world pays close attention to the environmental protection, exploitation and utilization of resources, the green public procurement (GPP) has been explored and practiced in some developed countries in order to promote the enterprise's cleaner production. This paper first addresses the current practices of the GPP in China, then discusses the barriers of carrying out the GPP from the legislation, tools and environmental ideas. Finally, the paper presents some suggestions on promoting the implementation of GPP in China. Data were derived primarily from an analysis of secondary sources (i.e. previously published newspapers).

articleTitle: Construction and Analysis of Promotion Strategies and Appraisal Model on Enterprise Quality Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Increasingly price competition has transformed into quality competition and quality gets more and more attention from customers and enterprises. Based on Quality Competitiveness Index proposed by General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine of People Republic of China (QSIPRC) and National Bureau of Statistic of China, a plural appraisal model of enterprise quality competitiveness is presented. Enterprise quality competitiveness is represented by two unobserved (latent) variables, namely the quality level (QL) and the quality strength (QS) which comprised by a number of constructs both. In order to promote enterprise quality competitiveness effectively, based on the appraisal model, all possible kinds of enterprise quality competitiveness levels are explained by different formulas or points on different arcs proposed, a promotion strategy guidance model is constructed and five promotion strategies are analyzed. Finally, some insufficiencies are proposed because of some restricts.

articleTitle: The Diffusion and Context of e-Commerce and e-Procurement: Some Corporate Findings
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: More than 80% of Fortune 1000 has adopted e-procurement and e-Sourcing technologies according to Abeerdeen Group. Focus has been on integration and automation of the extended sourcing lifecycle. The technology associated with Internet has increased the possibilities to do e-business, e-commerce, and e-procurement. [1] This paper describes and discusses the evolution and created benefits at Ericsson, the Swedish telecom company. A proposed new approach to discuss the procurement context, based on what to buy and how to do it, is also presented together with Swedish government cases. Tools in the presented cases have had a great effect on e-business and e-procurement processes and a lot of benefits have been created.

articleTitle: An Automatic Virtual Organization Structure Modeling Method in Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In supply chain management system there are a large number of event logs recording the performers who initiate or complete the activities. Virtual organization structure is so flexible as to be more suitable for supply chain management. However the existing organizational structure modeling methods are difficult to model virtual structure. This paper design an automatic modeling method of virtual organization structure based on event logs from SCMS. Firstly, six kinds of performer relations are analyzed, i.e. PR1-PR6; Secondly, Five kinds of modeling rules are designed, i.e. MR1-MR5; At last, an actual case are given to verify feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Application of Management Game Theory to the Practice of Human Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the process of human resource management, only scientific management and handling different sorts of problems can provide powerful guarantee for the business benefits. The author analyses the feasibility of applying the management game theory to the human resource management, and the problems in applying the management game theory to sports team management, and studies the methods of scientifically managing the human resource. So it can be taken as a theoretical guide to the scientific human resource management.

articleTitle: Investment Evaluation of Intelligent Residential Communities Using Value Engineering in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The investment in Intelligent Residential Communities (IRC) has become one of the current highlights in the construction industry in China. The most important task that faces real estate developers and owners during investment decision-making is how to select a design option that would optimize the value of IRCs within a limited budget. In order to tackle this task, using Value Engineering (VE), this paper develops a value function combining the simple arithmetic method and life cycle cost (LCC) analysis to calculate value parameter and measure how well a particular IRC alternative achieves the requirements taking into account its overall cost. The proposed approach helps owners and developers identify the final value of IRCs so as to optimize decision and support evaluation.

articleTitle: Effect of Soil and Water Loss on Water Eutrophication in Xiaojiang River Basin in Three Gorges Reservoir Region
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Soil and water loss is an important source of water eutrophication. In this study, soil erosion were measured in the four types of cultivated lands (Paddy land, Terraced farmland, Sloping farmlands <; 25°, and Sloping farmlands ≥ 25°) in Xiaojiang River basin, Chongqing of China. In addition, water qualities were investigated in 5 reaches of Xiaojiang River (Qukou, Yanglu, Gaoyang, Huangshi, and Shuangjiang) at various times (April, June, July, and November) in 2008. The results showed that (1) Soil and water loss was mainly result from sloping farmlands in Xiaojiang River Basin; (2) Soil and water loss made major contribution to eutrophication in Xiaojiang River. In the study area, the annual losses of TN and TP through soil and water loss from farmlands accounted for 45.7 % and 40.2% of the total TN and TP import of Xiaojiang, respectively; (3) TN and TP concentrations in Xiaojiang River were seriously exceeded the criteria of eutrophication at the sampling times; (4) The phenomenon of “water blooming” occurred in June 2008, one month early when the peak TN concentrations occurred. This may be attributed to interaction of other environmental factors, such as suitable hydrological conditions, temperature and light radiation; (5) TN and TP concentrations in Xiaojiang River were mostly controlled by both soil and water loss and the Yangtze River. And TP concentrations showed obviously seasonal variations. Our study demonstrates that nutrients losses from farmland can be effectively controlled by appropriated management practices, such as the shift of the sloping farmlands to terraced farmlands, proper application of fertilizers, and so on.

articleTitle: A New Way of New Service Development Based on Service Customized Approach
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Competitive pressures are prompting a new-found aggressiveness that questions established service offering and calls for new ways of identifying and satisfying buyers' needs. Today's customers are demanding quality, style, and uniqueness over homogeneous products. Therefore, it's necessary to deploy new service development (NSD) based on service customization approach. However, it's still void in academic field. In order to fill this gap, a new way of NSD is proposed in this article based on service customized approach. First, we review literature on NSD and service customization. Next, we analyze the relationship among the service level and service customization in a period of time, as well as in the long run. Then, we come up with a new way of NSD. We propose that service firms should collect its customers' customized needs first. Also, through the method of cluster analysis, we open up a new thread to deploy NSD. Management implications and areas for further research are discussed.

articleTitle: Study on Risk Assessment and Monitoring of Process-Oriented Large-Scale Mining Shaft Construction Project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we have considered the risk management status of large-scale mining shaft construction project and analyzed the risk characteristics in large-scale mining shaft construction project. Then, combined with stages of mining shaft construction project preparation stage, the freezing stage, the drilling phase and final phase four stages, we set up large-scale mining shaft construction project risk identification and assessment procedures. Based on the work above, combined different types of risk, we proposed process-oriented dynamic monitoring and response measures for large-scale mining shaft construction project risk management in order to provide support and assistance for risk management in future.

articleTitle: Research on the Development of Urban Infrastructure in China Based on Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the gradually deepened of China's economic and social development, the level of China's urban public infrastructure has been significantly increased. This article discusses the unbalanced nature of the development of urban infrastructure among the various provinces of China, based on the analysis of the current status of China's urban infrastructure development, using cluster analysis methods. Then the trend of unbalanced development about the China's urban infrastructure is discussed using years of data. At the end, corresponding policy recommendations are put forward, aimed at providing some references in construction of urban facilities in regions and providing a scientific basis for a reasonable quantification to country's macro-urban development strategy.

articleTitle: Triple Play: Development Trends and Business Strategy in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: “Triple Play”, convergence of telecommunication networks, Internet and the broadcasting media, in the developed countries has been achieved to a greater extent as compared to the developing nations. It has played an important role for the economic surge and the social progress. In China, it has delayed due to some policy constraints but finally, has started now. Triple Play is a multi-level synthesis of technical, business, marketing and regulatory agencies. Its development trend is the new Triple Play of telecommunications network, Internet and the media network. This brings the N networks convergence, this process is the U informatization process. In this paper, starting from the development route of Triple Play, we'll analyze and propose innovative strategies for Triple Play business in China.

articleTitle: Research of B2C E-Commerce Return Strategies Based on Return Price
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the relevant factors influencing returns of B2C e-commerce companies from the micro and macro levels and establishes function model of enterprise' profit and obtain the optimal mix of return price and return policy. Meanwhile, MATLAB software is utilized to conduct sensitivity analysis of relevant parameters and assists the development of companies' return strategies.

articleTitle: Penrose's Enterprise Growth Theory on China's Enterprise Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper uses the theory of deductive method to analyze the issues of Enterprise Development. First Penrose's Enterprise Growth Theory is briefly introduced and then an in-depth analysis of Penrose Effect is made. The theoretical expansion of Penrose Effect is also discussed. Finally inspirations brought by Penrose's Enterprise Growth Theory are summarized. Penrose Effect tells us that the fast-growing of the enterprise at one time is often accompanied by the slowing down of the enterprise growth during the next period. It is put forward in the paper that after a period of relatively slow growth stage, fast growth stage will arrive, which has supplemented the theory of Penrose Effect. Five inspirations have also been put forward on the development of Chinese enterprise growth: predicting scientifically the enterprise growth based on Penrose's Enterprise Growth Theory; creating diversified enterprise resource; concerning on the new resources of the enterprise; searching for the best point for resources replacement and utilizing diversification strategy with caution, which have offered the theoretical guidance for Chinese enterprises to develop rapidly.

articleTitle: The Analysis and Estimation on Risk Factors in Engineering Project Life-Cycle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years the engineering accidents, especially those occurred to large-scale public projects were paid more and more attention by engineers and even the normal public. The large-scale public projects involved such numbers of participants and complicated procedures, which challenge to the traditional project security management. There is should be anew method to do with the modern engineering's risk manage requirement. This article summarized the risk factors in all the engineering process as the risk theoretical research foundation. In this paper, considering the disadvantages of disseverment and isolation each engineering process stages of traditional engineering risk management method, the idea of project's life-cycle method is introduced in the risk analysis for improvement the traditional disadvantage. This article also shows how to determine the risk sources and the risk liability by analyzed the stages' risk possibility of project life-cycle. These works will help to build up an analysis basement for engineering risk control research.

articleTitle: The Application of QFD Based on DEA to Improve the TPL Quality of Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of the global economy, the quality of third party logistics becomes a hot topic of all fields of society. In order to improve the TPL Quality of Service, a new method to rate the engineering characteristics in house of quality of product planning is applied into the paper, in which the house of quality on the TPL Quality of Service is established about the environment and cost. In the method based on fuzzy data envelopment analysis, each engineering characteristic is considered to be a decision making unit, the relationships between the engineering characteristic and all the customer needs are regarded as output factors. While effect on the environment and cost are regarded as input factors, the importance of the engineering characteristic is determined by the efficiency score. At last, key factor is gained to improve their quality of service.

articleTitle: The Research of Business Intelligence CIMS System Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The intelligent CIMS system is a new integrated system model of intelligence production. It organically coordinates intelligent activities and intelligent equipments throughout the design, development and implementation of the whole CIMS project, and thus integrates in a flexible way the entire enterprise manufacturing processes from raw material acquisition, ordering, product quality assurance, and production to marketing and so on to improve the overall efficiency. This article studies the enterprise intelligent CIMS system model, and proposes that the enterprise CIMS intelligent system is not an independent system parallel to application projects, but it is attached to the production units, scattered and incorporated in the components of various production units for achieving their objectives and tasks. In the information organization and structure of the system, not only is the database used, but also the knowledge base is introduced. It can effectively help decision-making managers fully analyze and synthesize existing control and management data and knowledge, make more comprehensive judgments in the management of production scheduling and control, and thus the enterprise productivity is improved.

articleTitle: Sustainable Development Strategy of Sub-Center Cities in Hubei under the Energy and Pollution Constraint
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper first describes the development of energy-saving and production reduction status on the four aspects, in Yichang City. It has done a considerable work on energy saving and emission reduction in Yichang City while it also remains some serious problems due to irrational industrial structure, the unreasonable working mechanisms and the pressure of energy-saving and emission reduction from growing industries. This paper put forward concrete proposals and measures to resolve these problems.

articleTitle: Knowledge Management for SMEs Based on the Balanced Scorecard
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Compared with large enterprises, SMEs as an important force in the national economy also need knowledge management (KM). In this paper, in the process of the implementation of KM for SMEs, we introduce the Balanced Scorecard (BSC) as a tool, and implement the KM under the guidance of the BSC framework. The functions of the BSC on the KM are mainly: to decompose the objectives of KM, to guide the process of KM, to measure the performance of KM, and the article discusses mainly from the three aspects.

articleTitle: The Research on Personal Internet Banking Service Quality and Customer Loyalty Based on Complaints Handling
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The research focuses on the relationship among the factors of service quality, customer satisfaction and customer loyalty. Considering the fact that the manner of handling complaints of banks might influence the loyalty of customers who had these complaints, the research attempts to put complaint handling in the customer loyalty model and learn its impact. Based on literature review, we propose the preliminary concept model and hypothesis, then use SPSS data software to analyse the recovery samples from factor analysis, correlation analysis and regression analysis, and finally amend the previous model based on the findings and make recommendations.

articleTitle: Analysis on Volatile Organic Compounds of Artocarpus lingnanensis for Urban Environmental Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The benzene/alcohol extractives from Artocarpus lingnanensis Leavies have inhibitory effects on bamboo moulds. However Artocarpus lingnanensis leavies are still underutilized and hence wasted. In order to better utilize Artocarpus lingnanensis leavies resources, the biomedicine resource of benzene/alcohol extractives from Artocarpus lingnanensis Leavies were analyzed by GC/MS. Relative content of each component was determined by area normalization. The main ingredients of benzene/alcohol extractives of Artocarpus lingnanensis Leavies were toluene, 3-methylmannoside, 10-nonadecanol, ethyl .alpha.-d-glucopyranoside, 1-naphthalenamine, n-phenyl-, nordextromethorphan, 1-butanol, 4-butoxy-, phenol, 2-(1-phenylethyl)-, spiro[3-cyclohexene-1,2'-[2h]furo[3,2-f][1]benzopyran]-2,5-dione, 1',7'-dihydro-3,4,4',5',7',7'-hexamethyl-1'-(2-methylpropenyl)-, 1,4-benzenediol, 2-methyl-, 4-((1e)-3-hydroxy-1-propenyl)-2-me thoxyphenol, phenol, 2,4-bis(1-phenylethyl)-, d-glycero-d-galacto-heptose, phenol, 2,4-bis(1-phenylethyl)-, methyl-(2-hydoxy-3-ethoxy-benzyl)e ther, benzenepropanol, etc. The results obtained fully indicated that the benzene/alcohol extractives of Artocarpus lingnanensis Leavies had the great potential usements.

articleTitle: Using Parametric Modeling to Improve the Equipment Systems Coordination Process for Buildings
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The coordination of equipment systems has become a major challenge for building contractors. Specialty design firms and trade contractors, working independently, provide these systems. For the past several years the equipment systems coordination has involved sequentially comparing and overlaying drawings from multiple trades, in which representatives from each equipment trade work together to detect, and eliminate spatial and functional interferences between equipment Systems. This multi-discipline effort is time-consuming and expensive. With the recent development of Building Parametric Modeling(BPM)this process is now able to evolve with the software technology. Using examples from several case studies, this paper demonstrates how BPM can improve the Equipment Systems coordination process in buildings. The results of this research provide a foundation for a revised work process utilizing modeling software and information technology.

articleTitle: The Design of Remote Update System Based on GPRS Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The thesis analyzes and designs a remote update system based on GPRS technology. It mainly describes the application of GPRS technology in this system, the program structure in SCM (Single Chip Microcomputer), the subdivision of Flash code space and the design of communication protocol and system security. And it also briefly presents the specific achievement of the remote update system. The program framework of SCM in this system has a strong generability, which is applicable to a variety of data sources.

articleTitle: A Study on G2C ODR in E-Government
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Although ODR has almost been exclusively with reference to the private sector and business disputes in e-commerce, it can be useful in public sector and e-government arena. In this regard, governments have made some very preliminary attempts, so it is necessary for governments to further explore the potential for ODR as a public good rather than cordoning its use in the private sector. Many principles that have been developed in the private sector ODR context can be applied to the public sector process, but G2C ODR' special features should also be considered.

articleTitle: A Research on the Strategic Performance Management Systems from the Perspective of Core Competencies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: High performance is the goal that all companies hope to attain. And the strategic performance management systems are the basic safeguard for a company to get high performance. From the Perspective of Core Competencies, this paper has built a Hierarchical model of the strategic performance management systems for companies, and reviewed entirely the relationship between the strategic performance management systems and core competencies, the agreement between core competencies and performance culture, the agreement between performance culture and the implementation of performance management, and the harmonious relationship in the performance management process.

articleTitle: Analysis on Value Chain Model of the Media Business Based on Digital Asset Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Digital assets are strategic resources to provide content service and market competition for media organizations, and it is of important significance to set up management and operation model based on the value increment of digital assets. This paper first puts forward the value chain model of the media business based on digital asset management. It then sets forth key resource and core business process of the media. It also discusses a kind of basic idea to set up the value evaluation system and evaluation method. Finally, it analyzes the price strategy of the content products based on the development of digital assets.

articleTitle: Study on College Teachers' Performance Appraisal Based on VE
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the main resources for the development of universities, job performance of College teachers directly affect the development level of universities teaching and research, but their influencing factors of college teacher performance are numerous, certain, uncertain and fuzzy. Therefore, it is particularly important to establish a scientific and reasonable comprehensive evaluation model of college teacher performance for the development of universities in the new situation. In this paper, Value Engineering (VE) is introduced, on which basis new evaluation index systems of college teacher performance are worked out, and then AHP-multistage fuzzy comprehensive appraisal method is adopted to analyze them, in order to get the comprehensive and objective evaluation conclusion and provide a basis for actual performance management.

articleTitle: Research on Logistics Business Outsourcing and Logistics Service Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The increasing of competition press makes many companies to outsource logistics business for reducing cost and improving logistics performance. But currently, most logistics services (called logistics product in this paper) do not break traditional physical distribute business model and do not explore more potential logistics value, so they can't meet the demand of manufacturers in raising service satisfaction, supporting the business strategy and increasing their flexibility of manufacture. Logistics providers are facing the great challenge in logistics service innovation. This paper brings forward methods of logistics service innovation based on value propositions of customers. The methods can help logistics providers to find the value innovation points to match the value propositions of manufacturers and to conduct effective logistics innovation. This paper also shows logistics business outsourcing decision tools to help manufacturers to choose the suitable outsourcing mode and the excellent logistics provider.

articleTitle: Innovation Ability Evaluation Research Based on GIOWA Operator
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Technological innovation capability assessment is an important management tool. As the complexity of the process of technological innovation capability at home and abroad which lead how to measure technological innovation has no uniform standard. Considering the complexity of technological innovation capability and some shortcomings of the current evaluation methods this paper designs an evaluation index system which includes three abilities: finance external stakeholder, internal operating level, basic level, and set up a new model for Technological innovation capability evaluation based on GIOWA operator. At last, a case study is provided to verify the model. The research findings offer a workable approach in evaluating Technological innovation capability.

articleTitle: Housing Price Spatial Diffusion within Urban Region: A Case of Wuhan
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper investigates the housing price spatial diffusion within Wuhan city by using the quarterly data over the period 2001Q1 to 2009Q1. The Cointegration Test, Granger Causality Test and Generalized Impulse Response Function were employed. The results show that spatial interactions of urban region housing price take place. In the north of Yangtze River, the housing price of "core district" Jiangan has a significant influence on the Jianghan district, and then diffuse to the external districts. In the south of Yangtze River, the housing price of "core district" Wuchang works upon the external districts Hongshan, Qingshan. From the overall perspective of the city, the housing price of Jiangan, the "core district" in the north of Yangtze River, plays an promoting role in housing price of "core district" Wuchang, the "core district" in the south of Yangtze River.

articleTitle: Competence Exploration and Exploitation and Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Product innovation is critical for firms to sustain their competitive advantages, and firms need to exploit existing competencies and explore new ones to accomplish innovations successfully. As a result, both competence exploration and competence exploitation play significant roles on the innovations. However, as to the impacts of competence exploration and exploitation on innovation, there are conflicting views. This study provides a more nuanced and in-depth analysis on these relationships that the relationship between competence exploration and radical innovation is positive, and that between competence exploration and incremental innovation is inverse U shaped; in addition, there is a positive relationship between competence exploitation and incremental innovation and an inverse U shaped relationship between competence exploitation and radical innovation.

articleTitle: Implementing Constructivism Experimental Web-Based Learning Model on <<Business Negotiation>> Class
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Constructivism Experimental Web-Based Learning model is an important constructive learning model that efficiently collaborate latest multi-media, on-line technology and also emphasis the importance of educator's instruction. This theory views student as proactive learning constructor and teacher's role is collecting, organizing external information, guiding student to explore, interact with designed environment and having student learn from it. This paper describes the implementation of constructivism Web-based leaning model on "business negotiation" class. Through special designed learning environment, student can learn the fundamental knowledge through playing different role in different business negotiation session, apply knowledge to real practice, develop proactive learning skills and enhance creativity and team collaboration.

articleTitle: Media Selection of Artificial Soil Filtration System for Stormwater Runoff Treatment in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Filter media is the most pivotal element of artificial soil filtration system and directly impact the reduction of contaminants in runoff. Four typical filtration materials including sand soil, boiler slag, furnace cinder and ceramsite are selected and studied in laboratory scale in Beijing. The experiment is carried by two stages. One is selection of filtration media. Firstly, different materials' physical properties such as the percentage of moisture, apparent density and permeability coefficient are studied in the stage. Then their removal effects for pollutions are researched under static and dynamic conditions in turn. Results show that although ceramsite has the highest permeability coefficient and percentage of moisture, it couldn't remove the pollutants by adsorption and it wouldn't be solely used as filtration media for its low apparent density. Sand soil had the lowest permeability coefficient and the highest apparent density. It could hardly remove pollutants by adsorption. Apparent density and permeability coefficient of furnace cinder are close to boiler slag, but while its percentage of moisture is much higher than that of boiler slag. Both boiler slag and furnace cinder all could remove pollutants effectively in dynamic condition. Based on the first experimental results, boiler slag is selected as filtration media of faculty and its removal effects for various pollutants are further studied under dynamic condition in the second stage. The removal rates of the faculty for CODcr, turbidity and total nitrogen are 50%~70%, 50%~85% and 40%~60% respectively.

articleTitle: Service Efficiency Analysis of Chinese International Airports
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Service efficiency is gaining significant attention in both academic and practical circles. This study evaluates the efficiencies of 30 Chinese international airports since the localization reform. Using DEA, we draw the conclusions that most of the operations are invalid. Various characteristics are related to an airport's efficiency. We also extend to identify the inefficient airports and propose the optimal path. Results are used to extract some policy considerations to deepen the reforms of airports.

articleTitle: The School-Enterprise Cooperating Innovation and Industrial Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the contribution of school-enterprise cooperating innovation to the competitiveness of enterprises and colleges, and then demonstrates the necessity and inevitability of school-enterprise cooperating innovation indirectly. Through the related analysis of school-enterprise cooperation and industrial competitiveness, it can be find that school-enterprise cooperation and the associated five indicators are the main factors affecting the industrial competitiveness. Finally through the analysis of the coupling effects, the paper comes to the conclusion: The improvement of the school-enterprise cooperation can remote our country's industrial competitiveness effectively.

articleTitle: The Application of AHP and Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation for Appraising the Dry Port's Development Potential Level
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the analysis on dimensional structure and development pattern of dry port, this paper chooses seven factors to construct the evaluation indexes of appraising the dry port's development potential level. Using the analytic hierarchy processing method (AHP) and a Multi-level fuzzy comprehensive, it takes the Quanzhou-Jinjiang dry port as a case study. Thus, the application of AHP-Fuzzy to Quanzhou-Jinjiang dry ports proves that this method is practicable and feasible, for it helps to reduce the lopsided influence of subjective factors in such evaluations, particularly compared to the experience estimation systems.

articleTitle: Clarifying the Conceptualization and Measurement of Entrepreneurial Orientation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Entrepreneurial orientation (EO) is an emerging research area across the field of entrepreneurship and strategic management. On the leading edge of EO research are issues of conceptualization and measurement. This paper clarifies the EO conceptualization from two debates among current EO scholars. One is debate on whether EO should discuss from the perspective of individual-level or from firm-level, the other is debate on whether EO dimensions are independent with each other or not. Then the measurement of EO is discussed, three measurement approaches are introduced and the development of EO scale is classified and analyzed. Future research directions are also suggested.

articleTitle: Research on Business Platform Software Product Development Process Based on Knowledge Integration--Neusoft Business Platform Software Product UniEAP for Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Infrastructure software platform is not only the upstream and high ground of the software industry, but also the soft underbelly of China's software industry. Infrastructure software has a strong effect of driving the development of downstream application software and application systems. As a technological catching-up country, China has to research and develop its own infrastructure software platform conforming to its real technological standard as soon as possible. For all these reasons, case study on local infrastructure software platform becomes essential. This paper analyses and summarizes knowledge integration path and methods of the software development through a case of the Neusoft Business platform - Software Product UniEAP.

articleTitle: Sustainable Development Research on the Relative Carrying Capacity of Resources in Liaoning Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper adopts research methods of relative carrying capacity of resources, it regards Liaoning province as a research area and the whole country as a reference. The relative carrying capacity of nature resources, the relative carrying capacity of economic resources and synthetic carrying capacity of resources of Liaoning province from 1999 to 2008 have been calculated. This thesis draws from existing research and improves the computing process. Previous researches merely concentrate on land/water resources, this paper selects four natural resources as objects, so the result would be more accurate. Then we can conclude that: (1) synthetic carrying capacity of resources of Liaoning province from 1999 to 2008 has been in redundant state. (2) The carrying capacity of water resources is lower because Liaoning Province is lack of water. (3)The carrying capacity of economic resources is significantly higher than natural resources, which is the principal resources to support population. It is of significance of guidance to find their regularity through the study of Liaoning province, so that it can provide the theory basis for decision making of sustainable development.

articleTitle: Research on the Improvement Route of Customer Satisfaction Based on the Method of Customer Satisfaction Matrix Graph
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to direct organizations to implement customer satisfaction improvement effectively, and to help enterprises out of the "customer satisfaction cycle" and " customer satisfaction trap", and then improve the relations with customers continuously, this paper defines the common misunderstandings of customer satisfaction improvement and its reasons, and designs the method of priority improvement rules, measuring and evaluating customer satisfaction index based on the customer satisfaction matrix graph. Trough defining the objects of improvement and its improvement extent with the customer satisfaction matrix graph and customer satisfaction matrix, the prior improvement route can be configured.

articleTitle: Investment and Project Value in Oil Field Development Using Real Option Pricing with Mean-Reversion with Jumps
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The oilfield development is a high-risk venture and requires the largest outlay which is not Irreversible. This paper proposes a new model, based on Real Option Pricing with Mean-Reverting jump, to find an optimal decision rule for alternatives of investment regarding the development of an oil field under market uncertainty. The objective of this new model is to help decision-making in the following situation: appropriate biding for an oil field development, the optimal investment timing and the optimal transfer value of the oilfield if the investment opportunity to develop the field is not attractive. The uncertainty of oil prices is modeled as a mix jump-diffusion process. Normal information generates continuous mean-reverting process for oil prices, whereas random abnormal information generates discrete jumps of random size. Comparisons are performed with the Mean-Reversion Process and also the quantification and analysis of alternative timing policies for the petroleum sector.

articleTitle: Promote the Employment: From the Corporate Social Responsibility View
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Employment has a vital bearing on people's livelihoods. It is the fundamental prerequisite and basic approach for people to improve their lives. Corporate social responsibility (CSR) is seen to extend beyond the statutory obligation to comply with legislation and sees organizations voluntarily taking further steps to improve the quality of life for employees and their families as well as for the local community and society at large. Corporate social responsibility has positive function in promoting employment, protecting staff's rights and interests, and promoting staffs training etc. So the Corporate social responsibility should be implemented in the concrete practice of human resources management for promoting employment.

articleTitle: Interactive Rules on Supply and Demand Actions of Knowledge Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Few studies have paid any attention to the analysis of interaction between the subjects of knowledge supply chain, this paper studied subjects, characteristics, conceptual model of knowledge supply chain from the angle of supply chain management. Industry, university and government are considered to be subsystems of the main social system, and innovative achievements, enterprises profit and policies supporting intensity had been viewed as level variables of these three subsystems. System dynamics model of knowledge supply chain had been constructed using the method of simplified rate variable fundamental In-tree model. The problems of knowledge transmission, interaction and innovation mechanism between subsystems had been researched into, and the fields that the results in this research could be applied to had been summarized finally.

articleTitle: A Trust Based Solution for E-Business
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This electronic Some fraudulent register user could destroy the internet transaction environment in e-business. In this paper we could identify malicious user by trust mechanism based on reputation to calculate user's confidence. This availability of such a mechanism depends on the method of calculating confidence, the accurate of confidence mechanism and its anti-attack ablity. Reputation: the user's local reputation gave by the other user is calculated by the other users' evaluation to his transaction behavior.The user's global reputation is got by his all transaction partners' evaluation on him.We could solve the local reputation and global reputation 's accurate calculation through introduce the confidence factor which could impact confidence. And it also could promote the trust mechanism 's anti-attack capacity. We proposed a quality model by users' evaluation to determine users' evaluation's authenticity. The method to compute users' evaluation credibility is also given. In the progress of calculating confidence, we use confidence factor to synthesize global reputation and local reputation .And the method for choosing confidence is also raised.

articleTitle: Research on Trust Mechanism of Partners in Supply Chain of Agricultural Products
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, the cooperation relation among organizations of agricultural producers and production operators in China, between the both is decentralized. They have less communication and lower degree of trust because of decentralized management of a large number of peasant households which pursue the utility maximization.
