articleTitle: Three Dimension Model of China Defense Industrial Organization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The defense industry is a national strategic industry. With the development of China market economic system and the economic globalization, organization reform of defense industry is inevitable in China. This paper firstly analyzes the characteristics of China defense industry; then puts forward three dimensions of China's defense industrial organization, including industrial competitiveness, defense support and the macro-environment. At last the re-integration of the aviation industry has been taken as an example to demonstrate the three dimensions of China's defense industrial organization.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Structural Explanation of Knowledge-Based Corporate Strategy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Development and Research of Virtual Design Platform of Steel Wheel Series Products
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Taking steel wheel series products as prototype, this virtual design platform integrates the functions of rapid design, finite element analysis, and test detection. Practice shows that this platform could shorten design cycle, improve design quality, reduce production cost and enhance enterprise competence. The method of developing this platform could also be used by deign of other automobile parts and components industries.

articleTitle: The Research on the Constituent System of Growth Competence of Independent Intellectual Property Famous Brand -Based on Brand Competitiveness Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A number of manufacturing enterprises are locked into low-end value chain, facing shutdown or even collapse, especially affected by the current outbreak of financial crisis. However, many famous enterprises, relying on independent intellectual property, can turn adversity into opportunity, and thus obtain a lasting competitive advantage. As a result, many companies turn into cultivate independent intellectual property famous brand, in order to support the enterprise reap the core competitiveness in the market. This paper, taking enterprise growth theory as guidance and brand competitiveness theory as basis, defines the growth concept of Independent intellectual property famous brand, builds the concept model of growth competence of Independent intellectual property famous brand; seeks the key factors of growth competence of Intellectual property famous brand by making using of factor analysis, and analyzes the internal structure relationship of growth competence, aiming at helping enterprise to grasp inherent growth law of intellectual property famous brand and make effective operation decision.

articleTitle: Convergence or Divergence? China's Land Rents, Transport Cost and Its Industrial Agglomeration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper constructs a general spatial economic model integrating land rent and transport cost according to the actualities of industrial aggregation and relocation of China. Then it uses numerical simulation to gauge the significance of the model. We found that the level of rents and wages were decisive factors in the model while the effect of transportation was in two-ways. Applying this proposition it also explains the features of industrial agglomeration and transfer in the southeast coast of China and makes some comments on the effects of industry policies and logistics.

articleTitle: Research on the Problem and Countermeasure for the Development of the Service Industry in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China's services industry has experienced an extraordinary development accompanied with the rapid development of China's economy since the reform and opening up policy in 1978. The service industry becomes important drivers of economic growth and becomes the important department to absorb the workers in China. At the same time, there are still certain problems for the service industry in China at this stage such as the proportion of total economic output is not high, a lower proportion of the employed population, regional development imbalances and other issues. In order to promote rapid and stable development of the service industry in China, we must promote the market-oriented reform, speed up the internal industrial structure adjustment and realize the importance of scientific and technological progress on raise production efficiency.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Three Dimensionalities and the Management of Two-Oriented Society
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Assessment Index System of Program Management Capability Based on Organizational Project Management Maturity Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since program management provides a means to bridge the gap between project delivery and organizational strategy, the assessment of program management capability becomes more and more important. This paper is to construct an assessment index system of it based on Organizational Project Management Maturity Model. It begins by synthesizing the perceptions that surround program management; a preliminary assessment index system is then presented. After that, we carry out a survey in order to find out the disadvantages of the system, and to modify it, finally, come to the final assessment index system. At last, conclusions are presented.

articleTitle: The Standardization of Online Public Relations Is Imperative
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The existing problems of online public relations industry have seriously affected the healthy development of the industry; therefore the industry standardization is imperative. Firstly, we review the fact that public relations were obstructed during its development in the mid and late 1990s in China, from which we could draw a lesson. Secondly, we analyze the construction of PR industry's standards and occupational ethics. Thirdly, we summarize the impacts of internet on PR and the main performances of manipulating public opinions by online PR. Finally, we propose suggestions on the standardization of online PR from the following aspects: legislative, moral bottom line, industry self-regulation and the establishment and improvement of industry standards.

articleTitle: An Information Flow Based Approach to Schema Transformations for Information Systems Integration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In information systems integration, whether the instances of a schema of an information system may be recovered from those of another is a question, which seems profound, and yet has not been well investigated. We shed some light on it by using the notion of information carrying relation. In the literature, a conditional probability based approach has been proposed to finding such a relation within a schema transformation setting. To solve the problem of this approach that inter-schemata constraints might not be given in advance, this paper proposes another information flow based approach. Based upon a derivation of information flow constraints, this approach helps us find information carrying relations between conceptual constructs of two schemata.

articleTitle: Study on Demand Forecasting of Enterprise Management Human Resources Based on MRA-OLS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The role of human resources is becoming more and more important in enterprise development, management human resources is very important and sensitive. Human resource strategic management and strategic enterprise management are consistent, human resource demand forecast is very important in long-term development of enterprise. In this paper, we introduced multiple regression analysis to study on demand forecast of enterprise management human resources based on the characteristics of human resources demand and combined with enterprise strategic management theory, which will coupling the theory and practice in empirical.

articleTitle: The Effect of Service Fairness on Service Quality, Customer Satisfaction and Customer Loyalty
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We study the effect of service fairness on service quality, customer satisfaction and customer loyalty. An Structural Equation Modeling analysis was conducted on the hospital industry. The results show that procedural justice and interactional justice obviously effect customer perceived service quality positively. Moreover, the results show that procedural justice, interactional justice and distribute justice all effect customer satisfaction and customer loyalty directly or indirectly. Based on the results, this study explains the practical and academic implications for service fairness.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An Initial Study on Mechanism Construction of Visitor Environmental Education in Ecotourism--A Perspective of China Mainland
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Emotional and Satisfactory Research of Grouping Consumers in Service Recovery Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The industrial service failure is sometimes inevitable and the effective way to re-win customers is through a successful service recovery. Compared with the individual service failure, the group service failure is more complex, thus the loss brought to the service enterprises is more serious. Meanwhile, the implementation of a reasonable remediation strategy and the restoration of community satisfaction will become more difficult. In this article, the service recovery model based on the grouping service failure was established. The proposed model conducts four kinds of experimental designs according to the attribution of responsibility in a service failure. By using the scenario simulation method, the 434 valid questionnaires were analyzed by using the SPSS method and the influence of symbolic compensation and leader persuasion to the recovery satisfactory degree is investigated. The experiment verifies that there is a great influence of symbolic compensation and persuasion to the emotion and satisfaction degree of grouping consumers. It is also proved that the positive emotion after recovery is in positive correlation with the group satisfaction and behavior; the negative emotion after recovery is in negative correlation with the group satisfaction and behavior.

articleTitle: Urban Traffic Mode Structure Optimization Based on Eco-Transportation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Urban eco-transportation system is the development direction of urban transportation system; urban traffic mode structure is an all-important factor that affects the realization of it. Despite a voluminous empirical research of traffic mode structure, most of them have failed to adequately consider the ecology problem. On the basis of satisfying all requirements of eco-transportation system, and according to the common problems such as traffic jam, serious traffic pollution, low efficiency of utilizing resources, this paper first proposes the idea of traffic mode structure optimization, it combines optimization with traffic planning; secondly, it analyzes the main objectives and constrains; finally, it establishes an fuzzy programming model of traffic mode optimization as a result of the uncertainty of transportation system in the future.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Entrepreneurial Competency of Rural Migrant Workers on Willingness
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the iceberg model the entrepreneurial competency of rural migrant workers in this paper is divided into two parts: entrepreneurial quality of the upper part and entrepreneurial skill of the lower part. The upper part contains knowledge, skill and human relations, while the lower part includes competencies like opportunity utilization, resource utilization, commercial opportunity seizing, risk bearing and innovation. A model of entrepreneurial competency of rural migrant workers is designed, and a descriptive analysis on their entrepreneurial competency is conducted. The result shows that human relations, opportunity utilization and innovation have distinctive impetus on rural migrants' willingness. In view of this, some policy recommendations are given to improve the entrepreneurial competency of rural migrant workers and develop rural human resources.

articleTitle: The Impact of Logistics Mode on Retailer's Logistics Performance Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The improvement of logistics performance will improve the retailer's capability of quick response to the market changes, and impact the organization performance positively. However, if something could not be measured, it could not be managed, and could not be improved also. Based on defining the conceptual framework of logistics mode, this paper analyzes the impact of it on logistics performance measurement system.

articleTitle: The Job Satisfaction of Volunteers in Harbin Winter Universiade: A Factor Analytic Study
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper aims to find the factors influencing the job satisfaction of volunteers in Harbin Winter Universiade and measure the relationship among these factors. This study selects the volunteers working for this racing as the sample to make factor analysis and confirm 5 factors. A SEM (Structural Equation Model) is set up, which connects recruitment and selection, training, motivation, and interpersonal relation to the job satisfaction. The results indicate that these factors can effect the satisfaction for volunteers' job in varying degrees. This research is beneficial for Volunteers Services Management from the angle of Human Resource Management and supplies some inspiration to enhance the level of job satisfaction for other projects.

articleTitle: Application of Bayesian Network in Improving Customer Credit Precision
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to make CRM more effectively, we need to classify the customer and to realize the personalized service, so we can promote the customer satisfaction and the loyalty, analyze and appraisal the credit is an important step. In the traditional method, the customer credit evaluation precision is insufficient, which causes the enterprise into a dilemma situation. In view of this problem, this article proposed using data mining technology Bayesian network model increases the customer credit forecast precision. This method union prior knowledge and latter information, using the Bayesian network model to mine the credit concealed information, which realizes perfect forecast for the customer credit. The enterprises can use this forecasting result to complete the operating decisions, wins more customers for the enterprise, enhance competitive advantage.

articleTitle: The Research of Undertaking International Transfer of Service Industry and Promotion of Chinese Service Industry's Human Capital
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent year, along with the fast development of service industry, the function of undertaking international transfer of service industry to the promotion of human capital is appearing. This article first analyzes how the international transfer of service industry promotes Chinese service industry's human capital from theory angle, and then we further check the preamble theoretical analysis from empirical angle. The result indicates that undertaking international transfer of service industry can promote the development of Chinese service industry's human capital, and then we propose the related policy suggestion.

articleTitle: Study on Collaborative Workflow Process Modeling Based on the Extended Stochastic Petri Net
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to improve reusability of collaborative workflow process model, minify complexity of model, enhance to descriptive ability for dynamic workflow, and solve stochastic problem with priority, the extended stochastic Petri nets based on the classic stochastic Petri nets is proposed. Firstly, we give a formal description for extended stochastic Petri nets. And then, an instance is given to explain how to modeling and system implementation based on Exspect for a workflow process with priority. Finally, we draw some conclusions for this research.

articleTitle: Fair Valuation of Participating Life Insurance Contracts
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Fair valuation of the participating life insurance contracts (PLIC) is very important for life insurance companies. This paper applies stochastic discount factor model with specified exponential affine function form to value the contracts while taking the stochastic interest rate and assets structure into account. Compared with existed method, this new model performs better.

articleTitle: The Drivers Model of Customer Equity Based on the Service Profit Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With development of service profit chain theory, customers have been given unprecedented power. Customer relationship management is walking into a new stage: CEM stage. A trend is rising which emphasize upgrading CEM performance by the way of distinguishing high profitable customer, improving customer's loyalty and carrying on different management mode to different customers. The ability of CEM will become the important means of enterprises gaining competitive advantage. This paper, making perceived quality, customer emotions, brand image, customer loyalty as four-dimensional driving factors, studies driven model of customer equity based on service profit chain theory. On this basis, explore the formation of customer equity in the service profit chain and propose hypothesis, build drivers model between customer equity and driving factors.

articleTitle: Strategy of Coordination and Differential Price of the Closed-Loop Supply Chain under the Optimal Channel for Recycling
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The price strategy of closed-loop supply chain with product recycling between the manufacturer and retailer is studied under the optimal the channel for recycling. A model is established to find out the optimal reverse channel; the two price models are analyzed based on the optimal reverse channel to obtain the optimal pricing decisions and the optimal profit; a policy of sharing profit and coordination and differential pricing is presented. Under this coordination policy, the efficiency of decentralized closed-loop supply chain equals that of integrated closed-loop supply chain. Finally, the problem of recycling of waste camera is calculated.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Harmony between Manufacturing Structure and Environment in Changzhou
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The indicators that can measure the structure of manufacturing were put forward and the level of waste emission by manufacturing was carded. The harmony between the structure of manufacturing and waste emission in Changzhou were analyzed by using the coordinating measurement model of composite system. The result showed that the harmony is not high but it is becoming better. Some suggestions that can improve the harmony between the structure of manufacturing and environment were advanced.

articleTitle: Long-Term Performance in Service Economy: Multi-Methodology Comparison and Policy Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Long-terms performance in Service Economy is very crucial indicator for policy maker. Since the service economy has been playing a more important role in economic growth, it also raise up the request for evaluating service economy in different perspective, including long-term performance. We introduce HP filter, univariate and bivariate unobserved components model, a structural VAR model in this paper to estimate long-term performance for China's Service Economy as a whole. We concluded that long-term performance in China's service economy has been growing since the Reform began. Lately, it's also showing a steady trend in post-WTO period. Policies related to service economy should pay more attention to increase the competition of China's service economy in an international perspective.

articleTitle: Does Satisfaction Really Influence Loyalty? ----Based on Meta-Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the past decades, satisfaction dominant logic gained widely acceptance in both marketing practice and research because it is naturally believed to influence loyalty. However, can satisfaction really bring loyalty? Using meta-analytical method and based on 85 quantitative studies from 1980 to 2007, this research finds that although satisfaction affects composite loyalty, the effect of satisfaction on behavioral loyalty is not salient as that on attitudinal ones.

articleTitle: A Study of Project Bidding Decision Based on Analytical Hierarchy Process Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Bidding is a critical activity for most of contractors in face of intense competition. Thus, it is necessary to develop a practical bidding decision method. This paper presents a bidding decision model based on the analytical hierarchy process (AHP) method. As an illustration, a practical example of a construction company is cited, which demonstrates the application of this method and shows how this method can provide the decision makers with convincing and reliable results.

articleTitle: Research on Supply-Chain-Style Industrial Cluster's Competitive Advantage under the Perspective of Complex Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Industrial cluster network and supply chain network theory are applied to analyze connotation and characteristics of supply-chain-style industrial cluster. Supply-chain-style industrial cluster's network structure is discussed base on the complex network theory and its competitive advantages are identified from the aspects of production, innovation, anti-risk and so on. The research indicates that keeping network openness, cultivating and protecting network hubs are crucial for maintaining supply-chain-style industrial cluster competitive advantages.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of Some Urban Subway Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we present an investigation on the urban subway networks using various concepts of statistical physics of complex networks, and propose a model to understand the results obtained. We investigate some urban subway networks in China, which are the urban subway networks of Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou and Shenzhen. The empirical results show that all the urban subway networks have high clustering coefficient and small character path length, which exhibit small-world behavior, otherwise, these networks are organized by some motifs, which are all the globally coupled networks. In order to explain the results, we propose a model which is in good agreement with the empirical results.

articleTitle: The Overseas Investment VAR about Mineral Resources Based on GARCH Models
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We studied the risks of financial market in the international minerals market .This article, we take London copper and the exchange rate of RMB/USD for example, using GARCH models for measuring value at risk (VaR). At last, we use the Kupiec test as a back testing of VaR model. The purpose of this study wants to provide reference for the overseas investment of China enterprises.

articleTitle: The Design of Housing Maintenance Engineering System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In china, we can not be optimistic about the status of the property management system, housing maintenance and the funds we need currently. There exsits some problems. Although consumed much manpower and material resources in the past years, the problems in housing maintenance have not been solved. This paper gives the design of Housing Maintenance Engineering System (HMES) by concrete analysis and does the best to find some useful methods for the problems.

articleTitle: China's Labor Market Distortion and Excess Liquidity
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The excess liquidity is one major problem China faced today. This paper analyzes the effect of the labor market distortion on excess liquidity by establishing a simple AD-AS model and then uses the relevant data as empirical test. Results show that the imbalance of macro-economy brought by the labor market distortion is the main reason for China's excess liquidity. In a closed economy, labor market distortion results in shortage of domestic demand, speedy increasing of investment and excess production capability of enterprises and thus results in the internal imbalance; and further that, with the combination of internal imbalance and open economy environment, the export increases faster than the import, thus the trade surplus continues to expand; in China's current foreign exchange management system, the expand of trade surplus will inevitably lead to excess liquidity. So taking efficient measures to mitigate the labor market distortion is the key element to solve China's excess liquidity.

articleTitle: A Web-Based Joint-Distribution Platform to Reduce LTL Shipping of Urban Logistics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Joint-distribution can reduce the less-than-truck-load (LTL) shipping, so that it is important to metropolis, where individual logistic firms are usually small and can not obtain economies of scale. Unfortunately, most of existing web-platforms of common logistics can not play its pre-determined role of join-distribution because of lacking of the incentive mechanism and cost allocation mechanism among all players, including the all kinds of logistics firms and distributors. To address the problems, a new type of a web-based join-distribution platform is proposed in this paper. First, the framework of such a system is illustrated by multi-agent model. Second, two strategies based on game theory is devised to accomplish cost allocating scheme for all distributors. Furthermore, the system platform's procedure is discussed to improve its feasibility.

articleTitle: Open Library's New Service Tactics in the Era of Web2.0
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The advent of Web2.0 opens the new era of library service. What Web2.0 brings to the library is not only the improvement and promotion of service method, but also the transformation and innovation of service concept. However, the changes of service concept, content and method can not fundamentally guarantee the improvement of service quality. This paper newly examines , evaluates and ameliorates the traditional service from Web2.0's new point of view, discussing how to build the act of quality service for the library in the era of Web2.0.

articleTitle: Study on Community Participation of Rural Tourism Based on Property Rights Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is necessary for sustainable development of rural tourism to strengthen the community participation by virtue of home and abroad experience. Firstly, this paper reviews the application of property rights theory in tourism researches. And then, the existing problems in the course of community participation of rural tourism are analyzed, which includes the following four aspects: ambiguous property right subjects, obscure boundary, inaccurate value evaluation and imperfect administrative system. Based on property rights theory, four corresponding countermeasures are put forward in the end.

articleTitle: Risks in the Appraisal of Mortgaged Real Estate
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After more than ten years' development, Chinese real estate appraisal agencies have been developing so quickly. Of the total real estate appraisal business, the number of the mortgaged real estate appraisal business is more than half. However, because of all kinds of reasons, real estate appraisal agencies are faced with risks. This study explains the signification and classifications of risks in the appraisal of mortgaged real estate. At last, some proposals are put forward to prevent these risks.

articleTitle: Safety Assessment for Offshore Platforms Information System Based on ArcGIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper has done systematic analysis to safety of offshore platforms, indicators system of which has been established, we comprehensively study safety evaluation of offshore platforms with grey theory integrated method that using gray statistics method to establish evaluation matrix, determining the weight of related indexes with the gray connection analysis and carrying on the comprehensive judgement with the fuzzy method. Then We has developed the safety evaluation of offshore platforms information system with VB and GIS on base of this model to carry on the especial analysis and the demonstration with the region related information to make decision support more effective and efficient.

articleTitle: Oil Transportation Security Evaluation Based on Multi-Step Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Approach
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Chinese oil transportation security is evaluated based on the multi-step fuzzy comprehensive evaluation approach. The results show that Chinese oil transportation lines are in the optimal order: Kazaks tan-China, South America-China, Middle East-China, West Africa-China, and Russia-China. Finally some suggestions on Chinese regional cooperation are made to ensure oil transportation security.

articleTitle: Research on the Circular Management Mode of Municipal Domestic Solid Waste
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, the current status of Municipal Domestic Solid Waste (MDSW) in China was analyzed and discussed. Furthermore, management modes of MDSW in China and abroad were also investigated. Finally, the cyclic management mode of MDSW was carried out, which may accelerate the process of rubbish problem solving.

articleTitle: The Research on the Process Control of Project Progress System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Driven by the policy of the national construction projects, China's economy has been developing rapidly. In this situation, current construction projects have those features such as large engineering, complex structures, many construction links, long construction cycle, demanding technical quality, complex construction interface, and various influencing factors. In building construction, project investors and management only tend to attach importance to controlling investment and quality , while pay inadequate attention to the control of the construction project's progress. So many projects failed to complete within the specified time basing on a reasonable schedule, the project delays are quite serious, which causes the accumulation of funds , superfluous equipment and materials, waste of human resources. Base on the study of the current status of the control of China's large-scale construction projects' progress , this paper elaborates the principles of the systomatical management for construction project's progress , puts forward some measures for systematically managing construction project's progress, and gives some effective recommendations on construction project's control and systematical management.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Government Function in Industrial Cluster's Formation and Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The formation and development of industrial cluster have their own evolutionary laws, but the government function can not be neglected. Combining the characteristics of the industrial cluster's lifecycle in different stages, the government should give full play of the functions like support, coordination and guiding, it should also provide policy guarantee and environment support for the industrial cluster's development.

articleTitle: An Analysis on the Connotation of Electric Power Network and Influence Factors
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper explains connotation of the electric grid security from different angles; discusses the importance of electric grid security in our production, daily life and the national economy development; analyzes inherent and external reasons which brings about accidents, then summarizes factors that influence the electric grid security.

articleTitle: Optimal Sampling Frequency for Volatility Forecast Models in China Stock Markets
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on some methods for calculating realized volatility's optimal sampling frequency, we select the minimizing MSE because of its clear idea and easily calculating. Empirical study performed combining Chinese stock market's data, and two conclusions are got. Firstly, the optimal sampling frequencies are different in different trading days for the same stock. Secondly, even though the optimal sampling frequencies are different for different stocks, the distributions of optimal sampling frequencies are same on the whole, i.e. the large parts of optimal sampling frequencies are between 4 and 8 min.

articleTitle: Research on the Incentives to Top Management Base on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Prevention of the Moral Risks of Management is not only the key factor of Modern Enterprise System, but also one important issue of Corporate Finance and Human Resources Management. In this paper, we will start from the Principal-Agent Theory and Human Resources Management Theory, and we adopt Data Mining System to analyze 1276 listed companies in Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Market, in order to explore the moral risks- preventing functions of combined - incentive mechanism applied to the management by companies in China's unique economic environment. So, we can provide important references for the owners of companies when they want to choose suitable incentive mechanism to reduce the moral risks of management.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Stock Repurchasing Effect of Chinese Companies Listed in Mainland, Hong Kong and NASDAQ Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By analyzing the differences of Chinese companies' stock repurchase effect in Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Exchange, Hong Kong Stock Exchange and NASDAQ Stock Market during 1994 to 2007, this paper is devoted to indicate that the signaling effect and announcement effect of repurchase significantly result from the effectiveness of security market and government interference.

articleTitle: Digital Commerce Assessment in West Africa: An ECOWAS Countries Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Abstract: This study analyzes the reality of Africa's minimal integration into the global economy. It will attempt to assess this reality by calculating data collected by ECOWAS (Economic Community of West African States) nations. For illustration purposes, recent data were collected from reputable secondary sources, such as the World Bank. Furthermore, the study's results after analysis ought to be utilized by ECOWAS which has a noble mission to promote the economic integration in the West African sub-region.

articleTitle: Tender Evaluation Method for Engineering Projects Based on Modified DEA and Fuzzy Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The most common method of tender evaluation for engineering projects was traditional comprehensive scoring, and analytic hierarchy process or fuzzy comprehensive judgment was also used for tender evaluation, but all these methods had the defect of having highly subjectivity. Although the traditional DEA model can exclude bias caused by human factors, it can't distinguish efficient decision-making units. A systematic method based on modified DEA and fuzzy theory was proposed for the selection of tenders. The illustrative case was given to demonstrate that the proposed method is not only simple and operational, but also suitable for a general tender evaluation process, providing great reference for evaluation problems in other fields.

articleTitle: Offshore Service Outsourcing: A SWOT Analysis for Shandong Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Offshore service outsourcing is the latest wave in the global realignment of economic activities. As a leading coastal province in eastern China, Shandong has made ambitious plans to foster internationally competitive service outsourcing industries. This paper provides a brief SWOT analysis for Shandong province and concludes that Shandong has great strength and opportunities to realize its ambition while there are weaknesses and threats to be addressed.

articleTitle: Assessment on Environmental Impact of Building Tidal Gate on Yongjiang River
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The construction of a tidal gate on Yongjiang could bring certain social and economic benefits by blocking sea water and storing fresh water, but a serial of problems on sediment silting, water eutrophication, and the reduction of aquatic organism, especially the serious negative impacts of sediment silting on flood control and water draining, marine navigation as well as the current available ports will occur. Together with the consideration resulted from the advance of coastal line, earth surface sinking and Sea surface rising, it is better not to build the tidal gate on Yongjiang River.

articleTitle: Multi-Population Cooperative GA and Multi-Objective Knapsack Problem
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The knapsack problem (KP) is a classical NP problem. The multi-objective knapsack problem (MKP) is more difficult than KP. The fitness vector function is firstly introduced, that can solve the problem of non-convex solutions, which is difficult for the common aggregation function method. Then, with the master-slave multi-population cooperation method, the cooperation between the global exploration and local development is improved, so the multi-objective multi-population cooperative GA (MMGA) posed in this paper enhances also the optimization ability of GA. The experiment result shows, MMGA is superior to NSGAII for MKP. Furthermore, with the both of master-slave multi-population cooperation and the mechanism of holding non-dominate solutions, the premature and degradation phenomena are effectively prevent.

articleTitle: On the Role of Intellectual Property Protection during the Technological Innovations in Chinese Knowledge-Intensive Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of global economy integration, the competition among enterprises is more and more intensive, the indication of which is that the competition of capital has gradually transferred to that of technology with the purpose transferred from purely pursuit of high quality, low price products to new products, procedures of independent intellectual property. Under the new economic circumstance, the operation of knowledge-intensive enterprises changes fundamentally and technological innovations and new product development dominate. Therefore, protecting intellectual property is more and more important in the operation and management. Whether the enterprise can effectively protect, manage and use intellectual property will directly affect the existence and development of the enterprise.

articleTitle: The Study on Application Value of Cash Flow Information Connotation in Financial Early-Warning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since the cash flow information can be applied well in the evaluation of enterprise's financial situation, In this paper, the cash profit, which is the information connotation of cash flow, is a basis of financial evaluation index system and main criteria to define the distress companies. Two early warning models based on cash profit and traditional accounting profit separately are set up by logical regression and factor analysis methods. Empirical results show that the cash profit model is superior to the traditional one and cash flow information connotation has application value on the financial early-warning by comparing forecasting effects of models.

articleTitle: Human Resources Development Globalization under the Idea of Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article utilizes an integrated analysis method to summarize the main implications of sustainable development. It put forward the idea that the center of sustainable development is the sustainable development of the human and human resources which is also the basis and the prerequisite for sustainable development of human society. The author thinks that sustainable development promotes the human resources development globalization inevitably, also describes the essential features of it. The paper has reached the following conclusions: Establishe the human resources development globalization ideology is the future social development's strategic priority; Expande the abroad education is an effective channel to realize the globalization; Implement the immigration policy is the sensible way to respond to the globalization of human resources development; Open nationality restrictions is the inevitable choice to achieve human resources development globalization.

articleTitle: A New P2P Traffic Identification Model Based on Node Status
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Random port, blurred protocol features, as well as HTTP tunneling technology have become more and more popular in the new P2P applications. It makes current P2P traffic identification methods based on traffic features or deep packet inspection increasingly ineffective. To resolve this problem, a new P2P traffic identification model based on node's status is proposed in this paper. Through multi-level identification modules, the obtained node's status is stored into a Hash table, and a trusted list is created by mapping and feedback to the end of identification. Moreover, the definition of the active factor, incremental factor and link cache can help to identify the P2P traffic generated by port hopping and protocol encryption quickly and effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese Natural Language Understanding and Question-Answering System Based on Agent
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper applies the agent technology and the natural language understanding technology into the question-answering system. Firstly, it introduces the agent technology and the natural language understanding technology; and then a new design method is proposed and system's model including the problem analysis agent model and corpus and search algorithm is constructed. It has solved the problem of computer understanding Chinese, as well as improved the search efficiency and accuracy ratio of question-answering system; at last these methods are applied into the domain of forestry pests and diseases and receive better effect.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Risk Evaluate the Construction Project Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Do Domestic and Foreign Institutional Investors Have Similar Portfolio Preferences?
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Using the portfolio data of Qualified Foreign Institutional Investors (QFIIs) and Domestic Mutual Funds, we first compare their portfolio decision. The empirical results show that, despite the commonalities, the foreign and domestic institutional investors differ in portfolio selection in some aspects. We then examine the compensation ratio offered by non-tradable shareholders to tradable shareholders in the share structure reform. It is found that the state-owned companies with ownership of QFIIs but not domestic mutual funds, the average compensation ratio is the highest, while the state-owned companies with ownership of domestic mutual funds but without QFII ownership, the compensation ratio is significantly lower. Overall, our results imply that foreign institutional investors tend to have more bargaining power than their local peers.

articleTitle: Portfolio Optimization Analysis of REITs Based on CAPM and CREIs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the CAPM theory, this paper uses the historical data of CREIs (China Real Estate Index Systems) of Shanghai build an effective REITs (Real Estate Investment Trusts) investment strategy. Then using the Markowitz's mean-variance model, we calculated the optimal portfolio solutions, that is apply the classical security investment theory in the real estate investment decision-making, which have a positive practical significance.

articleTitle: Creating Emotional Reward for Customers: The Role of Employee Performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The present study investigated the impacts of employee's service performance on customer's emotional rewards, satisfaction and repurchase intention. Although both employee's service capacity and self-confidence had increased customers' satisfactions, but neither could reach the threshold of stimulating customer's positive emotions. Frontier employee's authentic empathy was the solely factor that created emotional rewards for customer.

articleTitle: Organizational Project Selection Based on Fuzzy Multi-Index Evaluation and BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Project selection is the key to organizational survival and development. Through surveys and interviews, the project evaluation index system is established from the fore aspects based on the Balanced Scorecard (BSC). Then the fuzzy multi-index evaluation method and the neural network theory are combined to create the BP neural network model of organizational project selection. Finally, the application process and effectiveness of the model are described and confirmed through some samples and a Matlab simulation example.

articleTitle: Safety Evaluation of Coal Mines Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Coal mines safety condition decides the economic condition of the regional development on one hand, more importantly the safety of employees working for mines on the other. This article has introduced a scientific system to evaluate the safety level of coal mine based on AHP so as to give out significant information for the managers of coal mine to make and implement corresponding polices concerning production safety and promote the safety level and efficiency of coal mines.

articleTitle: The Impact of Factory Managed Inventory(FMI) on Global Supply Chains
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper is concerned with the comparison of a factory managed inventory (FMI) supply chain to a traditional forecast-based orders supply chain. The particular emphasis of this paper is the impact the FMI structures have on the ''Bullwhip Effect'' generated within the supply chain. We especially focused on the relationship between the sales site and the factory site, and the developed FMI supply chain that the factory manages each sales site's inventory level, the production site inventory level and actual customer demand as a unified integrated system. A comparison of the performance of the FMI system and conventional supply chain system of a global electronics parts company was investigated by present value (PV) analysis using the value of inventories as a variable. The results revealed that FMI greatly contributed to both reduction of the Bullwhip Effect and improvements of the cash flow PV Index.

articleTitle: Construction of Ship Safety Management Performance Evaluation System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: At present, there are so many large marine transport vessels. Their types are complex, and management Grade is uneven. Many potential safety problems occur which often lead to ship accidents in the ocean. The paper analyzes problems faced by the performance evaluation of ship safety management. On the basis of the theory of "man - machine - environment - Management" system, the meaning of ship safety management performance evaluation is proposed. The paper illustrates ship safety management evaluation index system. By using method of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, it constructs an integrated evaluation model of ship safety management through the assessment of ship safety management performance Grade settings. The paper solves the quantitative assessment of ship safety management problems to an extent and provides a basis for scientific assessments for the safety of the ship.

articleTitle: Cluster Brand, Leading Corporate Brand and Brand Development of Small and Medium Sized Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper applies the structural equation model to discuss the links between cluster brand, leading corporate brand and brand development of Chinese Small and Medium Sized Enterprises, and analyzes whether leading corporate brand can mediate the relationship between cluster brand and brand development of Small and Medium Sized Enterprises. The results of the research are as follows: (1) cluster brand had a significant and positive influence on brand development of Small and Medium Sized Enterprises; (2) cluster brand had a significant and positive effect on leading corporate brand; (3) leading corporate brand had a significant and positive influence on brand development of Small and Medium Sized Enterprises; and (4) cluster brand had a significant and positive effect on brand development of Small and Medium Sized Enterprises with leading corporate brand as a partial mediator.

articleTitle: Improvement Research of Customer Segmentation in Knowledge Intensive Business Services
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Knowledge-intensive business services (KIBS) show the service specialized, knowledgeable, customized features, which determines its customers with a highly participatory and interactive. The reasonable classification of the customer will contribute to offering better solutions for the problem to meet customer's demand. Combined with features of KIBS customer services, this paper points out that the market segmentation is no longer limited to variables of customer behavior characteristics, poses the afterwards market segmentation strategy based on attitude variables. Describes traditional K-means and SOFM cluster methods, proposes SVC algorithm to conduct market segmentation. Through application case of market segmentation the paper contrasted clustering effect of three methods, improving the ability to determine the effect of classification and advantages.

articleTitle: How Adoption Is G2B Model E-Government? Evidence from Xi'an
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of information technology, E-Government has become a key indicator to measure the evaluation of government performance reform in the world. In this research, we took Xi'an Municipal's G2B model E-Government for example to survey how wildly adoption of G2B model E-Government in society, and explore what factors influence the enterprises' intention of using G2B mode E-Government.

articleTitle: Application of Synthetic and Integrated Analysis of Project Risk
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Synthetic and Integrated Analysis of Project Risk (SIAPR), based on the System Theory, is focused on the interrelationship of risk probabilities and the interaction effect of risk impacts, via the VERT method. In this paper four processes of SIAPR is provided, and then an application of SIAPR is described in detail, including the application planning, the methods and important achievements of each process. It is proved by way of practice that the SIAPR is powerful to uncover the secret of project risks, and is feasible to estimate the probabilities of project success and the impacts on the project aims.

articleTitle: The Mediating Role of Organizational Identification in the Relationship between Organizational Centrality and OCB
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study empirically examined the linkage among organizational centrality, organizational identification, and OCB. Survey data were collected from 312 employees and their supervisors in two state-owned companies in China. The results of structural equation modeling showed that organizational identification partially mediated the relationship between organizational centrality and OCB. This suggests that the more that people perceive to be inside the organization, the more inclined they are to identify with their organization, and in turn display high frequency of OCB.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Electric Power Data Integration System Based on the Extraction-Transformation-Loading Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The key of electric power Enterprise Information Portal (EIP) is data integration. Based on the analysis of ETL (Extraction-Transformation-Loading) technology, this article designs an electric power EIP integration system, which offers a uniform interface for different databases in the electric power system, achieving data exchange and share.

articleTitle: The Impact of Socioeconomic, Organizational and Individual Factors on Government Organizational Performance: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this study is to examine several key elements of organizational performance in the public sector empirically. By exploring the effects of socioeconomic, organizational as well as individual factors based on responses from a primary survey, the authors find that those governmental organizations with more public orientation, more employee orientation, clearer goals, less procedure constraints are more effective than their counterparts. Governmental organizations located in the area of higher new economic index usually have higher levels of performance than those lower. Those employees with higher levels of public service motivation tend to report higher organizational performance perception than those less. The study suggests that strengthening the culture of public interest, improving organizational management, and enhancing employees' public service motivation may be the efficient ways to improve the performance.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Environmental Management of Historic and Cultural Blocks in Old City - A Case Study of Shichahai Area in Xicheng District, Beijing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In China, many historic and cultural blocks in ancient capitals fend for themselves.The Messy architectural forms, the fuzzy property rights make it very difficult to take comprehensive environmental management. How to deal with the relationship between history and future, human and nature, are important issues to resolve. The text takes Shichahai area in Xicheng District of Beijing as an example.Five aspects of contents referred to urban environmental management are traditional dwellings, heritage sites, traffic conditions, scenery environment, trade and tourism.These five factors are interlinked but constrained with each other.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on Telecommunication Traffic Forecasting Based on Chaos Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Forecasting of Telecom Traffic influence directly the future development of telecommunications enterprises. According to the complexity and non-linearity of Telecom Traffic , in this paper, the hybrid of wavelet transform (WT), chaos and SVM model was established. First the chaotic feature of Telecom Traffic is verified with chaos theory. It can be seen that Telecom Traffic possessed chaotic features, providing a basis for performing short-term forecast of Telecom Traffic with the help of chaos theory. The original time series is decomposed by wavelet transform to eliminate the instability. Then Average Mutual Information (AMI) method is used to find the optimal time lag of Every single decomposed series. Cao's method is adopted to determine free parameters of support vector machines. Additionally, the proposed model and SVM model were tested on the prediction of Telecom Traffic of Chongqing province Telecommunications operator in China to prove the model's validity.

articleTitle: Seats Allotment Optimization for China Railway Operation Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Inventory control is an important branch of revenue management. In railway industry inventory means seats. Applications of revenue management in many fields are increasingly, including railway industry. To achieve the desired results, the specific application environment must be considered. The features of China's railway are discussed firstly, and then a method of demand forecast and a model of seats allotment with objective to maximize the seat load factor are proposed. The allotment method is adapted to multi seat classes on multi segments under the condition of fares relative fixed in China and also meet the need of opening pricing in future. Some trains are chosen as the object for illustrative analysis, and the result indicate that the method is useful to improve the seat load factor. Additionally it is also effective to make the seats more in line with the trends of passenger flow, and reduce the probability and amount of long-distance tickets randomly cutting into short ones during sales process.

articleTitle: The Study of the Main Influencing Factors and Relationship Structure of the Leisure Economy System Based on ISM Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Leisure economy is a kind of new economic form, and building the reasonable leisure economy system (or economic region) is great significance for perfecting the urban service functions, attracting investment, stimulating consumption, stimulating the development of relative industries, increasing employment, increasing farmers' income and promoting harmonious development. By using bibliometrics method, this paper made a statistical analysis of the papers about leisure economy system in China Journal Full-text Database so as to screen out eight major factors affected the leisure economy system development. Using interpretive structural model (ISM) to study the relationship structure between the main influencing factors, we found the superficial and direct influencing factor, intermediate and indirect influencing factor, essential and basic influencing factor. Results show that: the factors such as natural environment, per capita GDP and leisure industry GDP can affect on the development of leisure economy system deeply and fundamentally.

articleTitle: Design of Management Information System of Training: Based on Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In terms of features of athletes' training, this paper, integrating techniques of network devises a management information system for training based on B/S model and provides a training information processing system. This paper analyzes the systematic functional structure and the constitution of systematic sub-systems in detail. Meanwhile, it elaborates on the design of systematic functional structure, network structure, link modes and systematic soft wares' functions, and introduces web, database and ASP dynamic homepage technique applied in the interactive Web system design, followed by the cases for illustration of some relevant designs for the management and information system of training.

articleTitle: Research on Web-Based Test Item Bank System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Computer-based testing will be no doubt proved to be a positive development in assessment practice. A computerized item bank is the basis for computer-based testing system and distance learning. This paper briefly introduces characteristics of web-based test item bank, analyzes related issues in the developing of the system, and describes the architecture of a web-based system, database structure, system management, principles and methods of test paper generation.

articleTitle: The Application Tactics of Customer Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Under the condition of global economy integration and rapid development of information technique, the customer has become the most important resource of the enterprise. If we can effectively use the customer knowledge, we then can make the customer relationship management to correctly match the customer's needs, and make the enterprise's development to well accord with the market needs. So there are more and more enterprises trying to enhance their competence ability through the customer knowledge management. Although the scholars and practitioners have carried on extensive researches about the customer knowledge management, the application study of the customer knowledge management has not accorded with the practice. Therefore, this paper puts forward the improvement tactics about the application of the customer knowledge management based on the system model of the customer knowledge management in order to provide theoretical instructions for the enterprise practice.

articleTitle: A New Approach of Image Similarity Calculation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Due to fast development of information technology and increasing demand for the picture similarity used in clinical diagnosis, quality control of product manufacturing process and identified pictures, a similarity calculation method with fast, effective, correct relative similarity of two pictures is essential. This study proposes a new image similarity computing method, the method is to divide picture into a limited number of grids and then use Hough Transform to do the features capture among grids and calculate the amount of features and express as a image numeric vector format. By the vector pair comparison of two images, we calculate the distance similarity and the angle similarity and get the average of these two similarities as the relative similarity of two images. The research shows that the accuracy of this new algorithm of picture similarity is 80% as dividing picture into 100 grids. When we increase the more quantity of picture dividing grids, we can obtain the higher accuracy.

articleTitle: The Effects of Innovation Capability on New Product Development Performance: The Evidence of Zhejiang Province' SMEs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: New product development could be recognised as a key success factor in an increasingly competitive,global economy. The purpose of this paper is to examine the relations between innovation capability and new product development(NPD) performance in small and medium-sized business in China. This study builds a model related to the most important dimensions of innovation capability that influence mostly NPD performance of firms, such as technology, organization, strategy, manufacturing and marketing. Then it examines the relationships between these dimensions of innovation capability and NPD performance. A practical survey was carried out in the manufacturing industry of Zhejiang Province. Strategic planning capability, technology capability and marketing capability positively influence the NPD performance of manufacturing SMEs. Contrary to our prediction, market linking capability has a significant negative effect on NPD performance. Effects of other innovation capability dimensions are not significant. In general, it provides empirical evidence that different aspects of innovation capability will have significant different impact on the new product performance. Results of this study could lead to effective management of innovation for the SMEs in manufacturing industry and benefits for the firms' managers.

articleTitle: Control, Affect and Cognition Trust in Determining IT Offshoring Outsourcing Service Quality
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Trust and control are essential in inter-organization collaboration. This paper extends existing literatures by empirically testing the different effects of formal and informal control on cognition and affection trust and their impacts on service quality in IT offshore outsourcing. The results show that formal control and affect trust contribute to service quality. However, informal control negatively impacts service quality. Additionally, although both informal and formal control positively relate to trust, the effect of informal control on affect trust is stronger than that of formal control.

articleTitle: A Study on Motivation of Meeting and Exhibition Attendees in Macao
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Meeting and exhibition industry in Macao has been developed for a few years, while it is still lack of competitiveness compared with other major exhibition destinations such as Hong Kong and Guangzhou. The study assessed attendee motivations of Macao conventions and exhibitions, found that attendees to Macao were motivated by five basic motivation factors: educational benefits, personal attraction, self-development, convenience, and activities. The study showed that event organizers should design meetings and exhibitions based on the needs and motivations of potential attendees in order to make event more attractive.

articleTitle: Medical Service Quality Evaluation Based on Lingual Description
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The characteristics of medical service, such as information unsymmetrical and result uncertain, make the patient find it difficult to evaluate the service quality they accepted. Usually, the patient can evaluate the medical service by lingual description. The paper researches on medical service quality evaluation based on lingual description by convert the lingual description into fuzzy number. An example is used to demonstrate the evaluation flow.

articleTitle: Project Manager's Leadership Style Linked with Schedule and Cost Performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this study was to investigate the relationships of the project manager's leadership style with teamwork, and their associations with project schedule and cost performance. The second objective was to determine whether the effect of leadership style on project performance may be mediated by teamwork. To address the primary aims, a questionnaire-based survey was used to measure the project manager's leadership style, teamwork in terms of communication, collaboration and cohesiveness, and project success in the areas of schedule and cost. The analyses suggest that project manager's leadership style, teamwork, and project performance are highly correlated. The findings also indicate that teamwork dimensions may partially or fully mediate the relationships between leadership style and project performance.

articleTitle: The Risk Evaluation of the Construction Project Design Based on the Gray Relational Grade
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The design phase is the key to the implementation of construction standards and industrial policies, but the basis of the control of construction project investments to achieve its sustainable development. How to accurately identify, measure, control and manage risk is a focus of risk management to architectural design enterprises. This paper identifies the common risk factors in the design, combined with the main three stages where architectural design risks occur, then builds a set of rational evaluation index system of construction project risk and analyzes the risk factors based on the evaluation model of gray correlation degree.

articleTitle: Coordinate the Supply Chain with Risk-Averse Agents under CVaR Criteria
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Following the coordination framework created by Gan, Sethi and Yan[1], we address the supply chain coordination issues with a supplier and a retailer where their risk measure is Conditional Value-at- Risk (CVaR). We find the set of pareto-optimal solutions, and design contracts to achieve these solutions. When the supplier's profit is deterministic, we find that the wholesale price contract can coordinate the supply chain and when the supplier and the retailer have the same risk attitudes, we find that the revenue-sharing contract and the buy-back contract can coordinate the supply chain.

articleTitle: Managing the Risks of Financial Innovations in Banking
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the subprime crisis, people are paying more and more attention to analyze financial innovations and manage the risks. In this paper, firstly, we discuss the effects of risks, which may bring adverse or harmful impacts to us, and then we define the risks of financial innovations in banking, which are mainly market risk, credit risk and operational risk. Next, we study ways to calculate market risk, credit risk and operational risk, respectively. Finally, we analyze the effects of regulations in managing risks of financial innovations in banking. From our analysis, we find that people can take out countermeasures to assess and manage risks of financial innovations in banking to avoid or reduce losses.

articleTitle: Study on the Risk Management Strategy of China's Commercial Banks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Study on risk management of commercial banks(CB) is a hot issue in recent years. Especially after the financial crisis, more and more researchers begin to study how to manage the risk of China's CB. This paper combines the existing literature and Basel II to analyze the risk status of China's CB. We find that although China's CB have got a great achievement in risk management by now, three main kinds of risk: credit risk, market risk and operation risk, still threat to the China's CB further development. After analyzing these risk, we provide the risk management strategy from four aspects at last, including organizational structure, business procedure, technology and culture.

articleTitle: Research of International Webometrics in Frontier Domains in Visualized Information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the newly developed information visualization methods, this paper analyzed the literature themed at Webometrics cited by ISI Web of Knowledge. Using the software CitespaceII, this study developed a knowledge map of the representative personage and works on Webometrics. Finally, based on the detection of the subject headings with word frequency of significant fluctuation, the research frontier and the further development trend of Webometrics was determined and the knowledge map of them was developed.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Diagnosing and Overcoming Business Gene's Vulnerability
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Similar to the genes of creature organism, business genes determine all traits of enterprise. Defects in business gene will result in its vulnerability consequentially, as well reduce its immunity, and then, increase the probability of business crisis or risk. Therefore, it is very crucial to maintain business gene's perfectness and robustness, realize business's resistance to vicious environmental inducement by detecting and repairing business's defected genes, and overcoming business gene's vulnerability. In this paper, we try to find how to reduce the factors which affect business gene's vulnerability as well extract the smallest diagnosis rule employing Bayesian Rough Set model, to diagnose the target business gene's vulnerability. Based on the results, we find that, the specific gene segments located on the soft chain of business gene, critically impact business gene's robustness or vulnerability. That's why, in this paper, it's strongly recommended that enhancing a business soft competence is really vital to overcome business gene's vulnerability.

articleTitle: Application of Data Mining in Customer Relationship Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With economic globalization and the rapid development of e-commerce, customer relationship management (CRM) has become the core of growth of the company. Data mining, as a powerful data analysis tool, extracts critical information supporting the company to make better decisions by processing a large number of data in commercial databases. This paper introduced the basic concepts of data mining and CRM, and described the process how to use data mining for CRM. At last, the paper described the applications of several main data mining methods in CRM, such as clustering, classification and association rule.

articleTitle: Research on the Factors Influencing the Customer Knowledge Value
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Customer knowledge value is becoming increasingly recognized as an important part of customer assets, which has got more and more attention to domestic and foreign scholars. This paper proposed to analyze the factors influencing customer knowledge value based on the analysis of present relevant research both home and abroad. We developed a conceptual model of five factors impacting on customer knowledge value: trust in enterprise, satisfy with enterprise, relevance to enterprise, products understanding and customer's own professional skills. The results suggest that these five factors all have closely relationship with customer knowledge value.

articleTitle: 3G Based Mobile Internet in China: A Service Marketing Research
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The implementation of 3g has brought great business opportunities to China. But few scholars have focused on the service marketing of mobile internet in China. This paper first points out the characteristics of mobile internet and analyzes nine principles in the service marketing of mobile internet. Based on that, this paper adopts quantitative analysis and market survey to investigate the current status of mobile internet in China and gives a detailed analysis of the features and needs of the target customers in China. And accordingly, this paper puts forward three strategies for the service marketing of mobile internet in China, which can hopefully provides reference for mobile internet operators and related researchers.

articleTitle: The Investigation in Service Quality Management of 3G Business for Telecom Operators
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: 3rd generation mobile communication networks (3G) have been heralded as a great shift that will make the market competition to be fierce increasingly. In this situation, the telecom operators are improving service quality to develop 3G users. Based on the discussion of the basic principle of Customer Perceived Service Quality Model and SERVQUAL Model, this paper has improved them for the characteristics of the telecom industry. Finally, this paper has described the content of service quality management and put forward the parameters System in 3G era.

articleTitle: Research on Logistics Center Location in Home Appliances Going to the Countryside: Taking Liaoning Province as an Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
