abstract: In order to reduce the cost of China's "home appliances going to the countryside" effectively, the centralized logistics centre in a province was put forward to carry out the logistics distribution. The model based on the exact centre-of-gravity method was built to analyze the location of these centralized logistics centers. Liaoning Province was taken as an example to show the process of calculation. Results show that the optimal location of the centralized logistics centre can make the logistics costs of "home appliances going to the countryside" reduced well. The government and the enterprises participating in "home appliances going to the countryside" can plan the logistics distribution centers with this result.

articleTitle: A Study on the Growth Ability of the Small-Medium Enterprises Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the ages with economic globalization, knowledgeable informational, and marketable, the shape of enterprises which is as the part of economic activities is also keeping changed. The large enterprise is the pillar of national economy and an important mark that is used to measure the economic power and international competition abilities of a country, but the small-medium enterprises are also the important part of national economy. Because of the deficiencies of their own strength, stability and the ability to resist risks, the death rate of the small-medium enterprises is very high. The growth problem of small-medium enterprises has already become a world problem. We found the evaluation index system of the growth ability for the small-medium enterprise in this paper. We use the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation to measure the real enterprise. The conclusions is that technological innovation is the continuous driving force for the growth of small-medium enterprises and the entrepreneurs are the important and indispensable resources during the growth of small-medium enterprises.

articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis of Factors Affecting Coal Price
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A verification model of coal price (VEC) is established by using cointegration analysis method in this article, and an empirical study is carried on the corresponding statistics from the year 1985 to 2008. It shows that the main factors affecting coal prices are the output value of industry, GNP, retail price index, coal cost and coal supply. Considering the factors, the proposed verification model can predict the actual value of coal price with high forecast accuracy and explain the changes in coal prices, at the same time, the comprehensive short and long term relationship of these variables and coal prices is better than that of the long-term relationship. The model illustrates the factors' affection on the impact of coal price based on quantitative analysis, which will offer certain references for macro-control department and coal enterprises.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Financial Distress Early-Warning of Real Estate Listed Companies in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to investigate the impact of Macroeconomic Environment and financial factors on Companies in financial distress, This paper collects real estate listed companies from 2001 to 2008 as samples and then develops two models, model I of which introduces financial factors and Model II have the financial factors and the macroeconomic factors integrated together. Then this paper uses Logistic Regression Model to predict the financial Distress of Real Estate Listed companies. The Empirical results indicate that model II improves the goodness of fit and predictive power significantly. Besides, the Money Supply and the Real Estate Climate Index have significant influence on deciding whether the real estate companies falling into financial distress.

articleTitle: The Evaluation of the Biotechnology Cluster by Fuzzy AHP: Based on the GEM Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The biotechnology cluster, as a kind of innovation cluster, plays an important role in the economic development. This paper employs the fuzzy analytical hierarchy process approach to evaluate the biotechnology clusters, which is meaningful not only for the academic research, but also for the policy-making practice. In addition, a case study is presented to make the FAHP approach more understandable.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on the Career Development Stages of Chinese Employee
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With consideration of Chinese traditional culture and social context and by conducting a research on the life cycle theories, this paper first finds the turning points in Chinese employee career which is validated by the statistical analysis based on the career development theories. Besides the two conclusions, this paper also analyzes how the education system affects the employee's career development. With these achievements, this paper builds a development model of Chinese employee career and divides their career into four stages: establishing stage, developing stage, crisis stage and maintaining stage, characteristics of which are respectively discussed. An empirical research is then conducted to prove that the division of the Chinese employee career is reasonable.

articleTitle: The Calculation of Volatility in Real Option Investment Decision-Making Model Using System Dynamics Models
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Real options method has been increasingly used in value assessment and decision-making of investment projects. However, the determination of volatility factor in the pricing model is still an open issue. In this paper, system dynamics approach is presented, to set a model on influencing factors and decision-making process of uncertain investment projects. Acquire different volatility data of project value under varieties of situation influencing by various factors, then carry out the calculation of option value and project decision-making.

articleTitle: The Forecast of Coal Demand Based on RoughSet and BP Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the past, the accuracy of forecasting coal demand is not very satisfactory. In this paper, rough set for the coal demand factors affecting the reduction, the core factors extracted using BP neural network to predict, through the results of China coal demand forecast can be seen that the value of history fit very well, indicating that this model has better scientific and rationality. Finally, the model predicts the next four years coal demand in China.

articleTitle: Activity Theoretical Framework for Wiki-Based Collaborative Content Creation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Most recently, the use of collaboration element within information behavior research namely Collaborative Information Behavior (CIB) has been increasing. In addition, the success of wiki-based, large-scale, open collaborative content creation systems such as Wikipedia has aroused increasing interests of studies on their collaborative model. In contrast to previous related work, this paper focuses on an integrated theoretical framework of collaborative content creation activities in the context of wiki-based system. An activity theoretical approach is used to construct an activity system of wiki-based collaborative content creation and analyze its components, mediators, subsystems and dynamic processes. It's argued that collaborative content creation is the most important component of wiki-based CIB. Four stages involved in the dynamic process of collaborative content creation activity are learning, editing, feedback and collaboration, as well as conflicts and coordination. The result of the study has provided an integrated theoretical framework of collaborative content creation activities which combines almost all elements such as motive, goal, subject, object, community, tools, rules, roles and collaboration, conflicts, outcome, etc. into one model. It is argued that an activity-theoretical approach to collaborative content creation systems and information behavior research would provide a sound basis for the elaboration of complex collaboration and self-organization mechanisms.

articleTitle: Value Chain Analysis of the Digital Content Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With rapid development of digital content industry, the industry has been considered as an important part in the global economic system. This paper provides a model for the digital content industry value chain and a research on all segments of chains as well as on the correlations of all segments through analysis on the digital content industry chain. The value activities raising the digital content industry mainly consist of the value activities of digital content products and the value activities of derivative products different from traditional industry.

articleTitle: The Optimum Propeller of Regional Innovation: Public Technology Service Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The public technology service platform is an important content in the technological innovation system, in accordance with the requests of system integration, allocation optimization and sharing, in order to integrate a wide range of innovative carriers and resources and provide public innovation services within the region. This paper, Hangzhou Platform of Apiculture Technology Innovation Service as an example, analyzed the functional orientation and service models of the public technology service platform in the regional innovation. The public technology service platform can gather the industrial innovation resources, accelerate the pace of technology transfer, enhance capacity of production and research, create conditions to break though key industrial technologies, and promote the commercial application of technological achievements. Therefore, we should consider the public technology service platform as the optimum propeller of regional innovation, and devote efforts to build the platform, thereby enhancing regional innovation capability and the competitiveness of China's technological development.

articleTitle: Innovation and Development on Scientific Management of Water Resources
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Production and life action are changed because of the scarcity of natural resources. It is a reasonable choice that low-carbon economy, cut costs, energy-saving emission reduction under the conditions of today's limited resources. Pareto Optimal could be achieved with scientific management being as complementary production factor that can optimize and allocate the resources, adjust the ratio of production relations between the various factors under certain technical conditions. The socio-economic development and ecological environment construction have been seriously affected by factors of production shortage of water resources.Innovation of scientific management is the key toraising the level of water resources management in order to achieve maximum output at the lowest investment. The meaning and necessity of innovation and scientific management of water resources are put forward. The scientific management, technical support, system innovation, institutional innovation are discussed, and theoretical innovation of water resources management of innovation is outlined in this paper.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of the Impact of Corporate Governance on R&D Investment in High-Tech Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, high-tech enterprise is the research object. It studies the impact of corporate governance structure on R&D investment by establishing multi-regression model. Ownership structure and board structure are selected to represent the internal governance structure. The result indicates that ownership property makes significant contribution to R&D investment, and an appropriate percentage of equity ownership concentration and the shareholding proportion of executives can promote R&D investment, and variables representing the characteristic of the board have no significant impact on R&D investment, including board size, the proportion of independent directors and CEO Duality.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Four Types of Automated Negotiation System Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Four different types of automated negotiation model, including commodity-oriented automated negotiation, user-oriented automated, service-oriented automated negotiation and goal-oriented automated negotiation, are discussed in this article base on the existing basic principles and characteristics. And then are the comparison and analysis of their shortages.

articleTitle: The Empirical Analysis on the Contribution of Software & Information Service Industry to Economic Growth in Dalian, China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development of software & information service industry promotes the economic growth in Dalian, China. And this paper examines the contribution of software & information service industry to the economic growth through contribution analysis and an econometric model basing on C-D production function with the data of Dalian from 1999 to 2008. The results are that the software & information service industry has comprehensive influences on economic growth, and it is necessary to develop it in Dalian.

articleTitle: Research on Duration-Cost-Quality Model under Uncertainty in Construction Project Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Schedule, cost and quality control are main aspects in construction project management. Taking duration, cost and quality into account simultaneously, and keeping the balance among them during the whole process of project management are significant for the improvement of the overall benefits of construction project. In general, there is a trade-off between duration, cost and quality to complete a project. On basis of analyzing the relationship of duration, cost and quality, this paper establishes duration-cost model and duration-quality model which considering of uncertainty in construction project management. And a case study is given to verify the feasibility and practicability of the model. It provides scientific basis for project decision-making.

articleTitle: Chinese Affordable Housing System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Affordable housing system carried out more than ten years, which has made remarkable achievements in the protection of residents' basic housing needs as a core system. In recent years, affordable housing system is also facing quite a lot of controversy. The article analyze the defects of the system based on the formulation to implementation of the system, and learn from the advanced experience of foreign countries, in order to make reference views in improving the affordable housing system.

articleTitle: Order Promising with Capacity Reserved for Multi-Priority Orders
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: High degree of uncertainty in wafers cycle time brings semiconductor manufacturers' difficulty in making feasible order promise. After analyzing the roots of deficiencies in conventional order promising method, we develop a method called CRMPO (Capacity Reserved for Multi-Priority Orders) to promise orders. By dividing all orders into several priorities and reserving capacities for each priority in advance, CRMPO can improve feasibility of order promise, satisfy important customers' orders requirement and smooth production planning. Finally, we investigate some critical techniques used to implement CRMPO.

articleTitle: The Role of Relational Governance in Innovation Performance in Clusters
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper aims to examine the effects of two kind of inter-firm relationship characteristics to the firm's innovation performance. In addition, a 'climatic' characteristic, namely industrial symmetry was also involved in the framework to explore the contingency role of the two relationship characteristics on relational governance. Using survey data from a sample of 211 firms from mainland China, we found that both kinds of relationship features have a positive impact on innovation performance because they facilitate relational governance at the firm level. We also find that relational governance have a inverted U shape effect on the outcome variable. Further industrial symmetry positively moderates the relationship between inter-firm trust and innovation performance.

articleTitle: Adsorption of Carbon Dioxide on Coconut Shell Activated Carbon
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The adsorption equilibrium of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> was measured on coconut shell activated carbon by using a static volumetric method. Adsorption isotherms over the temperature ranged 308 K ~ 353 K were measured. The results showed that the capacities of adsorption of carbon dioxide on activated carbon at different temperatures were as follows: 308 K > 323 K > 338 K > 353 K. The absorption capacity increases with the decreasing temperature in the same pressure. The D-R equation was found better to fit the isotherm data for the adsorption of carbon monoxide, especially in 308 K and 323 K. Furthermore, Freundlich equation was chosen to calculate the heat of adsorption in this paper, the isosteric heat of adsorption was about 8 kJ/mol, and the results showed that the isosteric heat of adsorption for CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> decreased with the adsorbed amount increasing, and the process of adsorption is physical adsorption.

articleTitle: Study on Control Strategy of Management Information Cost
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, the author researches the content, the connotation, the goals, the characteristics of control strategy of management information cost, and the relations between management information cost control and value creation. Pointed out especially that management information cost control strategy includes the strategic management information cost control and the strategy in process of management information cost control, and its goal is also a combined system.

articleTitle: Effect of Preparation Conditions on Catalytic Hydrolysis of COS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Catalytic systems based on activated carbon(AC) modified by manganese oxide were investigated for the hydrolysis of carbonyl sulfide (COS) in a fixed-bed reactor. The catalysts were prepared by immersion method. Effect of preparation conditions on catalytic activity were studied, including calcination temperature, content of active component, drying temperature after immersing alkali and addition of rare earth Cerium ions. The results show the optimum preparation conditions of the catalysts are the samples are calcined at 300°C with impregnating 1~5% metal oxide, and then dried at 130°C. The results also show that the Mn-Ce/AC catalyst with Mn:Ce(mole ratio) of 5~10:1 has better performance.

articleTitle: An Optimal Synchronization Decision Model of Correlation Maintenance Task
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As to the equipment system comprised by multi-components with different maintenance modes, when one of the components has serious deterioration, there exists a problem that it should be repaired immediately or can be synchronized repaired with others in a slight delay. Aiming at this problem, the course of optimal synchronization decision of correlation maintenance task in different maintenance modes is researched, and the optimal synchronization decision model of correlation maintenance task is built. The target of the model is minimizing the maintenance/breakdown cost per unit of time with the information of fully considering and using the equipment technological status, the equipment system running time, big and small maintenance constraints, maintenance time and maintenance/breakdown cost under various maintenance modes. The calculation of the example shows that the model is feasible and effective, and it can provide decision support to solve the problem.

articleTitle: The Credit Risk Transfer and Negative Impact on the Stability of Financial System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Credit risk transfer (CRT) is developing rapidly in recent years. The activities of CRT are expanding globally, which can be seen from the increase of the number of CRT instruments transactions and the transfer across financial institutions. However, CRT, which will also have a negative impact on financial system stability can reduce the capability and flexibility of the financial system to withstand or resist risks; CRT will aggravate the instability among financial institutions, induce other risk factors in financial market, and increase the difficulty of financial supervision. The crisis will break out when the amount of the negative impact reach to a certain degree. Hence, we should considerate the impact of CRT on financial stability deliberately when we use the credit innovation.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Consulting System for University Athletic Sports
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The personalized demands of contemporary college students has been increasing with the development of information technology in teaching of P.E, thus, how to provide students with personalized physical education (P.E) course has become particularly urgent. This paper starts with the analysis of college students' demands for P.E classes, proposes the concept of consulting system for university athletic sports, and analyzes the functions and processes of the personalized recommendation system for P.E course at universities. Then, this paper describes the designing results and proposes the system application architecture. The main objective of the consulting system is to recommend physical education course for students, give sports advice to them, as well as to provide decision support for rational allocation of teaching resources of schools.

articleTitle: Research on Model of Digital Enterprises Information Resources Management System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nowadays, with the development of economic globalization, the establishment of high-performance digital integrated enterprise information resource management system has become the effective means to improve their market competitiveness, reduce costs, and timely access to the information for enterprises. According to the current situation that the traditional enterprise system integration can not be effective to coordinate the system work in the inner enterprise and between enterprise's new and old systems. This article makes a research on model of digital enterprises information resources management system, and introduces three main sub-systems of enterprise application system (EAS) components applied in the digital enterprises, which are ERP, CRM and SCM systems. It makes a compare among ERP, SCM, CRM and BRP and puts forward a framework for the integrated model based on Web Service's structure of information resources management system in the end.

articleTitle: Cognitive Factors in Adoption of Instant Messaging: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study investigates what cognitive factors affect the adoption of Instant Messaging. A theoretical model based on the Technology Acceptance Model within a cognitive perspective is developed, and a pilot study for an empirical analysis is conducted. A questionnaire is designed and uploaded to the professional research website. Through analysis using SEM, the key influencing factors are found including perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, perceived enjoyment, perceived number of users. Then some recommendations are proposed to the internet companies based on the result.

articleTitle: Macroscopic Forecasting on Chinese Civil Aviation Transportation Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Three methods are used to forecast the Chinese Civil Aviation Transportation Market over the next 20 years, namely international and domestic comparison, elastic coefficient method, and the regression method. The results show average annual growth rates, reasonable waving Intervals and the prediction values of the total transport turnover volume, the passenger traffic turnover volume, and freighter traffic turnover volume between 2008 and 2027. In addition, the results also tell about the elastic coefficient between the three turnover volumes and the GDP and GDP per capita. This forecast provides some scientific basis for decision making.

articleTitle: ECA Rule and Colored Petri Nets Based Workflow Modeling Research
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Designing model and realizing the workflow management system are the research focuses of workflow technology. This article describes a method of designing workflow management system, it gives full play to the excellence of colored Petri nets' graphical representation ability and ECA rule's easy to realize. It designs workflow model by colored Petri nets and translate the model to ECA rule figure, which is used to design workflow management system. In the end, we check the correct of the method by an example of Project Amount Declaration.

articleTitle: Research on the Measuring Model of Construction Industrialization Development Level
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Construction industrialization is the inevitable trend in construction industry. Construction industrialization could cut construction period down, improve engineering quality, increase labor productivity, save energy and exhaust less pollution and promote the overall level of construction industry. However, there is no clear conclusion about China's construction industrialization level. Based on the Japanese interrelated data, regarding these factors as independent variable and the degree of construction industrialization as a dependent factor, this paper analysis the factors affecting construction industrialization, and established a linear regression model. By the model, this paper analyzes the level of construction industrialization of our country, and find that the construction industrialization level of our country close to the level of the early 1980s in Japan. Further, this paper compared the factors of Japan and China, and analyzes the strengths and weaknesses of development construction industrialization in our country.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Evaluation of Urban Material Metabolism Based on MFA-A Case Study of Chengyang District in Qingdao
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With expanding exchange of material and energy between socio-economic system and eco-environment system, great change appears in structure and organization form of material social metabolism. It becomes one of mainstream of urban sustainable development to optimize and reorganize process of material metabolism. Based on method of Material Flow Analysis, the paper establishes indicator system of comprehensive evaluation of urban material metabolism. The indicator system comprises 37 indicators, which are divided into five kinds of indicators including socio-economic development, resources consumption, environmental pressure,metabolic intensity, control performance. Analytic Hierarchy Process is utilized to determine weight of indicators, and material metabolic level of Chengyang District is assessed. The results indicate that several indices show different trends: obvious growth appears in indices of SDI, RCI, and CPI; EPI and MII decreases slightly; CEI keeps fluctuant and slow rise. Higher resources consumption is the main problem of material metabolism in Chengyang District and key road to high level of material metabolism is control of material input and improvement of resources productivity. On the other side, the results show that it is an effective method of comprehensive evaluation of urban material metabolism established in this study, which is helpful to identify main problems in urban material metabolism and to provide policy support for local economic development and environmental management.

articleTitle: A Bayesian Network Structure Learning Method Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To find the implied dependency relationships and knowledge representation from sample data, a Bayesian Network structure learning method was proposed on the basis of ant colony algorithm, which provided support for the modeling of complex decision-making tasks. Algorithm design was presented after the formal description of Bayesian network structure learning problems. Accordingly, a Bayesian network structure learning rules were built, including node state transferring rule, node sequence scoring rule, pheromone inspired strength calculating rule, pheromone updating rule, process controlling rule, network structure establishing rule, etc. Finally, the important value of algorithm applied in complex decision-making fields was effectively verified with the example of construction about damage assessing system for a certain military engineering.

articleTitle: An Evaluation Model for Supplier Choice of Complex Products Based on ELECTRE Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to help complex products' users choose the right supplier, an evaluation model based on ELECTRE method was put forward. In the model, a three-layer architecture, which was composed of overall objective layer, second objective layer, and attribute layer, was set up. Then the weights of individual indicators were determined based on fuzzy AHP method. Subsequently the final result of the evaluation was obtained based on ELECTRE method. At last, a case was used in the model to illustrate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Technological Capabilities and Local Firms Upgrading within Global Value Chains
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: From current literature on global value chains (GVCs), the firm is explicitly regarded as the central actor, but it is invariably treated as a black box and most of researchers have neglected what happened inside the firm. In fact, what goes in inside the firm matters a lot. This paper aims to introduce technological capability (TC) approach into the framework of global value chain theory to open the black box of firms and analyze the relationship between technological capabilities and local firms upgrading. Moreover it presents a new classification of technological capabilities from the perspective of knowledge and proposes a new framework for analyzing the mechanism of local firms upgrading within GVCs.

articleTitle: Strategy for Supply Chain Coordination Based on Fashion Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the feature that demand for apparel products varies with the market fluctuation, and it thus affects the decision-making program of the supply chain participants. In the case of different game relations, bargaining power, information structure and organizational structure, retailers have diverse risk preferences in different product life cycles. This paper introduces the concept of fashion index and establishes risk aversion coefficient model, analyses expected utility function through both the centralized model and dispersion model, and obtains the optimal buyback strategy. By data simulation, it is demonstrated that the retailer's risk aversion coefficient is decreasing with the increases of fashion index in different fashion cycles. In order to achieve the perfect coordination of the supply chain, supplier buy-back price will also increase accordingly to encourage retailers. This study indicates that considering the fashion index will give a clearer fashion reflection of the members' market expectations, thus to obtain optimal coordination parameters to optimize the supply chain profits.

articleTitle: Optimal Model and Genetic Algorithm of Two-Echelon Inventory System with Correlated Demands
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Two-echelon inventory system includes a center depot (CD) and many sub depots (SD). There is little literature studying on the correlated demand which is the fundamental relationship between the CD and the SD. According to the idea of maximum part-period gain (MPG) in the operation management, the system optimal inventory strategy can be obtained through the trade-off between the order cost and the storage cost. Then the optimal model and the genetic algorithm are given. And the simulation result showed that it is a good way to get the satisfied order policy.

articleTitle: Business Advertising Strategy in Experiential Marketing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the differences between experiential marketing and traditional marketing, this article emphasizes that we should pay attention to involvements and experiences of consumers in experiential marketing. The key point of this article is the functions of advertising in experiential marketing. In other words, companies should focus on five different types of experiences, namely, sense, feel, think, act and relate to propose corresponding advertising strategies.

articleTitle: Knowledge Management in Computer-Supported Learning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A learning process is substantially a knowledge management process. Computers can play multiple roles in human learning and facilitated human learning processes by providing technical, cognitive, and social support. This paper discusses knowledge management in computer-supported learning, explores the knowledge management process in learning process, and suggests how to better support knowledge management in computer-supported learning.

articleTitle: Efficiency Evaluation of City Circular Economy Based on the Super-Efficient Mixed DEA Cluster Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the theory of traditional DEA, we built a super-efficient mixed DEA model, which, together with the optimal partition, builds the super-efficient mixed DEA cluster model. This model can simultaneously deal with those evaluation indicators meeting the cone and that does not meet the cone, by removing the decision-making units of self-constraints, we obtain the absolute sorting of index for the relative efficiency of decision making units, and also solve problems like that many decision-making units are judged to be relatively effective as the result of excessive evaluation index, that results evaluation model in failure. It is demonstrated by an example that the model can be used not only to reasonably and effectively evaluate the efficiency of city circular economy, but also to determine sensitive factors that can improve efficiency of city circular economy. It is of great help for government to improve their efficiency of city circular economy.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Evolutionary Path and Influence Factors of the Northeast Asia Regional Energy Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the evolution of the concept of energy safety, international regional cooperation has become an important way to countries to solve energy issues. In the Northeast Asia the regional energy cooperation is an inevitable trend. However, due to the complexity of regional energy cooperation, the progress of the Northeast Asia regional energy cooperation is not smoothly. This paper by using the dynamic analysis method of evolutionary game, constructs an evolutionary game model of regional energy cooperation, which introduces the capability structure, discount factor and other important factors. It can conclude that the evolutionary path of regional energy cooperation has non-linear complex trait. And it can be found that the abscissa and ordinate of the system saddle point is the coordinate value of the changing of system evolutionary path. Then analyses the key factors those influence the evolutionary path of the Northeast Asia regional energy cooperation.

articleTitle: A Survey for Real Estate Early Warning Methods
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the early warning theory of the real estate and divided by the science classification, presently used real estate early warning methods are generalized as the business cycle & quantitative statistic method, econometric method and non-linearity & systems approach. And the business cycle analysis, pattern recognition, ARCH, Hedonic, ANN, SWARM methods are summarized. The results show that mathematical statistic method stresses in quantitative relation of indices. Econometric model emphasizes the economical relationship of indices. And system approach focus on the overall impact of individual activities. Therefore all methods should be applied synthetically.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analyse the Financing Problems of the Energy Performance Contracting in China and Research on the Solutions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Cluster Density, External Search and Innovation Performance: Evidence from the ZGC Science Park
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Study on Human Error in Operation Based on Human Cognitive Reliability Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to improve the reliability of chemical equipments operation, the simulation research on the reliability of the operators is needed. Basing on the research platform of Dalian Chemical Industry Group Corporation (The Group), taking the reliability model of Human Cognition Reliability (HCR) as guide, in allusion to the 17 abnormal events which affect the running safety, the allowable operation time and the non-response time of the operators are video-recorded and analyzed. According to the indexes system of International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), various errors in operation and their potential harms are sorted out. Based on the three-parameter Weibull model, the non-response probability model is deduced. The countermeasures to prevent accidents are worked out from view of human factor engineering. The results show that the model of human error in operation basing on HCR is available.

articleTitle: Watershed-Based Management of Lake Dianshan for Source Water Protection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The increasing pollution load played a key role in the water quality deterioration and eutrophication of Lake Dianshan. The results of pollution surveys of 1985, 1995 and 2006 showed that the inputs of nitrogen and phosphorus from upper stream origin from Lake Taihu were up to 7565.0 t and 401.0 t in 2006, respectively, accounting for more than 90% of the sum; nitrogen input from non-point source decreased by 13% to 252.6 t, and phosphorus multiplied 1.78 times to 23.3 t; the nutrient inputs from the point sources declined sharply from 1985 to 2006, and the emissions of nitrogen and phosphorus decreased from 103.0 t and 10.2 t to 8.0 t and 10.0 t, respectively; phosphorus from inner source was only 6.35 t. The analysis of the concentration of nitrogen, phosphorus and chlorophyll a indicated that eutrophication in Lake Dianshan was so high that the frequency of harmful algal blooming increased rapidly in recent years, which threatened the safety of water supply system of Shanghai. Beside the increasing pollution load, regional and stakeholder conflicts also challenged the lake management efficiency in this watershed. A sustainable lake management system was proposed in this study in order to reduce pollution load and solve the trans-boundary conflicts, including reducing point source pollution, adjusting the local economic structure and land use implementations, restoring the lakeshore buffer and setting up a new management mechanism with stakeholder involving.

articleTitle: A Robust Model for Airline Seat Allocation with Multiple Seat Bookings
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Airline seat allocation problem has been studied by many researchers. In this paper, we develop an airline seat allocation model with multiple bookings considering the uncertain passenger demand. Using the idea of robust optimization, we assume that the probability of every booking request from a certain fare class distributing in a symmetrical interval. And the total deviation of booking requests probabilities is assumed no larger than a known value in a given period. Then, the robust model of airline seat allocation with multiple seat bookings is presented. Moreover, the analysis and solution procedure of the proposed model and a numerical example are discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Internet-Based E-Government on Construction Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There are some problems in construction industry of China, especially the inefficient management and lack of supervision. According to National Informatization Development Strategy and in accordance with the current situation of e-government, the paper puts forward the internet-based e-government on construction industry, which will lead to the government process reengineering, more supervision and the improvement of the construction management.

articleTitle: Research of Environmental Governance in Beijing's Urban-Rural District
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the assertion that village infrastructure and sanitary services of urban-rural district are not entirely belong to public goods, the investment on this field should be made by the people who make profit through illegal construction, in addition to the governments and village collectives. The work should focus on improving the village infrastructure and sanitary services of urban-rural district, strengthening food supervision and health service of floating population, in order to provide the basic security and comfort to urban-rural people.

articleTitle: Analysis on Food Customer Satisfaction----Survey on the Beijing Customers of High-Grade Restaurants
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As one of the traditional service industries, catering industry is experiencing the important development period of brand extensions. Customer satisfaction affects corporation economic efficiency and competitiveness. The paper presents six factors impacting the customer satisfaction basing on the literature reviews and in-depth interviews with consumers. The questionnaire found that the restaurant property and customer interests and quality of the meal have significant correlation with customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: What Factors May Shape the Performance of ISO 9000: The Cases of Canada, France and U.S.A.
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A survey questionnaire was obtained from companies with ISO 9000 certification in Canada, France and U.S.A., and of these, Grounded in the technology--organization-environment (TOE) framework, we develop a research model for assessing the performance of ISO 9000 certification at the firm level. Our empirical analysis demonstrates several key findings: (1) Within the TOE framework, quality awareness emerges as the strongest factor for the value for ISO 9000, while external pressures, ISO 9000 process management, employee commitment and size also significantly contribute to ISO 9000 value. (2) External pressures often drives firms to adopt ISO 90000, but ISO 9000 value is associated more with quality awareness than with external pressures. (3) The impact of firm size on ISO 9000 performance is negative.

articleTitle: The Transformation and Thinking of Management Concept in Construction Industry Based on Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper, based on the theory of sustainable development, discusses the fact that construction industry management must be conducted under the guidance of sustainable theory in the current situation of socio-economic development. Construction industry should change management concept in the aspects of project management, technology innovation management, construction materials management, project risk management and so on. For the purpose of contributing to social sustainable development, the industry should use green energy-saving buildings as a breakthrough point and take the responsibility of promoting social development.

articleTitle: Customer Experience Management Models: Perspectives from Environment, Psychology and Strategy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With ever-increasing competition, service providers seek to achieve a competitive advantage by aggressively designing, continuously innovating, and managing their customer experiences. In this paper we provide an overview of the existing literature on customer experience management models to give Strategic guidance for experience management and further study. According to different research perspectives, we assort all the customer experience management models into three typologies: environmental school's models, psychological school's models and strategical school's models. Environmental school focuses on the designing and management of the environment to influence customer experience. Based on the perspective of psychology, psychological school develops the experience management models on the basis of customer's subjective perceptions. Strategical school considers customer experience management as one of the organization's strategy choice which will enhance the operation management systems guided by the principle of customer-experience-oriented. At last, this paper comments on the advantages and limitations of each school, and suggests the areas require further research.

articleTitle: Research on the Relationship between Knowledge Management Infrastructure, Knowledge Sharing and Knowledge Management Performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The main purpose of this paper is to investigate the effects of KM infrastructure on knowledge sharing and KM performance. Knowledge sharing is the center of KM, so we take knowledge sharing as a mediator variable in the impact of KM infrastructure on KM performance. Based on the survey of enterprises from IT and software industry in Pearl River Delta, this paper examined the relationship between KM infrastructure, knowledge sharing and KM performance. The results revealed that KM infrastructure positively and significantly influenced the knowledge sharing, and knowledge sharing was an important mediator between KM infrastructures and KM performance.

articleTitle: The Role and Duty of Survey Center in Large Bridge Construction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Large bridge construction is a system engineering, survey engineering is an important component. The different survey contents contain in every stage of large bridge construction, for example, foundation of control datum, construction survey, quality test, deformation monitoring and so on. A large number of survey design, field work, data processing, result analysis are contained too, a little mistake may exert a greet influence on bridge construction. Choosing higher survey intelligence unit and better professional personnel to form a management organization of survey center on behalf of bridge construction management department, exercising duty independently, such as survey management, supervision, adjustment, examination, analysis and control, the bridge construction smoothly can be ensured. In the construction of Nanjing second Yangtze river bridge and RunYang bridge as well as SuTong bridge, the survey center takes on large survey management work for bridge construction management department and solved some crucial survey problem, it has important role in the large bridge construction.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An Empirical Study on the Relationship between TMT Structural Characteristic and Performance--Based on Listed Companies of Energy Industry of China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Spatial Distribution and Variation of Heavy Metals and Metalloid in ZhuJi LiPu Copper Mining Area
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The spatial distribution and variation of six heavy metals and metalloid in soil of Zhuji Lipu copper mining area was studied using geostatistics approaches combined with GIS. These elements included Pb, As, Cr, Cu, Zn and Ni. The statistical analyses showed that concentrations of these elements were lognormal distribution. Concentrations of Pb, As, Cu, Zn and Ni were strongly correlated with each other indicating that these elements in soils may be from the same pollution source. However, accumulation of Cr was unique with its geometric mean being close to that in the control soil. This indicates that Cr content was mainly influenced by soil factors. The Kriging method was applied to estimate the unobserved points. The Kriging interpolation maps reflected significant spatial distribution of these elements as influenced by both pollution and geological factors. The present study indicated that GIS based geostatistics method could accurately analyze the spatial variation of heavy metals and metalloid in the mining area. Overall, higher concentrations of heavy metals and metalloid were found in the center of both the north and south sides. The content of copper in the south was significantly higher than that in the north due to paddy field land uses. In addition, the terrain of four terraces tilted to the center and the broad irrigation accident occurred in the 4th trench in the south of sampling area were also contributed to the higher concentrations of these elements.

articleTitle: The Analysis and Design of a Reusable Web Indicator Evaluation System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article gives the requirement, theory and common character of manage information system base on indicator evaluation system, by analyzing the system. Then according to the principal of designing the common indicator evaluation system, the analyzing and designing method of system are given. It can provide the more effective and reasonable method and reference of how to analyze and design the information system which has the same purpose.

articleTitle: Strategy for Investment Project Induced Resettlement in Ecologically Vulnerable Areas: Long-Acting Compensation Policy and Its Application to the HA Hydroelectric Station
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In an ecologically vulnerable area, due to the severe man-land conflict and ecological vulnerability, the traditional approach of "greater agricultural placement" to the construction of investment projects would make the resources and environment of this area unsustainable, thereby affecting the effectiveness of resettlement. Therefore, it is imperative to avoid resource and environmental restraints in ecologically vulnerable areas, and establish a long-acting compensation mechanism for development project induced involuntary resettlement. Taking the "HA Project" in southwest China as an example, this article introduces the long-acting compensation policy for involuntary resettlement in ecologically vulnerable areas, and analyzes the theoretical basis, characteristics, operating mechanism and deficiencies of the involuntary resettlement policy of this project. It is thought that the involuntary resettlement policy for ecologically vulnerable areas should address interactions between investment projects and the local social and economic aspects, promote the sustainable development of involuntary resettlement, and further harmonize the construction of investment projects with local society.

articleTitle: An Evolutionary Game Theoretic Perspective on Online Reverse Auctions
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper focuses on integrating of reverse auctions into the ongoing operation of firms and forming a long-term cooperative relationships between the suppliers and the buyers. Based on the theory of evolutionary economics and the game theory, we present the construction of the evolutionary game model in online reverse auctions. For illustration, an evolutionary phase diagram is utilized to show the effective of the model in analyzing the influential factors of the supply chain stability. Analytic results show that the buyers might promote supply chain integration by relatively increasing the fixed costs of bidding, giving some investments to the suppliers, and qualifying the multiple criteria of the suppliers. Besides, the marketing regulator should establish a punishment mechanism to prevent the opportunists from entering the ORA marketing. Those results can guard and lead the participants of reverse auctions, and inspire the buyers to design a more efficiency mechanism.

articleTitle: The Issue of Internet Virtual Currency Should Be Uniformly Issued by the Monetary Authorities--The Topic Raised and Finished by Levying Tax on Internet Virtual Transaction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Beginning with discussing about whether internet virtual currency exchange should be taxed, this paper indicates that the monetary authorities should uniformly issue internet virtual currency which is money rather than ordinary commodity. And there is a design of the implementation steps of internet virtual transaction tax at last.

articleTitle: System Dynamics Method Study of Seawater Intrusion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Seawater intrusion is a natural disaster, can cause significant influence on production and daily life of people in coastal regions, it impede economic development of coastal areas. In this paper, system dynamics method (SD) is applied to analyze the influence factors and their causality of seawater intuition. The factors of seawater intrusion are divided into two sub-systems: the natural and human activities. The use of water resource is determined as main line of this study and the scheme of the influence factors' causality are built around this main line. Water resource exploitation affected by water consumption of human beings, as well as the amount of treated water supply, it further act on seawater intrusion. This study lay the foundation for the quantitative research by the system dynamics method.

articleTitle: Management of Agricultural Pollution in China: Current Status and International Experience
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nonpoint source pollution from agricultural and rural regions which are mainly from fertilization of cropland, excessive livestock and poultry breeding and undefined disposal of daily living wastes in rural areas is the leading source of water pollution in China, but they are ignored in management strategy and policy. And because that agricultural nonpoint source pollution will become one of the biggest challenges to the sustainable development of rural areas and to society as a whole. The system for agricultural nonpoint source pollution control in China should include an appropriate. According to international experience of protecting pollution, economical method might be a better path for decreasing the nonpoint source, for example, point-nonpoint trading program. This article further discusses the determinant factors and its rule of the trading ratio, especially the trading ratio's effectiveness under both condition of disregulation and regulation. So it is might be a good path in the future that Chinese authorities strength to process the economic path to control the nonpoint source and then obtain a sustainable development as a whole.

articleTitle: Study on the Supply Mode Selection of Water Transfer Projects Based on Water Right Quality
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The supply mode selection of water transfer projects is closely correlative with water right quality. This paper firstly proposed the concept of water right quality in water transfer project, and set up its quantitative model from the view of economy. Then the quantitative boundaries between the three kinds of supply modes, which are government supply mode, public-private partnership supply mode and private supply mode respectively, are given based on water right quality. Finally, according to the boundaries, water transfer projects are classified into three types correspondingly, and the supply scopes and investment duties of the public sectors and the private sectors in different types of water transfer projects are further discussed. The conclusions of this paper have some guiding significance in practice.

articleTitle: Assessment of Sustainable Management Level for International River under Non-Traditional Threats
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The non-traditional threats of International River are mainly on ecological and resource security threats. For sakes of sustainable management, one of major tasks of International River Management should be focus on how to assess the river health. However, international river has its own characteristics, like the diversity of interest bodies leads handle international river problems usually a little one-sidedness while the water resource is a integrate unit. This paper clarified the status quo of sustainable management for International River under non-traditional threats, then designed a index to assess the international river sustainable management level which took the international relationship as crucial sub-indexes, lastly analysis the key technologies to realize the evaluation system.

articleTitle: Agent-Based User Knowledge Management in Intelligent Tutoring Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A formal model of agent-based user knowledge management in intelligent tutoring systems is presented in this paper. It consists of an interaction agent and a coginitive agent. The interaction agent not only interacts with new users and gets their personal information for identification, but records interaction information of a user with intelligent tutoring systems. The cognitive agent is responsible for recording cognitive information concerning a user which is vital for the system's user-adapted operation. These two kinds of agents work together to construct user knowledge bases. After given the formalisms of the above two kinds of agents, the formal model of agent-based user knowledge management is presented, and the building and updating of user knowledge bases is discussed in detail to show that the model is practicable.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Evolution Process of Typical International Cooperation System and the Inspiration to Energy Cooperation in Northeast Asia
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Energy cooperation system is a complex system, and its evolution process is accordance with the evolution law of complex system. In the paper, first we analyze the evolution process and the running mechanism of the typical international cooperation systems and got the inspiration to the energy cooperation in Northeast Asia, that is, economic benefits is the basis of cooperation; the evolution process is from the enterprises' cooperation to industries' cooperation and then to the nations' cooperation; we should choose technical cooperation as the breakthrough point, and cooperate within energy industry chain; at last of the paper, we designed the energy cooperation mechanism in Northeast Asia.

articleTitle: The Relationships among Organizational Commitment and Job Performance of Aromatherapist: A Case Study of Day Spa in Taipei
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the growing pursuit of leisure and health in life, the goods and services of the traditional beauty industry produce a great impact due to the aromatherapy has different levels of approach to cosmetology and health protection. In response to the typical industrial styles of aesthetic economy and experience economy times, Spa industry not only requires high-quality service system, but also relies on the aromatherapist to provide the skills of cure for body and soul. The professional performance of aromatherapist is the core competence for establishing the brand image. It is different from the traditional beauty industry which is performance-oriented for job performance. aromatherapist must bear a high degree of physical and mental labor. In addition to providing technical services, they also have to meet the customers' demands for the knowledge of commodities in a consultative way. Behind these reasons, the higher work threshold, adaptation and movement of persons have become the major problems for the Spa industry. This research discusses the diversity of organizational commitment of aromatherapist with different background, and analyses the relationships among their organizational commitment and job performance. The presented result may serve as a reference for aromatherapy organization in developing human resource management and development. The population of research is the Spa aromatherapist in Taipei city. Of the 300 questionnaires the researcher took out 198 responded which is with the response rate of 66%. All the data for this research was analyzed by using the methods of t-test, product-moment correlation, and multiple regression analyses. The results indicate that there is a significant relationship between the aspects of organizational commitment and job performance for aromatherapist. The degrees of organizational commitment of aromatherapist whose ages up to 31 is higher than the age less than 30 has significant difference in the aspects of retention commitment; the aspects of citizen morality in job performance also show the significant differences. The degrees of organizational commitment of aromatherapist with different backgrounds have significant differences in the aspects of value commitment and effort commitment; the aromatherapist whose education background is college level above the high school level. In addition, the overall aspects in organizational commitment could forecast the job performance.

articleTitle: Study on the Innovation Integration-Model of Vertical RJVs under the Industry Value Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There is a value chain in the enterprise and between enterprises. Under the industry value chain, this paper advocates to integrate the loosely R&D resources of the upstream and downstream enterprises with the establishment of research joint ventures (RJVs). By building mathematical model, the paper analyzes three different kinds of benefits: the upstream enterprise without R&D, the upstream enterprise with an independent R&D and the vertical RJVs between the upstream and downstream enterprises. It points out two important factors to affect the profit of RJVS, the decline in the marginal cost and the number of cooperative downstream enterprises. And the intrinsic motivation of the downstream enterprises to participate in the vertical RJVs is also described.

articleTitle: Construction of Risk Management Construction-Agent Model Based on Factor Analysis-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the basis of the risk evaluation index system used for the decomposition of a governmental project of Construction-Agent work, this article proposes to establish a Construction-Agent project risk assessment model based on factor analysis-BP neural network and points out the basic ideas and steps of model-building after analyzing the strengthens and weaknesses of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model commonly used for risk management.

articleTitle: Reactive Strategies for Supply Disruption Management: Backordering vs. Upgrading
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This research examines two reactive strategies for supply disruption. We consider an assemble-to-order system with two substitute products where the demand is price-sensitive and time-sensitive. We propose and compare the performance of two strategies for managing supply disruption, namely, the backordering strategy and the upgrading strategy. We find that the upgrading strategy is superior to the backordering strategy at the beginning of the disruption in the system with high time-sensitive demand and high upgrading value. And the backordering strategy is usually superior to the upgrading strategy at the end of the disruption in the system with low upgrading value.

articleTitle: A Study on the Development of Non-Market Strategy in China and Its Revelation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study summarizes the Non-market Strategy researches of Chinese scholars, including Non-market strategy, Political action, and Political strategy. We conclude the types of the Non-market strategy, decision process, impact factors, function of enterprisers and their effect on performance, as well as the researches on improving corporate validity and performance through integration between Market and Non-market strategy. Based on the Chinese political environment, the Non-market strategy behavior of Chinese enterprises is different from that of western enterprises, which is the direction of future research.

articleTitle: A Queuing Network Stochastic Programming for Berth Planning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The efficient performance of port production operation requires shorten the ships' queuing time in port. Furthermore, promote the port throughput capacity and the performance level of the whole supply chain. In this paper, we use the theory of queuing combining with the berth allocation rules with stochastic Programming in the port. Set up queuing models for berth assignment for different types of ships and berths. Then according to the models we propose the special plan's performance in some conditions and discuss the different effects under different plans receptively.

articleTitle: Research on Factors Affect on Insurance Industry in China Based on Fuzzy-ANP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As "sunrise industry", insurance industry has broad space for development in China. The purpose of this paper is to provide an effective method for analyzing the factors which affect insurance industry in China. We use analytic network process (ANP) when considering the feedback and the relations between those factors. It is difficult for people to provide exact numerical values for the factors. Fuzzy-ANP was used to deal with complexity in assessing insurance industry performance.

articleTitle: A Method to Calculate the Collision Risk on Air-Route
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to improve the airspace transportation service and management capabilities, the airspace planning is very effective measure. The evaluation of safety is an important step in the design of air-route and is a key element in the specification of separation standards. In this paper, Collision risk model of air-route based on the variable nominal separation is given. In contrast to the most existing route collision risk models that are suitable for the invariable nominal separation between two aircraft, the collision risk model of variable nominal separation between two aircraft that are flying with different speed is researched. The expression of collision probability of the two aircraft at the any time on the air-route is given and then the number of fatal accidents per flight hour is given. The results show that the model characterizes the collision risk well based on the variable normal separation and the number of fatal accidents per flight hour of any flight segment can be calculated. These will provide the method and theory to research the safety and management in airspace.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Urbanization Way in Wuhan City Zone
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: While the goal of emissions reduction is widely accepted, the ways and means of achieving low-carbon in urbanization are still being debated, created and tested. The paper makes research on the background of low-carbon urban and draw up its planning strategy for Wuhan City Zone (WCZ).

articleTitle: Work-Family Conflict and Job Satisfaction: A Study Based on Multidimensional Measures
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The relation between work-family conflict (WFC) and job satisfaction was examined using a six-dimensional measure of WFC and a nine-facets measure of job satisfaction. Data were collected from 166 frontline employees in a manufacturing company in China. The results supported the negative correlation between WFC and job satisfaction. And the relation between WFC dimensions and facets of job satisfaction provided a finer-grained understanding of the relationship between them.

articleTitle: The Inspiration of Intellectual Property of Foreign Automobile Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyses the intellectual property strategy of America, Japan and Germany. Based on the description of the shortcomings of the intellectual property of the domestic automobile enterprises, some useful measures to enhance the construction of intellectual property of the domestic automobile enterprises are proposed.

articleTitle: The Type of Private Listed Firms, Political Connections and Market Valuation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A new measure of enterprise efficiency by using a stochastic frontier approach is introduced to estimate the production efficiencies of private listed firms in China in the period of 2002~2005. This paper investigates the relationship among the type of private listed firms, political connections and market valuation. The results show that, the direct listed private firms have significantly greater political connections and higher market valuation than indirect listed private firms; political connections of direct listed firms have no influence on the market valuation, but the political connections of indirect listed firms have significantly negative effect on the market valuation.

articleTitle: On the Employment of CNT in College PE Class
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The continual development and improvement of CNT (computer networking technology) provides college PE class with new power and technological support. Through studying the characteristics of CNT, together with studying teaching contents, teaching methods, teaching evaluation and teaching administration of college PE class, the employment of CNT in college PE class is analyzed and explored. It is aimed at improving college students' comprehensive sports quality, at promoting college PE teaching reform and at improving the teaching quality.

articleTitle: Cultural Differences and Performance: An Empirical Research on International Joint Ventures in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on data from 107 joint ventures between Chinese partners and partners from other countries, this paper distinguishes the varied effects of national and organizational culture differences on joint venture performance. Especially, this study explores their indirect relationship through behavioral process.

articleTitle: Trends of Climate Change on Mt. Gongga and Its Impacts on Tourism Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The objective of this study was to identify the trends of climate change on the eastern slope of Gongga Mountain and its impacts on tourism development. According to the weather data of Gongga Mountain Ecological Observation Station, climate has become warmer at 3000m of the Gongga Mountain (eastern slope) since 1988. The warming trend was 0.15°C per decade. The rise of temperature occurred in winters and springs, while cooling summers appeared. In addition, the east slope of Mt. Gongga has become wetter for the increase of precipitation and decrease of evaporation. The Hailuogou glacier, an indicator of climate change, has strongly retreated. There were many direct and indirect impacts of climate change on tourism at Gongga Mountain. They were mainly reflected in: (1) Plant phenology tended to change in spring and autumn, i.e., early flowering in spring and late leaves coloring and losing in autumn. The change of vegetation landscapes might influence best timing to enjoy them; (2) The quality of glacial landscape degraded with climate warming; (3) The optimal tourism season would range from March to November instead of the present April to October; (4) Monthly person visit tended to increase with the rise of monthly mean temperature.

articleTitle: Joint Decision of Pricing and Package Coupon Value
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We assume the retailers strive for the maximization of profits, and this paper talks about three kinds of package coupon, and focus on the optimal decision of coupons face value and product prices for each kind of them on the two strategies which is differential pricing and uniform pricing. We get a result that the profit of using coupon offer is higher than without-a-coupon offer, and the retailers who choose differential pricing will get more profits, besides we achieve the different joint pricing decisions of differential pricing for each kind of coupon. At the end of this paper, we compare the three coupons integrated, and find out the best offering mode and the best pricing decision corresponding.

articleTitle: Construction Bidding Negotiation System Based on Agent
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By means of simulating the real process of invite public bidding, this paper designs a system for construction bidding based on agent, and puts forward a multi-agent model of negotiation based on genetic algorithm. It shows the negotiation strategy by using the concept of "sequence of negotiation offer threshold", and provides an improving algorithm structure of the genetic operation in the flow chart to optimize the sequence of negotiation offer threshold. The negotiation model changes tender's unilateral-led situation, ensures equal status, and provides more negotiated space. It makes the bidding negotiation get an agreement in a short time, with the results have a win-win situation. Therefore, the system realizes the efficiency, fairness and scientific. It suggests a new idea to achieve the electronic and intelligent bidding.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Basic Perspective for Analyzing Production Safety Management in SMEs: Evaluation of the Value of Life
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on Environmental Pollution Cost in Highway Construction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Environmental issues caused by highway construction need to be evaluated as its environmental cost to minimize environmental impact in highway construction. The environmental impacts in highway construction include environmental pollution and environmental damage as well as environmental cost is comprised of environmental pollution cost and environmental damage cost. Based on the theory of Environmental Economics and the literatures and experts on highway construction, this paper developed a questionnaire to establish environmental pollution cost indicators of highway construction. Based on empirical results, we identified key factors of environmental cost based on exploratory factor analysis. Further, we factor weights were determined through contribution rates and indicator weights on each factor through confirmatory factor analysis. In the end, we developed an indicator system on environmental costs of highway construction based on Hierarchy Process Analysis and got final weights of each indicator.
