articleTitle: Study on the Industrial Structure and Decision Model of Industrial Scale of the Eco-Industrial Chain in Mining Area
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Eco-industrial chain in mining area is divided into production eco-industrial chain, surplus eco-industrial chain and energy eco-industrial chain, and the paper points out that the structure of eco-industry in mining area is made up of precursor industry, transmission industry and bottom industry. Based on above research, the four on-link modes of eco-industry in mining area have been constructed creatively and the structural characteristics of eco-industrial chain in mining area have been described systematically. Multi-objective Linear Optimal Model is set up based on industrial scale optimization of eco-industrial chain in mining area. The paper also puts forward some measures to take.

articleTitle: Study on Management of Construction Joint Venture
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, the tender by the forms of construction joint venture are more and more widely used in some domestic large-scale or complex structure of the bidding for construction projects. This paper analyzed the advantages of contracting by construction joint venture. Based on the current status of the development of China's construction joint venture, the problems were explored, and constructive suggestions to promote the current healthy development of China's construction joint venture were put forward.

articleTitle: Technical Changes of Listed Companies in Chinese Electronic Industry Based on DEA-Malmquist Index's New Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Data envelopment analysis (DEA) measures the relative efficiency of decision making units (DMUs) with multiple inputs and multiple outputs. DEA-based Malmquist productivity index measures the productivity change over time. The Malmquist productivity index based on DEA can be decomposed into two components: efficiency change index and technical change index. Through utilizing the principle of isoquant, it can not only be gained that the management information of each component included in technical change index, but judge whether the trends of technical change of DMUs are favorable or not through decomposing the technical change index. Then an empirical analysis was made to illustrate this thought by taking 15 listed companies in electronic industry for example, results of which implicated that as a whole electronic industry had a favorable trend of technical change during evaluated period.

articleTitle: Research on the Functioning Mechanism of Knowledge Intensive Business Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of the knowledge economy, knowledge-intensive business service (KIBS) becomes the important part of the knowledge infrastructure of the society. It has not only represented the multi-functions as fundamental knowledge production and reallocation, but also has a significant stimulated power for the other industries in the national economy. KIBS plays an important role in the national innovation system and economic development through the driving mechanism constructed by following aspects as knowledge share and transmission mechanism, interaction with customer enterprises mechanism, economic growth facilitating mechanism, etc. This paper aims to illustrate the principle and mechanism of innovation enhancement driven by KIBS in the national innovation system based on above three aspects. The three types of mechanisms also interact with each other to compose an integrated and complicated large system, under which KIBS is able to play a key important role in regional innovation and economic development.

articleTitle: Material Requirements Development Based on War Design Engineering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on analyzing the characteristics of material requirements, this paper puts forward the main challenge for material requirements development. The challenge is that there is no exactly future battle modality, but we have to predict battle modality in the future. Aimed at the above problem, a requirements development mechanism driven by a military mission, under a scenario of the future war, by the antagonism seminar of experts belonging to different realms is presented. Finally, material requirements development method based on Seminar Game of War Design Engineering is proposed.

articleTitle: Stock Repurchase Motivation and Effect of Signaling: A Comparative Analysis between U.S. and China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper compares different methods used for stock repurchase and examines the role of signaling in the U.S. and Chinese capital markets. We find that the ways to buyback stocks are very difference in two countries. Most U.S. stocks are repurchased through open market and the signal sent to the market through open market repurchase is getting weaker. Even though stock repurchase is at its early stage in the Chinese stock market and the dominated way to buyback is through a negotiated repurchase agreement for non-floating shares, the power of signaling seems much stronger. Examining stock prices pre- and post-repurchase, we find that stock repurchase records an average abnormal return of 3.42% on the announcement date and 3.24% on the date of actual repurchase.

articleTitle: E-mail System Based on Dynamic Password and Fingerprint Recognition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we have designed a high-security e-mail system using dynamic password and fingerprint recognition to solve the shortages of traditional system. In order to guarantee the security of users' fingerprint characteristic value, we encrypt it with dynamic password. Using a two-way authentication method, not only ensure authentication server can recognize the users, but also guarantee the users can verify authentication server, effectively prevent e-mail from counterfeiting and tampering.

articleTitle: Matter-Human-Affair 3 Principles' Harmony: An Empirical Study of the Water-Soil Conservation in Loess Plateau
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Earth is actually a system of everything on it and the relationships among them, which could be group into matter, human and affair where principles lie in. The harmony among them is absolutely necessary for the co-sustainability. When dealing with the complex geographic problems, the 3 principles should be all taken into account and the harmony worked for. Herewith the 3 concepts of "Matter -human-affair" principles have been defined and the relationship between the "3 Principles' Harmony" and the complex geographical questions discussed. Taking the research of the water-soil conservation in Loess Plateau as an example, the targets and requests of the "3 Principles' Harmony" in the research of complex geographic questions have been explained. As the scientific ideas transformed into the philosophic notions, the corresponding relationships between the "principles of matter", "principles of human", "principles of affair" and "as is", "ought to", "to do" have been described; The "3 Principles' Harmony" is regarded as the fruitful approach to completing the 3 missions of understanding, determining and reforming the world. The idea and methodology might help integrate natural sciences, social sciences and technologies as well as perceive the 3 principles whilst solving the complex questions.

articleTitle: Research on Indemnificatory Housing: A Case of Wuhan City
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: China's housing policy has entered the monetization stage and forms a relatively stable housing supply system to meet the housing needs of different income groups. In order to improve the housing needy households especially for low-income families, the construction of indemnificatory housing is sped up. Indemnificatory housing consists of low-rent housing, affordable housing and policy-regulated rental housing. Based on analyzing the relevant data in Wuhan, this paper clarifies the indemnificatory housing status of Wuhan and sums up the problems.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Environmental Accounting Information Disclosure Throwing Daylight on Relating Problems in Quoted Companies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of economy, human beings have been doing more and more damage to the environment. So the disclosure of the environment and the environmental accounting information is more and more important. This essay puts the environmental accounting information disclosure in quoted companies as the theme. And it emphasizes researching on the contents and style of it. At the same time, combining with the present situation of the environmental accounting information disclosure in quoted companies, some advice has been put forward, trying to build a pattern of the environmental accounting information disclosure that is suitable for our national circumstances, accelerating and improving the environmental accounting information disclosure in enterprises, strengthening the protection of the environment, and achieving the sustainable development of China's economy.

articleTitle: China State-Owned Overseas Corporation's Optimal Corporate Governance Based on Double Principal-Agency Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article essentially thinks the western traditional principal-agent theory is a kind of corporate governance theory aimed at the companies with the main character of diversified equity. Obviously it is not fit for being used as the analysis framework of the governance problem of the companies with the main character of the relatively concentrated equity or highly concentrated equity. For that matter, the article indicates that, for the companies with the main character of the relatively concentrated equity or highly concentrated equity, the explaining power of double principal-agent theory is stronger. In other words, it is more favorable to reduce the double agency costs of those companies and realize the maximization of all the stockholders' interest of the companies. This article, finally, discusses how to further perfect the corporate governance of Chinese state-owned overseas companies based on the double principal-agent theory.

articleTitle: Research on the Building of Jiangsu Energy Meteorological Service System Engineering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Energy resource is an important cutting-edge problem being concerned about in the international society. Energy conservation and emission reduction, clean energy and alternative energy development are closely related to meteorological service. Based on the service ideas of system engineering and the development and utilization trends of Jiangsu wind, solar and nuclear energy and the status of meteorological service, Jiangsu energy meteorological service system is built, the system framework and business processes of the energy meteorological service are researched, and the research is of theoretical and practical significance in response to the climate change, weather proof disaster preparedness and mitigation and the energy crisis.

articleTitle: Grid-Based Encoding QR-Tree K-NN Query
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: K neighbor search algorithm has a very wide application in complex surface of a large amount of data, aiming at the broad and irregular nature of mass data, this paper will use QR-tree index structure, in accordance with full octree encoding method to code each node, in accordance with the location relationship to establish grid, and nodes intersecting with horizontal and vertical lines are also involved in coding. When find the K-neighbor of a node in the QR-tree, it needs to find the corresponding grid units. Because the attached nature of the data object to the grid not only reflects the positioning in space, but also at the same time describes the relationship location between objects and other objects through the adjacency relationship between the grids, it can quickly find the nearest neighbor points, avoiding the complexity of previous traverse from the root node, raising the query efficiency, reducing the CPU running time and disk visits.

articleTitle: Consumer Attitude Towards Computer Mediated Communication-A Cross-Cultural Study
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Past research suggests that compared to face-to-face (FFC) contact, computer-mediated communication (CMC) is less effective in building trust. Yet there has been little research of cultural differences regarding the role of FFC and CMC in building trust. A study between Chinese and Australian subjects found that eastern cultures (featured by China) and western cultures (featured by Australia) differed significantly on their perceptions of the effect of communication richness towards FFC and CMC on trust building. The Chinese subjects believe more strongly that FFC's advantage of providing rich information has a significant effect on trust building. This paper closes with implications on e-commerce and future research.

articleTitle: A Study of Factors Influencing Customers' Online Shopping Behavior Based on ANP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This research explores which factors affect the online shopping behavior of Internet customer. This paper adopts the Analytic Network Process (ANP) as the main analytical tool. ANP was an effective method for considering the feed back and the relations between factors. The research results point out that the security of network transactions was the most important factors for customer's online shopping.

articleTitle: Thinking about Enterprises Transformation under Knowledge Economy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Facing intense competition increasingly, traditional industries regularly step in the declining period after the long term development. To get further more enterprise development, the only way for traditional enterprises is transformation, which has been imperative. Now, many enterprises has already carried on the exploration in practices. Based on the analysis of enterprise status, thinking about the enterprises transformation problem. This paper analyzes the obstacles for transformation and then propose that enterprise transformation task could be undertaken by knowledge enterprises or enterprise transformed from traditional enterprises and important way is to establish the knowledge enterprise to complete this task, the breakthrough point is producer service, and by adopting electronic commerce, knowledge management etc. to realize.

articleTitle: An Influence of U.S. and U.K. Stock Market Returns for Two Stock Markets: An Evidence Case by Singapore and Japan's Stock Markets
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The empirical results show that the dynamic conditional correlation (DCC) and the bivariate IGARCH (1, 1) model is appropriate in evaluating the relationship of the Singapore and the Japan's stock markets. The empirical result also indicates that the Singapore and the Japan's stock markets is a positive relation. The average estimation value of correlation coefficient equals to 0.495, which implies that the two stock markets is synchronized influence. Besides, the empirical result also shows that the Singapore's and Japan's stock markets do not have the asymmetrical effect. The return volatility of the Singapore and Japan's stock markets receives the influence of the U.S. and the U.K. return volatility rates. The square item of U.S. and U.K. stock market returns affects the variation risk of the Singapore's stock market. And the square item of U.S. stock market returns also affects the variation risk of the Japan's stock market.

articleTitle: The Study of Learning Type Strategic Alliance Construction Based on Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the advent of knowledge economy era, knowledge has becoming one of the most important resource for the community and then the building of a learning type society have become the mainstream of times. Learning type Community is cells of learning-based society.But the learning type community as the basis of learning type society encounter a lot of difficulties in the building process.that how to find the breakthrough become the key to the solution.The communities are unable to do it alone that Creating learning type community.therefore,the thing that higher education participating in the learning type community through the construction of learning alliance have important practical significance for the building of learning type society.

articleTitle: A Theoretical Model for Enterprises' Innovation Capability Assessing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To meet the challenge of knowledge-based economy in the 21st century, scientifically evaluating the innovation capability is important to strengthening the international competence and acquiring long-term competitive advantage for Chinese enterprises. In the article, based on the description of concept and structure of enterprise's innovation capability, the evaluation index system of innovation capability is established according to AHP. In succession, evaluation model based on BP neural network is put forward. which provide some theoretic guidance to scientifically evaluating the innovation capability of Chinese enterprises.

articleTitle: Functional Coefficients Regression Model for Security Pricing with Heterogeneous Beliefs: Application in Chinese Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A bivariate functional coefficients regression model for characterizing dynamics of security price is presented in this paper to reflect the feature of real financial market that is presence of repelling and mingling of different opinions amongst traders. The local polynomial regression approach is adopted to estimate the functional coefficients resulting from bayesian updating mechanism. After applying this model to Chinese stock market, three effects from heterogeneous beliefs are filtered , which could help investors to analyze the structure of market. Moreover, it is also tested that this model outperforms the constant coefficients regression model for out-of-smaple one-step ahead price prediction.

articleTitle: Advantages, Disadvantages of E-Business & Major E-Business Market Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has analyzed advantages, disadvantages of electronic business as well as advantages, disadvantages of major E-Business market mechanisms, which include non-technical aspects and technical aspects. Finally, this article give some suggestions on how to overcome these disadvantages.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Application of Enterprise's Sustainable Innovation Motivation Based on the Main Constituents Projection Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Only the enterprises that introduce new technical innovation projects continually can enhance the core competitive capability, and the innovation motivation is the key factor to realize enterprise's sustainable innovation, hence it's important to study how to measure and evaluate enterprise's sustainable innovation motivation. Based on this, the paper design the model of enterprise's sustainable innovation motivation from the perspective of the main constituents projection method, and take Yunnan Baiyao Group Ltd, Lenovo Group Ltd and Huawei Co as cases to analyze, finally arrive at the conclusions and put forward the suggestions.

articleTitle: Efficiency Assessment of Chinese Commercial Banks Based on Interval DEA-DA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Financial indicators are most able to reflect operation efficiency of commercial banks, for which anything others are no competition. And indicators from solely certain one quarter or one year are biased and not representative. So we use imprecise data instead of crisp data, applying interval DEA-DA for efficiency assessment. According to index structure proposed, we finally achieved results of discriminant analysis.

articleTitle: A Research on the Effect Evaluation System of Knowledge Exchanging and Sharing in Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The knowledge exchanging and sharing in enterprise acts an important role in enterprise knowledge management, and the effective knowledge exchanging and sharing is an important guarantee of the enterprise knowledge application and knowledge innovation. Through the analyses on six factors that affect enterprise knowledge exchanging and sharing include the tacit degrees of knowledge itself, the ability of the knowledge sender and receiver, the similarity degree of the knowledge sender and receiver, knowledge exchanging means and knowledge exchanging environment, the effect evaluation systems of knowledge exchanging and sharing in enterprise are constructed and analyzed in this paper.

articleTitle: The Puzzle of Low R&D Efficiency: As a Result of Research Capacity or Marketing Capacity?
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: By the way of analyzing the process of R&D activities, we propose that R&D efficiency should be separated into two parts: research efficiency and marketing efficiency both of which are crucial to success of R&D activities. In the light of this idea, this paper received some new findings from empirical study on R&D efficiency of private technological enterprises in Guangdong province. Production ability of research fruits (research capacity) is not weak, not as we imagined; actually, speed of marketization of research fruits (marketing capacity) is just "bottleneck" of R&D efficiency.

articleTitle: Knowledge Dissemination on Community Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we examine the knowledge transfer process on community networks by analyzing the average knowledge level as a function of the agent's absorptive capacity. It is found that the average knowledge level decreases with the increment of inner-community links and the decreases of inter-community links when we keep the total links (including inner-community and inter-community links) constant. It is also shown that as for inner-community (inter-community) links unvaried, the increment of inter-community (inner-community) will promote average knowledge level.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Preventing and Controlling of the Final Account Dispute on the Tendering Stage of the Construction Project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Visualization of New Institutional Economics: Subject Coverage and Core Theories
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: New institutional economics is a new economic school which grows rapidly in the twentieth century. CiteSpaceII visualization technique was applied to make co-citation networks in terms of bibliographic data results of papers, retrieved from Web of Science between 1900 and 2009, on new institutional economics. Information visualization was employed to identify the whole scene of new institutional economics through the quantitative analysis of Scientometrics, including subject coverage and core theories. It is shown that economics, environmental studies, planning & development, environmental sciences are the focuses among all the subjects with the high centrality and burst value in resent years. Moreover, transaction costs, property rights and institutional change emerge from the core articles in the document co-citation network.

articleTitle: Study on Logistic-Distributed Standards Based on AHP for Electrical Household Appliances Chain Enterprises--Taking Zhejiang Xinlianxin Electric Appliances Chain Supermarket as an Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper analyses the main logistic-distributed standards and their effect factors for electrical household appliances chain enterprises, forming the judging framework for it with AHP. The framework gets great application in Zhejiang Xinlianxin Electric Appliances Chain Supermarket. It then concludes that Xinlianxin should choose the self -distributed standard, but it can also take the third-party logistic-distributed standard, which conforms to the present distributed way for the enterprise.

articleTitle: Research on the Coordination Degree of Beijing's Economic and Environmental Subsystem
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the analysis of relation between urban economic and environmental subsystem, the article puts forward the concept of the coordination degree of economic and environmental subsystem and its calculation. Then according to Beijing's historical data, its coordination degree is calculated. The analysis and calculation indicates that although the order degree of urban economic subsystem's development is comparatively higher and remains a steady upward trend, the overall coordination degree of Beijing is quite low for the development of the environmental subsystem presents a disordered state.

articleTitle: Integration Environment of Test Bed for C2 Organization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper provides three major contributions. First, motivated by the need for a network of intelligent agents within C2 experimental settings, a brief overview of modeling techniques for the design of a network of C2 role agents and integration environment of test bed for C2 organization are provided. Second, techniques for modeling the decision-making processes of C2 role agents in task selection and resource allocation settings are presented. Third, the congruence model of organizational behavior is advanced, which is based on the degree to which different components of the organization fit together. And also quantify the performance of an organization based on this model.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Synthetic Evaluation of Enterprise Culture to the Supporting Degree of Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Traditional culture is a kind of "defective" culture. It only pays great attention to "conduct oneself", rather than to "conduct practice", fails to organically unify both. For an enterprise, the traditional culture is always expressed by such phenomenon, for instance, be afraid of innovation、suppress the new idea、neglect the innovation or not pay enough attention to it, etc. At last it will form the enterprise culture which hinders the development of enterprise innovation. The enterprise cultural factors have been appraised through fuzzy evaluation method in this paper to improve the culture construction and form the culture atmosphere that favorable to innovation.

articleTitle: A Multi-Agent Based Bidding System in VCIM Using Fuzzy AHP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Virtual CIM is the new concept to extend the Computer Integrated Manufacturing (CIM) system to a much wider scope. The traditional CIM systems can only deploy within an enterprise. VCIM break the barrier so that all manufacturing resources from different entities in different locations can be integrated and work together. It is especially helpful to Small to Medium Manufacturing Enterprises (SMMEs) as their resources are often limited and need intensive competition in the globalized market. In this paper, the limitations of current agent-based VCIM for SMMEs will be analyzed. A Multi-Agent based bidding System will be proposed as possible solution to address those limitations. Fuzzy AHP selection will also be briefly introduced to support the proposed system architecture.

articleTitle: The Dynamic Demand Model of China's Foreign Exchange Reserves
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies the demand for China's foreign exchange reserves. Previous research using econometric models in this area has a common problem that demand was replaced by the actual holdings, namely, assuming foreign exchange reserves achieve equilibrium at any time. In order to avoid the problem, the current study builds a dynamic demand model of China's foreign exchange reserves by the method of disequilibrium. Through the empirical analysis using the data from 1978 to 2007, we find that the scale of China's foreign exchange reserves are determined by gross domestic product (GDP), the dependence on foreign trade and investment rate. GDP and the dependence on foreign trade have a positive impact on China's foreign exchange reserves while investment rate has a negative impact. Furthermore, according to the dynamic demand model, we estimate the speed of the dynamic adjustment of China's foreign exchange reserves.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the Policy Implementation of the Government's Infrastructure Construction in Rural Areas: Based on the Theory of Value Engineering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since 2004, the central No.1 document has focused on issues concerning agriculture rural areas and peasantry for six years, Government has put emphasis on the agriculture more than ever before since the founding of PRC. In this year, the economic crisis has given a heavy blow to many countries in the world including China, and this made the world economy even worse. Governments have taken all the positive actions so that their economies are able to get through the difficulties. In response to the crisis Chinese government has introduced a lot of subsidy policies to benefit people especially to the agriculture, rural areas and peasantry. In this article, policy evaluation is expressed in the quantitative way instead of empty words, and gains and losses on the implementation of the government's infrastructure construction in rural areas are given rational assessment.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on Impact of Small and Medium Board Listed Companies Performance before and after Non-Tradable Share Reform------ An Empirical Study of Chinese Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Analysis on Two Principal Axes Shear Strength of Columns with Different Stirrup Quantity
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Reinforced concrete frame columns are critical load bearing structure members, once the damages occur, a certain part even the entire structure will get major destructed and lost, and if things go seriously, the collapse of whole structure will happen. The reinforced concrete frame columns, being applied in the field, often subject to lateral bevel loads, therefore causing biaxial bending and bilateral shearing in sections. By experiment and research, reinforced concrete frame columns with different amount of stirrups in two principal axes were studied by the method of quasi-static test, this paper obtained hysteresis curve, skeleton curve, ductility coefficient and failure mechanism of the reinforced concrete frame columns, providing reliable theoretical basis for the design of reinforced concrete frame columns.

articleTitle: Study of EPC Project Risk Management Based on Interrelated Tree Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper expounds the basic content of Interrelated Tree Method, and builds the Interrelated Tree model of EPC project risk management; On this basis, the paper makes a risk list with the combining methods of qualitative and quantitative analysis and through the prediction and identification of the risk in the EPC project's whole process, and sets up risk assessment index system of all stages of the EPC project; By using Interrelated Tree Method, this paper analyzes and evaluates the risk in the EPC project's whole process; and this paper explores effective methods and approaches for EPC project risk management.

articleTitle: A New Set of Social Benefit Evaluation Parameters for Underground Road Project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is an inevitable trend that more and more urban underground roads will be built in many big cities in order to solve traffic congestion problems. The underground roads can not only solve traffic problems on ground roads, increase vehicles operating speeds, save a lot of time for passengers and goods on the way, but also reduce the air and noise pollutions, save land use and advance cities continual development. The evaluation on indirect benefit of underground road system is quite different from ground road system on both impact factors and estimation contents. A new set of social benefits evaluation parameters for underground road projects is provided in this paper in order to distinguish feasibility of underground road projects.

articleTitle: The Study of Vector Angle Cosine Model Used for Project Bids Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the review of the traditional methods for evaluating bids in project, this paper analyzed the advantages and disadvantages of four types of traditional evaluation methods. From this, detailed the principles and specific steps of the project bids evaluation model, which is based on the victor angle cosine model. On the basis of these, used the numerical example to analyze, showing that this method is simple, reliable, and is an effective model for evaluating bids.

articleTitle: The Role of Smart Grid in Promoting Economic Development in Shaanxi Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the world's new energy industry, smart grid is becoming the world's focus on the development of the industries. Construction of smart grid can be optimized allocation of power resources in a wider scope, and China's limited energy resources will be fully utilized. That will help eastern and western regions to develop their respective comparative advantages, to alleviate environmental pressure in eastern and to promote coordinated regional economic development .Rich geological resources in Shaanxi Power Grid provides a development and growth opportunities. Only by seizing opportunities, Shaanxi economy could change advantage of resources to stimulate the economy by the development of the smart grid.

articleTitle: The Direction of Urban Leisure Industrial Promotion: A Shanghai Case
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the progress of the national leisure idea in China, leisure industry has become an increasingly important component of urban economy. This paper interprets the concept of urban leisure industry and key factors, and discusses its promotion effect to economy. The status and structure characteristics of Shanghai leisure industry are analyzed. The paper suggests that Shanghai should transform the model of economic development and adjust industrial structure. Especially, facing the impact of financial crisis, Shanghai should optimize the leisure industrial structure. Finally, the promote strategies and direction of Shanghai leisure industry are proposed.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Forecasting Power of Chinese Bonds' Interest Rate Term Structure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Abstract-According to the expectations hypothesis theory of interest rate term structure, the interest rate term structure contains the information about future interest term spread and future inflation rates changing. In this paper, based on Chinese whole dealing bonds' monthly data of five years, from 2004.07 to 2009.06, by using numerical methods we construct term structure both against time and against maturity first. Then we do the empirical study to test the forecasting power of Chinese bonds' interest term structure, in other words, we use the long and short term spread to analyse the expectation of the future term spread and the inflation rates changing. The empirical result shows that, Chinese bonds' spread can forecast the future term spread and future inflation rates changing.

articleTitle: The Plan of Elderly Smart Community: Based on the Concept of Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Relying on demographics structure, the essay is to analyze the trend of aging. Compared with the handling way of foreign countries, it would confirm the need to establish the elderly smart community under the current situation of China. Based on the foregone use of IOT concept, the feasibility of using IOT technology in planning and designing would be confirmed. At last, based on the foregoing analysis, the essay is to imagine the integer trending and details of elderly smart community based on the concept of IOT.

articleTitle: The Implementation and Application of Mobile Television in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of mobile phones, users have started to use them to watch TV. Now mobile TV has become a buzzword in China. However, there are few systematic and empirical researches in this field. This paper focuses on the implementation and application of mobile TV in China. Through theoretical analysis and market survey, this paper finds that mobile TV has the potential to become a prospective fifth medium after newspaper, radio, television and the Internet. Meanwhile, this paper points out the barriers and accordingly makes solutions to the implementation of mobile TV in China.

articleTitle: CFD Simulations and Assessment of Life Safety in Underground Emporium
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The object of this study is to investigate the human evacuation behavior and smoke behavior of a fire in an underground emporium. A practical survey about the occupants characteristics of number, age and gender was carried out. Then, different fire locations and occupants load in the fourth fire protection zone of the underground emporium were conducted numerically by using a CFD model FDS+Evac. And the coupling between the fire conditions and the human behavior were analyzed. The required safe egress time (RSET) and available safe egress time (ASET) of different cases were obtained. Under the same occupants number, the biggest difference of RSET is only 5 s. And ASET is 190 s for the fire far from the exit, 180 s for the fire near the exit. Accordingly we can identify the evacuation process is successful under the survey occupants number in case of a fire. In addition, the air temperature and visibility have a sharp change at a distance respectively 38.9 m near the fire, 42.1 m in the staircase near the exit.

articleTitle: CUSCORE Control Chart for IMA(1,1) Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: CUSCORE control chart is designed based on the thought of CUSCORE statistic to control the non-stationary autocorrelated process IMA (1, 1). The MMSE method is used to remove the auto-correlation among the observations. By comparing the performance of CUSCORE control chart to Shewhart Control Chart, the CUSCORE control is more effective in the case of the process mean drifting.

articleTitle: A New Recommender Model of Collaborative Filtering Based on User
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nowadays, Web has become the main way to gain information. However, "Information overload" and "information lack" has become a big problem to be studied. To provide the personalized service for people is especially essential. However, existing collaborative filtering algorithms have been suffering from data sparsity and scalability problems which lead to inaccuracy of recommendation. In this paper, a recommendation model of collaborative filtering based on user is proposed. The results of experiment show that the model can improve the two problems that traditional collaborative filtering faced efficiently. Simultaneously the quality of information recommendation also has the distinct enhancement compares to the traditional recommendation.

articleTitle: A Study on the ECR Method Evaluation of Urban Rail Transit Service Quality
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this study rational evaluation indicators were established to study Shanghai urban rail transit system, and the method of Extended Contributive Rule (ECR) was used to hierarchically analyze rail transit service quality, determines the different levels of service, and identifies various people groups' requirement difference in the service quality. It was aimed to objectively evaluate Shanghai urban rail transit service quality and provide the rail transit operator with service improvement measures.

articleTitle: Research on the Network Information Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies developments of the network information market, mainly the principles in the network information market, such as self-order principle, sharable principle, innovation principle, etc. At last the author gives his own thoughts for the development of network information market.

articleTitle: Research on Current Situation and Countermeasures of China's Basic Industry Patent Information Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the definition of related concept and importance with regard to basic industry patent information service , this paper analysed the distribution status of basic industry patent information resources, and then pointed out the key issues to be solved with China's basic industry patent information service. At last, this paper purposefully proposed the measures and suggestions on upgrading the levels of basic industry patent information service.

articleTitle: The Effect of Demand Strength on the Comparative Advantage Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The demand is one determinant to the equilibrium of international trade. It will affect the structure of trade and in addition the gains of countries from international trade. The stronger is the demand, the higher consumption utility will be achieved.

articleTitle: A Study on Vulnerability of Credit Chain and Risk Control of SME Cluster Financing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Nowadays SME clusters have become important economic bodies in national economy in China. However, financing difficulties of SME cluster may be the foremost difficulty that restricts economic development. So an innovative trend that SME cluster financing business should be developed to solve the problem. It is kind of secured loans based on the guarantee of small and medium guarantee companies. Through the analyses of Chinese credit chain and financing risk control process, we come to a conclusion: "SME - Small and Medium Guarantee Company - Commercial Bank" is still a relatively weak type of credit chain which is not adaptable for the development of SME cluster financing, the same as the corresponding financial risk control which based on the situation of guarantee companies and credit chain. Therefore, these financing mechanisms of SME clusters still have disadvantage & vulnerability of the credit chain and risk control in China.

articleTitle: Study on the Main Influencing Factors on the Online Shopping Behavior of the Undergraduate
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the undergraduate are the prosperous consumers in future, their consumption behaviours are important for the success of the online retailers. Recently the B2C and C2C of e-commerce has brought great benefits to the consumer and merchant. According to the theory of reasoned action(TRA) developed by Martin Fishbein and the theory of planned behavior (TPB) proposed by Icek Ajzen, a widely survey are conducted base on the sample of undergraduate students in Beijing city. The influence factors on the online shopping and behaviors are discussed in this paper. The research results indicate that the main influenced factors include convenience and experience, personal information and finical security etc. according to their importance degree. Therefore, the online retailers should insist that cheaper commodity pricing attract college student consumer, set up the products and retailer's prestige of network, and eliminate the doubts and worries about security of online shopping.

articleTitle: A Performance Evaluation System for Supply Chain Partners Using Fuzzy Clustering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Supply chain is a coordinate operation model beyond space and location constraints, so the performance for supply chain partners is not easily amenable for measurement. In this paper, a new evaluation method using fuzzy clustering is put forward. It can perfectly deal with the inherent limitations of supply chain alliance and measure the overall performance during all the work phases of supply chain by linking the key factors from each partner of supply chain alliance. In order to illustrate the viability and adaptability of this method, an example of application is given by this paper.

articleTitle: A Measurement Model of Innovative Talents Basing on ANP-TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, from knowledge structure, ability structure, psychological structure, and Performance Structure we build an assessment index system for innovative talents. Taking into account the relationship between the various evaluation factors, we use network analysis methods to determine the evaluation index weight, and adopt TOPSIS methods to build a measure model for innovative talents. The case study shows that this method can effectively evaluate the innovative talents, and provides a quantitative basis for analysis of innovative talents.

articleTitle: Study on Function Mechanism and Strategy of Network Leverage
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to gain competitive advantages, it is essential for enterprise to break through its borderline and enlarge the effectiveness of its inner resources through the outer network. This kind of stratagem managing mode is defined as network leverage. Firstly, the function mechanism of network leverage-accumulating inimitable resources of the enterprises through interaction between the inner and the outer network-is studied. We take the view that the core of network leverage management is optimizing the inner resources of the enterprise and building social networks, creating laborsaving leverage, and at the same time providing the fundamental condition for the operation of the network leverage. Then, the strategies of four kinds of enterprises based on network leverage theory are analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Innovation Ability Evaluation Based on Gray-Related Balance Factor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the complexity of the process of technological innovation, there is no uniform standard on how to measure technological innovation at home and abroad. Evaluation of technological innovation, however, is an important management tool in the process of technological innovation. Therefore, the author introduces the Balanced Scorecard on the base of summarizing the research on technological innovations at home and abroad, and then intends to build a technological innovation evaluation system, which takes balanced scorecard as a tool for the evaluation. The author also builds innovative capability assessment model with the application of gray relational analysis method and on this basis, introduces a balanced factor, taking into account of not only the capacity dimensions weights but also the overall innovation capability. Finally, validate that by means of case study.

articleTitle: The Research on the Correlation between the Asset Structure and Operating Performance of Listed Electric Power Companies in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Are asset structure and the operating performance of an enterprise correlated in one way or another and how to comprehensively evaluate the operating performance of an enterprise? To address these questions this study applies the Canonical Correlation method to analyze the financial data of 58 Listed Electric Power Companies in China in 2008 and finds that the two variables of asset structure and the operating performance are highly correlated with the asset structure being positively correlated with asset management in performance evaluation while being negatively correlated with revenue management and capital management.

articleTitle: The Research Report on Institution Old-Age Insurance Reform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For a long time, the Old-age Security System between the government and the enterprise has been in parallel track, which not only causing enormous financial pressure and hindering the normal movement of labor, but also seriously damaging the social justice. In order to break the "fragmentation" of the Old-age Security System, the institution old-age insurance system reform has started in five provinces and municipalities since last year. In this paper, through analyzing the views about this round of reform program from all walks of life, the writer set out the disputed points. Furthermore, based on the reform situation of the experimental areas, the writer summarize and elaborate the key issues which determine the success of the reform.

articleTitle: The Evolutionary Game Analysis on the Quality of the Public Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The issue of public service quality can be seen as an equilibrium process which includes the game between the supplier and the demander of the public service. The boundary rationality of the game participator in public service made the game process to be a process for the stable state. Based on the model of evolutionary game involving the supplier and demander of the public service, we find that the initial state run a key role on the strategy. And the unstable state strategies have the trend to achieve or degenerate to the perfect or the terrible strategy. And several parameters can be utilized as the locus of control for the government's policy.

articleTitle: The Chinese Insurance System Relative Efficiency Research Based on DEA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The obvious transplanting characteristic of Chinese insurance system has brought its interim characteristic. Such transplanting insurance system has an important role on the development of Chinese insurance industry. In this article we research about relative efficiency of Chinese annual insurance system with the solution of data envelopment analysis. It is on the aim of exploring the operational efficiency of Chinese insurance system as well as the directions of the improvement in future, supporting a source of reference to settlement of insurance system.

articleTitle: The Research Review and System Construction of Entrepreneurial Ventures in Transition Economies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After collecting and arranging the entrepreneurship research literature in transition economies over the past 20 years, this paper systematically reviewed the main achievements and weakness of the existing studies especially on entrepreneurial ventures, and then constructed the entrepreneurship research system in transition economies from the aspects of theoretical development, research perspectives and research methods.

articleTitle: Schema Matching Model of Build-Operate-Transfer Projects
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper formulates a schema matching model to analyze the model selection problem arising from pattern recognize and schema matching between infrastructures and different type build-operate-transfer (BOT) project. Through systematical review, an analysis of relevant literature and cases analysis yielded significant factors that would have a certain impact on the feasibility of any BOT project. These factors were classified into three relative categories forming the structure of the suggested project schema matching model. This model presents a new approach to evaluate the relationships between decisions factors related to a project financing model. The proposed approach to project feasibility evaluation aims to increase the decision maker's ability to determine the factors which make the greatest contribution to the financing model to the BOT project at hand.

articleTitle: International Comparison and Change Reasons of Employment Elasticity in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There have a positive correlation between economic growth and employment growth in developed marketing country, but many developing countries display high growth and low employment at varying degrees. This paper has proved that China exist long-standing employment elasticity decreasing trend to use the data of Chinese GDP and employment in years 1978-2007. This paper also has analyzed the declining trend and causes about employment elasticity.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Network Governance: A Path Selection of Sustainable Development for Chinese Heritage Resources
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: An Investigation and Analysis of the Satisfaction Degree of Administrative Staff in the Service Industry--On the Basis of Human Resources Research of the Headquarters of New Century Tourism Group
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Employee satisfaction is a key indicator of measuring the success of human resource management in modern hotels. Adopting SPSS15.0, this article has a descriptive analysis of the issues of the employees' being satisfied or not, the most satisfying factors, the most dissatisfying factors, the impact of gender on satisfaction, the impact of work experience on the turnover intention and so on. After this, the article also gives some suggestions on how to improve the employees' satisfaction.

articleTitle: Measurement on Economic Contribution of Rural Infrastructure Investment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to solve quickly the "Agriculture, Rural areas and Peasantry" problems. This article estimates capital stock of rural road, water supply and electric power facilities from 1990-2007. Then it sets up double logarithmic production function-C-D model on the basis of hypothesis. Finally, using Eviews 5.0, it estimates the economic performance, ascertains investment contribution level of rural road, water supply and electric power facilities.

articleTitle: The Financial Products, Accounting Information Disclosure and Financial Regulatory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In 2008, the world has experienced a financial crisis, which emanated from the core of the world's most advanced capital market, and holds back the global real economy in a short time. Financial product especially product innovations, the key thing for "Masters of the Universe", play an important role in crisis communication, and had caused wide public concern. July 2009, The Obama administration sent Congress its latest plan to spruce up the much maligned credit rating business in order to "increase transparency, tighten oversight and reduce reliance on credit rating agencies." One thing the administration plan wouldn't do is restrict the practice of bond issuers paying for ratings - a conflict of interest that some observers put at the center of the credit crisis. In This paper, I focus on the analysis of financial products transactions using the principal agent model (Holmstrom & Milgrom, 1987). Financial transaction or investment poses a classic problem of asymmetric information with latent conflict of interest issues. Based on more information such as capital markets' earnings and stock price information, principal agent contract could achieve optimal incentives for managers, and overcome harming the principals' benefits that caused by information asymmetry. Accounting information is cost-effective public information with widely concerned. We have noted the change of financial accounting in the financial crisis. But we must take a hard look at the change, accounting information should be helpful for investors not for elite group's aim or purpose to improve their investment performance. July 2009, The Obama administration sent Congress its latest plan to spruce up the much maligned credit rating business in order to "increase transparency, tighten oversight and reduce reliance on credit rating agencies." One thing the administration plan wouldn't do is restrict the practice of bond issuers paying for ratings - a conflict of interest that some observers put at the center of the credit crisis-This electronic document is a "live" template. articleTitle: Research on Fundamental Mechanism and Developing Mechanism of Financial Control Based on the Bureaucratic Structure of the Parent-Subsidiary Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The finance control pattern of the parent-subsidiary enterprise is the continual dynamical equilibrium which between the centralization and the decentralization. In this dynamic process, the essence is financial authority of the control mechanism which is fundamental match the financial non-authority of the control mechanism developing and replacing the authority control mechanism because of the bureaucratic Structure. We can understand the question about dilemma of the finance control pattern through studying the development of the finance control mechanism of the parent-subsidiary enterprise.

articleTitle: Customer's Adoption Decision Analysis of Mobile Banking Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Being Convenient and low-paid, mobile banking financial services based on WAP, SMS or 3G are more and more popular. According to TAM, the reason why bank customers have intention to accept mobile banking financial services were explored from five aspects, perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, perceived usability, consume concept and consumer experience. The effects of these factors on the intention to using mobile banking financial services were studied by SEM.

articleTitle: Optimal Capacity Expansion Policy with Given Reservation Contracts
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With a deductible reservation contract proposed, this paper characterizes an optimal capacity expansion policy on innovative product in a single-period setting. We describe a negotiation process for capacity expansion as a Stackelberg game in which the supplier is the leader and the retailer is the follower. Specifically, with the reservation contract exogenously given, we first investigate the retailer's optimal strategy. Then we study the optimal capacity expansion policy for the supplier and finally explore the effects of reservation price on the retailer and supplier's optimal decisions.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Game Attendance in the Chinese Professional Baseball League
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The current study was to investigate game attendance in the Chinese Professional Baseball League using data mining. Simultaneous multiple linear regression was utilized to perform data analysis. Results show that the proposed model explained 54.2% of the total variance of game attendance. Additionally,weekend game attracted more attendance than non-weekend games; games played in home field attracted more attendance; game attendance varied from one opponent from another.Managerial implications were provided.

articleTitle: The Effects of Consumer's Psychological Characteristics on Domain-Specific Deal-Proneness
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Most west studies have emphasized the psychological profile of the deal-prone consumer. However, consumers with different culture background and under different market environment would show different responses to promotions. In this paper, taking Chinese women clothing consumers as research object, structural equation model is applied to analyze the effects of consumer's psychological characteristics on three kinds of domain-specific deal-proneness, namely, coupon redemption schemes, discount and points. The findings confirm that the impact of psychographics on different types of promotion has obvious differences. And through comparative analysis, some useful suggestions are given to marketers to develop promotion strategies.

articleTitle: Relationship between Wage and Cost Management of Going to College in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the wage of college graduates in China becomes lower, more and more people care the cost management of going to college. This paper use pooling equilibrium and separating equilibrium to show relationship between wage and cost management of going to college so that people can see the costs of going to college and make decisions. Further, this paper gives some advices how to adapt to the relationship between wage and cost management of going to college in China.

articleTitle: Study on Knowledge Integration of Complex Product Development Team
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Member of Complex product development team usually come from different unit, use different language, and have different culture background, which not only obstacle knowledge communication, but also increase the difficulty of knowledge integration among team members, so how to promote knowledge integration in the complex product development is worth studying. This paper discusses the knowledge integration characteristics of complex product development team from two aspect, then using evolving game theory, knowledge integration model is put forward, and several conclusion are gained from analyzing the model, at last, knowledge integration polices of complex product development team are analyzed, which are strengthening effective communication, establishing trust based culture, and designing appropriate incentive mechanism.

articleTitle: An Equivalence Checking Method for Circuits with Black Boxes Based on Logic Cone and SAT
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, an approach has been proposed for solving this problem of equivalence checking for partial implementation in digital circuits. The partial implementation can also be called Black Boxes in which parts of the implementation are not yet finished or known. First, the reference and partial implementation designs are divided into small components called logic cones respectively; Second, logic cones are matched using matching techniques between reference and partial implementation designs; Third, an “exclusive-or” logic gate is applied to the two matched logic cones to construct a miter; Finally, each miter is proven to be functionally equivalent or nonequivalent using SAT engine. The method of circuit partition is used to equivalence checking for partial implementations in order to decrease the time and space complexity. A series of experimental results show the effectiveness and feasibility of the approach on the ISCAS'85 benchmark circuits.

articleTitle: The Research on Distress Warning for Chinese Listed Commercial Banks: An Option-Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Using an option-based approach, this paper constructs a distress warning model for Chinese commercial banks and analyzes the distress situations of China's 14 listed commercial banks with the samples in 2008. According to the empirical results, we obtain two valuable conclusions that the option-based approach is valid in distress warning of Chinese banking and the distance-to-distress is more sensitive to the interest rate than to the distress barrier. The study results also show that China's 14 listed commercial banks all appear to be safe because of their positive values of distance-to-distress and the state-owned banks have the best distress situations.

articleTitle: The Indefinite Model Evaluation for Groundwater Quality
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, the author make the grey forecast united with the fuzzy synthetic assessment to determine the regional classification problems for regulating and planning groundwater. In this case, the following models are adopted to forecast the water quality system: GM(1, 1) model groups, GM(1, 1) residual difference model, GM(1, N), GM(1, 1) Weighted model.

articleTitle: Preliminary Insights into M-Commerce Supply Chain in China: Illustrated by the Case of China Mobile
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Analyzed the participants which consist of m-commerce supply chain in China and how these participants create value and how information or service flows through the whole supply chain by investigating top three mobile network operators in China, China Mobile, China Unicom and China Telecom. Framework models of China's m-commerce supply chain are proposed simultaneously. A case study on China Mobile which is the largest mobile network operator in China is made to study its value-added service categories and supply chain of each category. The result indicates that the supply chain can be used to explain all the value-added services which is provided by China Mobile, therefore the supply chain model is proved to be reasonable.

articleTitle: Visitors' Satisfaction Measurement in the National Park: A Case Study of Zhangjiajie National Forest Park
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper researched on visitors' pre-visit expectation and reality experience about visitors' satisfaction in Zhangjiajie National Forest Park, and constructed visitors' expectation and experience matrix based on IPA (Important-performance analysis) and SWOT (Strength, Weakness, Opportunity and Threat). The findings showed that there were 14 opportunities, 3 strengths, 11 weaknesses and 6 threats according to visitors' expectation and experience matrix in Zhangjiajie National Forest Park. And it implied that there was good satisfaction of visitors in Zhangjiajie National Forest Park. Finally, some measurements would be put forward for the park.

articleTitle: Construction Quality Control System of Key Water-Control Project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The quality of key water-control project is important to the improvement of national prosperity, stability and economic development. The quality control in the construction of the key water-control project is much a difficult work. So this paper tries to form a construction quality control system. It mainly contains construction quality pre-control system, construction quality process control system, optimization of the construction quality issues treatment methods and quality assurance system.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Technological Characteristics of Patents for Beijing Hi-Tech Olympic Games
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The advance of hi-tech Olympics has played a sustainable role in promoting the development of technology industry since the opening of modern Olympic Games. Especially a wealthy scientific results made under the demand of Olympics, and it is obvious that understanding their characteristics and assessing their quality will contribute to the decision made when we want to make technological knowledge commercialization. So some patents for the needs of Beijing hi-tech Olympic Games will be analysized as a data sample that covers more than two thousand patents with the information of dates of application, IPC code and applicant address etc. In addition to providing an overview of patent actives during the period of preparing the Beijing Olympics, the paper also sheds light on some hot points of domestic scientific research and illustrates the positive effect of Olympics on local R&D.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Relational Embeddedness in Strategic Networks of Enterprises and NPOs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Strategic networks profoundly influence the behavior and performance of enterprises, in which the relationships between enterprises and other organizations are constituted by embedded ness. The researchers have not agreed on the appropriate strength of ties that enterprises should form. There is little research on relational embedded ness in the collaboration between enterprises and NPOs. In this paper, relational embeddedness of different cooperative forms is analyzed in strategic networks of enterprises and NPOs. It is proposed to shape strong relational embeddedness with their members for the enterprises to choose collaborative forms. The enterprises are suggested to improve the extent of relational embeddedness by deepening current ties and gradually forming stronger connections.

articleTitle: The Effect of On-Line Buyer Psychological Contract Violation on Trust: Taking Satisfaction as Moderator
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Psychological contract violation is firmed when on-line consumers perceived the firm did not fulfill its response and obligation. Although it's widespread among on-line shopping, consumers have different response for it. It's necessary for firm to understand the real reason for it. This paper arguments and empirical test the transactional and relational psychological contract affect trust, and introduces satisfaction as a moderator. It shows that the violation of relational psychological contract is more powerful, and satisfaction is do moderator the relationship.

articleTitle: An Optimal Control Model for Transformation of Industrial Ecology in Resource-Based Cities
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper presents a dynamic optimal control model with the aim of achieving industrial ecological conversion optimization and satisfying the requirements of sustainable development in resource-based city. The method used in our study is known as Hamilton function. We put forward the hypothesis with the consideration of key factors influencing the transformation of industrial ecology and developed an optimal control model. Necessary condition for optimal control of industrial ecological conversion is analyzed. The modeling results show that the government's efforts to guide can induce the transformation of industrial ecology and bring existing industries into the industry ecosystem. Our study strongly suggests and indicates that relevant governments in the resource-based cities should draw up policies and develop scientific control and appraisals system to effectively guide the transformation of industrial ecology.

articleTitle: Executable Workflow of Composition Architecture on Semantic Web Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In our previous article, we proposes an approach for automated composition of Web services which decomposes task into smaller And, Or subtasks to find out the optimized solution graph based on And/Or graph. This paper designs a layered architecture to support the transition from the And/Or solution graph to executable workflow by the composition approach above. The architecture consists of four layers which includes the Knowledge Ontology, Task Template, Mediator, and Web Service from up to down in the order. The architecture has the following features: 1) It designs a task template to support the semantic Web services composition and composite reuse; 2) the architecture realizes the task-driven Web services searching based on semantic capability representation and specifies the heterogeneity solution in the web usage. In this paper, we proposes composition algorithm and a motivation example provides a preliminary experimental illustration which clearly shows the benefits of our approach.

articleTitle: Study on Culture Integration Strategy of the Overseas Technology-Acquiring M&As of Chinese Manufacture Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Going out for obtaining core technology through overseas mergers and acquisitions (M&As) is an effective way to achieve the leaping development of Chinese manufacture enterprises. Of course, such development strategy has great risks in failures. Therefore, an effective integration management after the M&As is essential. Because of the need to analyze the multi-culture in the overseas technology-acquiring M&As, Chinese manufacture enterprises should choose the appropriate culture integration strategy, ensure the success completion of the M&As and achieve the expected commercial value.

articleTitle: What Is the Motivation of Closing an Open-End Fund: Investor Protection or Spill-Over Effect?
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Closing of an open-end fund to new investors in mutual fund market is more and more popular. The reason fund families give for the closing of a fund is reasonable: by preventing the size of the fund from growing too large to be managed effectively, the previous superior fund can maintain its good performance, so the interest of investors can be protected. However, by comparing the performances of open-end funds before and after closing, we find that the performance of the funds becomes worse after closing. The closing of a fund can't protect the interest of investors. Closing decision made by fund families is likely to be motivated by spill-over effect: by closing one of its funds, the fund family can attract the attention of investors and encourage them to invest in other funds of the family. There is strong evidence that closing a fund can bring more money inflow to the fund family.

articleTitle: Heterotrophic Bacteria in Industrial Recycling Cooling Water System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, industrial recycling cooling water system of a thermal power station in Beijing was selected. This system was made up by urban reclaimed water since 2007. The growth of heterotrophic bacteria was analyzed. Spring and summer test results showed, both in make up water and cooling water, the total numbers of heterotrophic bacteria in summer were all much higher than theirs in spring. The total number in summer exceeded the standard. Test results on different points in the circuit showed that, whether in spring or summer, the total number of heterotrophic bacteria in condenser was the largest. Therefore, more strict measures should be taken to control growth of heterotrophic bacteria in summer.

articleTitle: Formation Mechanism of Cooperative Spirit from Game Theory Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The cooperation spirit is an important part of the quality for modern university students. In this paper, starting from mechanism of economic behaviors in cooperation groups, using the method of Game Theory, discussed the impact of opportunism actions on individual cooperation actions, and through analyzing the formation of cooperative behaviors on the team situation, proved and further explored an hypothesis: by strengthening the students reputation education, how university students formed the cooperative spirit.

articleTitle: Web Design and Assessment for E-Commerce: A Case Study on the Visual Design of a Commercial Homepage
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The study is based on analytic hierarchy process (AHP) to constitute the evaluation structure and questionnaires for website visual design, with a view to assessing four visual design alternatives published on the homepage of an online shopping. This research concludes: (1) twenty evaluation criteria in relation to website visual design determined through access the relative importance of criteria set as sub-criteria within a hierarchical structure; (2) goal, criteria, and sub-criteria constitute the evaluation model for website visual design.
