It provides the reference for the industry and relevant researchers when evaluating the candidates of website visual design; and (3) this study adopts fuzzy multiple criteria decision making (FMCDM) with reference to the data analysis. The results can clearly show the preference ranking of decision-makers for proposed design alternatives and the optimal design solution could be selected. Therefore, this analysis method is effective and objectively reflected all of the decision-makers' subjective judgment on website visual design assessment.

articleTitle: Cooperation Negotiation Method of Manufacturing Corporation's Supply Chain Alliance Based on Computer Supported
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Manufacturing Corporation' preferences and the changes of environment lead to disputes or conflicts of profit allotting in alliance cooperation. Aiming at these problems, this paper puts forward a kind of negotiable profit allotting models of multi-person cooperation games. Then, a negotiation method was developed based on constructing negotiators' utility function and seeking the concession solution by steps to maximize these utilities. Finally, the effectiveness of this method is illustrated by a case analysis result.

articleTitle: Bounded Rationality Modeling in CAID
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Differences in the perceptions of the products modeling between the clients and the designers is common thing in product design. The bounded rationality gives reasonable explanation that because of user's the limited cognitive abilities and quantity of information they hold. In order to establish a multi-perception product model and design system, the user's bounded rationality must be taken into account. This paper proposes a product design method which based on the user bounded rationality. A network surveying based on multi-perception image is firstly created to carry out.Then, essential elements to product modelling were recognized and sort out with qualitative analysis, as well as the corresponding relationship between the product design and a number of the multi-perception factors obtained through the second investigating. Based on this, the product design knowledge repository can thereby be established, and feature model identified through studying the user's multi-perception image can help designer to improve the success rate of design proposals.

articleTitle: Information Rent and Hierarchies of Employee's Income in Corporate
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is universal phenomena that the higher is the position of employee, the higher is employee's income. The common proposition of those dominant theories such as "ability perspective", "bribe perspective" and "tournament perspective", that explain the phenomena is that employee's marginal production equal employee's income. This paper argues that the information of labor input and labor's marginal product is asymmetry among hierarchies of corporate. The higher position's employees can secretly reduce their labor input, undervalue marginal production of these lower position's employees, and acquire more added income, namely information rent, which is another satisfactory explaining of hierarchies of employee's income in corporate.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis on the Futures Price Bubble -Take the Wheat Market in China as a Sample
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, the author uses the spot-futures parity theory to calculate the real value of wheat futures . Based on the present research concerning the price bubble problem in stock market, both the extraordinary variable variance analysis and the three portions test can be used on this kind of problem in wheat futures market. After improving the to analytical methods, the author carries out an empirical analysis on a sample of historical data. The results prove that China's wheat futures market price bubble does not exist in the long term, but in the short term, it exists and the degree of wheat futures market price bubble has been decreasing significantly. Finally, this paper divides the different range of different kinds of price bubble according to the price bubble development stages.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On the Harmonious Development of College Sport and Community Sport--- from the Perspective of City Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Innovation in Industrial Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this article is to extend the interactive innovation model of the service sector so that it can be used to interpret innovation processes in thei industrial service sector more exactly. As industrial service is very special, which serve for the industry, the innovation in industrial service needs special research tool. The research tool in innovation in service pointed out by Sundbo is extended in this paper. The characteristic of the extended research tool is analyzed as while as necessity. Some example on how to use the tool is also given. Base on the analysis and the example, it is pointed out that the interaction is a very good window for the research on the innovation in industrial service.

articleTitle: Study on the Evaluation Index of Mass Customization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Mass Customization is a brand new production mode, which combines the advantages of Mass Production and Customization together. However, during its operation, production cost, delivery lead time as well as the degree of customization satisfaction became the major isssues. In order to detect enterprise Mass Customization performance, a set of evaluation index, so call PMTO structure, was established. Moreover, a simulation process was carried out based on a real enterprise. Utilizing expert marking system, the weight of each evaluation element can be settled down, meanwhile subjective scores were converted into normalized evaluation values by which enterprise Mass Customization ability can be expressed quantitatively. On one hand, the final evaluation score can help enterprise understand its position in the overall Mass Customization development; on the other hand, by analysing any individual evaluation element score, the enterprise weakness can be discovered. Hence the relevant improvement in the weak area can be carried out effectivly. Therefore, this evaluation index provide certain decision making reference to companies which are in the convert process from Mass Production to Mass Customization.

articleTitle: A Method of City Informatization Level Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the characteristics and trends of city informatization this paper established a set of evaluation index system of city informatization based on the essence of city informatization. Furthermore, the evaluation model, which is to provide feasible method for the appraisal of city informatization level, is brought out with the application of entropy-weight coefficient method.

articleTitle: The Effects of Suboptimal Investment Rules on Value
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study evaluates optimal investment rules under various stochastic processes and investigates the cost of adopting suboptimal investment rules to firm value. It is found that with consideration of the effects of preemptive competition or mean reversion, optimal investment trigger is lower than that under a geometric Brownian motion (GBM) process. Therefore, acknowledging option to wait, under the underlying GBM assumption, unnecessarily delays corporate investment. The study also proposes a loss function to measure the costs of adopting suboptimal investment rules. The main finding is that the best investment rule is the optimal investment rule itself. Any deviation from the optimal investment rule is suboptimal and may lead to a substantial loss in value.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Risk Evaluation Model of Dynamic Neural Network Based on TFN-AHP
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study of Monitoring System Based on Multicarrier in Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Electromagnetic interference in power plant is extremely complicated and there are many hidden trouble. The measure system in power plant based on Multicarrier(as OFDM, for example) technology was put forward. The system connected with communication and monitoring networks existed already, wireless sensor networks or carrier transmission on power line or fiber-optic is used in fully mechanized working face. Wireless communication system primarily include digital microwave link or simulation microwave circuits system, etc.. Wireless communication is used in flat area and the time of sudden accident; Power line or fiber-optic is used in mountainous areas or complex landform condition. The technology of Multicarrier combines with multiple access technology and various modulations technology easily. System structure of the communication system and hardware design, main scheme of the monitoring equipment were pointed out in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Conflicts Resolving for Collaborative Negotiation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper aims at resolving conflicts in collaborative negotiation of a core enterprise with more than one upper negotiators and lower negotiators. First, the type and effect of conflicts in collaborative negotiation are analyzed. Furthermore, we design the Domain Propagation Algorithm based on Constraints Propagation and Constraints Loosening (DPACPCL) to resolve conflicts for collaborative negotiation. And also a prototype system is developed. The experimental result validates the collaborative negotiation model and domain propagation algorithm proposed in the paper and it may help carry out multi-thread negotiation by supporting more than one upper negotiators and lower negotiators at the same time to achieve ideal business process integration.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Evaluation Method of Staff Competency Based on Rough Set Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the comprehensive evaluation of competencies to introduce rough set theory, using the theory to fully tap the link between the known data to determine the weight of evaluation index data, to avoid the subjectivity caused by human intervention. Experiments show that the use of rough set theory in the evaluation, with satisfactory results.

articleTitle: The Application of Network Planning Programming to Interbasin Water Transfer Project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The traditional network drawing method is limited to artificial drawing and artificial experience etc. Aimed at these problems exist in construction schedule management, network planning software is the key to improve the design efficiency and management of the project. In this research, the principle of network planning technique, drawing methods of bar chart and network graph, the characteristics of bar plan and network plan and the calculation of network plan time parameters were introduced. Taking the South-to-North Water Diversion Project in Tianjin Segment as an example, the network chart was drawn. The finished network chart provided a scientific and effective method for the management and decision-making associated with the construction. The network planning programming in Interbasin Water Transfer Project is of characteristics of system, controllability and dynamic.

articleTitle: Based on Tree Structure Group Key Management for Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Tree-based group key agreement protocol that allows group members to compute the group key based on their individual contributions can provide verifiable trust relationship between participants in ad-hoc networks. We discuss the principles and structural features of three tree-based group key agreement protocols, and compare the communication and computation that generated by each protocol when their members are adding, leaving, merging or breaking up. The analysis and comparison results show that each tree-based group key agreement protocol is applicable to corresponding ad-hoc network. We also provide reference and technical support for application of more complicated tree structure in ad-hoc networks.

articleTitle: Design of Road Lightening System Based on Taguchi Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the study of the design standard of road lightening, a design method of road lightening based on Taguchi method is introduced. Through analyzing and parameter designing of the geometrical properties of the road lightening system, visibility of small target as the measurable index, the result is ready for reference, and it is also a complement to energy saving requirement of sustainable social development.

articleTitle: Design and Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Modern design was born in Europe at the beginning of 20th century. A series of factors led to its emerging under the background of historical and social change, in which the influences from industrial revolution, economical and social system's transformation were extremely striking. Therefore, the birth and development of modern design have been involved in the interactive relations with such historical and social elements. From which, the relationship between design and management was especially remarkable from the perspective of both scientific and historical research. Firstly, modern design has played a very important role in the business management, and again, it has a strong connection with macro-social management, or it gradually became a measure to achieve social objectives or to deal with social problems, where, for instance, the environmental issue or energy crisis were highly concerned. Within such a discussion, the significance of modern design's role in the modern management could have been revealed totally and would draw a necessary attention at any respect.

articleTitle: Utilizing Service Science to Construct High-Performance Digital Publishing Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The reader merely read traditional books, but also they gain contents from new media (for example the network, mobile device and digital library). In recent years, the publishing industries focus on developing digital publishing. Currently some presses constituted the press group in order to develop new products to enhance competitiveness. But actual groups have many problems on management and the distribution of benefits. Service science provided a method to build a virtual group through products and services. This paper describes the use of services science and semantic web to build high-performance digital publishing industry infrastructure. Every press managed self-products that included paper-book publishing, digital book publishing, network publishing, mobile publishing, etc. The customers used mobile novels, Internet novels, mobile newspaper, Internet newspaper, digital book, and book. The service-oriented digital publishing infrastructure implemented the service combination and built the virtual publishing group through the mapping between two type products. The paper also described three important ontologies of digital publishing application.

articleTitle: The Impact of Financial Crisis on Chinese Exports--Analysis Based on the Method of Impulse-Response Function
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article firstly builds a synthetical index reflecting the degree of financial crisis, then studies the dynamic impacting characteristics between the degree of financial crisis and total export and exports of ten sub-industries with the method of impulse response function and variance decomposition based on Var model. The result is that: on one side, the impact of financial crisis on the total export is an unstable course and the financial crisis is relatively unimportant in the forecasted variance of total export; on the other side, the impact of financial crisis on sub-industries is structural hetorogeous and the financial crisis is very important in the forecasted variance of the exports of sub-industries.

articleTitle: Research on Control of False E-Accounting of Listed Companies Based on Forensic Accounting
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Since the 1990s, Internet-based E-Business and E-Government have undergone unprecedented rapid development. This makes the accounting based on cargo flow and cash flow quickly go from the traditional manual labor age into a digital age. Computer-based accounting and electronic accounts have thus appeared. As a consequence, false E-accounting is unavoidable. Fictitious huge operating income of Wuliangye Co., LTD in Yibin, Sichuan further indicates that false accounts are very common among China's listed companies. This leads to a turbulent capital market, continuous commercial bribery, and spreading corruption. This paper aims to explore the concept, features, content, form, prevention, and control path of electronic false accounts of listed companies by taking forensic accounting as the clew, so as to prevent the risks of false accounts of listed companies for the sake of healthy development of capital markets, effective control of commercial bribery, and apparent control of corruption of power.

articleTitle: Solution of Critical Water Depth Trapezoid Open Channel by SARAGA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The critical depth of water is an important hydraulic parameter in open channel hydraulics, which is a key sign of the state of water flow in open channel. Some usual method for calculating critical water depth of trapezoid open channel are trial method, approximate solution and iteration method, whose shortcomings are needing great quantity of calculation and rough accuracy of solution. A method of Accelerating Genetic Algorithm based on real coding (RAGA) was adopted to overcome the shortcomings in this paper. The Simulated Annealing algorithm (SA) was used to improve the convergence rate during the late of evolution of RAGA. The result of case study shows that SA can prevent from a local optimal value during the course of late period of optimization of RAGA and it is showed that convergence rate of SARAGA was faster 20% than that of RAGA. The accuracy of calculated results of SARAGA is higher than that of usual optimal methods for solve a critical depth of trapezoid open channel. Furthermore, SARAGA can be used to deal with some optimization problems in other fields.

articleTitle: Study on the Price Discovery Function of China Steel Futures
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on Co-integration test, Granger causality test, GS model and VEC model, this paper did the empirical analysis for the price discovery function of steel rebar futures and steel wire rod futures at SHFE. The major findings of this study are: (1) The futures' prices and spots' prices for both steel rebar and steel wire rod have the long-term co-integration relationship. There is two-way leading function between futures and spots. (2) With a high trading volume, The Steel Rebar futures play major role in price discovery and can be used for hedging risk. (3)With a low trading volume, the steel wire rod futures have less effect than spots in price discovery.

articleTitle: Study on Cooperation between Complementary Companies: Based on Evolutionary Game and Reference Effect
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The companies providing complementary products or services always have many similarities, which makes it possible to cooperate in a lot of areas to decrease operational cost and increase profit. This article based on the assumption of bounded rationality study (1) the traditional evolutionary game and (2) evolutionary game considering reference effect of the two complementary companies. By modeling them and comparing them, we can get the results that more allocation benefits contribute to higher cooperation possibility, with the reference effect being considered.

articleTitle: The Research on Brand Community Based on Community Activities
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Brand Community mode has a great effect on the development of an enterprise. Building well-established brand community becomes the main strategy for an enterprise to keep the relationship with customers, to level up the capital of the brand and to enhance the customers' loyalty. This paper studies brand community from the community activities and proposes some suggestion for building and managing brand community.

articleTitle: Product Quality and Trade Credit: Empirical Investigation into the Trade Credit from Quality Assurance Motivate in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Evidences from foreign countries show that trade credit signals the product quality. Through an empirical research based on the panel data of listed manufacturing firms in China from 2001 to 2003, the result indicates that the big-size firm has more warranty in its product quality, thus less credit and short time payment terms is provided. Those firms, with high-tech products and a large amount of R & D, provide more trade credit and longer time payment terms.

articleTitle: Research on Knowledge Management of State Key Lab in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: During the epoch of knowledge-based economy, knowledge management is important to the state key lab. This paper discusses on the problems of knowledge management of state key lab in China. Based on this, this research develops knowledge management process and flow pattern according the sample of four state key labs. The result reveals the knowledge management process includes six steps, and is a cyclical and dynamic loop, not a simple chain.

articleTitle: Synergistic Analysis of Material Flow of Economy-Environment System in the District-A Case Study of Minhang District, Shanghai
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The economy and ecological aspects in social system are coherently linked and can be examined by its material and energy flows. In this study, material flow analysis and synergistic analysis were employed to investigate the material input and output in Minhang District of Shanghai from the year 2000 to 2006. The analysis results showed that: (1) The grey order degree of economic sub-system showed monotonically increasing trend during the study period, which indicated there is a more rational economic structure and the solid construction of circular economy. (2) The grey order degree of resource subsystem showed the growth trend of the fluctuations during the study period, which indicated energy; water and biomass are important constraint Minhang future development. If Minhang keep the current economic development model and speed, energy demand and water demand will continue to grow and become major constraints of the future development in Minhang District, (3) The grey order degree of environment sub-system showed monotonically increasing trend during the study period, but compared to the needs of the construction of circular economy, intravenous Industry development is not enough.

articleTitle: Analysis of Credit Risk and Avoidance in Security Vulnerabilities Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper attempts to analyze the cause of security vulnerabilities trading risk by the models of Information Asymmetry, explore the sources of credit risk, and find ways to avoid risk.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Potential of Service Economics in China--On the Perspective of Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Scale of Input-Output in Diversified Railway
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, with DEAP Version 2.1,we analyzed the total efficiency and the scale of input-output on the basis of the statistic materials of all sorts of 18 diversified railways. The result shows that the scale efficiency of diversified railway is less than 1. Investment in fixed assets is on the high side, and profit is short. The best way to improve efficiency for 11 DEA inefficiency railway bureaus is found.

articleTitle: Implicit Multi-Dimension Fit Assessment in Personnel Selection Decision-Making Process
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Personnel assessment and selection is one of the most effective approaches to obtain the organizational competitive advantage. Traditional personnel selection technique based on competency assessment can't satisfy the organizational need, therefore, emphasize the importance of P-J-O fit in selection context. Based on the ASD growth model, this study conduct a semi interview, find out that the construct of the assessment could include five aspects: competency, KSAs, Values, personality and need-supplies.

articleTitle: Maintenance Decision-Making of Existing Buildings Based on System Optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, the fault results and maintenance decision-making chart of existing buildings were discussed, which include three fault results, the maintenance work types, and the logic decision chart; the maintenance decision-making models of existing buildings was established, which include three fault results models, and the optimal objective decision function of maintenance system for existing buildings. Finally, a case study of maintenance decision-making for existing buildings in urban renewal at Chaozhou historic city of China was introduced.

articleTitle: Risk Management for Infrastructure of Urban Gas Fuel Net-work System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Gas fuel net-work system is one kind of urban infrastructure which is very important to urban safety. At the same time, it is a potential hazardous source for the reason that people and properties around the system are subject to the risk from it. Risk management for this system is used to prevent these undesired events and improve the safety level of this system. In this paper, pipeline failure probability, accidents consequence mainly jet fire and explosion, risk criteria and risk control measures were analyzed respectively, these research can offer some useful suggestions to pipeline construction plan and pipeline accidents' rescue and evacuation.

articleTitle: The Application of Strategic Human Resource Management in Staff Training
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: How to make the training objectives forward-looking and initiative to achieve the union of the training objectives, organizational goals and personal goals; how to integrate resources effectively in training and improve the efficiency of training; how to achieve the transfer of the training effects, etc., are all training management problems to be solved. This article introduced the concept of strategic human resource management and analyzed the role of strategy orientated training as well as the implementation. This article believed that strategic human resource management can achieve the union of the training objectives, organizational goals and personal goals, and integrate various kinds of resources inside and outside the organization and transfer the results of training, enhance the training effect, and improve the core competencies of organization.

articleTitle: An Improved Method for Integrated Planning Model of Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Lagrangian relaxation technology is used to optimize the integrated planning model for supply chain, which is established by the factors such as price, inventory etc. To reduce the duality gap of lagrangian relaxation, an improved method with lagrangian relaxation and genetic algorithm is applied in the model. The number results prove the effectiveness of the model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis of Capital Market for China Aviation Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After the finance crisis, China's aviation industry has entered a reform period with rapid development. In face of the severe international situation, the self optimizing development of China's aviation industry has to be realized in a circumstance of capital market. The optimization and reorganization of the aviation industry basing on capital market will face many risks and challenges from the market. In this thesis, the market risk of the reorganization of China's aviation industry is analyzed, and some solutions are proposed under the current circumstance.

articleTitle: Research of Supplier Selection Based on Multi-Objective Programming
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies evaluation indices and selection methods by summarizing previous articles about supplier selection firstly, selects quality, price and delivery as evaluation indicators, and analyzes their priorities according to different characteristics of each stage of product life cycle (that is introduction, growth, maturity and decline). The paper proposes a model of multi-objective programming in different periods to resolve problem of supplier quantity and procurement allocation. Finally, an example is given to study feasibility and sensitivity of the model.

articleTitle: The Theory and Empirical Study on the Sensation Scenario Analysis Based on the Customer Perceived Value
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the perceived uniqueness of the service sector not only has the characteristics of the service itself, while the customer perceptions of quality expectations is difficult, as easy-to-measure benefits such as goods, how to determine and achieve customer perceived value will be of particular importance. In this paper, cognitive psychology, the concept of the environment, competitiveness, competitor information, and other scenario analysis, and construct structural equation model, to validate the perception scenario the impact of perceived value to the customer.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Impact of LIS Open Access Journals
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study selected 97 LIS open access journals, and evaluated the impact of them. The results indicated that LIS open access journals had become significant component of scholarly communication, Journal of Medical Library Association had the highest citation counts in Web of Science, followed by D-Lib Magazine and Information Research. Journal of Medical Library Association, D-Lib Magazine, Information Research, Ariadne, Cybermetrics, and First Monday were the 6 most important LIS open access journals, 10 classic papers were published on Cybermetrics (4), Journal of Medical Library Association (2), D-Lib Magazine (2), Information Research (1), and First Monday (1), " Sitations: an exploratory study " ranked 1st of the 10 classic papers. As the coverage in LISA, Bulletin des Bibliotheques de France (2151) performed best, followed by Journal of Medical Library Association (2068) and Information Research (850).

articleTitle: Delayed Response and Quantified Lake Health Indexes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The water resources development has changed the water and sediment situation in the waterway and ruined the balance between the lake system and the eco-environment. It is important to realize the new environment after the change of the water and sediment situation, and to explore the effective environmental improvement measures for the sustainable development and the lake health. Healthy lake is a lake whose social functions and natural functions can be balanced or compromised in corresponding periods. The indexes reflecting a healthy lake should be favorable lake bed, acceptable water quality and favorable lake ecosystem, and the social functions and natural functions of a lake perform in a balanced way. The lake health indexes should reflect the lake's natural function status which includes the lake bed, water quality, lake ecosystem and the relative runoff. The variety and quantity would be different for different lakes because of different natural features and social background. The indexes should be decided according to the requirement of maintaining lake's normal natural functions and the extent whether the social functions and the natural functions could perform in the balanced way, and also the indexes should be adjusted according to the change of the natural features and social background. The key to describe the lake health situation is to find out the relatively balanced lake situation based on several critical quantified indexes such as the runoff discharge into the lake, water quality etc., which are influenced by the delayed response of the lake to the changing upstream water and sediment conditions. This paper proposed a method to identify the relatively balanced lake condition and lake health indexes.

articleTitle: Resource Rent and Convenience Yield of Mineral Energy Resources
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Mineral energy resources are state-owned common property resources in China, while the licensed mining rights witness the transition of mineral energy resources from common property goods to private goods from the economic perspective. However, this process should take in account the usually overlooked or underestimated transfer of underlying monopoly rent formed by the monopoly supply and the consequent scarcity rent formed by the increasing excessive demand because mineral energy resources are non-renewable and exhaustible. This paper re-examines the resource rent of mineral energy resources based on the nature of goods, and argues the monopoly rent and scarcity rent are quasi-rents and will elicit the potential convenience yield in mineral energy resource products. Therefore, it proposes to levy the excessive progressive ad valorem mining royalities or mining taxation upon their convenience yields, and revaluate the corporations of mineral energy resources to ensure the fair distribution of mineral wealth to the national government as the resource property owner.

articleTitle: Travel Time Choice Behavior of Travelers' Non Working Activity
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Activity participation and time choice research is help for understanding the basis of travelers' behavior decision-making. Based on the surveyed travel data of Jilin city, travelers' time choice behaviors of non working activities were analysis by employing a duration model, which calculated the hazard ratios of activity participation in different time spans and provided some useful information regarding the factors that influence the activity start time, such as traveler' gender, salary or other socio-demographics. The results show that the duration model could anticipate the choice probabilities of non working activity in different time span and provide some valuable advises to transportation programming and management.

articleTitle: Product Maturity and Its Fuzzy Evaluation Model with Entropy -AHP Weight
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Product maturity model is capable to plan and control concurrent product development process, which the accurately evaluation of product maturity is particularly important. For this purpose, product maturity model and the key factor architecture of product maturity was constructed from the perspective of the integrity of product information model. To determine the weight of the key factors, the calculation method which combines entropy weight method and AHP was proposed. And the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation was used to evaluate product maturity. The fuzzy evaluation model with entropy-AHP weight was established by integrating the above-mentioned methods. The rapid development of PDM technology guarantees the feasibility of implementation of this model.

articleTitle: The Bank Assets Allocation under Equilibrium Liquidity Management Strategy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Bank assets allocation is one of the most important project of bank management. In this paper, we built sub-optimization models within DD model's three-period framework to study bank's assets allocation under equilibrium liquidity management strategy when bank faces depositors' early withdrawals. Our study shows that when a variety of interest rates and parameters satisfy certain conditions, the equilibrium liquidity management strategy will reduce bank's cash holding and increase bank's profit and max solvency in varying degrees, so that the bank can balance its profit and liquidity. The empirical tests show that Chinese commercial banks have the problem of assets solid-state which can make bank face liquidity risk, so we need to concern about it.

articleTitle: A Meta-Analysis of Value-Driven Service Customer Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A value-driven service satisfaction model is developed and tested in this research in order to know how customer's perceived value, defined in terms of benefits and sacrifices, systematically influences customer's satisfaction in service. By using meta-analytical method, the empirical generation results of 57 quantitative studies from 1980 to 2007 reveal that not only value construct as a whole can influence customer's satisfaction, but also the benefits and sacrifices parts of it can influence satisfaction directly and separately.

articleTitle: Over-Investment of Free Cash Flow--An Empirical Evidence from Chinese Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper examines the extent of firm level over-investment of free cash flow on Chinese capital market. Based on Scott Richardson's framework to measure over-investment and free cash flow (2006), the research introduces a new method to quantify the Chinese companies' over-investment and free cash flow, and provides evidence that in china, consistent with agency cost explanation, the mangers in the company with more free cash flow has stronger motivation to over-investment. The study suggests that firms with positive free cash flow over-invest.

articleTitle: The Study on Quality Advanced of Industrial Workers Based on Industrial Upgrading of Zhejiang Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the beginning of 2010, "Shortage of migrant workers" is once again attracting attention. At the same time, it presents two opposite views: "Shortage of migrant workers reminds that we should accelerate the pace of industrial upgrading" and "Shortage of migrant workers may not be able to force industrial upgrading, they may lead the industry to collapse ". The industrial upgrading is one of three big projects which would be put into effect to realize a strategic plan to build the advanced manufacturing industry base. And this paper studies large amount of related documents about industrial upgrading home and abroad, sums up the connotation and routes of industrial upgrading, and analyses the close relevance between the industrial upgrading and quality advanced of industrial workers in Zhejiang province. The paper emphasizes that, quality advanced of industrial workers will be a very hard and important project to realize industrial upgrading and build the advanced manufacturing industry base.

articleTitle: Modeling to Organization-Equality Evaluation and Demonstration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to constitute a model that apply to evaluate an organization-equality, according to the result of the evaluation model, the leaders of the organizations should establish a sort of policy to make sure the organization will run in a more fair way and the relatively equality will be formed within the organization eventually, and finally a harmonious social system can be established.

articleTitle: The Gross Product of the World Game 2009 in Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The World Game 2009 has been the first mega sport event hosted by Taiwan. This study is concerned about the economic benefits contributed by this game. This paper analyzed its gross product by investigating the total amount of all the participants, including Estimated Consumption of domestic and foreign of this game. The conclusions of 2009 World Games held in Kaohsiung area business economy has been a positive influence.

articleTitle: The Grey Simulation of Gross Value of Construction Industry in Central China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As a major industry in China, construction industry value weights a lot in GDP. In order to better simulate the development trends of this industry in Central China, this paper propose the first-order one-variable grey differential equation model (abbreviated as GM(1,1) model) from grey system theory as the main simulation tool. The conclusion is that the growth trends of Anhui, Jiangxi, Hubei and Hunan can be directly simulated. Through using smoothing processes and sensitivity analysis methods, the gross values of Shanxi and Henan can also be depicted with differential equations.

articleTitle: Application Study of Investment Risk Analysis of Coastal Transportation Business of Liquid Chemical Products
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the diversification of financing method, and the characters of huge investment of the coastal transportation business of liquid chemical products project, the investment costs will be uncertain. At the same time, the uncertainty of operational costs, shipping price and quantities add to the importance of the financial risk analysis to the success of the project in financial evaluation stage for the owner or in the tendering decision making stage for the contractors. In this paper, one project financial risk analysis method based on probability theory and Monte Carlo simulation technique has been put forward, and applied in the coastal transportation business of liquid chemical products project.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Non-Symmetric Evolutionary Game of Virtual Enterprise Knowledge Transfer
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the premise of limited rationality, the varied member enterprises in Virtual Enterprise can carry on Repeated Non-symmetric Games, simulate gradually by choosing advantageous strategy based on different profit and reach a balanced stable evolutionary state by adopting certain strategy finally. According to evolutionary game theory and the basic theory of Virtual Enterprise Knowledge Transfer, we construct the non-symmetric evolutionary Game model of Virtual Enterprise Knowledge Transfer. We carry on model in different income parameters, making an evolutionary analysis of non-symmetric co-competition game and finally find out some different strategies while doing knowledge transfer for the member of Virtual Enterprise. it will help to construct incentive mechanism of knowledge transfer in Virtual Enterprises that the analysis of Non-Symmetric Evolutionary Game of knowledge transfer among the members, Thereby enhancing the competitive advantage of Virtual Enterprises.

articleTitle: Study of Facility Location and Allocation Problem Based on Fuzzy Graph Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The location and allocation of regional distribution center is the key problem of logistics distribution network, it concerns that whether the distribution system can perform efficiently. The paper sets up a mathematic location model of generalized transportation costs on basis of economic scale, and then solves Location and Allocation Problem of regional distribution center by means of Fuzzy graph theory. Finally, compares the solution of Fuzzy graph theory with the one of dynamic cluster analysis through an example, it shows that the use of Fuzzy graph theory in solving this problem can decrease the calculating scale and time evidently, especially when the Fuzzy equivalent matrix can not be ascertained, this algorithm is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Strategy Research of International Trade Financing of Small and Medium Foreign Trade Enterprises in Heilongjiang Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the expansion of foreign trade scale and the increasing of demand for capital of enterprise in Heilongjiang Province, we advance new demand of trade financing. However, compared to coastal developed cities, the trade financing in Heilongjiang province still has a long way to go. Because of enterprises'having not enough knowledge of trade financing, bank's lacking of creativity and imperfection of credit system, the foreign trade enterprises in Heilongjiang province have the problems of effective demand insufficiency and the obstruction of supply in trade financing. Based on the background of increasingly internationalization of financing and foreign trade enterprises' imperious demands for funds, this paper started from the current situation of trade financing of foreign trade enterprises of Heilongjiang province, explored the problems and obstacles existed in the trade financing cooperation between foreign trade enterprises and banks, proposed the conception about trade financing mode selection strategy and new enterprises' credit system for the first time. We pointed out that the bank's trade finance products and their pricing should be adapted to the actual needs of foreign trade enterprises, and stressed that the commercial banks should strengthen the risk control of trade financing and so on, in order to comprehensively promote foreign trade and economic sustainable development of Heilongjiang Province.

articleTitle: Security of Short Piles for High-Rise Building in Nanning
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In Nanning basin, because of the peculiar relief and stratum model, the bearing support soil layers for pile foundation of high-rise buildings generally is gravel layer or mudstone layers or sandstone layers. On first or second terrace in basin, gravel layer is most chose as the bearing stratum for pile foundation of high-rise buildings. Static driven piles are commonly used in Nanning, because they have advantages of fast construction, high bearing capacity and noiseless despite costly. It is inevitable to form short-piles foundation, as a result of the length of piles will be too short for need of basement and becoming diminishingly thin of overlaying soil which terraces gradually rise to results in. Therefore many academic and engineering problems are occurred, which make engineers confused. Base on studying many engineering cases, conception and application and research situation for short piles were discussed in this paper, and some problem that aimed at to be brought about in Nanning stratum model, for example, calculation mode, vertical bearing capacity of pile foundation, construction cost, stability, construction and so on, were analyzed. Approach of settlement above problems was proposed. At the same time, it is considered to be a future potential danger if short piles are not droved into the bearing support layer of piling foundation.

articleTitle: Optimal Incentive Mechanism Design under Adverse Selection and Moral Hazard
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We investigate the design of optimal incentive mechanism under adverse selection and moral hazard with risk neutral principal and agents.The optimal incentive payment contract is derived.The interesting comparative statics of the optimal incentive contract are analyzed.First, we show that the optimal level of effort is an increasing function of the ability of agent and less than the one in symmetric information. Second, the optimal incentive wage contracts are Composed of a fixed income and performance related income. The fixed-income part of the optimal incentive contract is an increasing function of type. We also show that high ability agent obtain higher wage in success and lower one in failure than low ability agent for the performance related income.

articleTitle: Efficiency Measure and Analysis of Year Rural Infrastructure Investment Based on Malmquist-DEA: 1990-2007
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Analyzing investment efficiency of rural infrastructure is an important way to further exploit investment capacity and optimize resources distribution. On the basis of expounding basic principles of Malmquist-DEA, it chooses infrastructure investment of the east-central-west regions including 29 DMUs panel data in 1990-2007, and then analysis the annual change of MPI and variation trend of each group in order to improve investment efficiency of rural infrastructure in the east-central-west regions.

articleTitle: Mineral Resources Development Strategy in China--Macro-Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper offers an in-depth examination of the strategy trend of development and macro-management of mineral resources in China should be dynamic management of reserves: moderate development of resources, strategic resource reserves, overall value increase of mining area, dividing-area management of mineral resources, regulation and optimization of mining structure and layout, paid use of mineral resources, effective compensation for the ecological environment of mining area (or mine), management of mine safety and sustainable utilization of land in mining area etc. The paper analyzes and discusses all the eleven aspects above.

articleTitle: Study on the Urban Traffic Pollution Management Strategy in China --Taking the Typical Private Car City of Suzhou for Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The 20th century witnessed a rapid development of private car in China. More and more personal motors flood into the households. Traffic pollution caused by this has led to the air and sound pollution in the city, which does great harm to health and life quality of those who live in the city. Traffic pollution has become the focus of the world. By taking the typical "private car city" - Suzhou as an example, this paper analyzes the feature of urban traffic pollution in China and introduces some successful experience in controlling traffic pollution both at home and abroad. It focuses on discovering some practical strategies in controlling the urban traffic pollution in terms of management, policy and technology with the purpose of providing some illuminating ideas in the sustainable development of the urban traffic in China.

articleTitle: Research of SOA-Based CRM in Telecommunications Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper first analyzes the architecture of the existing CRM in operators and its disadvantages. When operators integrate the 3G services into their business, it is necessary to propel their business support system shift from DOA (data-oriented architecture) to SOA (service-oriented architecture).Then an architecture of the CRM system based on SOA is presented. The paper finally takes an example of how to integrate the CRM and SFS based on SOA.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on Escalation Factors of Conversion from Task Conflict to Relationship Conflict
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Cluster Analysis on Level of Performance of County Government Financial Resource Integration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper applies SPSS13.0 statistical analysis software, uses cluster analysis method, and conducts cluster analysis on level of performance of county government financial resource integration for parts of the county of Liaoning Province. The results show that level of performance of county government financial resource integration has imbalances, the larger gap and significant geographical differences. Finally, the article puts forward corresponding measures and recommendations on how to improve county government financial resource integration in Liaoning Province, narrow regional disparities and promote coordinated development of regional economy.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors That Influence the Output of Regional Technology Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper uses the dependence on foreign trade as the index of internationalization degree. It sets up the knowledge production function of regional technology innovation output, and does econometric analysis by using panel data of 30 provinces and autonomous in China. The empirical analysis suggests that internationalization is an important factor of influencing the regional technology innovation output. However, not all of the provinces can benefit from internationalization. Internationalization has great impact on the technology innovation output for eastern China, and has little impact on western China.

articleTitle: Dynamic Expansion of Power Capacity under Competitive Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Dynamic expansion of power capacity under competitive situation is a new topic that power market research faces. On which this thesis programs related discussion by means of Stochastic Dynamic Game Approach. Based on S-adapted open-loop information structure, this thesis frames a multi-stage model of dynamic power capacity expansion game under power demand stochastic uncertainty in the market, and then this thesis reaches a three-stage duopoly game equilibrium solution. Sensitivity analysis in this thesis signifies the correlation between added capacity and cost at each stage and the correlation between other participants' initial capacity and uncertainty.

articleTitle: Study on Agent Construction System for Government Investment Projects: A Mode Choosing Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper sums up the present characteristics on agent construction system through literature review, investigation and organizational structure analysis based on the performance evaluation of the projects. There are three modes available in China, which are Shenzhen mode, Shanghai mode and Beijing mode. The three modes have their own origins with adaption for different local governments. So many projects invested by the government are well prepared and operated. However, some of them did not succeed in the unsuitable mode choosing. By field research from Beijing, Dalian, Shanghai, Shanxi and Ningxia provinces of China, we bring forward a feasible choosing model for local government which contains Exterior conditions, Stakeholders and Project features. What is more, it aims to provide theoretical evidence for mode choosing for local government in China.

articleTitle: Asymmetric Information, Noise Traders and Chinese IPO Initial Returns
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: While the initial return of IPOs (Initial public offers) is a long argued anomaly, the view of IPO being underpriced is doubted by some empirical researches with the discovery of IPOs' overpricing. By introducing the impact of noise traders in IPO events and considering the two types of factors of asymmetric information and noise traders together, this paper systematically explained the abnormal initial return of IPOs. The findings suggest that both of the two factors can explain the so high initial return of IPOs in China, but only the factor of noise traders is the exactly main. Further, the positive feedback traders can also explain it well as the sentiment investors focused by previous studies.

articleTitle: Study on Financial Risks and Supervision under the Pattern of Mixed Operation in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Mixed operation is the optimal choice of the finance under dynamic conditions while pursuing its profits in competition. China finance industry is being transferred from divided operation to mixed operation, the setup of intersection, interpenetration; co-operation and development among finance are coming into being in China. It is necessary to pave the way and improve the level of financial supervision for Chinese financial industry to defense the risks of mixed operation, enhance their international competitiveness.

articleTitle: The Risk Management of Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the globalization, a product is assembled by various parts of the product that are produced in different countries. How to finish the task? It depends on the supply chain. The products are transported different area of the worlds by the supply chain; the enterprise gets the profit when the products are sold. But the supply chain suffers the different risks that are caused by uncertain economic cycles, consumer demands, and natural and manmade disasters. This paper analyzes various different supply chain risks and states various supply chain risk management strategies. We hope the risk management strategies can lower the risk of the supply chain and increase the profit of enterprise.

articleTitle: Information, Trust and Investment Return-- The Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper has researched that the public information which is based on the trusting of market participator effect on the investment return. The more trustable of public information in market, the cost of capital of listed company, in other words, the investment return of capital market investor would be reduced. Based on data of China's stock market, the study have shown that the number of information disclosure by listed company, and the trust of market participants to the system of information disclosure, has significant effecting on cost of capital. But the evidence of disclosure timeliness effecting on cost of capital, in this paper, has not be founded.

articleTitle: Analysis on Influence Factors of High-Tech Industrial Technical Innovation Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this article, we use the method of data envelopment analysis (DEA) to measure the national high-tech industrial technical innovation efficiency (TIE), using TOBIT model to analyze the influence factors of the national TIE and the eastern, central and western regions. In our country the level of TIE is low and that between regions is widely different. There is a significantly positive correlation between national high-tech industrial TIE and the level of regional industrialization, between that and the level of science and technology; There is a significantly positive correlation between innovation efficiency and innovation diffusion of the eastern and central region; In the western region invested funds of enterprise in S&T activities has a significantly positive effect on TIE.

articleTitle: Case Studies Analysis of the Difference in Characteristics in Web 2.0 Social Techno Graphics Ladder Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Web2.0 technologies explore a wide range of actions. This study discussion of employees eLearning2.0 awareness and use of the current situation to investigate Internet use behavior in Health Tatsu Standard enterprise at Taiwan. The research investigates the case staff's social network behavior, the staff's Web 2.0 technical services, and the use of Web2.0 tools and services.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for SWS Matching Based on Subsumption Relation Defined in Domain Ontology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Semantic Web Services (SWS) is proposed to ensure Web Service core missions automation, nevertheless, a dedicated Web Service discovery technology based on SWS is desired currently. For this reason, we propose an effective SWS matching algorithm to achieve service discovery based on semantics. In the paper, we first refine core properties and requirements to apply subsumption relation to involved SWS matching method, which is based on the semantic information of service's inputs and outputs. Then, we discuss a feasible service semantic matching algorithm in detail. Next, we implement and test it in related SWS registry. Finally, we point out its main properties. In fact, the algorithm proves to fully satisfy our expectations and be practical and feasible.

articleTitle: Transnational Cultural Conflict and Cross-Cultural Management Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Cross-cultural conflict is the important factor in the success or failure of the multinational company operating. This paper focused on analyzing the reasons for the formation of cross-cultural conflict and countermeasures to resolve cultural conflicts.

articleTitle: Knowledge Management, European Paradox and Triple Helix
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As everybody knows there is no automatic transfer of the results of researches on the economic and social world (business and public administration) despite the high quality of them. That's why the authors suggest the most appropriate and effective modalities to ensure that the results of the research can be absorbed by the economic and social world to become innovations. The aim is to enable companies to become more competitive and to the public administration to become more efficient. Of these perspectives there is increasingly need in Europe (European paradox), but also in China.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Market Concentration Rate and Transformation of Business Model in Investment Banking Business
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Investment Banking Business has the features of high homogeneity and standardization because of capital-intensive and high demand. It has the obvious features of economies of scale industries. This has been proved by the development and the theory researches in the West countries in the past century. Through the development of Investment Banking Business in our country in recent 20 years, the number of securities is increasing and the scale is enlarging. This article analyzes the business scale of Investment Banking Business by suing Market Concentration Rate index, and points out that it is not desirable to increase brokerage scale and economic benefit by merely depending on enlarging the numbers of sales departments. The essential is to transform the business models of Investment Banking Business.

articleTitle: Encouragement Mechanism for Knowledge Innovation in Multi-Organizational Information Systems Integration Based on Variable Compensation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Information systems integration is implemented on foundation of knowledge innovation, and effective mechanism is needed to promote knowledge innovation. Firstly, knowledge innovation parameter is put forward, and knowledge innovation cost model is built up based on it. Then mechanism on fixed paying is analysis to find that it could not promote knowledge innovation. Because of this mechanism on variable paying is put forward and it could promote knowledge innovation effectively. Further more, variable paying proportion is decided on how hard and how difficult the existed supplier work in knowledge innovation.

articleTitle: Study on Establishment and Quantitative Evaluation of the Index System for Chinese Agricultural Production Modernization-A Case Study of Jiangsu Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Until now there is no unified index system for agricultural production modernization around the country. This research takes the agricultural production modernization as a system. Based on the full consideration on the status quo, the index optimization has been conducted gradually by small-group discussions, specific research, counseling with the peers and administrative department. Combined with the availability and quality of statistical data, the index adjustment has been done with the aid of modern statistical analysis methods, so a systematic index system of agricultural production modernization has been formed. Then, taking 13 cities of Jiangsu Province as the example, data of the agricultural production modernization have been collected, standardized and analyzed relevantly in accordance with the hierarchy analysis and statistical model. Finally, the process of the agricultural production modernization in Jiangsu province has been appraised and sorted.

articleTitle: Research on BSC-Based Quality Evaluation of Enterprise Business Websites
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: More and more enterprises have started Electronic Commerce (EC) in recent years, and the quality of business websites plays a crucial role in the EC development. Based on the characteristics and effects of business websites, this paper first establishes the Balanced Scorecard-based (BSC) evaluation index system, determines the index weight by means of entropy of information theory and Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). It then appraises the quality of enterprise business websites in terms of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. An example of a certain enterprise business website is provided finally to verify the rationality of the evaluation index system and the validity of the evaluation method.

articleTitle: Incremental Evaluation Method- An Integrated Method to Assess Urban Energy System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: How to make decisions to choose urban energy systems is the key issue for urban energy planners or policy makers. It's crucial to develop an integrated method to assess urban energy system. Present methods emphasize on economic evaluation of energy system and care less for the difference and distinctiveness between planned system and traditional one. It can't reveal the incremental cost of energy-efficient techniques. Based on cost-effectiveness analysis method, an innovative incremental evaluation method (IEM) is introduced from the view point of energy increment index ΔE, environment increment index ΔP and economic increment index ΔZ, which focus on the difference between input and output increments in energy system to reduce negative effects of uncertain human factor and lower the workload of evaluation. IEM can be defined as an economic benefit analysis between the planned energy system and target energy system based on input and output increment analysis to meet the same energy demanding. Firstly, principle of IEM is present including the calculation of equivalent weight of various energy resources and environment emissions. Then, using quadrant diagram and Strengths-Weaknesses-Opportunities-Threats (SWOT) strategy analysis, IEM are analyzed in detail. And concepts of equivalent energy value and equivalent environment value are defined to assess systems both in II and IV quadrant. Finally, a case of different power plants is evaluated using IEM. It concludes that as an integrated assessment method, IEM reveals the difference and distinctiveness between planned system and traditional or popular one with a clear physical meaning but less negative effects of human factor and lower evaluation workload.

articleTitle: Study of Metrics System for Information Fusion Evaluation Methodology Based on Rough Set Theory in Intelligent Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: he theories and methods of performance evaluation for multi-sensor data fusion system based on Multiple Approximation Space are discussed. A information fusion performance criteria system is founded with C3I applications as background, the evaluation process is similar to the decision process, the general way of integration system evaluation and the algorithm of assign the weights to condition attributes using rough set are presented. In the meantime, a framework is presented for performance test and evaluation of the multi-sensor data fusion. At last, the algorithm of information fusion and the choice of parameters can be directed by using software, and experimental results reveal the efficiency of the method.

articleTitle: The Study of Human Capital Accounting of Venture Capital Project Based on EVA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The article Starting from the human capital costing, Mathematical Modeling as a leading, put forward research ideas that Divided Corporate profit into two parts of human capital and Physical capital. Building human capital accounting model Through the economic value added model (EVA), And then make a study of Human Capital Accounting. Provide a basis for Human Capital Accounting, and has solved the calculating difficulty of the human capital to some extent.

articleTitle: Studies on Human Resources in Science and Technology from a Nordic-Countries-Based Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the human resources in science and technology (HRST) construction analysis in three Nordic countries----Finland, Sweden and Denmark, the paper has illustrated the fundamental role of HRST construction in the national innovation capabilities upgrading. The paper finds that the three nations' transfer from small agricultural countries to highly innovated developed ones in several decades attributes greatly to their far-sighted strategies and policies in Talents Education, Talents Mobility, Foreign Talents Attraction as well as Science and Technology Awards Settings. And solutions to the problems emerged in the HRST construction in China are explored.

articleTitle: Research on Trust in C2C E-Marketplace
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study examined the antecedents and subsequences of trusting belief in C2C marketplace utilizing an integrated model, which posits that consumer-based and institution-based factors influence trusting belief in C2C marketplace, which further indirectly (mediated by the attitude) affect the willingness to participate in a C2C marketplace. Data were collected from respondents using questionnaire. The results of the analysis demonstrate that the two aspects have a significant influence on trusting belief in C2C marketplace, and provide support for 5 of the 7 hypotheses. The research results extend, augment, and apply prior research to an increasingly prevailed C2C marketplace domain. Our research contributes to theory and practice in C2C marketplace by focusing on building trust as the crucial aspect and integrating theory developed in other E-business contexts.

articleTitle: Age/Gender/Occupation and Mobile Phone Technology Adoption: A Cross-Cultural Study in China (Beijing) And the UK (Portsmouth)
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Mobile phone technology is popular globally, more and more people are communicating by mobile phones in different cultural environments. The aim of this study is to explore the mobile phone technology adoption by analyzing the influence of the age, gender and occupation of five different cohort samples from Beijing and Portsmouth. The findings are expected to support Hofstede's I/C cultural dimension that cultures (age, gender and occupation) influence people's attitudes and behaviour in adopting mobile phone technologies; to support the TAM theory that perceived usefulness, ease of use, cost, system quality and social influence affect consumers' adopting and using mobile phone technologies.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Methods for Airspace Sector Congestion Prediction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Abstract-In order to improve the accuracy of airspace sector congestion prediction, the probabilistic method for sector congestion prediction has been proposed. By analyzing the uncertainty of air traffic, on the basis of theoretical analysis about sector demand probabilistic forecasting, the sector demand probabilistic forecasting method and the sector congestion prediction method based on the Monte Carlo simulation have been proposed. The methods are easy to implement. The simulation results show that the methods reduce the uncertainty of the previous demand forecasting and improve the accuracy of sector congestion prediction.

articleTitle: Research on Personnel's Metewand Model Based on Brain Information Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To lay the foundation of further analysis of brain information characteristics, the article establishes a metewand model based on Uchida-Kraepelin test. The study can help to enhance the objectiveness and effectiveness of personnel assessment and service to their selection, use and training better.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Allocation in International Construction Projects
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: International construction projects are typical cases of researches in the field of risk management. The factors of human and nature which influence the success of construction are more uncertain and complex. This paper discusses some representative points in risk identification and classification of international construction projects. Risk allocation as a powerful methodology which improves the quality of risk management is presented. The importance and advantages of risk allocation is introduced. A framework of risk allocation for international construction projects is proposed.

articleTitle: A Research on the Relationship between Innovation Culture, Transformational Capabilities and Transformational Performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Organizational culture is closely related to organizational performance. The study tries to verify the relationship between innovation culture, transformational capabilities and transformational performance via multilevel organizational behavioral questionnaires. It points out that innovation culture have remarkably positive effect on transformational performance. The study farther indicates that transformational capabilities evidently mediate the impact of innovation culture on transformational performance.

articleTitle: Theories of Selective Attention and Presentation of Teaching Information in Multimedia-Based English Class
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The article generally analyzes the main theories concerning selective attention and some lasest findings in this aspect, and tries to integrate such theories with multimedia-based English class teaching, as well as explores such an issue as how to present in-class information and main factors which influence classroom attention. It is believed that the presentation of instructional information in class must take into consideration the learners' needs and their cognitive features. Besides, based on the theories of selective attention and some relevant researches, the principle of presenting instructional information in English class is put forward.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: How to Carry Out Service Innovation for Business Incubator? An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: System of Color Resource Management for Fashion Color Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Fashion color forecasting is more and more important to product development now. It is a creative work combined sense with sensibility and based on huge color resource analysis. In traditional color resource management, different kind of information is usually mixed together and designers can hardly compare accumulated resources and make trend prediction just from picture information. It not only wastes lots of useful information but also affects the accuracy of prediction. This system of color resource management aimed at supporting fashion color forecasting is very helpful and can be carried out by computer intelligence.
