It divides color resource management into 3 processes: (1) Color resource selecting and classifying. (2) Color resource numeration. (3) Color data optimization. This supposed system can let the color resource management more efficient and scientific and provide more practical data to fashion color forecasting.

articleTitle: Research on the Location of Knowledge Intensive Service Industry in Shanghai City
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We find the location of knowledge intensive service in Shanghai City by the means of Location Entropy of knowledge intensive service. The paper divides knowledge intensive service into information-dependence knowledge intensive service represented by the finance sector, innovative knowledge intensive service represented by design sector, and knowledge intensive service represented by hospital and school. We analyze in detail the location of three types of knowledge intensive service in Shanghai City and respectively sum up their location model.

articleTitle: The Research on System of Construction Materials Management by Project
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Theory and practice have proven that the cost of building materials accounts for a significant proportion in construction. The material saving is very cost-effective method for the enterprise, strengthen the material procurement management, timely, adequate, appropriate quality, suitable price to complete the procurement task is the goal of each enterprise; At present, resting on the building materials management by Project, this article focuses on the actual construction material purchasing pattern of current construction market and the analysis of the modern purchasing skill's merit and demerit. To promote the development of modern project management and improve the enterprise economic benefit, the "One Body Two Wings" materials procurement management system model and the system function analysis are presented in this paper, whichstarting from procurement process management of the construction materials, based on the system engineering theory, project management criteria and IT technical aids.

articleTitle: Research on the Logistics Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Intensified globalization and consequent competitive pressures have reemphasized the importance of third party logistics (3PL). Logistics distribution management is the core of logistics management. In this paper, We study a mathematics method to determine the logistics distribution location for reducing the logistics costs.

articleTitle: Management System Construction for Enterprise Logistics Outsourcing Based on Risk Aversion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to analyze the whole process of logistics outsourcing, identify the potential risks in every phase for logistics outsourcing including the decision-making phase, the implementation phase and the termination phase. On this basis, a logistics outsourcing management system was constructed with a view to risk aversion. The system put the outsourcing object at the core, include four blocks which are decision-making management, supplier management, enterprise internal management, control and feedback mechanisms.

articleTitle: Five Approaches to China's Urban Design Towards Rationality
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: One of the essential issues confronting the development of China's urban design is to seek a development approach towards scientific rationality. By reviewing and summarizing the development track of urban design in modern China, introspecting the problems and challenges when confronting its development, five approaches to develop scientific and rational urban design have been worked out i.e. market-orientated urban design, service-typed urban design, practical urban design, "legitimate" urban design as well as authentic urban design.

articleTitle: Analysis of China Stock Market: Volatility and Influencing Factors
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The volatility of stock market return is the main technique measurement in the risk management. This paper chooses GARCH class models to estimate in-sample period and to forecast out of sample period. The return of daily data was collected from Shanghai Stock Exchange, during the time period from January 1st 1997 to April 30th 2007. Three error measurement methods: ME, MAE and RMSE were used to evaluate the forecasting ability of GARCH class models. The empirical result indicates that EGARCH-M model is the best one for estimation of in-sample period. Asymmetric model or simple GARCH model is explained better for out of sample forecasting.

articleTitle: Regional Sustainable Construction Planning Information System Exploitation and Application in Civil Engineering Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Regional construction planning of civil engineering involved much content with different property and different character, and geographic variables and other data should also be used, such as vegetation, building, geology, road, pipeline etc. It should take large amount of personnel and energy to select and draw out the best scheme of regional construction planning in traditional way, especially in spatial topographic factors analysis and calculation. Furthermore, it was difficult to deal with spatial information and property information generally, efficiently in sustainable regional planning of civil engineering. In this paper, we make use of geographic information system (GIS) to handle spatial information in regional construction planning of civil engineering. A campus planning was investigated in the empirical studying. The data organization and general design principia were identified through the procession. The introduction plan of a campus construction and management GIS was put forward and then experimented through part of the function module and database of the system. The integrated regional construction planning system can help decision-makers and managers picking and analyzing spatial information and property information synchronously, and make scientific and sustainable decisions and schemes combined with planning policies and criterions.

articleTitle: Pricing Analysis for Remanufacture Products with Government's Incentive
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For the closed-loop supply chain system which is Posed by a single manufacturer and single-vendor,introducte government's reward and punishment. Compared and analysed pricing, recovery effort of enterprises with or without a reward and punishment among government, manufacturers and vendors. And discussed the manufacturers and vendors' profits as well as government benefits and total social benefits under different circumstances. Studies have shown that the product sales price, enterprise's recovery effort are related to the size of reverse logistics and the reward and punishment. At the same time when the reward and punishment is high enough, enterprises will increase their recall effort to increase their profits.

articleTitle: Six-Stage Hospital Beds Arrangement Management System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, the arrangement of hospital beds, utilizing the rule of First Come, First Serve (FCFS), reveals the common poor management of hospitals. Importantly, our proposed Six-stage Hospital Beds Arrangement Management System (Six-stage HBAMS) uses General Utility Function (utilizing Gray Correlation Analysis) to determine the hospitalization orders of patients. To verify Six-stage HBAMS, we use our proposed History Repeating Method utilizing our proposed Modified TOPOSIS Method as the evaluation method before we use Monte Carlo Simulation Algorithm for further verification. The result of verification demonstrates that Six-stage HBAMS is a reliable approach to improve the currently poor arrangement of hospital beds. At last, to achieve widely application of Six-stage HBAMS, we offer the method of model modification according to the matter of fact for hospital managers.

articleTitle: A Case Study on the Financial Early-Warning of State-Owned Commercial Banks with Efficacy Coefficient Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The financial early-warning research into state-owned commercial banks has not been carried out effectively due to the lack of samples. An easy and simple mode for financial performance early-warning could be established with the organic combination of optimum-aimed performance evaluation and security-aimed financial early-warning. With the efficacy coefficient method, the present paper illustrates the early-warning process of financial performance in state-owned commercial banks, which is significant for guiding the banks in strengthening their daily financial monitoring mechanism.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Logistics Service Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Effect Mechanism of Subordinates' Feeling Trusted on Loyalty to Supervisor
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study explores the effect of subordinates feeling trusted in the trust-loyalty interaction between Chinese supervisor and subordinates. We propose that subordinates' satisfaction with supervisor is the mediator in the effect process of subordinates feeling trusted on loyalty to supervisor. The proposed model is developed and tested. The findings indicate that feeling trusted positively affects their satisfaction with supervisor, and ultimately results in improving loyalty to supervisor. The article concludes with a discussion of some theoretical implications for trust research.

articleTitle: Framework for Evaluating the Service Quality of Project Preparation Consultants
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Project preparation work is the first stage of the implementation of a project, which has a crucial impact on the success of the project. In order to promote the standardization of project preparation consulting in China, this paper identifies comprehensive sets of evaluation criteria for the service process quality and service product quality of project preparation consultants, and the significance of these criteria is discussed by expert scoring method. Then, a multi-criteria model for evaluating the service quality of project preparation consultants is presented. At last the potential usages of the evaluation results are discussed.

articleTitle: Service Supply Chain and the Conceptual Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Compared with product supply chain, as a new field of study, service supply chain has not been taken seriously. With the service sector's role in the world economy becoming more prominent, research direction at home and abroad has shifted from the traditional product supply chain perspective to explore how to apply the supply chain thinking to the service industry. This paper summarizes the results of service research at home and abroad, defines the meaning of service supply chain, distinguishes the similarities and differences between product supply chain and service supply chain and builds a service supply chain model based on the system management which is characterized by integrated service provider-led and information processing.

articleTitle: BEST: An Assembler Structural Representation Tool Based on Flow Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: When mining security vulnerabilities in software, a structural intermediate representation of binary code should be obtained first. In this paper, we propose PANDA, a vulnerability-mining-oriented intermediate language and a series of algorithms for assembler understanding based on flow analysis. We implement a lightweight prototype system named BEST for assembler structural representation. The system uses control flow analysis and data flow analysis techniques to identify common control structures, analyze executive flow of a program, reconstruct expressions and functions, find data dependency, finally transform the assembler into a structured PANDA intermediate language program. Experiment results show that our system produces high quality intermediate language programs for further automatic security analysis.

articleTitle: A Method for Risk Assessment in IT Project with Incomplete Information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: When assessing risk in IT project, due to the limited knowledge, bias of subjective awareness and the impacts of environmental stress, the assessors often give the incomplete or even missing assessment information. In the case, the conventional assessment method can not effectively evaluate the risk factors in IT projects. This paper presents a method for risk assessment based on evidential theory, which can well evaluate the risk level of the IT project in the absence of information provided by experts. A study about risk assessment in an ERP project is applied to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Customized Training Model Evaluation System of Higher Vocational Education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Customized training model of higher education must be vigorously promoted. A customized training model evaluation system of higher vocational education should be built to help us improve the training model. Therefore, this paper first analyzes the strategic continuum of the customized training model of higher vocational education, and then builds the evaluation index, finally, adopts ANP approach to establish a multi-dimensional evaluation system.

articleTitle: Research and Improvement Based on Chord Protocol
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Distributed hash tables resource locating arithmetic in peer to peer network will lead the overlay topology is not congruent with the physical topology to a large extent. In this paper, an improved method taking advantage of structured node ID is promoted based on the serious research of Chord protocol. The experiments show the improved method can make the neighbouring nodes in physical topology approach as far as possible.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Cause of Employee Turnover Intention in Hotels
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The research constructs theoretical model of staff's turnover intention based on organization commitment and work stress. In this paper, 378 staffs in hotels in Yangtze River Delta cities are adopted as the trail samples. The result shows that career development and intercommunication tend to become the primary factor to influence staff turnover intention while organization commitment and work stress have significant relationship with staff turnover intention. The staff turnover rate would be low if the hotel can help the staff to improve career development expectation, build smooth communicating channels, enhance organization commitment, and reduce work stress.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Empirical Study on Gender Differences in Merchandise Picture Information Influencing Online Shopping Impulse
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on Ports Cooperation in China Tianjin and Hebei Area Based on Factor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Recently, the Tianjin and Hebei area has become one of the fastest developing areas in China. As the hub of logistics, the port system plays an important role in further boosting the region's economic development. This paper starts with an overview of port logistics in Hebei and Tianjin and then identifies the necessity of port cooperation in this area. An index system for port logistics competition is proposed on the basis of the connotation of port logistics competition. By using factor analysis, port logistics competition of each port in this area is evaluated. The results can be used to guide the positioning and development of each port based on its own advantages. Thus, the strength of the port logistics of the whole area can be improved.

articleTitle: Formation Mechanism of Quality and Safety Control Abilities of Core Enterprises in High Quality Pork Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Applying supply chain management is an effective approach to solve pork quality and safety problems in China at present, and it is the key of high quality pork supply chain management to form and improve quality and safety control abilities for supply chain core enterprises. On the basis of representing the construction of quality safety control abilities of core enterprises, this paper analyses the formation mechanism of quality and safety control abilities of core enterprises in high quality pork supply chain, from aspects of dynamic mechanism, conduction mechanism, realization mechanism, Incentive and restriction mechanism, and promotion and guarantee mechanism.

articleTitle: Study on the Application of FBG Monitoring on Roof Falling of Mine Based on Model Experiment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Using the Fiber Bragg Grating (FBG) monitoring technology, the signal characteristics of FBG anchor were studied and analyzed in this paper in order to diagnosis the stability of tunnel roof. To simulate the actual situation, a model experiment was carried out. Then according to the analysis of the experiment results, combining with the cusp catastrophe theory, the instability criterions of surrounding rock were established. The results showed that in the process of roof failure, the FBG signals could be divided in three stages of increase, steady and destructive mutation. During the process, variation of center wavelength was corresponding to the change of mine pressure, and transient vibration signal was corresponding to the blasting vibration. Meanwhile, high pressure would increase the response of signal, and shortened the three stages of signal change cycles. The mutation analyses showed that the mutation indicators could be divided into two types, and the surrounding pressure is the most significant effect of adverse factors.

articleTitle: Integrating Kano Model into Customer-Oriented Reputation Model in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Facing many rapid changes and challenges in the ever-increasing competitive pressure, higher education institutions are becoming increasingly aggressive in their service activities to raise their public reputation that is concerned by their customers. Higher education institutions are increasingly focusing on determining critical service attributes in order to fulfill customer needs and build a strong public reputation. This aim can be realized through an integrated model of Kano Model and Customer Oriented Reputation Model using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM). The objective of this research is to develop an integrated model that acquires critical service attributes that can promote good public reputation for higher education institutions. This integrated model is illustrated empirically in case study of Industrial Engineering department of four famous private universities in Jakarta, Indonesia.

articleTitle: Conceptual Model Used to Construct an Indicator System for Evaluating a City's Water Conservation Level
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An indicator system and an evaluation model are two important parts of evaluation. Successful evaluation is mainly decided by an indicator system. It is necessary to use an appropriate method to construct a comprehensive and scientific indicator system for accurate evaluation. Based on Entity-Relationship model and Sustainable Development model, hierarchy conceptual model is put forward to construct the indicator system for evaluating a city's water conservation in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Construction Cost Control Based upon BP Neural Network and Theory of Constraint
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Construction industry is an important material production sectors of the national economy, it has been an important pillar industry in China's economic development. Though the subprime mortgage crisis in the U.S. in 2008 has brought great impact on the global economy, large numbers of strong measures of domestic demand expansion issued China government which promoted stable and rapid economic growth and obtained remarkable achievements. A major reason for these achievements is a lot of construction investment, so the construction cost control is especially important when a huge capital is invested. However, In China, the current construction cost pricing model is changing from quota valuation pricing to bill of quantities (BOQ), the root of getting out of control is derived from the defect of the construction cost pricing model. This paper applies BP neural network to forecast the construction cost, and uses the outcome of the forecast to optimize the bill of quantities (BOQ), then takes advantage of the theory of constraint to control the construction cost based upon optimized the BOQ at last. A sample of data from six highways, including a testing data, using BP neural network simulation, building simulation model., The model fit well through 13 iterations, and the outputs of test data is consistent with the actual. Then using TOC to optimize based on the output, compared to the previous final account, the optimized final account of the project represents a reduction of 20.726 million yuan, lower by 1%.

articleTitle: Constructing Supply Chain Networks Based on the Adaptation Point of View
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Over the past few years, analysis of successful manufacturing and retail companies shows that in today's hyper-competitive business environment, supply chain efficiency is a necessary condition for survival. Falling margins, globalization, and accelerating innovation cycles are forcing businesses to switch from traditional supply chains to new pattern of supply chain which needs to respond to their environment in near real time. During the transition, companies must map the three key process enablers-the management of visibility, velocity, and variability-to the three key information enablers-quality, timeliness, and depth of information. Therefore, to create the new supply chain networks from the adaptation point of view, companies must advance through three specific stages to the evolution which are integrated, collaborative, and adaptive.

articleTitle: Study on the Evaluation of Enterprise Self-Technological Innovation Capability
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper, beginning with the content of self-technological innovation and its capability, re-decomposes and defines the elements of enterprise self-technological innovation capability, and then sets up the evaluation index system of enterprise self-technological innovation ability. Based on the theory of Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA), the article introduces the input-oriented C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>R model and C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>GS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> model to conduct a comprehensive evaluation of enterprise technological innovation capability, which enables companies to understand their own potential and shortages in the activities of technological innovation, sums up experience to fill gaps and improve enterprise competitiveness of core technology.

articleTitle: Managing Customer Services: Emotional Labor in Service Delivery
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the importance of service sectors in the world economy has been continuously increasing, customer service has become a topic of interest to organizational scholars in recent years. This study is conducted using questionnaire responses to explore the relationship among difficult customer, emotional labor and turnover intention. It also tests the moderating effect of coworker support and supervisor support in this model. The data was collected from 286 customer-contact employees in hospitality industry including the food services, accommodations, recreation, and entertainment sectors. The results of correlation analysis and linear regression analysis indicate that (1) Difficult customer has a significant correlation with emotional labor and turnover intention. (2) Deep acting, one dimension of emotional labor, mediates the impact of difficult customer on turnover intention. (3) Coworker support moderates the impact of difficult customer on emotional labor, but the moderating effect of supervisor support is not significant. Finally, the theoretical progresses and practical implications of this paper are discussed. The study contributes to the literature on emotional labor and the findings of study have indications for human resources management in service sectors.

articleTitle: The Theoretical Research of Spatial Information Service Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper research on spatial information service laws of development and application from angle of model and put forward the basic conception of spatial information service model basing on information service model. It presents a complete structure of model, and detailedly explains elements, the main characteristics and principles of interaction. Consider that the reciprocity between the various elements is the main inner factor which can produce a variety of different services type, and thus lead to different spatial information services with a variety of different forms. At last this paper accord to the relationship between the inner factor and elements to bring forward the abstract services classification results which currently can cover almost all the spatial information service types, and give theoretical support.

articleTitle: Research on Complexity Innovation Mechanism of Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises------Case Analysis of Fujian Haiyuan Automatic Equipments Co., LTD
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Article proposes small and medium-sized enterprises' (SMEs') complexity innovation theory and its intrinsic mechanism of multi-factors joint innovation, and then utilizes a case study of Fujian Haiyuan Automatic Equipments CO., LTD to further verify the theory and mechanism above, aims to offer references to SMEs in winning competition and fulfilling sustainable development.

articleTitle: Monotonicity of Quantum Relative Entropy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Quantum finance is freshly developing, for example, to model interest rates and price options, see, for example. In order to explore quantum portfolio and analyze its risk, this work will develop quantum relative entropy in theory of information for quantitative analysis in banks and finance firms, and for practitioners for fixed income securities and foreign exchange in decision making. One quantum relative entropy is introduced without Radon-Nikodym derivative, therefore much simpler to compute than Araki-Umegaki type, Belavkin-Staszewski type, and Hammersley-Belavkin type, in particular, its monotonicity is obtained.

articleTitle: A Process Optimization Method for High Maturity Process Improvements
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As high maturity process improvements receives growing attention, the implementation of it becomes urgent. This paper first analyzes the highly demands in CMMI high maturity process improvements. Then a process optimization method is brought up. There are five steps in this method: they are VPML-based process modeling, automated process simulation, process evaluation, rule-based process optimization, and identification of optimized processes' priority. The last step uses AHP-based decision making method to sort the optimized processes according to their satisfaction to the organization's quality and process performance objectives. Finally, the paper demonstrates how the process optimization method can be applied to CMMI Level 4 and Level 5.

articleTitle: Comparison Analysis of Intra-Industry Trade in Service Industry among China, Japan and Korea
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We find out the result that the service trade among China, Japan and South Korea is mainly focus on intra-industry trade by measuring and analyzing a series of intra-industry index between each of the two countries among China, Japan and South Korea from 2000 to 2008. The different levels of intra-industry trade and competitiveness exist both in each country and in its different domestic sectors. China's framework of service trade has an optimizing trend to high technology and high value-added, service trade in China has a huge space of international development.

articleTitle: Competency Assessment Study Based on IPCA-Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper puts forward a competency appraisal measure: IPCA-Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation, which applies the Improved Principal Component Analysis, combines the Multiple Linear Regression with the Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation. Finally, progressing example-demonstrated, explicating the application and maneuverability of IPCA-Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation in job appraisal and performance appraisal.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Dynamic Game Model between Government and Enterprises of Green Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents a dynamic game model between government and enterprises of Green supply chain. At first, this paper describes the development status of GSCM, then game of Corporate GSCM without Governmental Intervention and game of corporate GSCM under Governmental Intervention are analyzed. At last, governmental intervention can prevent opportunistic behaviors of individual companies, and make companies believe when choosing strategy that if they don't choose GSCM they will be punished, as well as estimate that other companies will choose GSCM, so that they change their strategy choices and avoid adverse choice, which can help building the green product market and sustainable development of the society.

articleTitle: Study on SMEs-Oriented Strategic Decision Support System Based on Competitive Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In today's fierce competitive business environment, less resource often put the Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) on the disadvantaged position. This paper aims to design a novel system (SDSS-CI) for aiding SMEs in strategic decision-making. This proposed system has the advantage of integrating the concept of competitive intelligence (CI) and strategic decision-making system (SDSS). The proposed system can help SMEs gain dynamical competitiveness by performing the strategic decision-making more efficiently and rapidly.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis on Impact of Foreign Direct Investment to Technical Efficiency of Service Industry in Heilongjiang Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper applies Stochastic Frontier Analysis method to measure and analyze technical efficiency of service industry in Heilongjiang Province to conclude that on the term of longitudinal trend the technical efficiency of service industry in Heilongjiang Province from 1988 to 2008 increases gradually, but the growth rate was in a gradually decreasing trend; on the term of horizontal comparison, the technical efficiency levels of service industry in various regions of Heilongjiang province are quite different, which indicates the technical efficiencies are not even. At the same time, we investigate the relationship between technical efficiency of service industry and foreign direct investment, and find that the model established on the both reflects a significant negative correlation, but the negative impact is very limited. Finally, this paper puts forward several policy suggestions to improve technical efficiency of service industry in Heilongjiang province.

articleTitle: Influence of Compatibility on Pricing Strategy of Firms with Two-Sided Markets
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Pricing strategy is a significant decision for firms with two-sided markets. This paper mainly focuses on the influence of compatibility on these firms' pricing strategy. Under the assumption of homogeneous and heterogeneous consumers, we get different conclusions. In homogeneous consumer model, we find that the price of any side market is determined by its own compatibility degree. While in heterogeneous consumer model, the price of any side market is determined by the other side market's compatibility degree, not by its own. What's more, compatibility enhances the market power of firms in homogeneous consumer model, but it intensifies the price competition of firms in heterogeneous model.

articleTitle: A Ranking Method and Its Application of Consumers' Brand Preference under Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To scientifically solve many uncertainties in consumers' brand preference ranking, with synthetic application of two-tuple theory and evidential reasoning approach, a ranking method for consumers'brand preference is proposed. The evidential reasoning approach and two-tuple operators are to be used to process calculate linguistic assessment information to obtain two-tuple-based linguistic evaluation values of all brands, and then the order of brand preference is ranked by the property of two-tuple. Finally, feasibility and effectiveness of this method are illustrated with an example of ranking brand preference of the family car.

articleTitle: An Empirical Investigation of Competency Construct Model of Middle-Level Managers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the basis of the Literature analysis and the advertisement content analysis, we develop a scale of middle-level manages' competencies. Then we hand out it to the MBA student. After the investigating and data analyzing, we construct the competency model. It includes leadership characteristics, mature mind, key construction, emotion quotient, thought ability, strong self-motivating, management capability, and team management.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Efficiency Evaluation of Energy-Saving and Emission Reduction of Straw Bale Building
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Strengthening Public Participation in China's Mine Environmental Protection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper reviews the development of public participation at the international level and describes the basic situation of public participation in China's mine environmental protection. Then the paper analyzes the reasons for inadequate public participation in China's mine environmental protection and offers suggestions for strenthening public participation in this field with reference to foreign countries' experiences. The suggestions include perfecting relevant laws and regulations, improving environmental education and training as well as standardizing mine environmental information disclosure.

articleTitle: Enlightenment of New Public Management Theory to the Party Building Management in Universities
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The new public management theory is the crystallization that a whole set of principles, techniques and methods for private enterprise management applied to the public section management. According to the new public management theory, management is the key factor of the social development and the sustaining economic growth. To effectively manage the labor factor, by the use of sophisticated information technology, organizational skills, commodity production and technology in the form of material appearance is the assurance of progress in the social productive forces. The new public management theory emphasizes on the political property of management, praises the management of liberalization, advocates market-oriented management, and promotes entrepreneurial leaders. The programmed control, standard considerations, continuous improvement of the party building management can be achieved by teasing, integrating and optimizing the party building management in universities and innovating in the ideas, regulations, management, processes and systems according to the new public management theory. Integrating the party building management into various tasks in a mechanism is good to make the party building management from the "soft" management into the "rigid" operation and enhance the quality and level of the party building management.

articleTitle: Grey Correlation Analysis between Liver Cancer and Drinking Water Quality in Southeastern Coastal Areas of China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Using grey correlation analysis to the relationship between the incidence of liver cancer and drinking water quality in Fujian , Jiangsu , and Guangxi provinces, considering the basic features of the original and the secondary environments in the study areas, the following conclusions can be drawn: liver cancer can be caused by many factors and drinking water may be among the most important ones; minerals (e.g. Ca<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>, Mg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>, Mo, Zn, etc. ) needed in drinking water by human body in southeastern coastal areas of China are relatively low; Ca<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>, Cu, NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> etc . are closely related to the incidence of liver cancer.

articleTitle: Research on the Knowledge Diffusion Mechanism of Knowledge-Intensive Based Services Cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the base recognizing of Knowledge diffusion characteristics of the Knowledge Intensive Based Services (KIBS), the paper discusses three main influencing factors of KIBS cluster knowledge diffusion: characteristics of the cluster main body, contents of the knowledge diffusion and the medium of the knowledge diffusion. The finding suggests level structures of KIBS cluster knowledge diffusion consists of two levels: one is the outer layer of KIBS cluster knowledge diffusion. The other is internal circulation of knowledge diffusion in KIBS cluster. The study indicates that the knowledge diffusion in the different phase of KIBS cluster life cycle has the different diffusion way and path.

articleTitle: The Study of Geographic Information Service by Emergency-Oriented
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The characteristics of Geographic Information Service of Emergency response is summarized in this paper.The function of Geographic Information Service System is classified into four moudles,which include automatic position of geographic,mark of geographic events,spatial quary and statistic,spatial analysis.At last the author implements key technologies and develop Geographic Information Service System.

articleTitle: Discussions on a New Model of Steel Logistics Based on Modern Supply Chain Management Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of socio-economic, the output of steel, which is one of the most important production materials in China, has been getting a significant growth. As a result of that, market puts forward new demands for steel logistics service. In this paper, traditional model of steel logistics is analyzed on the basis of a comprehensive previous studies. According to a new social required standard for steel logistics services, the authors propose a new model of steel logistics based on modern supply chain management (SCM) theory, as well as new developments in steel logistics areas prospected.

articleTitle: Study on the Impact of Firm Size on Patterns of Knowledge Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Concentrated on Chinese photoelectron firms, the paper analyzes the relationship between firm size and patterns of knowledge acquisition. The patterns of knowledge acquisition are described by 33 potential variables of knowledge acquisition. The empirical results confirm that differences in the firm size affect the choice of knowledge acquisition means, suggesting that firms with different size should look for appropriate means to obtain knowledge on their development process.

articleTitle: An Analysis Based on Game Theory about the Complicity between Contractor and Supervisor in the Construction Claims
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the game theory, the paper discusses the collusion between contractor and supervisor in construction claims. By creating a three-person game model, the paper analyzes the strategies of the entire three partners. There is no pure strategy Nash equilibrium, so they should select their strategies by chance according mixed strategy Nash equilibrium. Furthermore, the paper suggests government how to reduce the likelihood of collusion.

articleTitle: Model of Asymmetric Cost Information Game among Multi-Supply Chains under Bertrand Competition Framework
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the context of two supply chains containing one manufacturer and one retailer, the problem of asymmetric cost information game between two supply chains was discussed under Bertrand competition framework. We find that on the one hand, as price sensitivity increases, the profit will increase first and then turn to decrease drastically; On the other hand, as intensity of price competition increases, the uncoordinated scenario is better than coordinated scenario.

articleTitle: The Research of Distribution Center Optimization Addressing Based on Energy Saving and Emission Reducing Confine Factors
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Energy saving and emission reducing of logistics system is an important research area in low carbon society. Factors of energy saving and emission reducing, such as vehicle exhaust emission confine, energy consume confine is treated as confine factors to construct the optimization model of logistics distribution center addressing. GA is used settle the models, and a practical distribution centers addressing experiment is done to test the model effect.

articleTitle: A Test of Granger Causality between Internal and External Imbalances: The Case of China, Japan and United States
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper develops an econometric model to examine the casual relationship between internal and external imbalances using yearly data for China, Japan and United States ranges from1970 to 2008. Johansen Cointegration test reveals the presence of long-run equilibrium relationship among variables. The Granger non-causality test based on vector error correction model (VECM) indicates that: 1) the Japanese internal imbalance Granger causes that of China, with a short-run substitution effect and a long-run complementary effect; 2) In both short-run and long-run, the Granger causality runs from the Sino-US and Japan-US trade imbalances to China's internal imbalances with different signs of effects. However, the Japanese internal imbalance is an extraneous to the model; 3) the US internal imbalance is the Granger cause of Sino-US trade imbalance with short-run positive and long-run negative effects, implying that the US internal imbalance indirectly lead to the China's internal imbalance. To some extent, we argue that exist power effect among above three countries.

articleTitle: Financial Development and Economic Growth in China: Analysis Based on Panel Data Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Economists and policymakers have been always concerned with the role financial development plays in economic growth. This paper establishes dynamic panel data model to carry out the empirical investigation, and the results show that financial development has a significant effect on economic growth in China and the effect reveals the regional differences due to the imbalance of economic and financial development in various areas.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Business Process Reengineering Applicability and Process of Implementation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Business Process reengineering theory, popular in the nineties of the last century, is still the main pattern in Chinese enterprises' reform. However, any theory has its applicability and guidelines for the application. In this paper, we discuss the necessity of business process reengineering, preconditions, the ways of reengineering and the implementation process. Through re-examining business process reengineering theory, we hope to provide reasonable proposals for business reform.

articleTitle: SERVQUAL-Based Evaluation Study on the Quality of Community-Based Service Provided by University-Affiliated Stadiums
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To improve the community-based service provided by university-affiliated stadiums is a win-win situation for both the university and the community. Based on the SERVQUAL model, this paper firstly establishes an index system for evaluating the quality of community-based service provided by university-affiliated stadiums and then constructs an evaluation model by applying the method of Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (FAHP). The empirical results suggest that the evaluation system is easy to operate and has desirable application value.

articleTitle: On Evaluation of Intellectual Property of Cultural and Creative Industry Based on Evolutionary Economics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the basis of the relationship between cultural and creative industry and intellectual property protection, the theory of evolutionary economics, the essay analyses the formation and trading of intellectual property of cultural and creative industry. Then, based on the above analysis, the essay discusses the relevant and affective factors in the evaluation of intellectual property of cultural and creative industry, which mainly are market factors and non-market factors. Market factors are the cost of searching information and continuous testing malocclusion, the benefits resulted from creative products and services that they are the carriers of intellectual property, the conduction path of creative industry to achieve their value. Non-market factors mainly refer to cultural factors embodied in the moral, the religion and the ideology etc, the legal system and policy factors, the technology factors, evaluation institution and the mental factors of evaluators.

articleTitle: An Analysis on the Management Mode of Government Venture Capital Leading Funds
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Government venture capital leading funds act as fund of funds or gatekeepers with a policy goal to attract private capital financing small and medium enterprises. Compared with that of private venture capital funds, government venture capital leading funds are in an environment with less asymmetric information and therefore their rates of return are less uncertain. With a policy task to induce private capital funding small and medium enterprises, government venture capital leading funds have motives and capabilities to maximize their profits. Professional and standardized investment procedures facilitate the management of government venture capital leading funds. However, lacking efficient evaluation criteria and ownership in essence makes government venture capital leading funds unfit to be managed fully by government department or state-owned enterprise. Entrusting qualified private management companies to undertake their day-to-day management and operating affairs, government venture capital leading funds may be able to guarantee a prospective development in the long run.

articleTitle: Study on the Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation on Tourism Stakeholder Satisfaction Based on Entropy and G1 Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper constructs evaluation index system on tourism stakeholder satisfaction; ascertains weight of index system using the combination G1 and entropy theory. And then it constructs comprehensive evaluation model on stakeholder satisfaction based on the fuzzy mathematical theory, and studies empirical research on tourism stakeholder satisfaction in Shenyang. The result not only shows that fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is suitable for the evaluation on tourism stakeholder satisfaction, but also points out the evaluation result is consistent with the reality. In Shenyang, 5 aspects of tourism stakeholder satisfaction in order are tourist, government, resident, tourism enterprise, tourism employees. Besides, the paper analyzes the result of satisfaction, finds out the problems existing in the development of tourism in Shenyang and brings forward the development strategy.

articleTitle: A Blackboard-Based Negotiation for Collaboration in Construction Supply Chain System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The construction industry is being asked by more progressive clients to change its crude ways of working and to adopt more efficient business processes to improve its performance by adopting supply chain management (SCM) practices that have evolved in more advanced industries. Collaboration among the members of SCM plays a critical role to implement an effective SCM, but its implementation would not be easy only with the conventional information sharing mechanism. This study employs the idea of open tender concept with blackboard-based negotiation to develop a collaborative construction supply chain system. The open tender concept is designed to provide an open and free opportunity to all participants, which make a sound competition to obtain the tender. Blackboard-based negotiation is derived from the mechanism of negotiation among intelligent agents using a blackboard as a media where each agent exchange information.

articleTitle: Pricing Strategy of Reverse Supply Chain Based on Multi-Periods Recycling
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on multi-periods recycle of used-products, the pricing model of reverse supply chain with changeable remanufacturing cost is constructed. Collected used-products' sales channel are divided into two situations, one situation is the used-products that can be used directly enter into the second-hand market and the other situation is the used-products that can not be used directly will be remanufactured in this model. In our study, the optimal prices of the manufacturer's reclaiming price and the retailer's collecting price are given by game theory. The numerical analysis have shown that: the discount rate will affect the manufacturer's reclaiming price and its profit, the retailer's collecting price and its profit.

articleTitle: From the Knowledge Management to Knowledge Management Science
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper is based on the theme of "knowledge management" included in ISI Web of knowledge, according to visual co-citation analysis and clustering analysis by using of Citespace II. The author reveals the evolution, the representatives and representative publications, as well as the research hotspots and cutting-edge about knowledge management. In the end, the author concludes that knowledge management is gradually improving its theoretical system towards knowledge management science.

articleTitle: Study on Characteristics and Countermeasures of Heavy Metal Pollution in Yangtze River Delta
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With rapid development of economy & deterioration of eco-environment, heavy metal pollution has been a serious environmental problem in Yangtze River Delta. The typical events of heavy metal pollution happened in Shanghai, Nanjing, Taizhou, Wuxi & Ningbo. The research focuses on the Characteristics of heavy metal pollution in Yangtze River Delta and puts forwards five institutional innovations and three security systems for the control of heavy metal pollution. The results have important significance for control of heavy metal pollution in other parts of China.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: E-Government and Governance in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract:
Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles

"E-government and Governance In China"
by Yueqian Xu
in the Proceedings of the 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science, August 2010

After careful and considered review of the content and authorship of this paper by a duly constituted expert committee, this paper has been found to be in violation of IEEE's Publication Principles.

This paper was found to be a near verbatim copy of the paper cited below. The original text was copied without attribution (including appropriate references to the original author(s) and/or paper title) and without permission.

Due to the nature of this violation, reasonable effort should be made to remove all past references to this paper, and future references should be made to the following article:

"E-Government in China"
by Ian Holliday and Ray Yep,
in Public Administration and Development, Volume 25, Issue 3, August 2005, John Wiley and Sons, pp. 239-249


The article analyses e-government progress in China. It provides a brief overview of benchmarking studies and their evaluation of China, plus a contextual analysis of e-government initiatives in China and of the changing official position witnessed in the past two decades. On this basis, it considers the significance of contemporary e-government activity for Chinese governance. The argument is that e-government is currently having no more than a limited impact on the Chinese public sector. However, there are strong grounds for optimism about future development.

articleTitle: Hedging Security Portfolio with Random Parameters in Stochastic Linear Quadratic Framework
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Adding European contingent claims to hedge the risk is important for controlling or decreasing the risk of portfolio, so this paper is concerned with the selection of continuous-time portfolio which include European contingent claims as a two-criteria optimization problems. Under mean-variance criteria, the objective is to maximize the expected terminal return and minimize the variance of final wealth of portfolio. Under the assumption of free transaction cost and of frictionless market, by martingale theorem the hedging strategy of portfolio is transformed into a single objective stochastic control problem which is however not in the standard problem and can be "embedded" into a class of auxiliary stochastic linear-quadratic (LQ) problems. The stochastic LQ control model proves to be an effective framework to study the mean-variance problem in the light of the recent development on general stochastic LQ problems. This paper provides with optimal dynamically hedging strategy of one kind of investment portfolio with random parameters in stochastic linear quadratic framework when equity derivatives were added to security portfolio. Then, the article has proved the existence of solution of Riccati equation.

articleTitle: Research on the Internal Auditing of Commercial Banks Based on Corporate Governance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As an important component of self-control mechanism, the internal auditing plays an important role in commercial banks. There are many weaknesses in internal auditing of China's commercial banks, thereby affecting the internal auditing to function effectively. In this paper, from the corporate governance perspective, based on the analysis of on the problems existed in China's commercial banks, the basic ideas of how to reform the internal auditing of China's commercial banks is put forward.

articleTitle: A SE Model on Panic of Employee Turnover
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As one of the focus which management concern most in the domain of Human Resource Management, the panic of employee turnover (PET) is really affected by manifold factors. Based on the analysis tool of structural equation model (SEM), the authors endeavored to explore why and how the employee's turnover creates panic within the in-service staff in a first attempt. After a series of corresponding conversations, employing questionnaire survey, a quantitative SE model has been presented to disclose and testify the relationship between possible factors and PET. From the research, we could conclude that the panic of employee turnover might be mainly incurred by individual employee's personal characteristics, environment of the business organization, and the cognition of the group of the employees on turnover incidents. Actually, the last one is the most significant one comparing with all other factors.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Management Information Resource Allocation Based on Cloud Gravity Center Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the structure of generalized information resource, in this paper the evaluation index system of management information resource allocation is established. Based on the cloud gravity center theory, the allocation evaluation model is constructed. The cloud gravity center theory is the effective evaluation method.

articleTitle: The Spatial-Temporal Pattern of People's Daily Activities and Transportation Demand Analysis- A Case Study of Guangzhou, China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the humanism research especially after the development of temporal-GIS technology, the study on Time-geography and people's daily activities are now becoming one of the hop issues in urban studies. At the same time, lack of humanist consideration, the traditional "Four-step" OD transportation demand model also meets with new challenges. With the rapid urbanization, informatization, and marketing transformation, the structure and transportation demand in urban China are now changing. The individual micro-spatial behavior and the temporal pattern of people's daily activities are one of the angle views for explaining current situation. Taking Guangzhou as a case, using data of people's travel-log collected by questionnaire, developing spatial-temporal analysis tool with ARC GIS VBA program, this paper tries to analyze the spatial-temporal pattern of people's daily activities and its impact on urban transportation demand. There's closely spatial-temporal relationship according to people's travel chain. The central area of Guangzhou city is still the most attractive places for people's daily activities, and the social special diversity appear according to the distribution of people's daily activities with their social status.

articleTitle: HBUTiGrid: A Knowledge Management Model of Digital Library Based on Semantic Grid
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Semantic Grid can bring different communities together to solve large-scale problem, so human's interest on grid is increasing, and a secure foundation enable technology providers to collaborate and share information is urgently needed. The HBUTiGrid project deeply research on the grid technology, with aims of solving the problems of interoperability and heterogeneous resource in constructing the federated Digital Library (DL),applying both the grid and semantic web technology in the research of DL. In this paper, we will discuss details of the current research and technology that support HBUTiGrid project, elaborate the design proposal and illustrate the software architecture of the HBUTiGrid Infrastructure. We also present crucial experiences in implementing architecture of HBUTiGrid project and introduce the software tools that support it.

articleTitle: A Study on the Moderating Effects of Supervisor Support on the Relationship between Work-Family Conflict and Turnover Intention
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The present study examined the relationships among work-family conflict (WFC), supervisor support and turnover intention in a Chinese manufacturing company setting with a sample of 166 frontline employees. Hierarchical linear regression analyses demonstrated that turnover intention was negatively associated with supervisor support but positively associated with one of two sub dimensions of WFC, namely, work interfering with family (WIF). The study also revealed that supervisor support moderated the effects of WIF on employees' turnover intention.

articleTitle: Study on Risk Management of Investment on Food and Drug Safety of Fiddlehead
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Fiddlehead has been used in traditional Chinese medicine since Han Dynasty. However fiddlehead are still underutilized and hence wasted. In order to better utilize fiddlehead resources, the drug safety of benzene/alcohol extractives from fiddlehead were analyzed by GC/MS. Relative content of each component was determined by area normalization. The main ingredients of benzene/alcohol extractives of fiddlehead were toluene,2-furancarboxaldehyde, 5-(hydroxym ethyl)-, n1-(4-hydroxybutyl)-n3-methylguani dine acetate, 1,3-dihydroxyacetone dimer, sulfurous acid, cyclohexylmethyl hexadecyl ester, 1,4,7,10,13,16-hexaoxanonadecane, 18-propyl-, 1,6-anhydro-.beta.-d-glucopyranose(levoglucosan), oxirane, hexadecyl-, etc. The results obtained fully indicated that the benzene/alcohol extractives of fiddlehead had the great potential of noble natural biomedicines.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on Carbon Dioxide Emissions between China and USA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, we have compared the feature of carbon dioxide emissions both in USA and China. Firstly, the total carbon dioxide emissions were large both in China and USA. Secondly, the per capita carbon dioxide emissions in USA are at a stable high level, while China's relatively low. Thirdly, as per capita carbon dioxide emissions index, the EKC of USA has already turn to the right, but China is still in the left side.

articleTitle: The Effects of Market Orientation on Performance in Property Service Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The effects of market orientation on the performance in property service enterprises have been examined by an empirical study. The popular scales have been adopted to measure the market orientation and organizational learning degree of the sample enterprises. The results show that market orientation has significant positive effects on enterprise performance directly and indirectly through a mediate variable named organizational learning. Therefore, the implementation of market orientation strategy should be applied in Chinese property service enterprises after appropriate adjustment for environment and industry characteristics.

articleTitle: Gray Correlation Model Based Evaluation of Real Estate Projects
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper summarized and reviewed the current primary evaluation means of real estate projects,and analysed its evaluation index system.Based on these,using gray correlation model,we designed evaluation procedures of the real estate project and analysed the process of the case.

articleTitle: A Study of Stackelberg Inventory Model with Vendor-Buyer Interaction on Lead Time
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A stackelberg inventory model taking vendor-buyer interaction in lead time into account is developed in this paper. In this supply chain both parties involved in the lead time decision-making; and the assumption of the lot-for-lot policy of the vendor is relaxed, from this way, the model is more practical. An iterative algorithm is developed for searching the integral nonlinear programming, and numerical instance and sensitivity analysis are given also.

articleTitle: Research on Implementation of Green Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Specific countermeasures and suggestions on implementation of green supply chain management are presented in the paper based on the analysis of implementation actuality and existent questions in China, combined with both implementation experience, home and abroad, and the environmental characteristics of China.

articleTitle: Building a Common Enterprise Technical Architecture for an Universal Bank
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Researches on enterprise architecture mainly focus on business process organizing, software development, enterprise application integration and etc., but not much emphasis is focused on the enterprise technical architecture and its components. The paper proposed a domain based integrated enterprise technical architecture for a universal bank, helping to build common patterns to manage bank's technical IT applications and infrastructure in a unified IT environment. The authors also propose to define the enterprise technical architecture in different levels based on the bank's real business need referring to the enterprise business architecture and industry's best practices like TOGAF 9 and Zachman Framework. It is concluded that the proposed enterprise technical architecture with its holistic view of all the technical component patterns will enhance the effectiveness of the bank IT lifecycle management and also increase the adaptability with a controlled manner.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis on Operation Mode of a Personal Brand of Chinese Sports Star
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the constant development of world sports and economy, the larger market value of sports stars' personal brands have displayed. In our country, we have created our own stars' brands such as Yao Ming and Li Ning, However, comparing with other more mature operations of international sports stars', the level of commercial development in our country is still low, the administration is yet to be standardized, and it is urgent to select a way of being suitable for stars' commerical operations. This text is analyzed theoretically under the rules of knowledge in marketing theory and brand theory which focus on sports stars' personal brand and category of its mode of operation. After these studies above, we can not only enrich the knowledge of sports stars' personal brand, but also provide references for creating the operation model of Chinese stars' personal brand.

articleTitle: An Approach to LCC Simplification in Design Alternatives Evaluation of Navy Vessel during Early Stages
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The characteristics of the navy vessel's Alternatives evaluation and the basic indexes composition of the evaluation system are analyzed, and the difficulty of calculating navy vessel's LCC accurately during early stages is pointed out. It analyzes the synthesis and calculation process, and makes an assumption that measuring the LCC of navy vessel with substitution indexes. Then, it makes a systematic analysis on the bottom attributes' measurement indexes of the navy vessel LCC's components, and provides the measurement indexes that can reflect LCC's characteristics, and discusses the approach of standardizing the indexes and determining its weight. At last, an example is given to illustrate the approach's feasibility of evaluating the alternatives during early stages.

articleTitle: Ontology Approach for E-Learning System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-Learning aims to deliver individualized, comprehensive, dynamic learning content in real time, aiding the development of communities of knowledge. The use of ontologies to model the knowledge of specific domains represents a key aspect for the integration of information coming from different sources, for supporting collaboration within virtual communities, for improving information retrieval, and more generally, it is important for reasoning on available knowledge. In the e-Learning field, ontologies can be used to model educational domains and to build, organize and update specific learning resources. One of the main problems of educational domains modeling is the lacking of expertise in the knowledge engineering field by the e-Learning actors. By incorporating ontology technologies, this paper presents an integrated approach to model educational domains by ontologies, and used to define the process of personalised e-Learning experiences, without any specific expertise in knowledge engineering.

articleTitle: Research on talent-cultivating mode in the tourism undergraduate discipline of engineering university and the form of business & administration college: the case study of "1+3" talent cultivating mode in the tourism undergraduate discipline of Zhejiang University of Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Firstly, this paper analyzes current situation, existent problems and their causes of talent cultivating mode in the Tourism Undergraduate Discipline, and then summarizes some classical kinds of talent cultivating modes. Based on this, it combines characteristics of engineering university and the form of Business & Administration College, at last, the paper proposes “1 + 3” talent cultivating mode in the tourism undergraduate discipline and its construction ideas.

articleTitle: Cost Optimatize Algorithm for Hub-and-Spoke Logistic Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Many logistic system rely on a network of hub facilities to help concentrate flows of freight or passengers to exploit the economies of scale in transportation. Wheras , "bypass cost " and "congestion effect" also exist in hub-and-spoke network .This paper address a novel approach which unite economies of scale and "bypass cost" and reports on implementation of a route optimazation algorithm .Finally ,computational work was performed on a personal computer with data for postal operations in Australia.

articleTitle: Heat Transfer Study of the Temperature Environment of Air Source Heat Pump Using Air in Underground Tunnel as Cold and Heat Sources
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article analyses the temperature environment of air source heat pump using the air in underground tunnel as cold and heat sources, then models tunnel heat transfer and numerically computes, compares with experiment data and gets the result. It can provide some practically help on tunnel wind cooling technology and tunnel heat transfer calculating.

articleTitle: Design of Meteorological Information Display System Based on Data Warehouse
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of meteorological data display system based on SQL Server meteorological data warehouse. The purpose is to apply data warehouse to the field of meteorological research. The system uses SQL Server Reporting Services platform to generate meteorological data report and shows the reports based on two-dimensional maps. Moreover, the system is published to the internet in Web form to provide support for meteorological research work.

articleTitle: Research on Financing Strategy and Financial Support Pattern for Small and Medium Size Enterprise Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Lack of financial support has been a prime obstacle to the transformation process of the technological innovation in small and medium enterprises and two factors are responsible for this phenomenon: the juvenility of their financing strategies and insufficiency of financial support from the government. This article analyses the proper financing strategy which the corporations should take during innovation and also suggest the governmental policy of national financial support pattern.

articleTitle: A Review of Material Flow Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Material flow analysis (MFA) has been a hot topic on the research of circular economy and sustainable development of the environment - economic systems in recent years. This paper briefly reviews the development process of MFA. A detailed summary of the recent progress of MFA has been given in three forms, which respectively for three research levels (the national level, the regional level and the industrial level). The fundamental methodology of MFA has been introduced. And its development has been summarized in a list. In the end, the research prospects have been concluded and discussed.

articleTitle: Research on the Local Government Communication Mechanism from the Governance Perspective: A Case Study of the "11.17" Mass Incident in Longnan, Gansu Province
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: After a thorough analysis on the recent mass incidents in China, the author found that, the communication between each aspect with the core role of local government has played a very important role in the occurrence and development of mass incidents. Accompany the social transformation process entering a critical period, the sensitivity and complexity of local government communication are continuously increasing, which makes the communication more multidimensional and network-like. Based on the case study of "11.17" Longnan mass incident, this article analyses the reasons, influencing factors and the development mechanism of mass incident from the perspective of governance, and tries to construct an innovation model of government communication.

articleTitle: Managing Service Quality: Call for a Network Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Studies on service quality management is primarily based on the service quality management theories raised in the West in 1980s. Their mutual research perspective is mainly reflected at the business (employee) - customer level, and their study focus is on the technical operational level of enterprises, by solving major issues such as "what should enterprises do to evaluate and improve the services quality". This study suggests that the service sector is essentially a temporary collaborative production system consisting of enterprises and customers as different interest parties, and the opportunism incentives of enterprises and customers, as well as some external factors would affect the output quality of this production system. Therefore, it is necessary to include more participating parties into the system to establish a multi-level network management mechanism, so as to enforce greater influence and binding on the completion of the collaborative service production by enterprises and customers, and provide some new thinking and approaches for a broader, more active community participation in the service quality management.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Theory Framework of Project Construction Management Process Reengineering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Needs and Present Condition of Online Scholarly Communication Service in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The rapid development of the Internet provides researchers with the opportunity of collaborating and communicating by means of online tools.
