More and more Chinese scientists and researchers in Universities or research institutions begin to use online scholarly communication services. In the paper, Chinese researchers' needs and present condition of online scholarly communication are discussed. Questionnaire survey method was used to collect data. Descriptive statistics was used for data analysis. Results have confirmed the necessity of transforming present scholarly communication system by providing online services. Researchers' attitudes toward online scholarly communication and their needs for online services are clarified, which specifies in the direction of improvements of online scholarly communication services in China.

articleTitle: Knowledge Architecture Based on User Experience--A Review of the Basic Principles of KA in Web2.0
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As an open complex adaptive knowledge system, Web2.0 uses some applications like Blog, Wiki, Tag, SNS, RSS as its kernel, and puts many complex new theories and technologies, for example, Six degrees separation, Synergetics, Long tail, XML, Ajax into the background. So that knowledge production, communication and utilization have realized in self-organization and ordering through users' widely particip- ating under the restriction of simple rulers by the patterns of multiple, multiple, personalization and decentralization. The above make users become the adaptive agent of knowledge architecture (KA) in the Web2.0, revert KA to its original state of human-oriented and gives users abundant experiences, and made KA present the new characteristics of hierarchy, multiple and complexity. Therefore, the traditional KA theory can't explain and serve the new character, so that it is necessary to reveal the basic principles and evolution mechanism of the personal KA, Website KA and social KA in Web2.0 by introducing some complex theory and methods such as self-organization theory, emergence theory, and loop feedback theory from a new perspective.

articleTitle: How Do Companies Adjust Their Independent Directors after a Mishap?: Evidence from Independent Directors' Background
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The mission of independent directors is mitigating conflictions between majority and minority shareholders. This paper selects listed companies punished by CSRC or received qualified audit opinions from 2002 to 2004 as our target sample, empirically tests behavior and economic consequence of adjustment of independent directors. Empirical evidence shows that listed companies will increase independent directors with accounting background after a mishap to mitigate agent distress, and these companies enjoy significantly contemporaneous return after the adjustment.

articleTitle: The Individual-Organization Fit between Organizational Culture and Individual Values as Predictor of Job Satisfaction and Organizational Commitment in a Italian Municipality: The Role of Human Resource Management in a Public Organization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The aim of this research is to explore organizational culture and individual-organization fit (I-O Fit) as predictor of job satisfaction and organizational commitment. It's hypothesized that values composing organizational culture: a) are joint in constructs that postpone to some typologies already explored in the studies concerning organizational cultures; b) they behave as stable elements of that same typology of culture, also when, time passes, their intensity seems modified. Besides it is hypothesized that the different typologies of organizational culture emerged by the analysis modify their own intensity, as time passes, compared to their different ability to keep on guaranteeing the success of the organization. As far as the relationship between organizational culture and job satisfaction, it's hypothesized that higher is the perceived organizational culture and desired organizational culture fit, higher is the level of job satisfaction. Finally, higher is the level of person's fit to values of dominant organizational culture more is the level of job satisfaction. It's also hypothesized a statistically significant relationship between cultural models and multiple bases and foci of organizational commitment. The results of the research seem to confirm the hypotheses. A discussion is also provided.

articleTitle: The Evaluation of the Coordinated Development between Subsystems: A Case in Nanjing of China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to evaluate the coordinated development of a system, a method named Synchronous Coordination Judgment (SCJ) is designed, which involves such five procedures as following. Firstly, a system is divided into several subsystems and a number of elements are chosen. Then, based on some criteria these elements are divided into three ranks. Secondly, in each subsystem the number of the elements in each rank is calculated, which is used to determine the state degree of the subsystem. The third step is to determine the line of Ideally Coordinated Development (ICD) and the state point (Q) of system in a specific state space. Fourthly, two distances----the vertical distance (d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>) from Q to the line of ICD, and the distance (d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) between Q and the origin, can be calculated. Finally, based on the two distances, both the coordinated development between subsystems and the optimum degree of the system are evaluated. This method is adopted to evaluate the coordinated development between three subsystems (tourism, eco-environment and social economy subsystem) in Nanjing. The results indicate that the subsystems had been approaching coordinated development during 1996-2007. The paper suggests the SCJ method can be applied to evaluate the coordinated development of many subsystems.

articleTitle: Study on Fixed-Mobile Substitution of Global Voice Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies the historical data of 152 countries between 2003 and 2008 on the development of the fixed telecommunication and mobile telecommunication based on the ITU database, classifies the Fixed-mobile Substitution (FMS) degree of the countries worldwide into eight clusters using Cluster Analysis method, summarizes five stages of FMS, and finally comprehensively estimates the overall FMS degree of the countries worldwide or in each continent. It is found that global FMS is severe and will be accelerating in the next three to five years, large difference exists for FMS stage of the countries worldwide, although in the same continent. Most developed countries worldwide have basically crossed over the peak stage of FMS, and most developing countries and underdeveloped countries in Asia, Africa and America which have an advantage on population are still in the middle stage of FMS, therefore, the future FMS will be mainly centered on these areas.

articleTitle: On the Investment Modes of RJVs to Solve SMEs' Dilemma in Independent Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Over the past 30 years since the reform and opening up the practice shows that opening market cannot bring core technologies without which enterprises can not achieve sustainable development. SMEs must have their own core technologies if they want to reach the set goal of economic development, so independent innovation becomes an inevitable choice for sustainable development of SMEs. In this paper, the new conception of SMEs' joint ventures of independent innovation is proposed to solve the difficulties SMEs are facing, such as shortage of technology and products with independent intellectual property rights, resources, social prestige and recognition. The authors research into the incentive mechanism's effect by the option theory, and point out that SMEs should make full use of resources from the government and establish different forms of research joint ventures (RJVs) according to the needs of their development. Thus in the stage of R&D they can invest and R&D jointly, share the results and achieve common development, while in the stage of producing and marketing they will compete.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Industrial Organization of Chinese Software Service Outsourcing Based on SCP Paradigm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: How about the software service outsourcing industry in China? Employing the combination research methodologies of field survey, literature research and analysis of the collected data from the survey questionnaire using the SPSS statistic software and its relativity tests, this empirical study analyzed the market structure and performance of Beijing software service outsourcing industry. Based on the SCP paradigm of the industrial organization theory, the conclusion revealed that the market concentration of Beijing software service outsourcing industry was on the low level. The industry possesses the characteristics of low risk, low profit and low product differentiation. There is an apparent trend that increasing profit occurs to the large scale service organizations. Low level price competition dominates the industry at present. The market performance of the industry is therefore low, resulting in the low average profit to most service companies; but the average ratal of these firms is on an upward trend year after year.

articleTitle: Effective Coordination and Response Measures of Public Economic Policy under the Financial Crisis in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the background of the global financial crisis, the public economic policy to play an important role as the operational guidelines and measures of regulating macroeconomic and controlling to guide people's economic activities. This article talked about the response initiatives of the public economic policy in the financial crisis based on the categories of the public economic policy, which from the financial, monetary, industrial, employment, income distribution, social security and social welfare policy on the macro-perspectives.

publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Presents the welcome message from the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: [Title page]
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: business management; quality management; human resource management; finance management; knowledge management; e-commerce; e-government; risk management; environmental management; supply chain management; and service science.

articleTitle: [Copyright notice]
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Presents the copyright information for the conference. May include reprint permission information.

articleTitle: Crisis Communication Issue Discussion with the Prospect of Online Public Opinion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the Internet's technical characteristics, it allows audiences to give feedback by public sentiment and opinion in the cyber space, the interactive relationship between the public and organization has been promoted to an important position. This paper focuses on crisis communication issues from the perspective of online public opinion, analyzes the new characteristics of online public opinion, and some countermeasures and suggestions are proposed for online crisis communication.

articleTitle: Fuzzy and Neural Network Method in Quality Identification of Building Structures
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on fuzzy mathematics theory, an estimation model for single and multi layer structure is presented to evaluate comprehensively the reliability of building structures. Meanwhile, the neural network technology is introduced to quality identification of concrete structural members in the present paper, which not only reduces the influence caused by human factors but also unites the standard of the examination criteria. The application of fuzzy mathematics and neural network realizes the attempt to introduce the artificial intelligence technology into the quality identification of civil engineering.

articleTitle: Services Scientific Principles Implementation into Talent Development Models: An Example of Synvision Technology Company
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study discloses the scope of services innovation of the case company, to understand how to proceed with the service of science, technology and services to construct value chain of Synvision Technology. The results of the entire interview by the following four points: (1) The value chain of services science, including core management structure, E-service management, quality certification and authentication services. (2) 5S for the management of core organizational culture perspective. (3) Through the information technology achieves the goal of improved services and importing ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and GSP mode of operation.

articleTitle: Financial Crisis and the Capital Structure of Listed Company-Empirical Research on Chinese Real Estate Industry
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the financial crisis sweeping the world, the capital structure of listed companies has also changed. Firstly, based on the panel data between 2006 and 2009 of 40 listed real estate companies, multiple regression analysis was done to find long-term factors affecting capital structure of real estate listed companies. Secondly, year by year regression analysis was done on the basis of the cross-sectional data from the same sample of companies to find the differences between the influencing factors of each year. The results showed the crisis made the behavior of enterprises conservative and now during economic recovery the enterprises became much radical. Finally, this paper gave some advice of optimaizing the capital structure of real estate industry in the current situation.

articleTitle: Based on Independent Component Analysis Method to Analyze the Influence Factors of Close-End Funds Fluctuation by Shanghai Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Factors influencing the volatility of the close-end funds listed in Shanghai Stock Market are investigated based on ICA (independent component analysis). In this study, investor sentiment, net asset value of close-end funds, volatility of shares, policy factors and business cycle are found to explain the volatility of close-end funds.

articleTitle: Can Covariance Matrix Refinements Alleviate the Contradiction of Mean-Variance Efficiency and Diversification of Portfolio Selection?
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this paper, through the prism of refining covariance matrices, we study the mean-variance efficiency and diversification contradiction that the high concentration in a few securities in portfolio selection implicates the incompatibility of efficiency and diversification which are two corner stones of modern finance. Typical treatments include refining covariance matrices and imposing portfolio constraints. Unfortunately, the existing studies usually suffer from simplified models, small-scale computation, and crude representation of efficient frontiers. To make thing worse, inequality constraints of portfolio optimization such as restrictions of short sales knock out the possibility of closed-form type of optima, so computational methodology based on empirical data can be the only way to study the contradiction. We sample 13, 26, 52, 125, 326, and 687 Chinese stocks from 2003-2005 and 2006-2008 periods, deploy factor models and equal correlation coefficient models to refine covariance matrices, and utilize parametric quadratic programming to obtain precise and complete efficient frontiers of portfolio optimization. We find that contrary to existing beliefs, the refinements can not alleviate the contradiction. Our systematic sampling, large-scale computation, and precise representations of efficient frontiers are original in the area in China, which alone make the paper unique. The research can help both individual and institutional investors balance efficiency and diversification and consequently serve portfolio theory and finance industry of our motherland, especially in the turmoil world-wide financial crises. Moreover, our methodology is based on the latest computational extensions of portfolio optimization and can be deployed to stock markets worldwide to draw more comprehensive conclusions.

articleTitle: Research of Rumors Spreading Based on Transmission Dynamics of Complex Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper reviewed the status of studies on transmission dynamics on complex network and introduced classical propagation model and the general law of dissemination to discuss the propagation characteristics of small-world networks and scale-free networks, also made an in-depth analysis of the social composition of the network topology. Then, we explored the complex network theory introduced into the social network research is reasonable, summed up the significance of transmission dynamics being introduced into the research of social rumours prevention and control. Finally, as from the empirical analysis, establishment of network models and the proposition of prevention and control strategies in three areas, there were answers remain unknown by the current but worth further studies.

articleTitle: A System Towards Commercialisation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the development of the world market as it is today in with its expanse, customer base and variety, we should have a much larger injection of new technology. This may be in the form of new services, products, processes, etc. However, even with the market at its most expansive yet seen we are still only seeing around a 5% take-up of these new technologies. Extensive work has been carried out in the fields of project management and risk assessment that are being utilised that will be able to provide a base to work from. It is apparent though that they don't go into the depth of new technologies but rather work from existing technologies and concentrate on refinement rather that new innovation. As a result no great understanding of the different intertwined problems associates with new technologies has been developed and as such they continue to suffer a high mortality rate. An in-depth look at these problems and the development of a frame work or decision model to overcome them will enhance the possibilities of success for new technologies. This decision model will also be an invaluable tool for incremental changes with existing technologies, being the most common type of innovation that we are seeing in the market place today.

articleTitle: Information, Credit Reputation and the Motivation of Producing Green Agricultural Products
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Adverse selection caused by asymmetric information impacts the product of green agricultural. With the increase of the number of agricultural Producers and the level of consumption, the green agricultural products will be promoted to a certain extent. Given a certain consumption level, joint in the region and construction the network organizations, which can effectively reduce the opportunism of farmers' green agricultural production and form the market size, and thus greatly enhance the confidence of consumers of the regional green agricultural products. This confidence can break the dilemma in the development of regional green agriculture.

articleTitle: Incompatibility between Demand and Supply of Senior Talent Policy in China: The Case of Xiamen
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes the relationship between demand and supply of senior talent policies based on interviews with 46 senior talents and 26 organization leaders in Xiamen. The finding is that the policy supply is incompatible with the policy demands of senior talents and organizations. It concludes with discussions on the limitation and constraints of policy makers and policy design and presents some tentative measures for policy modification.

articleTitle: Knowledge Transfer between Users and Technicians in Phase of IS Usage: Promote Users to Internalize Knowledge Embedded in IS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Knowledge Management (KM) has been focused in information systems field, in which knowledge transfer is a key problem. Although there is substantial research about knowledge transfer during the implementation of IS, there is little research in the phase of IS usage. Based on author's project experiences and former literatures, this paper describes the conflicts between the knowledge users acquired themselves and embedded in the IS. Investigating the knowledge transfers between users and technicians form the view of four knowledge transfers processes, analyze that how users internalize the knowledge embedded in the IS which can extend a new IS research direction and provide the theoretical foundation for further researches.

articleTitle: Research on the Road of China's BPO
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Service outsourcing includes information technology outsourcing(ITO) and business process outsourcing(BPO). ITO mode makes India the most successful and developed developing country in undertaking international service outsourcing. In contrast to India, China is away behind in developing ITO, but has great advantage in developing BPO. Therefore China should focus on the road of BPO instead of imitating India's ITO in the field of service outsourcing.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On the Model for the Complex Non-Linear System and Its Application to Predicting the Output of Northwest Construction Industry of China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on Multi-Task Agent Model of Research and Development in Knowledge Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The core enterprise of knowledge chain may delegate both research task and development task to agent, and this phenomenon can be seen as multi-task agent. When designing the contracts, the core enterprise should consider the influence of ability of profit transferring, task correlation of research and development, task observation.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Coalmine Manager's Safety Work Behavior in Optimal Incentive Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Dynamic Characteristics of the Enterprise Network in Xi'an Software Industry Cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the enterprise data of year 2000-2007 in Xi'an software industry cluster from the State Intellectual Property Protection Center, this study derived one-mode network from the cluster's affiliation network and analyzed the dynamic characteristics of the enterprise ego-centered network and the whole network by the index description, the cluster analysis and the optimal matching. Several conclusions were drawn: (a) The enterprises that involve in only one industry take overwhelming majority of the enterprises; (b) Though the trend of diversified development is weak, the scale of peer enterprises is burgeoning; (c) The scope of information communication among the enterprises in the cluster is enlarging; d) The communication among the enterprises is more and more frequent, and the cohesion is generally increasing.

articleTitle: Political Functions of E-Democracy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Electronic democracy is a new democracy form taking advanced information and communication technology, network and relevant technologies as the operation platform, direct democracy as development trend, taking citizens' partaking in democratic operation procedures collectively, initiatively and practically such as democratic decision-making and democratic election as typical feature. Political democratization trend, abuse of traditional democracy i.e. democratic representative system, citizens' desire of partaking in political affairs, development of social economy, advanced information and communication technologies are main reasons for development of electronic democracy. In modern political life, electronic democracy plays a role in supplying necessary information, training citizens' participation skills, inspiring citizens' democratic participation enthusiasm, improving citizens' political participation, enhancing legality of government and improving political decision-making, the development of electronic democracy supplies the growth space for direct democracy.

articleTitle: Mechanism on the Reform of Enlarging Powers to Counties Accelerating the Development of Rural-Urban Economic Integration
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The Rural-urban Economic Integration (abbr. REI) is becoming a theme in the 21st century in China, and the reform of Enlarging Powers to County (abbr. EPC) becomes one of effective approaches of promoting the development of REI. The reform can boost intra-county economies development by improving enthusiasm, enhancing decision-making efficiency, hastening fluxion of factors between city and county rationally, constructing more infrastructures, optimizing space structures; and can make urban economy adjust its strategy by altering its development orientations and perfecting service function. It is because of the reform that the relationship of competition-cooperation between city and county is established in the long run, and so the development of REI is accelerated.

articleTitle: Estimation for the Flexibility of Enterprise Management System Based on Extension Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The flexibility of enterprise management system is one of the important ways in which modern enterprise gets competitive advantage facing with complex and changing environment, and is essential to enhance its environmental adaptability and stability. To cultivate and enhance the flexibility of management system in an enterprise, the effective approach is to estimate it scientifically and reasonably. Based on Extension Mathematics, an extension matter-element model using to estimate the flexibility of enterprise management system is build. With the help of MatLab software, the evaluation result is shown by quantitative figure. The example proves that the method is easily put and the effect is significantly made, and the result provides the theoretical basis for enhancing the flexibility of enterprise management system.

articleTitle: Research on Monopoly Model of Combined Technical Standard in High Technology Virtual Industrial Cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: High technology virtual industrial cluster is a new kind of cluster mode in knowledge economic area. By utilizing the methods of combined technical standard monopoly, the members of high technology virtual industrial cluster control the direction of industry development into their favorable ways to maintain their monopolistic position. Based on cellular automata theory, the combined technical standard monopoly model is established. Then applying MATLAB, the process of combined technical standard monopoly is simulated. Furthermore, according to simulation result, the phenomenon that competition activities are influenced by combined technical standard monopoly intensity is analyzed. This paper has a very important theoretical meaning and practical significance on researching control strategy of technical standards, promoting effective competition of cluster and improving the cluster's competitiveness.

articleTitle: Study on Contract Conditions of Natural Disasters Based on FIDIC Criterion
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: FIDIC contract conditions are more and more used in china in recent years, according to fairness, justness, efficiency of FIDIC, a view of contract risk allocation are put forward. An experienced contractor can reasonably forecast and prevent, which is a fuzzy concept, this paper makes a special definition for this concept and a clear partition standard for the responsibility of natural disaster, which can provide reference for responsibility allocation of the contractor and owner after natural disaster, reduce the dispute and issue of both sides.

articleTitle: Analyses on Development Directions and Digitizing Tendency of Management Science
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The author firstly describes the duly development directions of management as a discipline of science; then, following this thinking, he analyzes developments of management science experiencing formation of management ideology during management activities and formation of management science and its disciplinary theories during management practices; the theoretical supports for the various disciplinary theories are identified in this stage; the various courses of theoretical maturity, actual management proofs, argumentations and developments. Finally, the basic directions and future development tendencies of management science are annotated electronic document is a "live" template. The various components of your paper [title, text, heads, etc.] are already defined on the style sheet, as illustrated by the portions given in this document.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Influencing Factors of Trade Credit Risk Management Performance in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Firstly, the author has analyzed some relative papers of Jianmin Jia, Allen N. Berger, Xiao-jun Shi and Robert Culla, etc, and found out mistakes existing in these papers. On the basis, the author has conducted an empirical study on influencing factors of Trade Credit Risk management performance by using the method of Factor Analysis and Pearson Correlation Analysis. Research shows: key influencing factors are "setting credit risk management Functions", "assessing credit of client" and "drawing up credit policy", enterprises should take efforts to improve management performance from above three aspects.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on the Relationship between Top Management Teams' Tenure and Firm Performance: Evidence from Chinese Listed Real Estate Companies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study focuses on the investigation of the relationship between tenure of top management teams (TMTs) and corporate performance. 73 Chinese listed real estate companies are selected as our samples, and hierarchical regression statistical methods are used to analyze the collected data. Then we conclude that: (a) TMTs' average tenure is negatively related to short-term firm performance. But it is not significantly related to long-term performance. (b) TMTs' tenure heterogeneity moderates the relationship between TMTs' average tenure and short-term firm performance.

articleTitle: A Study on Organizational Change and Human Behavior in the Process of Organization Information Reform
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Information Technology is a kind of technology which will be fully embedded into the enterprises' management system. This character results in the great changes of organization's external and internal environment. Organization changes are needed if we want to achieve the anticipated goal. Traditionally, some theories argue that, with such a change, organizational structure would be forced to be more flexible, decentralized and flattened. But recent practices present that some human factors would make the enterprise hierarchy structure be enhanced during the change because of lacking of supervise and the agency problem. Under such a condition, enterprise need implement IT governance effectively to guide the organizational changes.

articleTitle: Application of Grey System Model to Water Resources Allocation Schemes Assessment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The reasonable allocation schemes of water resources have the character of multiple objective and incompatibilities. In order to evaluate the reasonable allocation schemes scientifically, a synthetic evaluation model is proposed based on grey relational degree model. In this model, the method of variation coefficient is used to determine the evaluated index weight and decreases the subjectivity of weight decision. The model is used in comprehensive evaluation of rational allocation schemes in South-to-North Water Transfer District of Hebei province and the study shows that the model applied in evaluating the schemes of water resources reasonable allocation is rational and feasible. It validates the evaluation model is simple and feasible in evaluating water resources planning schemes.

articleTitle: Slack Resources and Firm Growth: The Mediator Role of Organizational Legitimacy
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The inconsistent views about the effect of organizational slack (slack resource) on firm growth performance appeal to us explore the relationship by more powerful theoretic. Based on organizational slack theory and organizational legitimacy theory, this paper examines the internal mechanism and path through which organizational slack affects firm growth performance. Through the mediator variable of organizational legitimacy, this study attempts to open the black box of how organizational slack affects pe performance. rformance. Meanwhile, a case discussed contributes to comprehend the key model of this research.

articleTitle: E-Government System Investment and Subsidy: Differential Game Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper proposes a Stackelberg differential game model of the higher government's subsidy for the lower government's investment in setting up an effective, perfect E-government system. The higher government, as a Stackelberg leader, controls his subsidy rate for the lower government, and the lower government, as a follower, controls his investment level in E-government system. We give the steady state equilibrium solutions for the game. Parameters sensitivity analysis of the steady state equilibrium solutions is provided and some useful conclusions are drawn. Conditions under which the higher government will subsidize the lower government are identified. By comparing the total welfare when they engage in subsidy-investment cooperation with the one of non-cooperation, we show that such subsidy-investment cooperation is preferable.

articleTitle: Research on Incentive Modes for Engineering Project Organization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Presently, it is critical important for client to choose a proper incentive mode as well as incentive intensity since the friction between client and contractor/s or other project participants has been more serious than before during the process of engineering project. This article systematically assesses the incentive modes and the condition of them for engineering project organization (EPO) basing the complete incentive theory for organization in institutional Economics, for the sake of helping people to understand the incentive theory of EPO systematically and directing the practice of engineering corporations.

articleTitle: Interorganizational Citizenship Behavior, Social Capital and Buyer Performance in Supplier-Buyer Relationships: A Theoretical Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Social capital between supplier-buyer relationships is growing a key factor to affect firm competitive advantage. Study on interorganizational citizenship behavior (ICB) is rare by now. Drawing on OCB and social capital theories, this paper considers the relationship comprehensively among ICB, social capital and buyer performance improvement in supplier-buyer relationships, proposes a new concept model and the corresponding propositions. In the concept model, social capital firsly mediates the relationship between ICB and firm level performance. Future research implications are discussed in the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Non-Market Strategy and Firm Performance: The Empirical Study of Listed Companies in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Firms usually adopt non-market strategies to influence outside stakeholders' behavior processes for creating sound and advantageous market environments. Taking industry evolution stage as a bran-new angle and choosing listed companies of China as the object, the paper studies the mechanism impact of non-market strategies on the enterprise performance. On this basis, the paper puts forward academic hypothesis, and conducts the empirical analysis, which fills the gap of empirical study shortage on no-market strategy.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Earthquake Emergency Management System in Middle-Sized City of China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of Sponsorships in Niche Communities Online: A Preliminary Study
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper intends to gather some evidences on how sponsorship effectiveness is positively or negatively affected by the choice of focusing on niche communities (the Long Tail Communities), i.e. whether in niche communities there are differences in the members' brand perception between online and offline sponsors. The preliminary results demonstrate how the explanatory power of the involved variables differs in the case of online and offline sponsors supporting long tail communities.

articleTitle: Comparison of the Sino-Japanese Environmental Greening
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Japan leads the world in green technology. With the expansion of the scale of land development and the higher level of civil Engineering Construction mechanization, Japan has already developed the appropriate technology to green land. Japanese government implements strict environmental protection measures. The concept of ecologically sustainable development take root in people's community. Many of concepts and methods of work have a good inspiration and learn for the Chinese greening and ecological construction. This paper is main to consider the experience of Japan advanced greening and China's current greening shortcomings. The purpose of the study was designed to learn from Japan's experiences and lessons in the greening, and introduced the Japan's advanced green technology and international cooperation in the greening contribution. All of them are aim to do our modest efforts for the greening of our country.

articleTitle: A Control Table-Based Universal Solution of Urban Geological Data Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzed the status of current solutions of urban geological data management and the intricate features of urban geological data, and introduced a "control table" concept via the mechanism of view in the relational database. The operation of the data by users and the processing of the data by computer were separated by "control table", it did not allocate physical storage space to store data as a kind of middleware, users would not only be able to view interested data through the "control table" that likes a window, but make operations analysis on specific data. We hereby put forward and implemented a universal solution of urban geological dada management. Based on this universal solution, we implemented customization module of user tables automatically and warehousing module of urban geological data easily. Applications show that the solution is feasible.

articleTitle: China's Real Estate Price Inflation and the Expansion of Bank Credit
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: From a global point of view, real estate is the leading industry of the national economy; bank credit and the development of real estate industry have shown inextricable links. In recent years, the real estate price of some cities in China continues to rise rapidly. This article embarks from the relation between the development of the real estate industry and the bank credit, studies the mutual influence of China's real estate price inflation and the bank credit support, using qualitative and quantitative methods, and makes the reasonable judgments of China's real estate market. The result shows that China's real estate price rises fast under the push of the bank credit funds, while the real estate development is too dependent on the bank credit, if some link of the real estate industry gives rise to the problem, the banking industry will have the huge risk.

articleTitle: The Research on Interest Expropriation of the Cash Dividends Policy in China's Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: High payment of cash dividends is one of the ways majority shareholders to expropriate minority shareholders' interests. The higher majority shareholders hold shares, the greater the cash dividends are paid, the more serious the excoriation will be. The use of equity financing to pay cash dividends is a more serious act of interest expropriation which directly leads to expropriation of the capital of minority shareholders. When they have common interests, it may lead to “collusion” effect. A conflict of interest may leads them to supervise each other. But the supervisory role is not obvious because of higher concentration of shareholder's right.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Assessment of Competitiveness of Technical Standards
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on Technology - Market - Regulation Model, we proposed the index system for appraising the competitiveness of technology standard. Furthermore, we use analytic hierarchy process method (AHP) to make the scientific & reasonable quantification analysis of the indicators of the technical standard competition which are quite difficult to be quantified. Finally, By using technical standard 3G as study object, we make an in-depth empirical research on the proposed appraisal index system of the competitiveness of technology standard.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: Analysis of Sustainable Development of Family Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study points out the problem why the family enterprises cannot realize sustainable development with analysis of the current situation to the China's enterprises, moreover,the corresponding countermeasures to solving those problems are proposed.The proposed measures include carrying on the management system reform, implement innovation of manpower, developing successors,national policy support and optimizing financing channel of the family enterprises,etc.. It is believed that proposed package of measures could benefit the China's family enterprises.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Research of the Design Contractors' Incentive Management for Owner
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The Myths of E-Government in Developing Countries
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-Government has already arrived in developing countries, though it is essentially an imported concept based on imported designs. There are many challenges and myths in these countries, so it requires more responsibilities and technical support from public sectors, especially transparency supervision.

articleTitle: On the Risk Management for Construction Phase in Underground Engineering of Urban Mass Transit
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Through the establishment of Project Risk Management Group and the realization of dynamic risk management in the construction phase to build the project risk management system for construction phase in underground engineering of Urban Mass Transit ; The same time, Owner and the Construction Unit must do a good job in each risk management; And define the responsibilities and rights in underground engineering of Urban Mass Transit between the engineering parties involved in order to achieve the purpose of reducing the risk of construction.

articleTitle: Biodiversity Evaluation for Ecosystem-Based Management in Daya Bay, South China Sea
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this study, we created a set of biodiversity indices (BI) to track the changes of biodiversity components in Daya Bay of the South China Sea. The timely information is thereby obtained for decision-making of biodiversity conservation. The calculated BI score ranged from 0.89 to 1.07 during the periods of 2004-2008, and the mean annual loss of biodiversity ranged from -3.98% to 3.17% and reduced gradually. The benthic diversity exhibited an increasing trend, while the loss of phytoplankton and zooplankton diversity was obvious. The assessment suggested that more work should focus on the improvement of water quality, protection and conservation of fisheries resources, and the control of thermal discharges from nuclear power plants.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Innovation in Urban Environmental Management System in China-Case of Shenzhen City
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to explanation of four factors concerning innovation in urban environmental management system, namely, innovation in conception of urban environmental management system, innovation in subject of urban environmental management system, innovation in urban environmental property system and market mechanism, as well as innovation in urban environmental management legal system, the author employs structural equation model (SEM) to analyze correlation effect between various factors for innovation in urban environmental management system of Shenzhen City and urban development of Shenzhen City, and make empirical analysis on the basis of proposal on an theoretical model and in combination with investigation data.

articleTitle: The Value Chain of Context Awareness Service Based on User Perceived Value
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In view of characteristic of context awareness service, this paper presents a new approach to measure user perceived value. Based on user perceived value, we established context awareness service value chain model. In the value chain, mobile operators play a central role.

articleTitle: Transformation and Upgrading of Brand Agents in Global Value Chains: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Facing with the captive global value chain of capturing, how can Chinese local agencies surmount the control of brand leaders and achieve the transformation from OEM to OBM? In this paper, a case study on Guangdong Redstone Fashion Co. Ltd will be discussed, which reflects the business leader's vision, the accumulation of entrepreneurial talents and capabilities, as well as the governments' construction of an enabling environment for enterprise which has a imperative impact on the upgrading of the brand agency. This paper puts forward suggestions through two levels of both the state and enterprises.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Laneway Ventilation Reliability Based on Computational Fluid Dynamics(CFD)
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The ventilation system is the basis to control the hazards in coal mine laneway. High reliability ventilation system can continuously convey fresh air into laneway , dilute the noxious gas, reduce disaster and ensure the mining productivity safe and effective. As we know that, many noxious gases in the coal mine laneway are compossible and their flowing states are complicated. In order to acquire the distribution characteristics of fluid movement, and evaluate the performance of ventilation system, a geometry and physical model of laneway was established in this paper with Fluent software, and the physical field of fluid such as velocity field, density field and temperature field were built and analyzed. A standard model was introduced to simulate the laneway fluid movement according to the turbulent kinetic energy equation and turbulent dissipation rate equation. The case study results showed that the CFD approach can effectively observe the performance of ventilation system and evaluate the safety and reliability of ventilation environment.

articleTitle: Two-Stage C2GS2 DEA Method for Ranking Based on the Optimal Frontier Surface
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Evaluation and Ranking decision making units with independent subsystems is one of the hot problems in the area of data envelopment analysis(DEA) research. Applying the virtual optimal frontier surface concept , this paper puts forward the output and input nonradial two -stage C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>GS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> data envelopment analysis model for evaluating and ranking the decision making units with independent subsystems based on the nonequal proportion expansion or reduction thoughts. The method in this paper which has fewer calculation is objective and optimal, so it is a operable and practical DEA ranking method.

articleTitle: The Influence of Transitional Metal Oxides on the Smoke Suppression of Epoxy Resin/Intumescent Flame Retardant/Silane Couple Agent System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The smoke produced will do great harm on the public and environmental safety during polymer combustion. People lost their life during fire disaster mainly be attributed to the dense smoke and toxic gas under combustion, which hinder the escape of people and the rescue of firefighters under fire disaster. The influence of several kinds of transitional metal oxides on the smoke suppression of epoxy resin (EP) treated with intumescent flame retardant (IFR) and silane couple agent (EP/IFR/silane) systems have been investigated. The results showed manganese dioxide and cobalt oxide have small effect on the smoke suppression of EP/IFR/silane system, however cadmium oxide and titanium dioxide can decrease smoke density rate (SDR) of EP/IFR/silane system obviously, and especially copper oxide can decrease maximum smoke density (MSD) and smoke density rate of EP/IFR/silane system substantially. The MSD and SDR of EP/IFR/silane system can reduce 18.8% and 33.2% respectively when 2% of copper oxide is introduced.

articleTitle: Traffic Flow Simulation of Container Terminal Yard
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A case study of using simulation to support the road planning of a large container terminal yard in China is presented, which demonstrates the method and procedures of combining discrete event simulation technology with road traffic capacity theory to assist road planning of container terminal yard. The architecture, components and processes of the model are discussed. Through simulation experiments, the peak traffic flow data were obtained. Based on the experiment data and analysis of the road traffic capacity, we can evaluate the reasonableness of the road planning and make recommendations for improvement.

articleTitle: Research on Coal Mine Safety Prevention Management Based on Catastrophe Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The occurrence of accident be understood as mutations in a qualitative change caused by a continuous change of some of the parameters within the system. The system from security state into the state is actually a mutation phenomenon. The paper applies the Catastrophe theory and system analysis method of the accident causation, establishes the spire catastrophe model. By analysing the model, indicates the causes and mechanism of the accident. And further points out the effective preventive management measures. It has a theoretical value and practical significance to provide important theoretical basis for improving the security situation in coal mine.

articleTitle: A Study on Stability of Closed-Loop Supply Chain Based on Markov Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: There are a large number of uncertain factors when the closed-loop supply chain works. For the internal closed-loop supply chain, as we can see in accordance with the process of forward and reverse are marked Markov and stability of the closed-loop supply chain is evaluated. For the whole course closed-loop supply chain, by calculating the transition probability between the different modes, we can get probability at the limit state, that is the long-term selection probability in each cooperate mode, and we can get the long-term stable cooperation mode in the closed-loop supply chain.

articleTitle: Research on the Grading Model of Financial Risk Alarm Condition Based on Extension Discrimination
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the basic principle and method of extension discrimination, this paper constructs an extension discrimination grading model of enterprise's financial risk alarm condition based on the financial risk monitoring indicators. Then it measures and grades the financial risk alarm condition of some listed companies using financial indicators. The model and method will supply a management tool of financial risk for the investors' decision, securities market management department's supervision and internal managers' management.

articleTitle: Management of Corporate Governance Risk: An Integrated Perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Corporate governance risk is a kind of uncertainty, attributed to the change of external & internal environment and the unexpected events, which could not lead the corporate governance structure and mechanism to perform accountability for stakeholders. The management of corporate governance is a process across the corporate, effected by an entity's board of directors, management and other personnel, designed to identify potential risk that may result to corporate governance defeat, and manage corporate governance risk to be within it appetite, to provide reasonable assurance regarding the achievement of corporate governance objectives. This paper puts forward an integrated framework of corporate governance risk management which includes three objectives categories, ten components and three entity levels.

articleTitle: Competency-Based of Staff Mentoring Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In this study, business managers as the research object, build the management of competency-based mentoring model. Management Mentoring-Job Competency Modeling from a higher starting level of organizational development to reflect the behavior of structured mentoring active mode, making mentoring activities into a "target-the development of" new process; and the diagnosis of jobs and tasks by characteristics of the key evaluation competence to conduct mentoring and development of competence.

articleTitle: Enterprise Group's Logistics Mode Based on Structural Holes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the constant change of marketing condition, i.e., the variation of market share, shifting customer needs or supply channel et al. lead enterprise group to optimize their logistics system as needed. After the analysis of nowadays enterprise group's logistics characters such as the value chain integration, the integration of purchase & logistics management, the need for advanced logistics system to support its integration advantage as a whole. This paper put forward the concept of enterprises group's logistics mode based on structural holes. Its integrating logistics not only results in the shared resource, but also leads the entire group to harvest "recardian rents" through intra-group ties. Moreover, its operation is much more targeted and flexible under its networking organization structure and its networking arrangement of resources allocation.

articleTitle: Theoretical and Empirical Study on the Relationship between Household Health Investment and Government's Public Health Investment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper studies empirically mutual influencing relationship between government's public health investment and household health investment by using Beijing data from 1986 to 2006, based on analysis of theoretical model between public health programs and private efforts to improve health and longevity. The results reveal that increase of public health investment will impel increase of household health investment, but if government has more rapid increase extent, then increase extent of household health investment is restrained. Furthermore, there exists long-term co-integration relationship among household health investment, disposable income and public health investment. At last, this paper provides some advices.

articleTitle: Depending on Marketing to an Ecological Vision: A Case Study of Overseas Chinese Town's Developing Management in Shenzhen, China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Marketing explores how to use "market" to attain win-win results of the two sides in exchange activities. Human beings neglect that environment promotes human society development. That caused conflicts between urban development and environment protection. The experiences of Overseas Chinese Town, China, proved that employing the concept of environment marketing in developing management can smooth the relationship between urban development and environment protection. The techniques of developing management based on environment marketing includes: Creating environment-product; establishing brand; satisfying users' demands; and employing the catalyst effects.

articleTitle: Building the Financing Platform for the Small and Medium Enterprises in China's High-Tech Zones under the Financial Crisis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In 2006 china made strategic decisions about building an innovation-oriented country. While building an innovative country is inseparable from the vigorous development of small and medium sized enterprises, high-tech zones are the collection areas of small and medium enterprises. This paper begins with the status quo of SME financing, combining with the financial characteristics of SME and the analysis of the shortcomings of the existing financing channels. Then, the paper uses Caohejing Development Zone in Shanghai as an example to analyze SME financial platform for the construction of the financial platform for small and medium sized enterprises. At last the paper suggests a simple, convenient and practical way to solve the financial problem in the context of the financial crisis.

articleTitle: The Research on Imbalance Degree of Regional Knowledge Capability: Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Region as an Example
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The application of the entropy theory in system's imbalance is proposed. Use evaluation indicators as random variables and adopt equivalent transformation to change them into corresponding probability distributions. After that, combining the Theil index to use inequality of the indicators to figure the weighing. The application is to make a quantitative evaluation of the imbalance degree of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei regional knowledge capability. The result shows that Beijing's regional knowledge capability is above Tianjin and Hebei's a lot. The imbalance of the regional knowledge capability didn't change in the recent 5 years.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Study of RFID Reader Pivotal Technology for Circulation Management System of Fuel Gas Automobile Gas Cylinder
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Communication Based on Multi-Carrier Modulation in Mine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Geology circumstance of mine seam is extremely complicated and there are many hidden trouble. After analyzed the existing current problems underground mine communication system, a kind of comprehensive information communication system based on the multicarrier modulation technology was designed. This system makes wire communication combined mutually with wireless communication by tandem adapter. In this paper, the framework of communication system network hardware was introduced, and software architecture and the realization of the function were described. Wireless communication system primarily include through-the-earth communication, inductive communication and microwaves communication system, etc.. The key of the system design and the process of implementation were presented. Practical operation shows that the system actually resolved many troubled in coal production site. The technology combines multiple access technology with various modulations technology easily. This system makes use of the advantage of multicarrier technology to provide many kinds of access service in mine. As technical difficulties and major hazard safety issue in communications systems during the operation has been solved, so it has definite meaning and a good value.

articleTitle: The Use of Grey Relational Analysis for Project Selection Based on Multi-Granularity Linguistic Assessment Information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Project selection problem is the core issue of the organizations. In this paper, the method of grey relational analysis for group decision making is applied to select the best project based on multi-granularity 2-tuple linguistic assessment information processing. The subjective judgement of decision makers is represented by means of linguistic variables. The basic linguistic term set is chosen from multi-granularity, linguistic term sets and the computational formulae are given to uniform the multi-granular linguistic assessment information into the normalized representation of the 2-tuple linguistic. Then the optimal project alternative is determined by calculating the linguistic degree of relative grey relational grade of alternative and positive ideal solution. Finally, a numerical example illustrates the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Construction of Early Warning Index System for Knowledge Acquisition Capability
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the definition of knowledge acquisition capability, the early warning index system is established from six aspects. The weights of the indicators are determined by AHP and Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation is used for the total score. Finally, the applicability of this system is evaluated through case studies, which also provides a new channel of thought for senior managers to distinguish the level of crisis and take precautions immediately.

articleTitle: Research on IPO Underpricing, Trading Volume and Investor Interest
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With a sample of 245 IPOs of A shares issued listed on Chinese Stock Market during sample period between 2006.6 and 2008.6, the relationship between investor interest and IPOs underpricing are investigated by using the multivariate regression model. Several findings are obtained: the level of pre-issue investor interest is positively related to the initial return; IPOs with greater pre-issue investor interest experienced higher return during the first year of trading; the level of the long-term investor interest is positively related to the initial return. The regression results show that the variable of investor interest can explain the phenomenon of IPOs underpricing well in Chinese Stock Market.

articleTitle: An Empirical Investigation to Examine User Acceptance of Mobile Hotel Reservation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study examines the user acceptance of mobile hotel reservation (MHR) by proposing and examining a new research model. Data from 235 usable questionnaires, collected in Taiwan, were tested against the research model using the structural equation modeling approach. This study will be helpful to researchers in developing and testing MHR related theories, as well as to hospitality firms in understanding individual perceptions of utilizing MHR and implementing successful MHR system to attract more customers.

articleTitle: The Political Economy of China's Manufacturing Labor Productivity
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the perspective of political and economic analysis, the paper decomposes the sources of manufacturing labor productivity growth into four parts: technological progress, the effect of increasing returns to scale, capital deepening caused by wages and institutional changes. We can get the empirical results as follows: technological progress and the effect of increasing returns to scale stimulate the labor productivity growth. The contribution of capital deepening caused by wage growth is on starting stage. The effect of institutional variable on behalf of government plays a significant role on labor productivity progress, but its effect is descending.

articleTitle: Higher Social Responsibility, Better Environmental Performance
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Globalization induces some Multinational Companies (MNCs) exploit lax environmental regulations in the host countries. The cluster analysis of 30 enterprises in Shanghai shows the fact that some electronic MNCs neglect their environmental responsibility in China while they have better performance in their own countries. Based on the discussion of reasoning, some corresponding suggestions are put forward.

articleTitle: Implementing Circular Consumption by Means of Second-Hand Goods Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The implementation of circular consumption plays an important role in saving resources and reducing waste emissions. Second-hand goods market circulation is an important form of circular consumption. This paper analyzes the problems of China's second-hand goods market and suggests China make a multi-stakeholder involvement and efficient second-hand goods circulation industry to promote circular consumption and establish a harmonious society.

articleTitle: Research on the Development Strategy of China's Renewable Resource Industry Based on SWOT Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Renewable resource industry has been recognized as a sunrise industry universally. The development of renewable resource industry has become an important factor in the 21st century economic development in every country. The use of SWOT analysis method to analyze strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats of China's renewable resource industry development will enable the industry development to make full use of its advantages, overcome the disadvantages, accurately grasp the opportunities and effectively avoid the threats, and then propose effective renewable resource, industrial development strategy.

articleTitle: The Research and Application on the Work Resource Management Based on JD-R Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the development trend of companies flattening the organizational structure, because of promotion space for employees getting smaller and increasing professional frustration, most people have different levels of sense of insecurity and having difficulty to control future. From the dimensions of job requirements and job resources, Job Demand-Resource model study the impacts of working conditions on the various dimensions of job burnout. In this article, current research for the JD-R model is reviewed and limitations of this model are analyzed. What's more, we look forward the research orientation of future application of this model.

articleTitle: Session Identification Algorithm for Web Log Mining
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper takes session identification in web log mining as research object, proposes an improved algorithm based on average time threshold value. By calculating the average intervals dynamically among request records in the session, adjusting the time threshold value individually, and compared to the traditional algorithm that defines a uniform threshold value for all users' web pages, the algorithm in this paper can identify the long session more accurately. At last, the algorithm re-identifies the generated sets of candidate session, which make the identified session more reasonable and effective. Experiment result shows that the quality of session identification is improved.

articleTitle: Research on Knowledge Management Applications in Innovation Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Knowledge management (KM) with collective wisdom can enhance the innovation capacity and emergency ability of enterprises in the international competition. For an innovation network, the innovation agents cannot cooperate and share resources well without KM. This article will study the related theories of KM and analyze the benefits of KM in innovation networks, then discuss the processes and strategies of KM in innovation networks. The result shows that KM have become more and more important to the innovation capacity of enterprises.

articleTitle: Competition Networks and Topology Characterization
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In the field of network science, current primary interest is collaboration relationships. Differently, this paper focuses on the competition networks that are constructed on the basis of the competition behaviors. The topology of a firm competition network has been investigated empirically and theoretically. The obtained results are significant for further network analysis of the omnipresent competitive phenomena.

articleTitle: Innovate Firm's Value Chain to Integrate Corporate Social Responsibility in Strategy Development for Strengthened Competitive Advantage
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article looks into some prevailing ideas and approaches related to corporate social responsibility (CSR), and shows the possible reasons of a disconnection between these approaches and business operations. It then provides a perspective of value chain analysis to help firms concentrate on their CSR activities rather than merely on the internal resources and capabilities so as to integrate CSR into firm strategy development, and to deliver as well as create value for today's customers who are aware of corporate social responsibility, thus creating strengthened competitive advantages.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on Organizational Citizenship Behavior of University Teachers in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Teachers' organizational citizenship behavior (TOCB) is a kind of extra-role behavior and attitude which is beneficial for school. It is voluntary, unrelated to labor remuneration, and is the representation of the teachers' contextual performance. Through the effective investigation to 430 teachers in 18 universities located in Bejing , Tianjin and Hebei province, this article found that: (1) teachers' organizational citizenship behavior consists of five dimensions: identification with the organization, conscientiousness, assisting colleagues, interpersonal harmony and protecting company resources; (2) The teaching age, professional title and educational background of teachers have significant impact on their organizational citizenship behavior, and other background characteristics have no significant effect on TOCB. The empirical results will lay the theoretical foundation for further exploring the relationship between teachers' organizational citizenship behavior and other variables; and it will provide practical guidance for evaluating and stimulating teachers' performance in Chinese universities.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation of Resources in Production Line Based on Flexsim Simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is easy to find the bottlenecks in current production systems and provide an important basis on resource optimization in production line to use Flexsim simulation. First, find the bottlenecks in a production line and proposed a targeted solution based on Flexsim simulation. The simulation also shows that the solution can ease the bottlenecks in the process. Secondly, the output as an evaluation criteria, carry out the simulation and analysis on human resources conducted for the production line. Finally, according to simulation results, proposed the reasonable proposals on staffing in the production line.

articleTitle: Detecting Cartoons: Automatic Video Genre Classification
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article shows the improvement of automatic cartoon classification. Two new visual features - color component and color kind based on region segmentation - are proposed. Compared to traditional HSV color histogram and texture, experiment using the two new features can achieve better result, with less dimensions and higher mining efficiency.

articleTitle: Innovations Drive the Enterprises to Sustainable Development: An Empirical Research on Delixi-Electric Co. Ltd in WenZhou
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Management innovation is the key element for an enterprise's sustainable development, which determines whether an enterprise can stand out in the fierce competition of 21st century, and develop rapidly so as to keep an enterprise sustainable running. Through empirical research on innovative management of Delixi-electric Co.Ltd, a Sino-French joint venture, this article summarizes the practice of the enterprise values rebuilt, the new brand promotion and supply chain management innovation as well as its effect.

articleTitle: The Management Innovation of Family Business Based on the Ownership Preference
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper, based on the Ownership Preference of family business, analyzes the driving force factors of innovation management and the factors show how to break the Ownership Preference of family business. In order to reflect the dialectical relationship between the development of family business and enterprise innovation more clearly, this paper constructs an innovation logic model which includes the Ownership Preference of family business, family enterprise development, family business innovation-driven force and the innovation of family business management.

articleTitle: Optimizing Scheme of Concrete Large Dam Temperature Operation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: During concrete dam construction, optimizing temperature measurement scheme prevents dam cracking due to temperature fluctuation in concrete dam leads cracking produce. In paper, the temperature operation optimizational model was established from three aspects (Variance selection, object function and constraint condition).Additionally, the temperature optimizing model was implemented in reality dam construction to analysis temperature measurement and gain conclusion which post-temperature measurement is much better than pre-cool measurement.

articleTitle: Study of the Interactive Effect about Urban Organic Update and Real Estate Market in Hangzhou
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This text studies the interaction between the urban organic renewal and the real estate market in Hangzhou.
