It discusses the organic renewal promotion effect to the real estate market as well as the real estate market funding guarantee for organic update by analyzing the factors such as land optimal allocation, urban context excavation, major construction projects and land transfer payments feed. It is found that organic renewal promoted the value of land upgrading. Organic renewal promoted the increased real estate demand in Hangzhou as well. Hangzhou huge amount of land transfer receipts provided organic update important financial protection and financing channels. It is showed that organic update and real estate market exists promoting each other, protecting each other interactive effect relationship.

articleTitle: Study of Relationship between Debt, Investment and Output Market Competition Based on Bankruptcy Costs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Drawing on Brander and Lewis' train of thought in reaserch, we provide a new model concerning the impact of bankruptcy-cost-based liability on investment in the Cournot oligopolistic competitive environment. We have found out that in Cournot oligopolistic competition environment, the impact of debt on investment depends on the type of product competition strategy and influence of environmental changes on the marginal returns and cross marginal returns of the firm's output and investment respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Influence Factors of Service System Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The impact of innovation in services industry is no less than the technological innovation in manufacturing industry from the degree and scope on the socio-economic. Services are the process between suppliers and customers. The most important character is that the suppliers and customers act as the active participants in the service process. The activities are not simply value activities, but rather the interaction. According to the difference between service system and traditional trading system, the value chain of service system can be divided into the suppliers, employees and customers. The influence factor of service innovation can be summed up by using the method of value chain analysis.

articleTitle: A Research on Knowledge Management to Promote Enterprise Original Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the advent of the knowledge economy, knowledge has become one of the most important fundamental resource for innovation. Based on analyzing the bottleneck of enterprise original innovation and combined with related contents of knowledge management, the paper researches how knowledge management promotes enterprise original innovation, from the aspects of knowledge standardization, knowledge effectiveness, knowledge capitalization, knowledge entitlement and cultural knowledge.

articleTitle: Research on Disaster Prevention Safeguard Measures for Building Engineering of Villages and Towns
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the fast social development and the acceleration of urbanization, the project has expanded continuously and the number has increased gradually of building engineering of villages and towns, but the present relief work has not brought casualty loss under the fundamental effective control. The reasons lie in the constant emergence of the new disasters, as well as the poor quality of building engineering of villages and towns, which provided the frequent disasters and the vulnerable building engineering, and the relief work has not be completed and enhanced, the key lies in the lack of the effective measures for disaster prevention and control work that is enforced by the coercive power of state. So it is particularly important and urgent to establish and improve disaster prevention safeguard measures for building engineering of villages and towns. Aiming at the disadvantages above, this paper analyses in detail the problems with disaster prevention for building engineering of villages and towns, with the law, statutes and methods of disaster precaution for cities, this paper proposed the engineering and non-engineering disaster prevention safeguard measures for building engineering of villages and towns, in order to ensure the scientific and orderly progress of disaster prevention under the direction of the government.

articleTitle: SWOT Analysis on an Emerging and Modern Service Industry: China R&D Industry Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The R&D industry is an emerging, top and modern service industry. China economy and other industries will benefit from the development of R&D industry. After analyzing the internal and external environments of China R&D industry with SWOT analysis method, we can draw a conclusion that there are not only strengths and weaknesses, but also opportunities and threats in R&D industry. Authorities should carry forward the strengths, avoid weaknesses, seize the opportunities and reduce the threats when they formulate competitive strategies and enhance competitiveness of China R&D industry.

articleTitle: The Relationship between Perceived Organizational Support and Performance: The Mediating Role of Job Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study investigated the relationships of perceived organizational support (POS), job satisfaction and behavioral outcomes, partially to help explain in past research regarding the relationship between POS and performance (task performance and organizational citizenship behaviors (OCBs)). In this study, 261 employees from Small-Medium sized enterprises in China were selected as participants. Data analyzed using two steps of AMOS showed positive correlations of POS with job satisfaction and OCBs, and not with task performance. And also showed job satisfaction is correlated with both task performance and OCBs. Especially, it suggests job satisfaction mediated POS-performance relationship.

articleTitle: Research on Risk Control of Knowledge Share in Knowledge Network Based on Relation Capital
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Inter-organizational knowledge share can greatly improve enterprises' competition advantage. However, in the process of knowledge share there also exist some risks from potential opportunism, knowledge specificity, cultural diversity. But, the relation capital can control relation risk and performance risk to some degree, compensating for weak points of formal contracts in knowledge share.

articleTitle: Influence Factors Research of Traffic Flow Caused by Constructing New Container Logistics Park in Port
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Freight traffic flow, triggered by Container logistics park district, has brought significant effect to urban traffic. The article faces the problem of predicting freight traffic flow in constructing container logistics park district during the planning period, and analyzes the influence factors of freight traffic flow in container logistics park district, both internal factors and external factors. Discussing the incidence relation of influence factors through system dynamic method, constructing the grey relational model in order to compare the effect caused by influence factors in a measurable way. Take a new container logistics park, which locates in Lianyungang, as a demonstration to analyze. The research in the article will provide basis for predicting the volume of freight traffic in new logistics park district.

articleTitle: Vegetation Biomass Estimation Based on CBERS Data: A Case Study of the Submerged Area of Angu Reservoir
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The estimation and distribution of the vegetation biomass in submerged area of Angu Reservoir, Sichuan Province, based on CBERS data acquired in 2006 was researched. In order to select the optimum image characteristic data, correlative analysis were calculated among the biomass field sampling data, CBERS band 1- band 4 data and the NDVI data. The results show that field sampling data is best relative to band 4 data, and the correlation coefficients to aquatic vegetation and terrestrial vegetation were 0.703 and 0.678 respectively. Therefore, linear regression models were established between the field sampling data and band 4 data to estimate the total biomass of the Angu Reservoir area. The modeling results shows that the biomass of aquatic vegetation and terrestrial vegetation in the area were 1.15×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>kg and 0.99×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>kg respectively. And the biomass distribution map was drawn. The study shows that there are many advantages to apply CBERS image to biomass investigation over the traditional methods.

articleTitle: Analysis on Feasible Construction Modes of New Rural Residential Area in Tianjin
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Aiming at the problem of the low rate of land utilization, poor living conditions in rural residential area, this paper puts forward the concept of new rural residential area construction which of the characteristics such as clear aim, sustainable development, systematic construction, regional differences, urban-rural coordination, and diversity of subjects. It also analyzes the problems and the reasons of rural residential area construction in Tianjin. Base on the classification of the rural area in Tianjin according to natural, social, economic and other factors, it puts forward the four feasible modes: the urbanization model, off-site migration model, construct the central village model and the internal transformation control mode. Finally, four kinds of modes were compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: Major Problems in China's Road Traffic Safety Management and Countermeasures for Them
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The management of road traffic safety by the government is in lower level and affects the change of serious road traffic safety situation in China. The paper is targeted at analyzing the problems in current management of road traffic safety and looking for the countermeasures for them. The problems in the ideas, institution and actions of the management of road traffic safety are discovered and discussed in details. For them, the countermeasures such as changing traditional ideas on road traffic safety, establishing the centralized powerful agency for road traffic safety and taking the actions based on the systems perspective of road traffic safety are proposed. Different from other studies in China, comprehensive deep analysis into the management of road traffic safety from ideas, institution to actions is provided.

articleTitle: Agent-Based Simulation on Real Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper tries to present a more suitable computer simulated stock market model according to the statistics of real stock data. As the real stock market change violently due to the financial crisis, we divide the real market into the one before financial crisis and the one after it. Time series are analyzed from the standpoint of well-known empirical features in real markets as benchmark. Firstly, some modifications are done to make agents more "real" according to the statistics of real stock data before financial crisis, the modifications including agents with different learning speeds, strategy-sizes, utility functions. Secondly, when the best modified model before financial crisis failed to replicate the statistics feature of the real market after financial crisis, we make further research to find out the best simulate model after financial crisis. Finally, the best simulated model after financial crisis is able to replicate several of the real market phenomenon, including first-order autocorrelation, Kurtosis, standard deviation of yield series and the first-order autocorrelation of yield square.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Research on Statistical Analysis Methods of Factors Influencing Cementing Quality in Daqing Oilfield
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on the Resources Tax System in China Based on Scarcity Rent Theory and National Reference
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper is based on the scarcity rent theory which emphasizes the resources price should consist of marginal cost of winning, marginal User Cost(scarcity rent)and marginal social cost. guided by this theory, having a bird eye on the foreign resources tax system, we found that the design of Chinese resources tax system was so fragmentary, rent dissipation is very serious. To change the present condition, it is imperative to reform the mechanism of resources price by building up resources tax system.

articleTitle: Research on STOF-Model-Based Innovation of E-Waste Recycling Service System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: E-waste recycling is one of the main issues facing the challenges of resource shortages, environmental pollution and sustainable development. This paper analyzes the e-waste recycling systems, which is considered as a service system. Service System is the theoretical foundation of service science. In service interaction and value co-creation process of e-waste recycling system, producer services surrounding e-waste recyclers are clarified. Service innovation model STOF (Service, Technology, Organization and Finance) is applied to explore the potential innovations in e-waste recycling service system from four different perspectives, such as service, technology, organization and finance. To establish a sustainable e-waste recycling system, stakeholders should assume their responsibility and collaborate effectively concerning information flow, material flow and financial flow. Further, it is proposed that cloud platform can enable e-market for the producer services, to ensure an efficient management of the whole service system.

articleTitle: Construction of Performance Evaluation Index System of College Political Instructors
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the basis of the function and significance of performance evaluation of college political instructors, and by the principle of performance evaluation, the performance evaluation index system of the college political instructors was established in three aspects, including working philosophy, daily work and academic research, and the mismatch between performance evaluation index system of the political instructors and evaluation targets, the problems between static evaluation and dynamic evaluation of the instructors, and the problems between static assessment and dynamic adjustment of index are analyzed.

articleTitle: Research of the Development of Knowledge Intensive Business Services Based on City Circle Innovation Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Proceeding from the concepts and capabilities of Knowledge Intensive Business Services (KIBS), this paper analyzes how KIBS service manufacturing enterprises in city circle innovation systems. And for example Wuhan city circle, the paper describes innovation and development of Knowledge Intensive Business Services of the central city - Wuhan. Also pointed out that: in the context of the space hierarchical structure of city circles, the uneven distribution of KIBS led the gradient development of the innovation activities of cities within the city circle and promote the rapid development of service self so that the original manufacturing industry to upgrade. This became a new model for the optimization and upgrading of industrial structure of city circles.

articleTitle: Database System for Performance Evaluation of Training Talents by Government S&T Programs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In recent years, as both the number of government S&T programs and the number of talents concerned grow rapidly, the government pays more attention to the performance of the programs it subsidizes in training talents. Because of the vast amount and variety of the information of the programs, it takes people too much time to sort and evaluate the data, even if with the help of the computer. This database system we've adopted in our study is Microsoft SQL SERVER 2000. DELPHI 7.0 is used to transport the database to the page frame. We choose as samples the closed programs of Jiangsu Province between 2003 and 2004, so that we can better manage the data and get more accurate about the evaluation. Our approach helps make the evaluation of talent-training programs more systematic, scientific, and automatic. We can at the same time achieve standard and centralized database management of the talents.

articleTitle: The Combined Double Generally Weighted Moving Average Control Chart for Individual Observations
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study investigates control charts for simultaneous monitoring of process mean and process variability when an individual observation is taken at each sampling point. A combined scheme consisting of a two-side double generally weighted moving average (DGWMA) mean chart and a two-side DGWMA variance chart is developed. This new combined scheme will compare with the combined generally weighted moving average (GWMA) charts. It is shown that the combination of the DGWMA charts is more sensitive than the combination of the GWMA charts for detecting small shifts in the process mean and variance. A simple procedure for the design of a combined DGWMA chart are also given to illustrate this study.

articleTitle: The Lifecycle Comprehensive Risk Evaluation for Real Estate Projects--Principle
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The project comprehensive risk evaluation method is to consider each kind of project target risks at the same time, and carry out risk balance and optimization to decide a scheme which comprehensive risk valuation value is the least. The paper analyzes the major methods of project comprehensive risk evaluation used at present, and points out that whole level valuation of multi-target risks is a research direction of comprehensive risk evaluation methods in the future; puts forward the mathematics model of lifecycle risk degree evaluation for real estate projects, which would be beneficial to perfect the theory of lifecycle comprehensive risk evaluation for real estate projects.

articleTitle: Monitoring Methods Study on the Great Pacific Ocean Garbage Patch
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article explores the damage of marine debris such as plastics on marine environment according to the analysis on the formation of the Great Pacific Ocean Garbage Patch and the origin of plastic garbage there; then, it formulates the monitoring methods on marine debris at this oceanic area to record its size, density, growth, decay and movement, and eventually devises feasible solution proposals based on a comprehensive deliberation on the actual situation.

articleTitle: The Application of Multi-Level Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Method in Technical and Economic Evaluation of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is a comprehensive analysis of combining method, which combines AHP with fuzzy comprehensive evaluation.It is an effective quantitative analysis method for technical and economic evaluation of distribution network with the difficult “fuzzy problems”. As the gradual formation of China's electricity market, distribution network has become an important part of power system, and China has paid great attention to its distribution network technical and economic evaluation. At the same time, China has also emphasized on the construction, operation, and implementation in various link indicators for evaluation. This article first establishes the corresponding index of the evaluation system,then using AHP determines the weights of indicators. Finally, according to the evaluation index we make the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation through the blur of fuzzy transformation.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Crisis Management about Food Enterprises Based on Corporate Social Responsibility
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper takes a comprehensive positive test on the crisis management style and crisis management performance about the China food enterprises based on corporate social responsibility. The results consistently show that CSR influences deeply food enterprises crisis management styles. Therefore CSR is an effective approach for crisis management; China food enterprises should take CSR as the most important method for crisis management.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Impact of Sales Promotion on Brand Loyalty of Service Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Promotion activities and points-based reward are two major sales promotion patterns for advancing customer brand loyalty of service enterprise. Based on the review of domestic and international related theory, this paper put forward a concept model which focuses on the impact of sales promotion on brand loyalty of service enterprise. On the basis of the hypothesis model, by the samples of customers of china's telecommunication service enterprise, this article investigates the relationships between sales promotion and brand loyalty. Presented empirical evidences indicate that customer satisfaction has direct effects on brand loyalty, promotion activities have indirect effects on brand loyalty through customer satisfaction, points-based reward has direct and indirect effects on brand loyalty.

articleTitle: Modelling Business Processes for Limited-Lot Producers with Aixperanto
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In an economically challenging situation process management is one of the main topics in the industry. Stable and lead time reducing business processes are a key factor for the success of a company in today's market environment. Especially, limited-lot producers suffer from the economic situation due to their project based business. In addition, they usually lack any kind of professional process management as their size does not allow to cope professionally with such long-term management issues. Scientists of the Laboratory for Machine Tools and Production Engineering WZL of the RWTH Aachen University developed a tool called aixperanto to model business processes especially for limited-lot producers. The intention of aixperanto is to present and analyze business processes holistically and truthfully. One main aspect of aixperanto is to integrate the personnel as early as possible. By integrating those who are involved in and affected by the business process directly, reorganizations of business processes can be implemented much easier.

articleTitle: Partners' Risk Level Considered CDDM Model for Risk Management of Virtual Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Risk management in a Virtual Enterprise (VE) is an important issue due to its agility and diversity of its members and its distributed characteristics. In this paper, we develop a partners' risk level considered Constructional Distributed Decision Making (CDDM) model for risk management of the VE. The model has two levels, namely, the top model and the base model, which describe the decision processes of the owner and the partners of the VE respectively. Here we focus on the case of symmetry information between the owner and the partners, and the situation of keeping the partners' risk level in low is considered. A Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is then designed to solve the resulting optimization problem. The result shows that the proposed algorithm is effective and the CDDM model can help to reduce the risk of the VE.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Integration through Business Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper introduces the meaning of Business Intelligence and the basic technology of Business Intelligence, and then analyzes the contents of Supply Chain Integration. Combining with the contents of the Supply Chain Integration, this paper focuses on the analysis of the application of Business Intelligence in Supply Chain Integration to provide basis for enterprises to implement Business Intelligence.

articleTitle: A Servo System of Tracking Automatically for Solar Cell Based on Fuzzy Controller
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper presented the servo system structure and work principle of tracking automatically, the system was composed of the sunlight transmission unit, the fuzzy logic unit, the output drive control unit, the comparing and adjusting unit, and it analyzed design methods and implementation of the closed-loop fuzzy controller, so has improved the system dynamic performance; the system controlled solar cell panels with the use of industrial personal computer (IPC) to driving stepper motor, and tracked automatically sunlight, in order to increase the conversion efficiency of solar energy, and to reduce the cost of photovoltaic power generation, thus there is a further promotional and applied values.

articleTitle: The Interval Estimation Order Relation Analysis Method and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To overcome the disadvantages of the traditional subjective weight method-AHP (eigenvalue method), research paper [1] gives a direct, simple and easy to calculation method-relations sequence analysis. The paper will develop sequence analysis relations, puts forward an interval estimation relations sequence analysis, the method is closer to the actual application. Finally, a numerical example will be given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: On Analysis of Suggestions on the Development of China's Renewable Energy Industry Based on "Low-Carbon Economy"
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: It is of significance to reduce the demand of high-carbon energy such as fossil, increase the production and demand of low-carbon energy such as the renewable energy (new energy) and so on, and promote the economic development mode from “high-carbon economy” to “low-carbon economy” to transfer based on the innate requirements of “low-carbon economy”. The article analyzes the importance developing the renewable energy industry on developing “low-carbon economy”, and problems currently existed in the development of China's renewable energy industry. Accordingly, the article puts forward policies for the development of the renewable energy industry of China required for “Low-carbon economy” followed as: To improve the awareness of the importance to develop the renewable energy industry; To promote the renewable energy technology innovation, enhance the independent innovation capability of the renewable energy enterprises, and improve the technology level of the renewable energy industry; To establish the coordination organizations to promote the renewable energy industry to develop, and set up the coordination mechanisms through the integral management ways; To improve the policies and laws of the renewable energy industry.

articleTitle: Research on BP Neural Network Evaluation Model of Credit Risk of Bank Clients
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Credit is the cornerstone of modern market economy. Credit risk is one of the most important risks which the banks are facing to. Credit risk Evaluation virtually is a non-linear classification matter. The banks evaluate and classify the clients according to their information data, then according to the results of classification to decide whether to authorize the loans. This article established the artificial BP neural network evaluation model and achieved intelligence of the bank's credit risk assessment and increased the scientific of bank credit evaluation and management. It is very significant that using trade credit division to determine the credit rating for dealing with bank's non-linear complicated credit management. And we select part of the clients' information of several banks' real estate industry to establish the evaluation model for the empirical test.

articleTitle: On Tourism Environment Protection for World Cultural Heritage Sites in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: As the famous and attracting tourism destination, world cultural heritage sites attract great amount of tourists and gain large revenue in China. However, with long-term over-exploitation, the problems such as resources destroyed, energy ecology degradation and energy waste environmental deterioration greatly threat its sustainable development and whole environment. While the implementation of Circular Economy theory will be a new way to lead its long-term development through the practice of eco-designing, energy conservation, green services facilities providing, waste eco-disposing and green consuming in world cultural heritage sites in china. At last, a friendly, safe, healthy and competitive environment can be formed.

articleTitle: How Multilingual Digital Information Is Used: A Study in Chinese Academic Libraries
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Digital library, because of its resource demanding and other issues to solve, is an important application of multilingual information access (MLIA). However, the requirements of MLIA systems and applications are not typically addressed or assessed in our evaluations of digital libraries. This paper, therefore, aims to study the usages of MLIA in Chinese academic digital libraries. We conducted some surveys to study MLIA in current Chinese academic digital libraries and to get to know the users' real requirements for MLIA in Chinese academic digital libraries. The initial results offer thoughts on specific MLIA functions and insights on future digital library design and developments.

articleTitle: An Security-Enhanced Authentication System Based on OTP System in E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzed the shortages of S/KEY OTP system in mobile commerce identity authentication and suggested an improved one-time password system based on bidirectional virtual authorization in mobile application systems. On one hand, this suggestion can reduce the calculation stress of both client and server, accordingly increases the efficiency of authorization and withstands the DoS attack. On the other hand, the suggestion can implement the bidirectional authorization and reduce the possibility of fishing attack.

articleTitle: Efficient Compressed Domain Video Copy Detection
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: We propose a video copy detection scheme for compressed domain video. Our scheme firstly analyzes texture from DCT coefficients in the compressed domain video, then computes video signatures from the texture properties, and finally computes the distance between candidate video and original video by the video signatures. The proposed scheme is shown to be effective and efficient.

articleTitle: Efficient Auction for Risk Averse Buyers
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An ex-post efficient auction is one auction maximizing surplus conditional on all available information. It is well known that, for private values, the Vickrey auctions for risk neutral buyers for one indivisible good are ex-post efficient. In this paper, we model an ex-post efficient auction for risk averse buyers, and exploit that Vickrey auctions for risk averse buyers are still ex-post efficient.

articleTitle: Revenue Management in the Service Industry: Research Overview and Prospect
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With service economy time coming, the service industry is playing an increasingly important role, meanwhile the research of Services revenue management is moving frontier rapidly. On the base of consulting large amount of relative literatures, this article shows the western progress of research on revenue management in the service industry and sums up the domestic studying actuality. Finally this article gives the prospect of researches in the future.

articleTitle: A Fundamental Framework of Business Process Reengineering Methodology Based on IT
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Abstract-BPR requires a fundamental theoretical framework and a proven, reliable methodology, which is generally applicable and repeatable. BPR requires a fundamental theoretical framework and a proven, reliable methodology, which is generally applicable and repeatable. Towards this end, this paper proposes a business process re-engineering framework based on IT. And then a hospital logistics process is used as a case study to analyze and implement the framework.

articleTitle: Changes of Carbon Emission Intensity from Industrial Energy Use in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Decomposition analysis has been popular in the study on influencing factors of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions. This paper analyzes the change of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission intensity in China over the period 1980-2007 based on a complete decomposition approach-the logarithmic mean divisia index (LMDI) method, and examines the factors driving the changes of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions intensity. The research shows that energy intensity is the main influence factor for CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission intensity decrease in China over the entire period, China has achieved a considerable decrease in CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission intensity mainly due to the improved of energy intensity. In addition, the change of energy structure exhibits positive effect to CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission intensity increase. According to research, the author suggests CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission intensity reduction strategies should aim at accelerate technological innovation and industrial structural adjustments; diversify energy supply with preference on renewable energy and perfect environment protection management system.

articleTitle: Application of Support Vector Regression Method in Stock Market Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Stock market forecasting has attracted a lot of research interests in previous literature, and recent studies have shown that artificial neural networks (ANN) method achieved better performance than traditional statistical ones. ANN approaches have, however, suffered from difficulties with generalization, producing models that can overfit the data. This paper employs a relatively new machine learning technique, support vector machines (SVM), to the stock market forecasting problem in an attempt to provide a model with better explanatory power. To evaluate the prediction accuracy of SVM, we compare its performance with three-layer fully connected backpropagation neural networks (BNN). The experiment results show that SVM outperforms the BNN.

articleTitle: The Relationship between Organizational Identification and Organizational Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Organizational identification means the member has a feeling of consistency with its organization and with relevant behaviors. It is the feeling that the member feels oneself belongs to the organization. Based on a sample of 492 college teachers from 9 universities, the study test the relationship between organizational identification and job satisfaction, task performance as well as organizational citizenship behavior. The results show that the organizational identification has the positive relationship with job satisfaction, task performance and organizational citizenship behavior.

articleTitle: Using Content Management System Joomla! to Build a Website for Research Institute Needs
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper introduces the important concepts, main features, basic function and common applications of the award-winning content management system (CMS): Joomla!, which enables you to build Web sites and powerful online applications. After that, we will focus on the procedures and techniques on how to customize a unique template that you or your clients wanted.

articleTitle: Research on a Fashion Knowledge Management Platform for Women Garment Development
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Knowledge platform can not provide a better design resolution than qualified designers. But it would be a very useful tool for those less experienced designers who works for small or medium size enterprises that have plenty of past design records. This paper recommends a women garment design knowledge management platform which covers four main research fields concerning garment designs: the shape/style design, pattern design, sewing and post processing, and business. Data clustering is adopted to classify those design samples that are difficult to be categorize to certain classical garment style. Knowledge model is based on ontology theory and RDF is used. Future works would mainly be life-cycle based data mining routines and knowledge reusage problems so that the design knowledge may be much more 'active' and needs less human interaction.

articleTitle: A System Dynamics Approach to Human Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The main objective of this paper is to give system dynamics approach of human resource management, which involves the computer simulation models that portray processes of accumulation and feedback. Through the simulation results, suggestions are given for effective control of policies for overcoming policy resistance.

articleTitle: Perceived Organizational Politics and Organizational Commitment: Exploring the Moderating Effect of Job Insecurity
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study examined the moderating effect of Job Insecurity on the relation between the Perception of Organizational Politics and organizational commitment. Data collected from 314 employees indicated that the negative relationship between perception of organizational politics and affective commitment as well as normative commitment were alleviated as quantitative insecurity increased, while the negative relationship between perception of organizational politics and affective commitment was weakened as qualitative insecurity increased.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Customer Churn in E-Commerce Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the e-commerce market competition becoming more and more furious, it has become one of the focuses of companies that how to avoid customer churn and carry out customer retention. This paper applies many techniques of data mining to the research of customer churn, such as clustering analysis, decision tree, neural network, etc, establishes an e-commerce customer churn model and analyzes the factors which influence customer retention.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the Internet Real-Name Authentication System Based on Public Key Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The development of internet brings people unprecedented freedom and convenience. Nevertheless, it also leads to conflicts between behavior of individual and the legitimate rights of society. The internet real-name system is just an effective means to compensate for this defect. The internet real-name system has played an important role in promoting orderly development of internet environment by declaring his real identity. This paper designs an internet real-name authentication system based on PKI. The system makes full use of digital certificate issued by the third-party authority organization, and their implied relationship of public and private key pairs, then exerts a strict background verification mechanism to ensure the real identity of internet registered users. The internet real-name authentication system based on PKI provides a reliable solution to internet real-name system.

articleTitle: The Game Analysis on the Cooperation of Green Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The issue of green supply chain management can be seen as an equilibrium process which includes the game between the supplier and the submitter of the whole supply chain. The boundary rationality of the submitter and supplier made the game process to be a process for the stable state. Based on the model of evolutionary game involving the cooperation between the supplier and submitter of the supply chain, we find that the initial state run a key role on the game. And the unstable state strategies have the trend to achieve or degenerate to the perfect or the terrible strategy during the operation of the green supply chain. And several parameters can be controlled for the well operation of green supply chain management.

articleTitle: Using the Technology Acceptance Model to Explore Online Shopping Behavior: Online Experiences as a Moderator
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study examines the causal relationship of perceived ease of use, perceived usefulness, attitude, trust, behavior intention and actual behavior, which occur online shopping with the moderating effects of online experience. An estimated model discusses building an effective relationship with online shoppers. The survey was conducted with 600 undergraduates in Taiwan. Structural equation modeling was employed to validate the measures and confirm the hypothesized model. All variables have significant and positive impact, and online experiences moderate the causal relationship.

articleTitle: Compare and Contrast Analysis to the Development Pattern of Energy Producing Provinces with the Aim of Carbon Emission Reducing
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to evaluate the carbon emission of energy producing provinces, to which, the interrelationships between energy and economical developing are more complicated, indexes are selected to structure the three primary subsystems and eight selected primary producing provinces are compared and contrasted under the admixture method of TOPSIS and entropy weight. Not only the results of each subsystem of social economy, energy production and environment are ordered and discussed but also the whole system, the development pattern of carbon emission, are analyzed. As a result, suggestions of industry and energy structure optimizing are given to reduce the carbon emission by updating and applying advantaged equipments and technologies.

articleTitle: Water Resources Proof Decision Support System for Construction Projects
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This study applies Visual basic 6.0 object-oriented programming thoughts to design and develop water resources proof decision support system for construction projects. According to design of users, Human-Computer Interface, sub-system of database and sub-system of model base, it fulfills informationized management to groundwater, surface water, and abstraction and return waters of construction projects. It provides necessary data information for decision-makers.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Assessment of Estuarine Wetland Health
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An assessment indictor system for estuary wetland health is established in this paper, based on the Pressure - state - response framework, which can denote the relationships between the pressure and the wetland healthy state. Then with the weight of each indicator decided by analytic hierarchy process, a fuzzy pattern recognition model is employed to evaluate the wetland health. Furthermore, according to the choice principles and five-grade assessment standard, ten indicators are chosen to evaluate the states of three wetlands in Yangtze River Estuary. The assessment results prove that this method is feasible.

articleTitle: Study on Distribution of Oil Price Return Based on NIG Distribution
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The application of Normal Inverse Gaussian (NIG) distribution to the oil price return distribution fitting is explored. The statistical properties of oil price return were studied and the normality test was performed. The result shows that the return distribution is characterized by asymmetry, leptokurtosis and heavy tails. The NIG distribution was introduced to calibrate the return dataset to find the fitness of NIG model. NIG distribution, which is able to capture the skewness and excess kurtosis, provides not only an excellent fit in the center of the return distribution, but also in the tails.

articleTitle: Loan Indicator Analysis of Down-Risk-Averse Loaner Based on Supply Chain Financial Innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: According to the 'corporate and debt' method in trade credit and based on the logistic features of Uniform Credit mode and the relevant cost-benefit structure, this paper analyzes cash flow statement of borrowers in supply chain financial innovation. Then, this paper assumes downside-risk-averse logistics enterprises and analyzes key loan indicator consistent to risk tolerance level of logistics enterprises. The results show that downside-risk limits can control the risk of seasonal inventory financing in supply chain financial innovation and make the loan consistent to risk tolerance level of logistics enterprises.

articleTitle: The Investigation Analysis on Knowledge-Sharing Barriers and Incentives of University Scientific Research and Innovation Teams
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper analyzes knowledge-sharing barriers and incentives of university scientific research and innovation teams through a questionnaire survey. We find that knowledge-sharing barriers of university scientific research and innovation teams include psychological barriers, managing barriers and communicating barriers. Knowledge-sharing incentives of university scientific research and innovation teams include receiving respects, recognition and personal career development opportunities.

articleTitle: A Design for Standard Activity-Based Cost Management Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The main purpose of this paper is to establish a set of scientifically designed cost management model, which could both tally with the actual situation and keep pace with future development in China. Based on the concepts of flexibility in tactics, integration and system, the paper makes a relatively systemic research of activity cost theory and its application by means of combination of qualitative analysis and quantitative analysis and brings forward application and method improvement of the relevant theory. According to the existing levels of production of Chinese enterprises --most enterprises are at produce stage of mechanized production or the semi-automation, and consulting the experience and current situation of cost management of other countries that numerous enterprises are using the standard cost system in the world now and absorbing the innovated idea and the marrow of activity-based management, I make a design for standard activity-based cost management model basing on the supplying chain from the whole status of Chinese enterprises.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Enterprise Emergency Response Capability Based on Grey-AHP Method
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The ability to respond to emergency is one of the significant indicators to measure the level of enterprise administration. Enterprise emergency response capability assessment can be the elements of emergency management and provide credible warrant for emergency preparative. It is of great significance to establish a set of evaluation system to identify the achievements and deficiency in the enterprise emergence management work. This paper presents a grey AHP approach to the enterprise emergency response capability evaluation. The weight of each index is derived by AHP and the weight among its indicators is derived by grey theory. Finally, the simulation example is presented.

articleTitle: Food Supply Chain Management under Conditions of Food Safety
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Food safety and food supply chain management has become a hot research at home and abroad. This article describes the background of the food supply chain, and puts forward a new idea to solve the food safety problems in the food supply chain induced by the causes according to the problem. Analysis based on the quality and safety of the food supply chain information to track state of developments well as the food supply chain security protection mechanism to build the main model, in which the food supply chain management -for technical support in order to EAN-UCC (global harmonization of identification) system, based on the use of RFID technology (radio frequency identification).

articleTitle: Study on Trans-Regional Cooperative Innovation System Model of Aviation Industry Cluster
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Making the aviation industry cluster, a typical trans-regional innovation cluster, as the research object and based on the characteristics of the aviation industry cluster, this study suggests that the innovative action of aviation industry cluster is characterized by diversified innovation subjects, trans-regional, omnibearing, cooperative and three-dimensional innovative methods, and a huge amount of knowledge transfer. This study, based on the analysis on the subjects and external environment of the cooperative innovation of the aviation industry, builds up the cooperative innovation system model of the aviation industry. It is believed in this study that the innovation of the aviation industry is a process during which all trans-regional innovation subjects cooperate and interact with each other and make use of their mutual complementary advantages under the restrictions of the external environment.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Intelligent Collaborative Urban Emergency Warning and Processing System Based on SOA
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis for Individual Performance Management and Psychological Boundary
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In order to verify how psychological boundary impacts individual performance, a structural equation model (SEM) is used in the paper. The paper analyzes the relative factors of boundary. Relevant variables are selected to measure the boundary and performance. A full model is set to test and verify the hypothesis by means of SPSS and AMOS. The empirical results show that psychological boundary has positive correlation with individual performance, but not significant. Factors as personality and management institution have positive impacts on individual performance and organizational environment impact performance negatively. The three factors have positive correlation with psychological boundary. Such empirical research provides the management with effective information in view of psychological boundary, which promotes the humanity in the HRM practices.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analyze on the Credit Risk Management Efficiency of Chinese Commercial Banks
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Commercial banks play a very important role in our financial market; their credit risk management efficiency determines the stability of the financial market. This paper introduced DEA (Date Envelopment Analysis) to analyze on our credit risk management efficiency based on the current studies. We've established the commercial bank efficiency assessment model, and used the model to measure the 13 main banks' credit risk management efficiency from 2004 to 2008. The results showed that: (1) Chinese commercial banks' credit risk management efficiency is ascending; (2) the non-state-owned commercial banks' credit risk management efficiency in China are all higher than state-owned ones; (3) the average increase rate of the management efficiency in the non-state-owned commercial banks are lower than in state-owned ones.

articleTitle: SWOT Analysis and Strategic Choice of Eco-City Construction in Dalian
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The eco-city construct is a very important approach for the urban sustainable development. As a result, the government of Dalian puts forward a new object of eco-city construction in 2009. In this paper, based on SWOT analyzing the strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats of Dalian, a better eco-city construction mode is proposed, which is tourism, political and economic integrated eco-city construction mode with a greater impact and control in the Bohai Sea and the Northeast Asian region.

articleTitle: The Coming Era of Experience Economy and Breakthrough of Service Innovation Dilemma
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In modern society, experience is more important than the function of tangible products to more and more customers. Every customer has his own unique experience, so the service for customers should be heterogeneous. Under this circumstance, enterprise should provide individualized service for different customers and service innovation for every customer is necessary. But most extant theory of innovation is come from product innovation theory, service innovation become very difficult for service itself can be imitated easily. This paper deeply analyzes academically the dilemma of service innovation and explores the nature and characteristics of service innovation in experience economy.

articleTitle: A Heuristic Algorithm for Large-Scale Job Shop Scheduling Based on Operation Decomposition Using Bottleneck Machine
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A new heuristic algorithm for large-scale job shop scheduling problem is proposed based on operation decomposition using bottleneck machine. It detects bottleneck machine by orthogonal experiment. Based on the operations which are processed on the bottleneck machine, the large-scale job shop scheduling problem is divided into three sub-problems: the scheduling problem of the operations on bottleneck machine, pre-bottleneck machines and post-bottleneck machines. The operations on bottleneck machine are first scheduled by dispatching rules, and the other two sub-problems are solved by genetic algorithm to subordinate the schedule of the operations on bottleneck machine. A number of simulation results shown that the scheduling strategy and technique for the problem can improve the computing efficiency and quality of the solution.

articleTitle: Research on the Relative Competitiveness of Companies Based on Patent Analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Patent has becoming an important indicator and factor to measure technology innovation ability and competitiveness of companies. The aim of this study is to reveal the relative competitiveness of companies through patent analysis. The basic idea of patent relative competiveness analysis is set up. Base on the indicators of patent count, patent citation number, relative growth rate, relative development growth rate, relative technology position and revealed technological advantage etc., integrated index system of relative competitiveness analysis is built up and quantitative method is adopted. The empirical analysis has been made to study leading companies in communication industry. The result shows the proposed method is appropriate for analyzing the relative competitiveness among companies in certain industry.

articleTitle: A Ciphertext Retrieval Model for Encrypted XML Database with Bucket Management Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To resolve the problems of security and ciphertext query efficiency for the XML database, a ciphertext retrieval model is presented in this paper. In this model, the value index and structure index in the encrypted XML database are established and the entrance addresses are recorded with the bucket management algorithm to realize the rapid retrieval for encrypted XML data. Experiments results show that this model not only has high security and improved ciphertext retrieval efficiency, but also supports the range query and easy to update.

articleTitle: Postponement Method in Service Process Re-Engineering: A Catering Case
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The research integrated the postponement approach into service BPR by conducting a case study in catering services. It justified the effectiveness of postponement method for service BPR in dealing with the feature of customer contact in service process. And it also identified the role of modularization in postponement for service BPR project and the way modularization is applied. The paper then summarized the factors that may affect the postponement point and revealed how they worked in the postponement process. Finally future research direction was also discussed.

articleTitle: Simulation Research of the Retailer's Ordering Strategy Based on System Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: In supply chain, the ordering strategy is one of the main reasons leading to Bullwhip Effect which can induce inventory's fluctuations or excessive inventory. In this paper, we set up a simulation model on the retailer' s demand-driven supply chain by virtue of system dynamics, in which we compare the inventory's behavior mode based on different ordering strategy, whose simulation results testify that the retailer's ordering should include not only the inventory ordering, but also the pipeline order; on the other hand, making full use of real-time demand data utilizing information-sharing technology also can reduce the bullwhip effect and maintain the stability of stock.

articleTitle: Thoughts on Emerging Issues in Strategic Human Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Due to the ever changing business environment and the emergence of hypercompetition in the global markets organizations are under tremendous pressure to produce new products with short life cycles, in less time and continuously. Such an output can be achieved through various ways including that of viewing an organization's human resources as assets rather than costs, and using them in alignment with the organizational strategy. It is therefore of key importance that, the organization attracts, develops and retains the most appropriate human capital available from within as well as outside the organizational boundaries. This paper tries to highlight some of the issues that need to be considered as strategic functions of human resource management.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Game: Economic Analysis on Differentiated Competition
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Theories and methods of supply chain game are exploratory and advanced topics. Differentiated competition is the key element of the game. Based on classic economic models, the game participants are extended from two to multiplicity. Studies show that supply chain games all get 0 profits with no differences. Analysis on differentiation suggests Hotelling Model arisen from horizontal differentiation can break 0 profits and solve the mystery of Bertrand Paradox. So does the vertical differentiation. They can all bring excessive profit.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of Bilateral Trade Complementarity between China and the U.S.A.
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The author have conducted an empirical analysis on the data of Sino-US trade in the period of 2000-2006 with a focus on the level of intra-industry bilateral comparative advantage and international competitiveness using the index of RCA and intra-industry trade. The trade difference in the patterns of specialization observed in China and in the USA, and that the two countries are in a lasting and stable complementary relationship in trade.

articleTitle: The Real Estate Market Forecast of Shenyang Based on Gray System Theory
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the use of GM (1,1) gray forecast method, the demand and price forecast model of Shenyang real estate market is built. This model gives a forecast that there will be a trends of rising during the steady development in 3 years. It also gives proposals and countermeasures for the recent Shenyang real estate market development based on qualitative analysis.

articleTitle: A Mathematically Generated Criteria Weight Approach for Multi-Criterion Decision
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The weighting sum method has been widely used in multi-criteria evaluation, ranking, classification and selection problems. A key issue is to determine criteria weights. Many methods to address this issue involve subjectivity. This paper presents an approach to mathematically generate the criteria weights. The proposed approach only needs the importance order of criteria and is mathematically simple. The appropriateness is illustrated by a real-world example that deals with multi-criteria ABC classification.

articleTitle: Application of Balanced Scorecard in Library Management and Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the review of BSC, the paper proposes BSC used in library management and evaluation. It devices the application into 3 steps: reviewing the library statement, developing a strategy map and selecting performance measures. It also creates the benchmark for library evaluation used BSC, and concludes the details on the implementation.

articleTitle: The Impact of Learning Culture on Individual Innovative Behavior
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on literature review, this study proposed three hypotheses about learning culture and individual innovative behavior. The model was validated in structural equation modeling by investigating 391 employees from 46 organizations. The results indicate that individual learning has positive effects on innovative idea generation, organizational learning has positive effects on both innovative idea generation and innovative idea implementation, and team learning has no significant direct effects on individual innovative behavior.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on E-Commerce Customer Website Loyalty
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Customer satisfaction was the basic of building long-tern buyer-seller relationship, and customer loyalty was the key ways for firm's payoff and developing. As the internets became a media of building buyer-seller relationship, customer's satisfaction on product or service turn around website satisfaction, and their loyalty represent directly on website loyalty. Moreover the technology readiness of customer made great moderating effects through the whole process. Based on the researches home and abroad, this study analyzed e-commerce website quality effects on website satisfaction and website loyalty. The results showed that website quality consisted of website ease of use, website content, website security and website interaction; The website ease of use, website security and website interaction were direct antecedents of website satisfaction; And the website security took the strongest effects on customer's website satisfaction. Website content made no significant effect on customer's website satisfaction. Customer's website satisfaction made a significant effect on customer's website loyalty; Furthermore, the technology readiness of customer made great moderating effects on website quality and website satisfaction as well as website satisfaction and website loyalty.

articleTitle: Does Chinese Stock Indices Agree with Benford's Law?
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Benford's law is used to describe the statistical character of first digits from natural and experimental data sets. In this paper, we examined the first digits distribution of two main indices in Chinese stock market, the SSE Composite index and SSE Component index. We find that Benford's law reasonably holds for the two main Chinese stock indices. The result can be used in future research, like detecting anomalous behaviors in Chinese stock market.

articleTitle: The Access Control Model Based on Role and Function Body
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The roles and system resources are connected directly in normal role-based access control (RBAC) model, but the RBAC model can not be used widely in large information systems which have lots of system resources, because of the poor maintainability. This paper proposes an access control model based on role and function body (FRBAC) which adds function bodies between roles and permissions. The paper details the formal description of FRBAC and the extension about authorization constraints on function body. In FRBAC model, roles can so repeatedly use the connection between function bodies and permissions that the authorization workload is reduced obviously.

articleTitle: Design Service Level Agreements in Outsourcing Contracts
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This paper took an in-depth look at service level agreements in outsourcing context. Service level agreements play an important role to guide outsourcing management to eliminate outsourcing risk. The goal of designing service level agreements is to bridge the gap between outsourcing service vendor and the customer. This paper addresses the specification of service level agreements on the basis of theoretical principles and proposed an approach to improve the performance of service level agreements. Six Sigma is one of the useful tools to improve management performance and was applied to the outsourcing service sector. Based on the analysis, the process of designing outsourcing service level agreements is discussed. Finally, the consideration for applying Six-Sigma in service level agreement development was discussed.

articleTitle: Study of a Practical Method for Real Estate Investment Risk Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: With the rapid development of the real estate industry in China, the risks carried in them are being concerned greatly. In the real estate investment decision making, it is not only needed to consider profits but also to predict the risk accurately. The risks in a real estate development project were firstly analyzed. Then based on the traditional cash flow analysis, a practical method for the real estate project financial risk analysis was developed. The monetary value, specifically the expectation and the standard deviation of the Net Present Value were employed as the final evaluation criteria for the selection of multiple development plans. A case study was conducted to test and validate the model, including identification of risk variables, estimation of cash flow, probability distribution of the risk variable and the calculated value of NPV, and the analysis of the simulation outcome. The results showed that it is feasible to build a practical method for the risk-based decision making of a real estate investment. The proposed model and the system in this paper could be used to predict the level of financial risk of a real estate investment effectively and be helpful to better control the risk for the decision maker.

articleTitle: Heterogeneity Analysis Application in Development Project Social Assessment
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Based on the Chinese experience in development project social assessment, this paper makes a theoretical and experiential explanation from the perspective of heterogeneity analysis, which has important engineering sociological significance. Qualitative methods and quantitative methods can be mutually complementary. In order to make the theory application in social assessment more appropriate, the authors build two middle theoretical concepts, "regional variability" and "massive variability". The concepts can be used well in practice through a Chinese concrete case.

articleTitle: The Study on Reverse Logistics for E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Companies moved into E-commerce have not fully prepared for handling the subsequent surges in product returns. Thus, it has become increasingly important that developing reverse logistics management to cope with new challenges. Focusing on this situation, this paper will firstly explain the concepts of E-commerce and reverse logistics; next, discuss the importance of developing reverse logistics for e-commerce; and then, analyze the challenges of reverse logistics under E-commerce; at last, put forward some solutions and proposals for companies to develop reverse logistics for their E-commerce.

articleTitle: Research on the Government Incentive of Green Buildings in China
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: This article carry on depth analysis on the four main factors which restricting the development of green buildings in China, and on this basis put forward that governments need to establish and improve incentives to promote the green building market prosperous. To make the incentive policy, the government should clear with its long-term and short-term incentive goals, and grasp the incentive-degree. This paper establish a model based on the fundamental point of principal-agent theory, combined with a concrete project, this model can calculate the best degree of the government incentive intensity to make the whole society to achieve Pareto-optimal returns.

articleTitle: A Study on Environmental Impact of High Speed Maglev Traffic Engineering
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: On the research of contrastive analysis, this paper discusses the environmental impact of high-speed maglev and high-speed wheel-rail in land use, noise pollution, energy consumption, ecological effect, electromagnetic radiation and other aspects. On this basis, this paper describes the influences on environment of high-speed maglev in transit system of China, and puts forward the concrete opinions and suggestions for the engineering investigation, construction, and environmental impact assessment of high-speed maglev. Adopting the linear motor, maglev system has the characteristic of low noise, and which does not produce machinery noise via a way of no touch to put support, guide, driving, braking and power supply into effect, and aviods the interface contact of trains. There are aerodynamic noises chiefly when the maglev is moving with high speed. Meanwhile, maglev system is one mode of energy-conservation transportation, which emits no harmful substance in operation. And, since the magnetic intensity of maglev is somewhat above which of the magnetic field of Earth, which seems harmless to the human body. Maglev runs very quietly in low speed, which shows a predominance of environmental protection, compared with urban elevated rail and elevated highway. Moreover, in high speed, maglev can run along the existing transportation corridor without costing too much land resources, and also ease the burden on the environment.

articleTitle: Dynamically Updating the Knowledge Regular Library for BBS Public Opinion Analysis System with Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: An important element of BBS public opinion analysis system is to update the contents of knowledge regular library dynamically adding sensitive words constantly to knowledge regular library. Apriori algorithm is classical algorithm of mining association rules. This paper presents a new method of adding the contents of knowledge regular automatically using association rule models. Experimental results show that the system obviously improves the accuracy of monitoring BBS public opinion by means of this algorithm.

articleTitle: A Multi-Stage Stochastic Electricity Portfolio Model with Forwards Contracts
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: A stochastic multi-stage portfolio model for a hydropower producer operating in a competitive electricity market is proposed. The portfolio includes its own production and a set of forward contracts for future delivery or purchase of electricity to hedge against risks. The goal of using such a model is to maximise the profit of the producer and reduce the economic risks connected to the fact that energy spot and forward prices are highly volatile. Our findings show that the use of forward contracts for hedging purposes results in a risk reduction and in a more efficient use of the hydroplant, taking advantage of the possibility of pumping water and ending up with a higher final value of the reservoi

articleTitle: An OBDD-Based Method for the Reliability Analysis of Construction System
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: To analyze the reliability of large projects, an OBDD(ordered binary decision diagram)-based method is proposed in this paper. After describing the construction system of project with a directed network, this method turns the network states into an OBDD structure and computes the reliability. For the convenient storage of OBDD in computer, it can be easily implemented and efficiently calculate the reliability.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Influence Factors in Customer Loyalty for Department Store Service
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: The paper has done an empirical study in five large department stores of Baoding to explore the mechanism of influencing factors on customer loyalty. This study finds that traffic facilities, product value, reputation factor, Consumer individual factor, service function quality and shopping environment are six main dimensions in customer loyalty influencing dimensions.And then, taking Baoding department store and supermarket as an example, a factor extraction model based on Support Vector Machines for classification (SVC) is constructed. Experiments show scale of park, having shopping card of this store and product breed is the important ones on customer loyalty.

articleTitle: Analysis and Optimization of Coal Enterprise Supply Logistics System Based on SCM
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: For the characteristics of the coal enterprises and the status quo of its supply management, with the idea of supply chain management, the main problems of the coal enterprise supply logistics system are analyzed, the logistics resources of coal enterprises are integrated, the supply logistics system of the whole enterprise is optimized, the supply logistics activities are rational organized, so that the logistics efficiency is improved and the logistics cost is reduced. Thereby the economic efficiency of coal enterprises is improved.

articleTitle: Study on Distribution Demand Forecast Based on Grey-Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Management and Service Science
abstract: Distribution demand forecast is one of the core of the logistics system planning. In this paper, to forecast distribution demand, a Grey Markov Model is presented by means of combining Grey system theory with dispersed Markov Chains theory.
